label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Windshield Glazing — Size, Shape & Panoramic / Wraparound
description: Wide, wraparound or larger windshield glazing (often curved in two directions) that visually opens the upper structure and increases field of view. Glazing area, width and aperture shape determine forward field of view, visual exposure and the perceived cockpit proportion (e.g. low greenhouse with wraparound glass creates a compact, sporty cabin). Increased rake may necessitate larger glazing to maintain coverage and visual continuity.
text:
名称：Windshield Glazing — Size, Shape & Panoramic / Wraparound
描述：Wide, wraparound or larger windshield glazing (often curved in two directions) that visually opens the upper structure and increases field of view. Glazing area, width and aperture shape determine forward field of view, visual exposure and the perceived cockpit proportion (e.g. low greenhouse with wraparound glass creates a compact, sporty cabin). Increased rake may necessitate larger glazing to maintain coverage and visual continuity.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: TransmissionType

名称：TransmissionType

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Crumple zones / Energy-absorbing structures
description: Managed front, rear and side deformation regions and associated controlled-collapse members designed to absorb and dissipate impact energy. Includes tailored geometries, material selection, sectioning and thickness (reinforced/controlled crumple zones) and front crush structures that fold predictably to limit peak loads and occupant deceleration. Often integrated with a high-strength occupant safety cell to preserve survivable space while controlling collapse paths.
text:
名称：Crumple zones / Energy-absorbing structures

Includes tailored geometries, material selection, sectioning and thickness (reinforced/controlled crumple zones) and front crush structures that fold predictably to limit peak loads and occupant deceleration. Often integrated with a high-strength occupant safety cell to preserve survivable space while controlling collapse paths.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver-centric Cockpit
description: Cockpit organized and detailed around the driver to prioritize ergonomics, visibility and control feedback — low seating posture, concentrated control layout, and minimised passenger interference and visual clutter to enhance driver engagement and sporting character. (中文：以驾驶者为中心的座舱布局，优先考虑人体工程学、视野和操控反馈，强调低座姿、控制集中、减少乘员干扰与视觉冗余，以强化驾驶体验与运动属性。)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Ingress/Egress Clearance
description: Clearances and geometric features related to entering and exiting the vehicle, including door opening width/height, sill/step height, passage/cabin clearance, grab-handle placement, and specific local clearances (e.g. gap between occupant and wheel/tire when swinging a leg into the vehicle).
text:
名称：Ingress/Egress Clearance

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Modularity / Modular Architecture
description: Architectural design that decomposes a product into modules with defined interfaces to enable late variance, reuse and parallel development. Supports component sharing and mirrored modules to accommodate LHD/RHD and different market requirements, enables rapid reconfiguration of interior layouts for different uses, and designs components for easy replacement or upgrade to support service packages and customization.
text:
名称：Modularity / Modular Architecture

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Passenger compartment integrity
description: Resistance of the occupant cell to intrusion and maintenance of survival space; influenced by subframe stiffness, longitudinal load paths and reinforcements. Equivalent to 'Rigid passenger compartment'.
text:
名称：Passenger compartment integrity
描述：Resistance of the occupant cell to intrusion and maintenance of survival space; influenced by subframe stiffness, longitudinal load paths and reinforcements. Equivalent to 'Rigid passenger compartment'.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Steering wheel position (adjustable / fixed)
description: Steering wheel position and its adjustability. 可为可调（高度、前后/进出、倾角），以覆盖不同臂长与坐姿；或可选择固定（不可调），以简化成本与包装。可调方案需提供较宽的纵向与横向行程以覆盖驾驶工况/驾驶人群（示例覆盖目标：L11/L53/H30）。固定方案下位置由试装台（buck）与人模（manikin）决定。
text:
名称：Steering wheel position (adjustable / fixed)
描述：Steering wheel position and its adjustability. 可为可调（高度、前后/进出、倾角），以覆盖不同臂长与坐姿；或可选择固定（不可调），以简化成本与包装。可调方案需提供较宽的纵向与横向行程以覆盖驾驶工况/驾驶人群（示例覆盖目标：L11/L53/H30）。固定方案下位置由试装台（buck）与人模（manikin）决定。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

description: Traditional hinged swinging door which constrains the shape of the front cut-line and may prevent a straight vertical cut at the sliding door front.
text:
名称：ConventionalSwingingDoor

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Forward / Visibility Vision Angles (前向/可见性视角)
description: Defines forward and occupant visibility sightlines measured tangent to the eye ellipse to cowl/header trim and through windshield/side apertures. Used to set aperture, roofline and interior geometry to achieve perceived visibility for drivers and rear occupants. Includes regulatory angular constraints: EU requirement — visibility between 5°–65° from Y plane at bulb center; US requirement — ±47° horizontally, +12° up and −7° down. Also requires lens and glazing maintain a visible surface at off-axis viewing.
text:
名称：Forward / Visibility Vision Angles (前向/可见性视角)
描述：Defines forward and occupant visibility sightlines measured tangent to the eye ellipse to cowl/header trim and through windshield/side apertures. Used to set aperture, roofline and interior geometry to achieve perceived visibility for drivers and rear occupants. Includes regulatory angular constraints: EU requirement — visibility between 5°–65° from Y plane at bulb center; US requirement — ±47° horizontally, +12° up and −7° down. Also requires lens and glazing maintain a visible surface at off-axis viewing.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seating Layout & Flexibility
description: Arrangement and number of seats, fore–aft positions, sliding ranges, folding strategies and removable/multi-position seats that determine occupant vs cargo allocation and usable interior space. Includes seating capacity and overall configuration (e.g. 2-seat, 5-seat, multi-row, fold-flat or movable seats) as well as flexible/quick-change layouts and dedicated child seating options for ease of care and anchoring.
text:
名称：Seating Layout & Flexibility
描述：Arrangement and number of seats, fore–aft positions, sliding ranges, folding strategies and removable/multi-position seats that determine occupant vs cargo allocation and usable interior space. Includes seating capacity and overall configuration (e.g. 2-seat, 5-seat, multi-row, fold-flat or movable seats) as well as flexible/quick-change layouts and dedicated child seating options for ease of care and anchoring.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Squareback profile

text:
名称：Squareback profile

name: High-strength steel unibody/frame

text:
名称：High-strength steel unibody/frame
描述：High-strength steel structure (unibody/frame) used for primary crash structures including pillars and floor. Provides stiffness and crashworthiness, meets durability and towing requirements, and offers cost efficiency.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Airbag Systems (车辆气囊系统)
description: Coordinated vehicle airbag system encompassing front/driver, side, curtain and knee airbags and their variants. Designed to deploy in collisions to buffer occupants and reduce injury by protecting head, chest and other body regions. Includes side-impact specific systems for limited door/structure space, integration/packaging considerations for effective deployment, and coordination with seatbelt pretensioners and adaptive (smart) deployment strategies.
text:
名称：Airbag Systems (车辆气囊系统)

Designed to deploy in collisions to buffer occupants and reduce injury by protecting head, chest and other body regions. 名称：Self-leveling Damper

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Two-box silhouette (hatchback / minivan)
description: Two-volume (two-box) silhouette characterized by an integrated cargo area and passenger cabin. Common features include short front overhang, cab‑forward packaging and an upright or tall greenhouse. Variants: hatchbacks — near‑vertical tailgate and emphasis on practicality and cargo access; minivans — taller greenhouse and cab‑forward design prioritizing interior volume and ease of access.
text:
名称：Two-box silhouette (hatchback / minivan)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Control Reachability
description: Placement and design of controls and touchpoints relative to elbow/forearm reach envelopes and defined primary, secondary and tertiary reach zones so that frequently used controls fall within comfortable reach without excessive posture change. Includes required manipulation (arm/torso movement), actuation forces, tactile differentiation, and positioning of primary controls inside the primary reach zone to reduce awkward postures and operation failures. / 控制件及触点相对于肘/前臂可达包络和主要/次要/三级可达区的布置与定义，确保常用控制件在舒适可及范围内，减少尴尬姿势和操作失败，并考虑操作所需的伸臂/身体动作、触发力与触觉差异化。

name: GapPrecision

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Torque converter / CVT & Epicyclic gearset (扭矩变换器 / 无级变速 / 行星齿系)
description: English: Describes mechanisms that enable effective overall ratio variation and multi-gear implementation in automatic drivetrains. A torque converter provides smooth launch and allows some ratio variation via controlled slip; CVT provides a continuously variable ratio for seamless variation beyond fixed gear steps; an epicyclic (planetary) gearset supplies multiple gear ratios in a compact layout and is commonly paired with a torque converter in traditional automatic transmissions (AT). 中文: 说明用于自动传动系统中实现有效整体传动比变化与多档位实现的机构。扭矩变换器用于起步平顺，并可通过滑差实现一定的传动比变化；无级变速（CVT）可提供连续可变传动比，超越固定齿比的限制；行星齿系用于提供多档位并具备紧凑布局，常与扭矩变换器结合构成传统自动变速器（AT）的核心。
text:
名称：Torque converter / CVT & Epicyclic gearset (扭矩变换器 / 无级变速 / 行星齿系)
描述：English: Describes mechanisms that enable effective overall ratio variation and multi-gear implementation in automatic drivetrains. A torque converter provides smooth launch and allows some ratio variation via controlled slip; CVT provides a continuously variable ratio for seamless variation beyond fixed gear steps; an epicyclic (planetary) gearset supplies multiple gear ratios in a compact layout and is commonly paired with a torque converter in traditional automatic transmissions (AT). 中文: 说明用于自动传动系统中实现有效整体传动比变化与多档位实现的机构。扭矩变换器用于起步平顺，并可通过滑差实现一定的传动比变化；无级变速（CVT）可提供连续可变传动比，超越固定齿比的限制；行星齿系用于提供多档位并具备紧凑布局，常与扭矩变换器结合构成传统自动变速器（AT）的核心。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Monocoque / Unibody construction
description: Integrated body-shell (unibody/monocoque) where the bodyshell carries structural loads instead of a separate ladder frame. Typical implementations use welded stamped panels to form an exterior, load-bearing structure that improves stiffness, packaging efficiency and crash performance, enables cleaner external surfaces and more integrated profiles, and can express a unified sculptural form. Variants include mixed-material executions (e.g., steel monocoque with aluminum front/rear sections and drilled subframes) to reduce mass and influence center of gravity. Historically introduced on production cars such as the Traction Avant.

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 线条光顺度观察法
description: 将头部逐步靠近图板并注视已贴胶带曲线，通过视角收缩放大局部起伏以发现微小抖动与不规则。
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: User segmentation (target group) as input

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver posture / H-point / Driving position (驾驶员坐姿与H点/高坐姿)
description: 覆盖驾驶员坐姿相关指标，包括座位高度、相对腿部与躯干角度（影响头部空间与视野）、H点及乘员相对于车顶与挡风玻璃的位置关系（例如保时捷911式布局）。亦包括高坐姿（继承马车的高坐姿）带来的设计影响：视野改善但可能增加正面与底部空气阻力，影响车内布局与人体工程学。
text:
名称：Driver posture / H-point / Driving position (驾驶员坐姿与H点/高坐姿)
描述：覆盖驾驶员坐姿相关指标，包括座位高度、相对腿部与躯干角度（影响头部空间与视野）、H点及乘员相对于车顶与挡风玻璃的位置关系（例如保时捷911式布局）。亦包括高坐姿（继承马车的高坐姿）带来的设计影响：视野改善但可能增加正面与底部空气阻力，影响车内布局与人体工程学。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Independent suspension
description: Suspension in which wheel motions on one side do not directly transmit to the opposite wheel. Improves roadholding, steering and ride comfort by allowing each wheel to react independently to road inputs, helping maintain tire contact and reducing camber/tracking disturbances. Common front implementations include MacPherson, double wishbone and multi-link; frequently paired with a variety of rear layouts (e.g. four-arm rear) depending on compromise between comfort and sporty handling.
text:
名称：Independent suspension
描述：Suspension in which wheel motions on one side do not directly transmit to the opposite wheel. Improves roadholding, steering and ride comfort by allowing each wheel to react independently to road inputs, helping maintain tire contact and reducing camber/tracking disturbances. Common front implementations include MacPherson, double wishbone and multi-link; frequently paired with a variety of rear layouts (e.g. four-arm rear) depending on compromise between comfort and sporty handling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

name: Seat cushion vertical adjustment

name: ReliablePerformance

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Handmade / Manual Construction

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Full-size Clay Model
description: Full-size (1:1) physical clay mock-up and sculpting process created and refined by modelers under stylists' direction (commonly using CNC roughing followed by hand finishing). Used to evaluate and refine overall proportions, packaging, surface lines, curvature transitions and details; to validate package and surface decisions after basic dimensions and hard points are set; and to provide body-surface data for engineering and tooling. This covers both the physical model and the clay-modeling/clay-sculpting process.
text:
名称：Full-size Clay Model

This covers both the physical model and the clay-modeling/clay-sculpting process.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Low Part Count

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Head-Down Display (Instrument Panel)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 垂直尾翼 (tailfin / 高耸后掠尾翼)
description: 受飞机垂直尾翼启发的垂直鳍状造型，常表现为高耸且向后掠的尾部装饰（tailfin）。在20世纪的汽车造型中用于强调流线感和航向感；随着设计演变，此类装饰在乘用车上逐渐缩小或消失。
text:
名称：垂直尾翼 (tailfin / 高耸后掠尾翼)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HandControlReach

text:
名称：HandControlReach
描述：Spatial relationship between a seated driver’s hands and primary vehicle controls (steering, stalks, gear selector), including reach envelopes that define reachable control positions across different user percentiles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Honda Civic seat (competitor)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Novel Organic Shape (有机形态)

text:
名称：Novel Organic Shape (有机形态)
描述：受生物形态启发的连续、有机表面与曲面过渡，强调自然流动感与视觉连贯性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seamless Mobile App UI
description: 一键预订、实时车辆与电量状态、可视化地图与最少输入的交互设计，降低用户操作成本。
text:
名称：Seamless Mobile App UI

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Cruise Control / Navigation / Connectivity

text:
名称：Cruise Control / Navigation / Connectivity
描述：Driver assistance and navigation features (e.g., cruise control, GPS navigation) and the vehicle interface points for devices and connectivity. (中文：驾驶辅助与导航功能，如定速巡航、GPS导航，以及车辆与设备的连接与接口点。)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Open Bed / Offroad Design Features
description: Design attributes associated with truck functionality and off-road utility: open cargo bed, reinforced or long-travel chassis, higher ride height, and other structural/tactical features aimed at utility and toughness. (与卡车功能及越野实用性相关的设计特征：开放货斗、加固底盘/长行程悬挂、更高离地间隙等，侧重载荷与耐用性。)
text:
名称：Open Bed / Offroad Design Features

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Keywords
description: 用一到两个高度凝练的词汇来概括概念车的核心感觉。
text:
名称：Keywords
描述：用一到两个高度凝练的词汇来概括概念车的核心感觉。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 可投影图形/像素显示（Projected graphics / pixel display）
description: 高分辨率的LED阵列可以在路面或远场投射图形、文字或指示信息，拓展灯具功能性与交互性。
text:
名称：可投影图形/像素显示（Projected graphics / pixel display）
描述：高分辨率的LED阵列可以在路面或远场投射图形、文字或指示信息，拓展灯具功能性与交互性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Symmetry (Overall Bilateral Symmetry)
description: 整车围绕中轴线的镜像或双侧对称性，用于建立视觉稳定性、平衡感与识别性，体现在前脸、车身轮廓与内饰布局。该属性也可表述为轴线对称的构图，用于表现平衡与庄重。
text:
名称：Symmetry (Overall Bilateral Symmetry)
描述：整车围绕中轴线的镜像或双侧对称性，用于建立视觉稳定性、平衡感与识别性，体现在前脸、车身轮廓与内饰布局。该属性也可表述为轴线对称的构图，用于表现平衡与庄重。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Compact Convertible Silhouette (紧凑敞篷车侧面轮廓)
description: 由紧凑轴距、短前后悬与下沉的车顶线条构成的敞篷车侧面轮廓，强调灵活性与运动感 (Side profile of a compact convertible defined by short overhangs, compact wheelbase and lowered roofline).
text:
名称：Compact Convertible Silhouette (紧凑敞篷车侧面轮廓)
描述：由紧凑轴距、短前后悬与下沉的车顶线条构成的敞篷车侧面轮廓，强调灵活性与运动感 (Side profile of a compact convertible defined by short overhangs, compact wheelbase and lowered roofline).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Direction-of-Motion Stereotype

text:
名称：Direction-of-Motion Stereotype
描述：Design attribute that ensures control movements match user expectations (e.g., push/pull, clockwise to increase).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Compact Urban Form

text:
名称：Compact Urban Form
描述：Short overall length, tight turning radius and space-efficient cabin layout suited to city delivery and commuting.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Collapsible steering column

text:
名称：Collapsible steering column
描述：A steering-column design that deforms or telescopes under load to prevent intrusion into occupant space.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sharp Cutoff Shield

text:
名称：Sharp Cutoff Shield
描述：Optical feature producing a distinct luminance cutoff line to prevent direct glare into oncoming drivers and control vertical spill.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: StrokeDetail
description: Arrangement, relative thickness and spacing of strokes and gaps in character glyphs (e.g., top/mid/bottom strokes and two inter-stroke gaps in 'E').
text:
名称：StrokeDetail
描述：Arrangement, relative thickness and spacing of strokes and gaps in character glyphs (e.g., top/mid/bottom strokes and two inter-stroke gaps in 'E').

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Flush fittings and minimized appendages
description: Design choices that visually express aerodynamic intent and reduce protrusions.
text:
名称：Flush fittings and minimized appendages
描述：Design choices that visually express aerodynamic intent and reduce protrusions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ImageQuantityControl
description: 控制意象板上图片数量，避免过多图片导致感觉分散或变异。
text:
名称：ImageQuantityControl
描述：控制意象板上图片数量，避免过多图片导致感觉分散或变异。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Carbon Fiber (CFRP)

text:
名称：Carbon Fiber (CFRP)
描述：Selective use of carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) for bonnet, roof and aerodynamic elements to reduce mass and lower the center of gravity while preserving premium surface quality.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Headliner hardpoint reference (头顶衬板硬点参考)
description: 头顶衬板与参考线（8°偏离垂直通过H点）相交的位置，用于在车顶表面布置硬点
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Labeling Clarity

text:
名称：Labeling Clarity
描述：Use of clear identification and setting labels on controls and displays to indicate function and state.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 内饰环境氛围灯 IAL（Interior ambient light）
description: 嵌入式LED条带用于营造可变氛围色彩与亮度，增强内饰的情感与层次感。
text:
名称：内饰环境氛围灯 IAL（Interior ambient light）
描述：嵌入式LED条带用于营造可变氛围色彩与亮度，增强内饰的情感与层次感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 序列动态点亮 (Sequential dynamic illumination)
description: 按时间顺序激活单元，产生流动感与指示性（例如转向或制动的动态效果）。
text:
名称：序列动态点亮 (Sequential dynamic illumination)
描述：按时间顺序激活单元，产生流动感与指示性（例如转向或制动的动态效果）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Vibration level / Body vibration (振动幅值/车身振动)
description: 车辆结构与车舱受到的机械振动的幅值及其时间/频率特性。通常以有效值(RMS加速度)、峰峰值或位移/速度表示，直接影响乘坐舒适性、可靠性与感知质量，幅值越低通常越好。
text:
名称：Vibration level / Body vibration (振动幅值/车身振动)
描述：车辆结构与车舱受到的机械振动的幅值及其时间/频率特性。通常以有效值(RMS加速度)、峰峰值或位移/速度表示，直接影响乘坐舒适性、可靠性与感知质量，幅值越低通常越好。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Unity of form
description: Continuous, coherent exterior surfaces and consistent motif across the vehicle to create a unitary visual impression.
text:
名称：Unity of form
描述：Continuous, coherent exterior surfaces and consistent motif across the vehicle to create a unitary visual impression.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Casting process selection (铸造工艺选择：上坡灌注/壳型铸造等)
描述：Choice of casting techniques to control porosity, segregation and surface defects.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Shoulder Room
description: Interior lateral space measured between inner door trim panels; a key factor for occupant comfort and interior volume.
text:
名称：Shoulder Room
描述：Interior lateral space measured between inner door trim panels; a key factor for occupant comfort and interior volume.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Foot Swing Clearance
description: Available clear space for the lower leg/foot to swing past the A‑pillar and wheelhouse during ingress/egress and pedal operation.
text:
名称：Foot Swing Clearance
描述：Available clear space for the lower leg/foot to swing past the A‑pillar and wheelhouse during ingress/egress and pedal operation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Fiberglass body
description: 模制复合材料车身面板，可降低质量并允许更有机的表面造型，适用于需要复杂曲面与轻量化的设计。
text:
名称：Fiberglass body
描述：模制复合材料车身面板，可降低质量并允许更有机的表面造型，适用于需要复杂曲面与轻量化的设计。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: FixedParkingStations

text:
名称：FixedParkingStations
描述：运营方提供固定场站，可在App查询并保证还车点明确。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Clear and logical details

text:
名称：Clear and logical details
描述：Details organized so that function and assembly logic are legible and visually coherent.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Surface Friction
描述：Tactile friction/coefficient felt when touching controls, trims and handles that influences perceived quality.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Reduced engine bay / short bonnet

text:
名称：Reduced engine bay / short bonnet
描述：Smaller motors and lack of large engine assembly allow for visually and physically shortened front overhang and engine bay.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: UnexpectedFailureRisk

text:
名称：UnexpectedFailureRisk
描述：Risk profile where transmission failures are sudden and not progressively evident (historical DAF CVT issues).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Proportion/size as compositional means

text:
名称：Proportion/size as compositional means
描述：Size and proportion organize the shape and affect perception and structural performance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Closed / Minimal Front Grille (含贯穿光带)

text:
名称：Closed / Minimal Front Grille (含贯穿光带)
描述：封闭或最小化的前格栅/前脸，开口减少或封闭以反映电驱动系统较低的散热需求；通过减小正面湍流与迎风阻力提升空气动力性能，并传达电动车身份特征。常与贯穿式LED光带或灯带结合，作为视觉识别与造型细节。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High Roofline

text:
名称：High Roofline
描述：Raised roof to prioritize headroom and perceived interior volume.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: BrakePadAccessibility
description: Ease of inspection and replacement of friction elements (pads/shoes) through caliper design and wheel/arch packaging.
text:
名称：BrakePadAccessibility
描述：Ease of inspection and replacement of friction elements (pads/shoes) through caliper design and wheel/arch packaging.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Aluminium body / Aluminium body panels / Aluminium bodyshell
description: 外罩与车身面板采用铝合金制造（包括 Alcan AVT 合金与剖面，以及低量产手工成形如 EB110 的铝车身）。铝材密度较低，可显著减轻整车质量、改善耐腐蚀性并支持新的有机表面造型（如门、引擎罩与后备箱盖等外板）。权衡点为材料成本更高、焊接与连接工艺更复杂。生产应用覆盖常规高产能工艺与低量手工成形工艺两类场景。
text:
名称：Aluminium body / Aluminium body panels / Aluminium bodyshell
描述：外罩与车身面板采用铝合金制造（包括 Alcan AVT 合金与剖面，以及低量产手工成形如 EB110 的铝车身）。铝材密度较低，可显著减轻整车质量、改善耐腐蚀性并支持新的有机表面造型（如门、引擎罩与后备箱盖等外板）。权衡点为材料成本更高、焊接与连接工艺更复杂。生产应用覆盖常规高产能工艺与低量手工成形工艺两类场景。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Roof rail/pillar/header trim & Roof Rail Height/Seal
描述：Trim integrated into roof rail, pillars and header sections to provide head impact protection and aesthetic continuity, together with roof-rail geometry and sealing plane which influence torsional rigidity and head clearance/sealing performance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Superleggera Lightweight Structure (Superleggera 轻量化结构)

text:
名称：Superleggera Lightweight Structure (Superleggera 轻量化结构)
描述：通过轻量化车身结构提升性能并允许更极端的气动造型。

名称：High roll stiffness / anti-roll design

名称：封闭式前格栅饰板

text:

描述：用外壳包覆机械组件以呈现整体化的“有机”外形，同时在文化上掩饰工业化的零碎性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sensor Fusion
description: 将来自多路传感器的输入经由ECU和AI算法融合处理：一方面可减少冗余硬件与外部传感器数量，从而实现更简洁的外观/视觉设计；另一方面通过融合车速、转向角、制动压力、车体/车轮加速度、整备高度信号、油门等输入来推断路况与车辆状态，用于诸如阻尼/悬架控制等功能。
text:
名称：Sensor Fusion

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Two-seat layout
description: Driver + 1 passenger seating (biplaza) with reduced cabin length to save mass and cost. Covers open bench (carriage-style) arrangements, compact two-seat sports coupe packaging targeted at performance buyers, and two-seat convertible (biplaza) configurations. Emphasizes minimal cabin to enhance driver engagement and allow long-hood packaging, while accommodating limited child seating or cargo flexibility.
text:
名称：Two-seat layout

Emphasizes minimal cabin to enhance driver engagement and allow long-hood packaging, while accommodating limited child seating or cargo flexibility.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：bodyStyle / 车身外形 (Body Style / Body Form)
描述：车身外形/造型指车辆整体轮廓与外观特征，包含轮廓线、腰线、肩线、车顶弧线与车身断面共同构成的视觉造型特征，以及整体形态（例如长、流线型或方正等）。该属性用于描述车辆外观的形态特征与设计风格，影响视觉感受和空气动力学表现。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat Track Travel / Seat Track (座椅滑轨前后行程)
description: Fore-aft (longitudinal) sliding range/adjustability of the seat track that determines foremost and rearmost seating (H-point) positions, driver reach and legroom, and affects the H-point envelope and head-form validity when seats slide fore/aft. Also defines seat track fore/aft position and height relative to vehicle floor/BOF and SgRP; used to achieve accommodation targets such as 95% accommodation. / 座椅滑轨的前后（纵向）可调行程，决定最前和最后的座椅（H点）位置、驾驶员可达性与腿部空间，影响H点包络和头模有效性，并定义相对于车身基准(BOF)与SgRP的座椅前后及高度位置；用于实现例如95%适配率的目标。
text:
名称：Seat Track Travel / Seat Track (座椅滑轨前后行程)
描述：Fore-aft (longitudinal) sliding range/adjustability of the seat track that determines foremost and rearmost seating (H-point) positions, driver reach and legroom, and affects the H-point envelope and head-form validity when seats slide fore/aft. Also defines seat track fore/aft position and height relative to vehicle floor/BOF and SgRP; used to achieve accommodation targets such as 95% accommodation. / 座椅滑轨的前后（纵向）可调行程，决定最前和最后的座椅（H点）位置、驾驶员可达性与腿部空间，影响H点包络和头模有效性，并定义相对于车身基准(BOF)与SgRP的座椅前后及高度位置；用于实现例如95%适配率的目标。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Eye ellipse / Eyellipse (Eyellipsoid) — SAE J941
description: Statistical geometric representation of driver eye positions — as a planar eye ellipse and/or 3D eye ellipsoid as defined in SAE J941. Represents nominal and population-based eye locations (commonly 95th and 99th percentiles) with centroid coordinates and tilt. Used to generate sightlines, visibility envelopes and tangent planes for display location, instrument packaging, mirror sizing and placement, A-pillar/windscreen clearance, wiper and defogger design, and other forward-vision considerations. Often used together with headform geometry to derive vision-angle lines.
text:
名称：Eye ellipse / Eyellipse (Eyellipsoid) — SAE J941
描述：Statistical geometric representation of driver eye positions — as a planar eye ellipse and/or 3D eye ellipsoid as defined in SAE J941. Represents nominal and population-based eye locations (commonly 95th and 99th percentiles) with centroid coordinates and tilt. Used to generate sightlines, visibility envelopes and tangent planes for display location, instrument packaging, mirror sizing and placement, A-pillar/windscreen clearance, wiper and defogger design, and other forward-vision considerations. Often used together with headform geometry to derive vision-angle lines.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Coil spring
description: Primary elastic element providing vertical support; widely adopted for independent suspensions. Compact and tunable for a range of stiffnesses; spring rate controls ride frequency and static/dynamic ride height. Typical vertical coil spring configuration. Long-travel coil spring variants increase wheel travel and improve comfort on irregular terrain.
text:

Compact and tunable for a range of stiffnesses; spring rate controls ride frequency and static/dynamic ride height. Typical vertical coil spring configuration. Long-travel coil spring variants increase wheel travel and improve comfort on irregular terrain.

name: In-wheel / Hub Motors
description: Electric motors packaged at or inside the wheels or axle (in-wheel or hub motors) that replace conventional central drives, transmissions and long driveshafts. This packaging frees up space in the engine bay and underfloor, enables flat-floor/coffin-style tubs and shorter driveline runs, and allows configurations with a motor per wheel.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

description: An elongated, torpedo-like (teardrop) low-slung bodyform with continuous curved surfaces, integrated/flowing fenders and roofline. The profile is smoothly tapered (raked front, narrowing rear) to minimize frontal area, reduce local drag and avoid flow separation. Historically used by early streamlining proponents (Jaray, Rumpler, Tatra); notable example: La Jamais Contente.

描述：Box sections are primary longitudinal and transverse structural beams (e.g., framerails, sills, crossmembers, pillars) that carry crash loads, provide attachment points and establish stiffness/load paths. Closed box sections (闭合箱形截面) significantly increase torsional constant and torsional stiffness but demand higher joint strength, more careful connection details and more complex bracket/attachment design. Exposed box sections (外露箱形截面) are visible or emphasized box-section geometries around door apertures and body flanks that communicate structural intent while remaining functionally part of the load-bearing system.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PushButton
description: Discrete contact-switch activated by finger press, often requires small force; may be momentary or latching.
text:
名称：PushButton
描述：Discrete contact-switch activated by finger press, often requires small force; may be momentary or latching.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 算力水平
description: 车辆搭载的中央/域控制器计算能力。
text:
名称：算力水平
描述：车辆搭载的中央/域控制器计算能力。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 矩阵化单元模块 (Unitized matrix modules)

text:
名称：矩阵化单元模块 (Unitized matrix modules)
描述：以独立可控的单元构成矩阵式光源，表现科技化与模块化特征。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Straight waistline aligned with hood and boot
description: A continuous horizontal character line that visually divides upper and lower body, contributing to a dynamic, engineered look.
text:
名称：Straight waistline aligned with hood and boot
描述：A continuous horizontal character line that visually divides upper and lower body, contributing to a dynamic, engineered look.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 便捷停车能力
description: 通过缩短车体或分体停放实现的更高停车灵活性与更小占位面积的特性。
text:
名称：便捷停车能力
描述：通过缩短车体或分体停放实现的更高停车灵活性与更小占位面积的特性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visible Wheel Diameter
description: Perceived or visually emphasized wheel diameter used in sketches and styling — oversized wheel graphic (larger flange diameter and/or reduced tire sidewall) that increases vehicle presence, perceived capability and signals sportiness or an aggressive, elevated appearance.
text:
名称：Visible Wheel Diameter
描述：Perceived or visually emphasized wheel diameter used in sketches and styling — oversized wheel graphic (larger flange diameter and/or reduced tire sidewall) that increases vehicle presence, perceived capability and signals sportiness or an aggressive, elevated appearance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: FrontCrashStructure
description: 可控变形单元、横向梁与挂点设计，直接决定前端能量吸收性能与入侵控制。
text:
名称：FrontCrashStructure
描述：可控变形单元、横向梁与挂点设计，直接决定前端能量吸收性能与入侵控制。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 前倾线条 (Forward-leaning lines)
description: 线条向前倾斜的取向，传达冲刺感与前驱动态。
text:
名称：前倾线条 (Forward-leaning lines)
描述：线条向前倾斜的取向，传达冲刺感与前驱动态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visual First Impression
description: High-impact front and side graphics, proportion and lighting that create immediate appeal.
text:
名称：Visual First Impression
描述：High-impact front and side graphics, proportion and lighting that create immediate appeal.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: VentOutletPlacement
description: Location and orientation of HVAC vent outlets on the instrument panel and center stack.
text:
名称：VentOutletPlacement
描述：Location and orientation of HVAC vent outlets on the instrument panel and center stack.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed truss visual (外露桁架视觉特性)
description: 可见的三维桁架结构传达轻量、赛道性能导向的视觉语言。
text:
名称：Exposed truss visual (外露桁架视觉特性)
描述：可见的三维桁架结构传达轻量、赛道性能导向的视觉语言。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seatbelt Line Height / 安全带线高
description: 安全带固定点/肩线高度，会制约车窗高度、车门肩线位置与侧窗视野；决定座舱视觉高度、侧面腰线位置和乘员空间感受；需满足相关安全法规并考虑人体工程学。
text:
名称：Seatbelt Line Height / 安全带线高
描述：安全带固定点/肩线高度，会制约车窗高度、车门肩线位置与侧窗视野；决定座舱视觉高度、侧面腰线位置和乘员空间感受；需满足相关安全法规并考虑人体工程学。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: torsion bar spring (longitudinal)
description: Longitudinal torsion bar enabling lower load floor.
text:
名称：torsion bar spring (longitudinal)
描述：Longitudinal torsion bar enabling lower load floor.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Speed / High Top Speed (Velocidad punta alta)
description: 与直线加速与车辆最高速度相关的性能指标，指车辆在直线条件下可达到的最高速度（high top speed）。例如 Jaguar XJ220 的宣称最高速度为 343 km/h。 Performance metric related to straight-line acceleration and the maximum achievable top speed (high top speed). For example, the Jaguar XJ220 was advertised with a top speed of 343 km/h.
text:
名称：Speed / High Top Speed (Velocidad punta alta)
描述：与直线加速与车辆最高速度相关的性能指标，指车辆在直线条件下可达到的最高速度（high top speed）。例如 Jaguar XJ220 的宣称最高速度为 343 km/h。 Performance metric related to straight-line acceleration and the maximum achievable top speed (high top speed). For example, the Jaguar XJ220 was advertised with a top speed of 343 km/h.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Weld Quality
description: 焊缝完整性与一致性，包括焊透、焊缝外形、缺陷率以及防腐层完整性；直接影响疲劳寿命与局部刚度。
text:
名称：Weld Quality
描述：焊缝完整性与一致性，包括焊透、焊缝外形、缺陷率以及防腐层完整性；直接影响疲劳寿命与局部刚度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wheel Arch Emphasis / Prominent Wheel Arch (轮拱强调 / 突显轮拱)
description: 对轮拱外廓进行凸起或凹陷处理，通过加深轮拱轮廓与拓宽拱缘来增强轮胎尺度感、突显车轮体积并强化与车身的互动，从而提升整车姿态与视觉张力。
text:
名称：Wheel Arch Emphasis / Prominent Wheel Arch (轮拱强调 / 突显轮拱)
描述：对轮拱外廓进行凸起或凹陷处理，通过加深轮拱轮廓与拓宽拱缘来增强轮胎尺度感、突显车轮体积并强化与车身的互动，从而提升整车姿态与视觉张力。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: InteriorSurfaceSmoothness
description: Perceived quality of touch surfaces (smoothness, softness) and low micro-vibratory sensations when contacting surfaces or controls.
text:
名称：InteriorSurfaceSmoothness
描述：Perceived quality of touch surfaces (smoothness, softness) and low micro-vibratory sensations when contacting surfaces or controls.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Front Bumper Design (前保险杠造型)
description: 前保险杠的安装高度与轮廓对接近角有直接影响，高位与向上收分造型有助于增大接近角。
text:
名称：Front Bumper Design (前保险杠造型)
描述：前保险杠的安装高度与轮廓对接近角有直接影响，高位与向上收分造型有助于增大接近角。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: InstrumentClusterVolume
description: Allocated volume and packaging region around the instrument cluster for instruments, steering column, HVAC ducting and structure.
text:
名称：InstrumentClusterVolume
描述：Allocated volume and packaging region around the instrument cluster for instruments, steering column, HVAC ducting and structure.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 探头数量
description: 车端感知硬件的数量和类型。
text:
名称：探头数量
描述：车端感知硬件的数量和类型。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Interior Space (Maximized interior volume)
description: Generous cabin/interior space achieved via wheelbase optimization, thin sills and efficient HVAC/packaging; refers to the cabin's spatial feeling and layout that affect comfort and utility. 乘员舱的空间感与布局，影响舒适性与实用性。
text:
名称：Interior Space (Maximized interior volume)
描述：Generous cabin/interior space achieved via wheelbase optimization, thin sills and efficient HVAC/packaging; refers to the cabin's spatial feeling and layout that affect comfort and utility. 乘员舱的空间感与布局，影响舒适性与实用性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Ducted Flow
description: Air is guided by defined ducts into and away from the radiator to reduce spill and control velocity distribution.
text:
名称：Ducted Flow
描述：Air is guided by defined ducts into and away from the radiator to reduce spill and control velocity distribution.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Heel point height
description: Vertical position of the driver's heel relative to the ground or vehicle floor; critical for pedal geometry, underbody packaging and perceived seating height.
text:
名称：Heel point height
描述：Vertical position of the driver's heel relative to the ground or vehicle floor; critical for pedal geometry, underbody packaging and perceived seating height.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ThermalExpansionCoefficient
description: Rate at which a material expands with temperature; varies across ceramics, metals and polymers (order of magnitude differences).
text:
名称：ThermalExpansionCoefficient
描述：Rate at which a material expands with temperature; varies across ceramics, metals and polymers (order of magnitude differences).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 模块可推入购物场景
description: 分体单元能脱离车体并作为可推动的购物车或婴儿车，便于购物与短距离室内移动。
text:
名称：模块可推入购物场景
描述：分体单元能脱离车体并作为可推动的购物车或婴儿车，便于购物与短距离室内移动。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Left layout — low handle + rearward pull cup
description: Example observed layout where inside-opening handle is mounted low and the pull cup is located rearward in the armrest (inside minimum reach zone); users found opening and closing difficult.
text:
名称：Left layout — low handle + rearward pull cup
描述：Example observed layout where inside-opening handle is mounted low and the pull cup is located rearward in the armrest (inside minimum reach zone); users found opening and closing difficult.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Redundancy
description: Design approach that provides multiple load paths or backup elements so that the system or structure can tolerate the loss or removal of some parts without catastrophic failure. In structures this may mean some components are redundant and the structure can still carry loads (often with reduced efficiency). Overall redundancy reduces single‑point‑failure risk through redundant load paths or backup systems.
text:
名称：Redundancy
描述：Design approach that provides multiple load paths or backup elements so that the system or structure can tolerate the loss or removal of some parts without catastrophic failure. In structures this may mean some components are redundant and the structure can still carry loads (often with reduced efficiency). Overall redundancy reduces single‑point‑failure risk through redundant load paths or backup systems.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visibility(视野)
description: 驾驶员头部位置与玻璃面积、A柱处理决定道路与侧方视野，影响安全与驾驶信心。
text:
名称：Visibility(视野)
描述：驾驶员头部位置与玻璃面积、A柱处理决定道路与侧方视野，影响安全与驾驶信心。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Headroom
description: Clearance above the crown of the occupant's head to accommodate sitting eye height, posture, trim and optional sunroof. Influences roofline trade-offs between aerodynamic goals and occupant comfort and provides required space for headform clearance and trim details.
text:
名称：Headroom
描述：Clearance above the crown of the occupant's head to accommodate sitting eye height, posture, trim and optional sunroof. Influences roofline trade-offs between aerodynamic goals and occupant comfort and provides required space for headform clearance and trim details.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: asbestos_free_friction_materials
description: Use of aramid fibers (e.g., Kevlar), rockwool and vermiculite instead of asbestos in clutch and brake friction linings for health and regulatory compliance.
text:
名称：asbestos_free_friction_materials
描述：Use of aramid fibers (e.g., Kevlar), rockwool and vermiculite instead of asbestos in clutch and brake friction linings for health and regulatory compliance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HotSpotIntensity
description: Peak luminous intensity of the hot spot region (cd); affects pavement luminance near the vehicle and glare at distance.
text:
名称：HotSpotIntensity
描述：Peak luminous intensity of the hot spot region (cd); affects pavement luminance near the vehicle and glare at distance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Proximity to Models
description: Stylist preference to be close to full-scale and scale models for direct visual assessment and quick iterations.
text:
名称：Proximity to Models
描述：Stylist preference to be close to full-scale and scale models for direct visual assessment and quick iterations.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Plate / Shell elements (壳/板单元)
description: 用于更精确地表示薄壁板件/钣金件的壳或板单元，通常为四边形或三角形网格单元，适用于子组件与局部细节分析。
text:
名称：Plate / Shell elements (壳/板单元)
描述：用于更精确地表示薄壁板件/钣金件的壳或板单元，通常为四边形或三角形网格单元，适用于子组件与局部细节分析。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High / Exaggerated ground clearance (高/夸张的离地间隙)
description: 通过明显抬高底盘（相对于传统轿车）以强调越野感与多用途属性，提升越野通过性并增强视觉上的强悍感。常与粗犷轮胎、加固护板（防擦底板）及短前后悬设计共同出现以改善涉水、越障能力与整车耐用性。
text:
名称：High / Exaggerated ground clearance (高/夸张的离地间隙)
描述：通过明显抬高底盘（相对于传统轿车）以强调越野感与多用途属性，提升越野通过性并增强视觉上的强悍感。常与粗犷轮胎、加固护板（防擦底板）及短前后悬设计共同出现以改善涉水、越障能力与整车耐用性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High strength-to-weight
description: May allow panel thinning in some cases, but structural/stiffness requirements can force thicker panels in others.
text:
名称：High strength-to-weight
描述：May allow panel thinning in some cases, but structural/stiffness requirements can force thicker panels in others.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Radiator Blockage
description: Porosity/blockage of radiator matrix (dense matrix increases pressure loss and reduces face velocity).
text:
名称：Radiator Blockage
描述：Porosity/blockage of radiator matrix (dense matrix increases pressure loss and reduces face velocity).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Luminance / Brightness (Lamp Surface)
description: Surface luminance (cd/m²) of light sources or lamp surfaces as perceived by other road users; a physical measure affecting visibility and potential glare.
text:
名称：Luminance / Brightness (Lamp Surface)
描述：Surface luminance (cd/m²) of light sources or lamp surfaces as perceived by other road users; a physical measure affecting visibility and potential glare.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: DeepBeamSideRails
description: 加深的侧梁提高截面二次矩/单位面积比，从而提高弯曲强度和刚度，适合承载弯曲/扭矩载荷。
text:
名称：DeepBeamSideRails
描述：加深的侧梁提高截面二次矩/单位面积比，从而提高弯曲强度和刚度，适合承载弯曲/扭矩载荷。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ModularCargoBed (模组化载物空间)
description: 可配置的后舱/后床设计，支持拉货、露营及多种载物场景。
text:
名称：ModularCargoBed (模组化载物空间)
描述：可配置的后舱/后床设计，支持拉货、露营及多种载物场景。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Small tire envelope
description: Use of narrow, small-radius tires and minimal wheel arch packaging to reduce overall footprint and mass.
text:
名称：Small tire envelope
描述：Use of narrow, small-radius tires and minimal wheel arch packaging to reduce overall footprint and mass.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ServiceAccess
description: As above: accessibility for maintenance and repair.
text:
名称：ServiceAccess
描述：As above: accessibility for maintenance and repair.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Trailing arm pivot axis
description: Pivot arrangement for the trailing arm that provides controlled camber change as the wheel moves fore-aft and up-down. Also encompasses the longitudinal and vertical positioning and the inclination of the trailing arm pivot relative to the vehicle body and wheel.
text:
名称：Trailing arm pivot axis
描述：Pivot arrangement for the trailing arm that provides controlled camber change as the wheel moves fore-aft and up-down. Also encompasses the longitudinal and vertical positioning and the inclination of the trailing arm pivot relative to the vehicle body and wheel.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: rear hatch + fold-flat rear seats (后掀背与可折叠后座)
description: 大开启后备厢与可折平的后排座椅以最大化载物空间与灵活性。
text:
名称：rear hatch + fold-flat rear seats (后掀背与可折叠后座)
描述：大开启后备厢与可折平的后排座椅以最大化载物空间与灵活性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Matrix / OLED lighting elements
description: Discrete controllable light pixels or continuous OLED strips enabling dynamic patterns, animation and fine-grained styling.
text:
名称：Matrix / OLED lighting elements
描述：Discrete controllable light pixels or continuous OLED strips enabling dynamic patterns, animation and fine-grained styling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 色彩搭配 (color matching)
description: 基于文化语义与目标受众选择的主色/辅色/饰条色与表面效果组合规则。
text:
名称：色彩搭配 (color matching)
描述：基于文化语义与目标受众选择的主色/辅色/饰条色与表面效果组合规则。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Laser range finder (LIDAR)
description: Active optical sensor measuring distance and contours of obstacles; key for object detection and scene mapping.
text:
名称：Laser range finder (LIDAR)
描述：Active optical sensor measuring distance and contours of obstacles; key for object detection and scene mapping.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large Glass Roof
description: Extensive glazed roof area that increases interior daylight and changes vehicle silhouette.
text:
名称：Large Glass Roof
描述：Extensive glazed roof area that increases interior daylight and changes vehicle silhouette.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Effective Headroom
description: Vertical clearance above the occupant's head accounting for seat cushion height, roof contour and occupant posture; used to evaluate usable headroom rather than gross roof-to-head dimension. Relevant to packaging, roofline design and occupant comfort.
text:
名称：Effective Headroom
描述：Vertical clearance above the occupant's head accounting for seat cushion height, roof contour and occupant posture; used to evaluate usable headroom rather than gross roof-to-head dimension. Relevant to packaging, roofline design and occupant comfort.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Prominent rear fenders (wide haunches)
description: Emphasis on enlarged rear fender/haunch volume to convey power, grip and a strong rear stance. / 加宽后轮拱，突出后轮拱体积以表现动力与抓地，形成车尾的力量感。
text:
名称：Prominent rear fenders (wide haunches)
描述：Emphasis on enlarged rear fender/haunch volume to convey power, grip and a strong rear stance. / 加宽后轮拱，突出后轮拱体积以表现动力与抓地，形成车尾的力量感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Programmable / Reconfigurable Display
description: A programmable, reconfigurable in-vehicle display: modular multi-zone screens and software-defined layouts that adapt content, format and controls to selected modes (e.g., radio, media, navigation), driving context, and user preferences.
text:
名称：Programmable / Reconfigurable Display
描述：A programmable, reconfigurable in-vehicle display: modular multi-zone screens and software-defined layouts that adapt content, format and controls to selected modes (e.g., radio, media, navigation), driving context, and user preferences.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Rugged high-ride SUV styling / 粗犷高离地SUV造型
description: Tall greenhouse, large wheel-arch clearance, upright stance, widened wheel arches, skid-plate-like elements, three-dimensional front end and high waistline that convey a robust, solid visual impression while emphasizing interior volume and off-road character. / 高离地车顶舱、较大轮眉离地、加宽轮拱与护板感造型、立体前脸和高腰线等特征，传达威猛结实的视觉印象，同时强调车内空间感与越野气质。
text:
名称：Rugged high-ride SUV styling / 粗犷高离地SUV造型
描述：Tall greenhouse, large wheel-arch clearance, upright stance, widened wheel arches, skid-plate-like elements, three-dimensional front end and high waistline that convey a robust, solid visual impression while emphasizing interior volume and off-road character. / 高离地车顶舱、较大轮眉离地、加宽轮拱与护板感造型、立体前脸和高腰线等特征，传达威猛结实的视觉印象，同时强调车内空间感与越野气质。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 用户行为洞察
description: 由实地调研得到的对目标用户停车习惯、购物习惯、家庭使用场景等的系统洞察，作为设计输入。
text:
名称：用户行为洞察
描述：由实地调研得到的对目标用户停车习惯、购物习惯、家庭使用场景等的系统洞察，作为设计输入。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: reduced_frontal_area (减小迎风面积)
description: 通过低矮车顶、窄车身或缩短迎风投影来减小迎风面积，从而降低迎风阻力。
text:
名称：reduced_frontal_area (减小迎风面积)
描述：通过低矮车顶、窄车身或缩短迎风投影来减小迎风面积，从而降低迎风阻力。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Composite body (metal‑plastic, monocoque & full composite)
description: Composite body solutions encompass hybrid metal‑plastic constructions, localized composite panels/reinforcements, monocoque or semi‑monocoque composite shells, and fully composite vehicle bodies. Common goals are significant vehicle mass reduction, increased local and global stiffness, and the ability to integrate structural load paths with exterior surfaces. Implementations also improve crash-energy management by using composite reinforcements or structural shells and enable different surface and joint expressions (e.g., visible composite seams or tailored material transitions).

Common goals are significant vehicle mass reduction, increased local and global stiffness, and the ability to integrate structural load paths with exterior surfaces. Implementations also improve crash-energy management by using composite reinforcements or structural shells and enable different surface and joint expressions (e.g., visible composite seams or tailored material transitions).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Carbon-composite prop shaft bonded to steel end fitting

text:
名称：Carbon-composite prop shaft bonded to steel end fitting

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 断线呈弧形(arc-shaped breakline)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：USB / Plug-and-Play Media Interface

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Reconfigurable / Rotating / Stowable Seat Systems
description: Seat systems and mechanisms that enable rotation, stowing, removal or re-orientation to improve ingress/egress, reconfigure interior layouts, or convert seating to cargo modules. Covers kinematic functionality, anchorage/attachment implications, packaging and structural/occupant-safety considerations; typically requires early-stage integration study.
text:
名称：Reconfigurable / Rotating / Stowable Seat Systems
描述：Seat systems and mechanisms that enable rotation, stowing, removal or re-orientation to improve ingress/egress, reconfigure interior layouts, or convert seating to cargo modules. Covers kinematic functionality, anchorage/attachment implications, packaging and structural/occupant-safety considerations; typically requires early-stage integration study.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Instrument Panel Lighting Color
description: Hue and tint of dashboard/backlit instruments affecting readability and perceived character of the cabin lighting.
text:
名称：Instrument Panel Lighting Color
描述：Hue and tint of dashboard/backlit instruments affecting readability and perceived character of the cabin lighting.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 灯组外形多样性（Lamp shape diversity）
description: 外形不再受限于传统配光组件，出现曲线、几何及品牌特征化造型。
text:
名称：灯组外形多样性（Lamp shape diversity）
描述：外形不再受限于传统配光组件，出现曲线、几何及品牌特征化造型。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Cooling provisions for batteries
description: Allocate space and interfaces for thermal management systems (ducts, heat exchangers) because batteries generate heat and require cooling.
text:
名称：Cooling provisions for batteries
描述：Allocate space and interfaces for thermal management systems (ducts, heat exchangers) because batteries generate heat and require cooling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Knee Blocker (KneeBlockerPosition)
description: 仪表板上的膝部止动器的布置、几何形状与结构；在正面碰撞中与乘员膝部接触，限制下肢向前滑动并分散冲击力。
text:
名称：Knee Blocker (KneeBlockerPosition)
描述：仪表板上的膝部止动器的布置、几何形状与结构；在正面碰撞中与乘员膝部接触，限制下肢向前滑动并分散冲击力。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: RainGutterAndWiperPosition (雨槽与雨刷布置)
description: 雨槽几何与雨刷位置，会引起局部涡流或周期性噪声源。
text:
名称：RainGutterAndWiperPosition (雨槽与雨刷布置)
描述：雨槽几何与雨刷位置，会引起局部涡流或周期性噪声源。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large greenhouse / low beltline
description: Tall and expansive glazed area with a low sill to maximize vertical and lateral sightlines.
text:
名称：Large greenhouse / low beltline
描述：Tall and expansive glazed area with a low sill to maximize vertical and lateral sightlines.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High-pressure hydrogen tank robustness
description: Tanks designed for very high pressures (e.g., ~10,000 psi) and placed to avoid rupture on impact.
text:
名称：High-pressure hydrogen tank robustness
描述：Tanks designed for very high pressures (e.g., ~10,000 psi) and placed to avoid rupture on impact.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Low deep high-sided seat
description: Seats with low mounting and high side bolsters, providing lateral support and a deep seating position to secure occupants during cornering.
text:
名称：Low deep high-sided seat
描述：Seats with low mounting and high side bolsters, providing lateral support and a deep seating position to secure occupants during cornering.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 高品质感(high-quality perception)
description: 通过精致的面形与连续光影传达高档次感。
text:
名称：高品质感(high-quality perception)
描述：通过精致的面形与连续光影传达高档次感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Body-on-frame construction (梁式底盘)

text:
名称：Body-on-frame construction (梁式底盘)
描述：梁上结构提高稳定性与牵引能力，常见于传统越野或重载车型。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Soft suspension (high r_s)
description: High r_s indicates softer suspension (k_s smaller relative to tyre stiffness).
text:
名称：Soft suspension (high r_s)
描述：High r_s indicates softer suspension (k_s smaller relative to tyre stiffness).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visual Uniformity
description: Consistency of color, gloss and pattern across surfaces that affects perceived quality.
text:
名称：Visual Uniformity
描述：Consistency of color, gloss and pattern across surfaces that affects perceived quality.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Door aperture/entry clearance
description: Geometry that determines ease of ingress/egress.
text:
名称：Door aperture/entry clearance
描述：Geometry that determines ease of ingress/egress.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: FrontPlateAirflowClearance
description: Design attribute prioritizing that front-mounted plates and pockets do not obstruct cooling or aerodynamic flow.
text:
名称：FrontPlateAirflowClearance
描述：Design attribute prioritizing that front-mounted plates and pockets do not obstruct cooling or aerodynamic flow.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Anti-lock brake system (ABS)
description: Control system that modulates brake torque to avoid wheel lock and keep slip near region of maximum controllable μ_b.
text:
名称：Anti-lock brake system (ABS)
描述：Control system that modulates brake torque to avoid wheel lock and keep slip near region of maximum controllable μ_b.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SeatMaterialAttribute
description: Tactile and frictional properties of upholstery material that affect occupant sliding and repositioning.
text:
名称：SeatMaterialAttribute
描述：Tactile and frictional properties of upholstery material that affect occupant sliding and repositioning.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exterior Shape Consistency
description: Keeping the same exterior profile/silhouette across different size variants so family resemblance is preserved.
text:
名称：Exterior Shape Consistency
描述：Keeping the same exterior profile/silhouette across different size variants so family resemblance is preserved.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: interior_rearview_mirror
description: Center-mounted mirror providing IMF coverage behind the vehicle; contributes to direct rear visibility and night reflection management.
text:
名称：interior_rearview_mirror
描述：Center-mounted mirror providing IMF coverage behind the vehicle; contributes to direct rear visibility and night reflection management.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: CompactProportions
description: 在紧凑车身尺寸下，通过短前悬、紧凑轴距比例、较高的车窗比与紧致亲和的轮廓，表现运动化且亲和的外观，强调短前悬与紧凑比例以营造动感。
text:
名称：CompactProportions
描述：在紧凑车身尺寸下，通过短前悬、紧凑轴距比例、较高的车窗比与紧致亲和的轮廓，表现运动化且亲和的外观，强调短前悬与紧凑比例以营造动感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Expected Location
description: Placement of controls and displays in positions drivers commonly expect (e.g., HVAC near center stack, turn signal on stalk).
text:
名称：Expected Location
描述：Placement of controls and displays in positions drivers commonly expect (e.g., HVAC near center stack, turn signal on stalk).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: multi-cavity lamp geometry
description: Stacked/stepped cavities for separate tail/park/backup functions; creates depth but allows functional separation.
text:
名称：multi-cavity lamp geometry
描述：Stacked/stepped cavities for separate tail/park/backup functions; creates depth but allows functional separation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed Spare Wheel & Wire Wheels
description: External spare wheel mounted on the side or rear and wire-spoked wheels as visible features; contribute to a period/heritage appearance and expose functional elements as styling cues. 车外露备胎及钢丝辐条轮为外露设计要素，增强年代感/传统工艺视觉效果，同时将功能性部件作为造型要素展示。
text:
名称：Exposed Spare Wheel & Wire Wheels
描述：External spare wheel mounted on the side or rear and wire-spoked wheels as visible features; contribute to a period/heritage appearance and expose functional elements as styling cues. 车外露备胎及钢丝辐条轮为外露设计要素，增强年代感/传统工艺视觉效果，同时将功能性部件作为造型要素展示。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 无彩色系
description: 由白到黑的黑白系列，理论上仅具有明度（色相与纯度为零），用于表达纯粹的亮度层次。
text:
名称：无彩色系
描述：由白到黑的黑白系列，理论上仅具有明度（色相与纯度为零），用于表达纯粹的亮度层次。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver Reach Zone
description: Occupant reach envelope from H-point used to set control placement and perceived cockpit spaciousness. Ergonomic reach zones derived from anthropometric studies that determine where controls are comfortably operable. Identifiable interior regions (zones) for placing controls and switches derived from the reach envelope; includes recommended z-heights and lateral offsets relative to the H-point.
text:
名称：Driver Reach Zone
描述：Occupant reach envelope from H-point used to set control placement and perceived cockpit spaciousness. Ergonomic reach zones derived from anthropometric studies that determine where controls are comfortably operable. Identifiable interior regions (zones) for placing controls and switches derived from the reach envelope; includes recommended z-heights and lateral offsets relative to the H-point.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Traditional sand-cast water pump housing
description: Conventional one-piece sand-cast housing with lower initial tooling cost but lower production rate and less flexibility for bonded tube orientation.
text:
名称：Traditional sand-cast water pump housing
描述：Conventional one-piece sand-cast housing with lower initial tooling cost but lower production rate and less flexibility for bonded tube orientation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 低重心运动感
description: 通过视觉上拉低车身重心与加宽轮距表现出的运动姿态感。
text:
名称：低重心运动感
描述：通过视觉上拉低车身重心与加宽轮距表现出的运动姿态感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposure Duration
description: Temporal duration of the visual stimulus or eye fixation. Shorter exposures (e.g., 1/30 s) require higher contrast thresholds than longer exposures (e.g., 1/3 s).
text:
名称：Exposure Duration
描述：Temporal duration of the visual stimulus or eye fixation. Shorter exposures (e.g., 1/30 s) require higher contrast thresholds than longer exposures (e.g., 1/3 s).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Photometric Compliance
description: As above.
text:
名称：Photometric Compliance
描述：As above.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Personalized exterior/interior customization (可个性化外/内饰)
description: 可选颜色、饰件、座椅与灯光方案等，支持用户定制以体现个性化。
text:
名称：Personalized exterior/interior customization (可个性化外/内饰)
描述：可选颜色、饰件、座椅与灯光方案等，支持用户定制以体现个性化。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 紧凑比例(CompactProportions)
description: 短前后悬、较高的车顶线与紧凑轮廓，符合城市使用场景和停车需求。
text:
名称：紧凑比例(CompactProportions)
描述：短前后悬、较高的车顶线与紧凑轮廓，符合城市使用场景和停车需求。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: provideDistinctFeedback
description: Every control gives perceptible confirmation (tactile, auditory, visual) upon activation.
text:
名称：provideDistinctFeedback
描述：Every control gives perceptible confirmation (tactile, auditory, visual) upon activation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Foldable Rear Seats
description: Rear seat architecture that folds (forward or flat) to increase cargo length and volume, enhancing versatility. Common in hatchbacks and wagons where seats fold over fuel-tank packaging. Folding functionality can conflict with packaging elements such as a fixed cross-brace.
text:
名称：Foldable Rear Seats
描述：Rear seat architecture that folds (forward or flat) to increase cargo length and volume, enhancing versatility. Common in hatchbacks and wagons where seats fold over fuel-tank packaging. Folding functionality can conflict with packaging elements such as a fixed cross-brace.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HighSeatHeight_ErectBack
description: Preference for higher H30 and seatback angle ~12–18° (more vertical) in commercial truck products.
text:
名称：HighSeatHeight_ErectBack
描述：Preference for higher H30 and seatback angle ~12–18° (more vertical) in commercial truck products.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat Support Distribution
description: Local support levels across cushion and backrest areas (ischial, thigh, lumbar); subjects rated degree of support per area in diagrams.
text:
名称：Seat Support Distribution
描述：Local support levels across cushion and backrest areas (ischial, thigh, lumbar); subjects rated degree of support per area in diagrams.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: parabolic reflector curve
description: Reflector shape (typically parabolic) used to control beam spread and to form an internal sculptural surface.
text:
名称：parabolic reflector curve
描述：Reflector shape (typically parabolic) used to control beam spread and to form an internal sculptural surface.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Acoustic Insulation
description: Measures to reduce transmitted airborne and structure-borne noise, including multi-layer insulation, acoustic laminates, door seals, barriers, absorbers and targeted damping. 通过材料与结构措施（多层隔声与吸声组件、隔声层、门缝密封及定向阻尼等）降低结构和空气传播的噪声，减少透入噪声与高频杂音，提高车内静谧性与音质。
text:
名称：Acoustic Insulation
描述：Measures to reduce transmitted airborne and structure-borne noise, including multi-layer insulation, acoustic laminates, door seals, barriers, absorbers and targeted damping. 通过材料与结构措施（多层隔声与吸声组件、隔声层、门缝密封及定向阻尼等）降低结构和空气传播的噪声，减少透入噪声与高频杂音，提高车内静谧性与音质。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Voice Control
description: Speech-recognition-based control and spoken feedback integrated into vehicle systems to operate infotainment, navigation, phone and other vehicle functions hands-free. Enables hands-free interaction but can be sensitive to noise and recognition errors; effectiveness depends on keeping commands simple and minimizing working-memory demand.
text:
名称：Voice Control
描述：Speech-recognition-based control and spoken feedback integrated into vehicle systems to operate infotainment, navigation, phone and other vehicle functions hands-free. Enables hands-free interaction but can be sensitive to noise and recognition errors; effectiveness depends on keeping commands simple and minimizing working-memory demand.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: RepetitiveElements

text:
名称：RepetitiveElements
描述：Repeated forms or details (grilles, trims, ribs) used to create rhythm and identity.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 亚形态

text:
名称：亚形态
描述：基形的延伸或变体，用于在不同尺度和视角下保持形态连贯性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wide tyre contact patch

名称：Wide tyre contact patch
描述：Wider tread for improved grip and braking.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Warning Signal Coding
description: Modality, intensity, sequencing and urgency mapping for alerts (e.g., soft chime → loud tone → haptic pulse).
text:
名称：Warning Signal Coding
描述：Modality, intensity, sequencing and urgency mapping for alerts (e.g., soft chime → loud tone → haptic pulse).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Apticote ceramic coating
description: See above.

名称：Apticote ceramic coating
描述：See above.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: RemoteCoolingRouting

text:
名称：RemoteCoolingRouting
描述：Cooling modules located remotely (front of car) with piping to rear-mounted engine or placed adjacent to engine inboard of rear tires.

name: SplinesAndSweeps(样条与弧板工具)

name: LongitudinalEngineAheadOfRearAxle
description: Engine mounted longitudinally just ahead of the rear axle producing rearward mass concentration and visible rear mechanical volume.

名称：LongitudinalEngineAheadOfRearAxle
描述：Engine mounted longitudinally just ahead of the rear axle producing rearward mass concentration and visible rear mechanical volume.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: glass / DLO & frit (玻璃与DLO，含frit遮光带)

text:
名称：glass / DLO & frit (玻璃与DLO，含frit遮光带)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Control Operability and Intuitiveness

text:
名称：Control Operability and Intuitiveness
描述：Ease of understanding and operating in-vehicle controls.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

These attributes influence seat anchorings, structural packaging and overall occupant protection.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Glazing Profile
description: Tall beltline, extreme windshield rake or dropping side glass choices that affect visibility, perceived height and sealing complexity.
text:
名称：Glazing Profile
描述：Tall beltline, extreme windshield rake or dropping side glass choices that affect visibility, perceived height and sealing complexity.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 近车形态

名称：近车形态

text:
名称：Fabric Texture Rendering
描述：对内饰织物、合成材料等表面纹理和材质细节的可视化表现能力。

名称：Flushness
描述：Degree to which mating surfaces are flush and parallel with constant gap appearance; contributes to seamless visual continuity.

text:
名称：Safety Cues
描述：Visually perceptible expressions of safety in styling — e.g. a composed/stable silhouette, strong shoulder lines, clear light clusters and detail elements that convey solidity and robustness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: NoRearSeatProvision

名称：NoRearSeatProvision
描述：Packaging choice to prioritize mechanical layout and performance over rear passenger space.

name: 车身形态

名称：车身形态
描述：最终在车身上体现的轮廓、比例与表面处理，是抽象意象到量产的直接表现。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Battery Pack Integration
description: Underfloor, floor-mounted or chassis-integrated battery modules arranged as flat or stacked low-height packs. Packaging and outline include module footprint, coolant routing, and structural integration to optimize center of gravity, interior space, thermal management and safety.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: OTA升级能力

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Benchmark-derived Attributes and Comparisons
description: 对竞品与量产车进行对比以确认设计方向、比例与目标度量，并识别可视化特征与工程比较实践。包括从竞品图像与实车中识别出的具体可视化特征（如灯光签名、格栅层次、面与线的处理），以及通过比较现有产品得出的属性与目标指标以验证设计方向与比例选择。同时涵盖工程上的基准比较方法，例如整车包件工程师依据 SgRP 测量的整车净空尺寸（T, H, K, F, B, R 及后部等效尺寸）与基准车辆对比以制定设计目标。
text:
名称：Benchmark-derived Attributes and Comparisons
描述：对竞品与量产车进行对比以确认设计方向、比例与目标度量，并识别可视化特征与工程比较实践。包括从竞品图像与实车中识别出的具体可视化特征（如灯光签名、格栅层次、面与线的处理），以及通过比较现有产品得出的属性与目标指标以验证设计方向与比例选择。同时涵盖工程上的基准比较方法，例如整车包件工程师依据 SgRP 测量的整车净空尺寸（T, H, K, F, B, R 及后部等效尺寸）与基准车辆对比以制定设计目标。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：付费APP生态与功能订阅
描述：可在车内通过官方渠道购买/订阅增值应用（如增强驾驶辅助、媒体服务等）的能力与开放性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:
名称：Engine Safety
描述：Improvements in reliability, tolerances, controls and redundant systems to reduce failures and operational risks (mejoras en fiabilidad, tolerancias, controles y sistemas redundantes para reducir fallos y riesgos).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Instrument Cluster

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

Together these cues support both heading orientation and near-field lateral placement of the vehicle.
text:

Together these cues support both heading orientation and near-field lateral placement of the vehicle.

Where crash requirements are relaxed, simplified bumper structures may be used to reduce complexity and weight.
