description: 包含车联网、语音、自动化驾驶辅助等功能集合
text:
名称：Interior_Intelligent_Functions
描述：包含车联网、语音、自动化驾驶辅助等功能集合

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large rear hatch (大后备厢门)
description: 宽大垂直掀背门，便于装载与多用途使用，是两厢车的核心功能性特征。
text:
名称：Large rear hatch (大后备厢门)
描述：宽大垂直掀背门，便于装载与多用途使用，是两厢车的核心功能性特征。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Compact V configuration
description: Vee-configured engine packaged compactly to reduce longitudinal length compared with some inline layouts.
text:
名称：Compact V configuration
描述：Vee-configured engine packaged compactly to reduce longitudinal length compared with some inline layouts.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Raked / Steeply Raked Windshield (Windshield Rake)
description: Windscreen/windshield tilted rearwards (raked) — sometimes steeply and/or flush-mounted — to reduce stagnation area, smooth airflow over the roof, reduce separation and shape drag, lower cabin noise and improve aerodynamic efficiency. The degree of rake (windshield rake angle) also affects forward visibility; steep/bonded glass is a common implementation.
text:
名称：Raked / Steeply Raked Windshield (Windshield Rake)
描述：Windscreen/windshield tilted rearwards (raked) — sometimes steeply and/or flush-mounted — to reduce stagnation area, smooth airflow over the roof, reduce separation and shape drag, lower cabin noise and improve aerodynamic efficiency. The degree of rake (windshield rake angle) also affects forward visibility; steep/bonded glass is a common implementation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PassengerMirrorCurvature
description: Specified convex curvature of passenger-side mirror per regulation.
text:
名称：PassengerMirrorCurvature
描述：Specified convex curvature of passenger-side mirror per regulation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Apillar_Windshield_Hood_Continuity
description: A柱与前风挡曲面直接延伸至机舱盖，形成浑然一体的前端视觉
text:
名称：Apillar_Windshield_Hood_Continuity
描述：A柱与前风挡曲面直接延伸至机舱盖，形成浑然一体的前端视觉

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Decklid Height
description: Vertical position and slope of the trunk/deck lid relative to driver eye point and vehicle rear; affects rear visibility and rear styling proportions.
text:
名称：Decklid Height
描述：Vertical position and slope of the trunk/deck lid relative to driver eye point and vehicle rear; affects rear visibility and rear styling proportions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Material selection / Material choice
description: Selection and combination of material families for vehicle body and interior (e.g., high-strength steels, aluminium alloys, composites, MMCs) to balance density, stiffness, strength, manufacturability and lifecycle cost.
text:
名称：Material selection / Material choice
描述：Selection and combination of material families for vehicle body and interior (e.g., high-strength steels, aluminium alloys, composites, MMCs) to balance density, stiffness, strength, manufacturability and lifecycle cost.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: LicensePlateMountingLocation
description: Choice of mounting on bumper, trunk lid/liftgate, or removable tailgate for trucks affects appearance and packaging.
text:
名称：LicensePlateMountingLocation
描述：Choice of mounting on bumper, trunk lid/liftgate, or removable tailgate for trucks affects appearance and packaging.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Low‑slung Silhouette (低矮运动轮廓)
description: 整体高度降低且横向拉伸的车身姿态（长引擎罩、低车顶线、紧凑轮拱间隙），传达运动感与精致感，同时支持空气动力学表现 (Reduced overall height with a stretched profile—long hood, low roofline, tight wheel‑arch gaps—to communicate sportiness and refinement).
text:
名称：Low‑slung Silhouette (低矮运动轮廓)
描述：整体高度降低且横向拉伸的车身姿态（长引擎罩、低车顶线、紧凑轮拱间隙），传达运动感与精致感，同时支持空气动力学表现 (Reduced overall height with a stretched profile—long hood, low roofline, tight wheel‑arch gaps—to communicate sportiness and refinement).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Flat roof & lean proportions (扁平车顶与匀称瘦长比例)
description: 低矮车顶、窄薄的车身横剖面、紧凑玻璃面积以营造扁平、瘦的视觉效果
text:
名称：Flat roof & lean proportions (扁平车顶与匀称瘦长比例)
描述：低矮车顶、窄薄的车身横剖面、紧凑玻璃面积以营造扁平、瘦的视觉效果

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Smartphone_Like_UI
description: 界面与交互流程模仿手机/消费电子习惯
text:
名称：Smartphone_Like_UI
描述：界面与交互流程模仿手机/消费电子习惯

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tire Dimensions & Profiles
description: 综合轮胎尺寸与剖面属性，包括胎面宽度、扁平比/剖面、轮圈直径、整体/外径（实际滚动直径）和胎壁高度。此类参数决定车辆的高度与视觉比例、接地补丁（影响加速、制动与弯道抓地力）、滚动阻力、载重能力、乘坐舒适性与操控特性，并影响轮拱包装与离地间隙。包含前/后轮的详细尺寸信息以及用于性能车的前后错配（staggered）尺寸说明。
text:
名称：Tire Dimensions & Profiles
描述：综合轮胎尺寸与剖面属性，包括胎面宽度、扁平比/剖面、轮圈直径、整体/外径（实际滚动直径）和胎壁高度。此类参数决定车辆的高度与视觉比例、接地补丁（影响加速、制动与弯道抓地力）、滚动阻力、载重能力、乘坐舒适性与操控特性，并影响轮拱包装与离地间隙。包含前/后轮的详细尺寸信息以及用于性能车的前后错配（staggered）尺寸说明。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ModularStorage
description: 可配置、分区的储物单元，便于放置文件夹、挎包、购物袋和专用物品（如开车鞋）
text:
名称：ModularStorage
描述：可配置、分区的储物单元，便于放置文件夹、挎包、购物袋和专用物品（如开车鞋）

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ClearInformationDisplay
description: High contrast, prioritized information layout (minimal clutter) to reduce recognition errors.
text:
名称：ClearInformationDisplay
描述：High contrast, prioritized information layout (minimal clutter) to reduce recognition errors.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: GPS & Location Services
description: Integrated positioning and location databases (service stations, POIs) that augment navigation with contextual service data.
text:
名称：GPS & Location Services
描述：Integrated positioning and location databases (service stations, POIs) that augment navigation with contextual service data.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Slim continuous rear light bar
description: 贯穿尾部且细长的尾灯光带（slim continuous rear light bar），通过贯通光带增强视觉宽度与家族识别，同时传递科技感与高级感。
text:
名称：Slim continuous rear light bar
描述：贯穿尾部且细长的尾灯光带（slim continuous rear light bar），通过贯通光带增强视觉宽度与家族识别，同时传递科技感与高级感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seating Position (height)
description: Vertical placement of seat surfaces within the vehicle: high seating positions raise occupants for improved outward visibility and perceived commanding view; low seating positions lower occupants to create a lower center-of-gravity feel and a sporty, low-slung appearance.
text:
名称：Seating Position (height)
描述：Vertical placement of seat surfaces within the vehicle: high seating positions raise occupants for improved outward visibility and perceived commanding view; low seating positions lower occupants to create a lower center-of-gravity feel and a sporty, low-slung appearance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tunnel-mounted energy module
description: Energy modules routed along the central tunnel and underfloor to free up cabin floor height.
text:
名称：Tunnel-mounted energy module
描述：Energy modules routed along the central tunnel and underfloor to free up cabin floor height.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Simple_Purchase_Process
description: 直观的配置选择、线上购车与少选项化流程，降低决策负担
text:
名称：Simple_Purchase_Process
描述：直观的配置选择、线上购车与少选项化流程，降低决策负担

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Monocoque square lines (整体式方正线条)
description: 单体壳体（monocoque）配合较为方正的车身线条，营造简洁、功能性强的外观。
text:
名称：Monocoque square lines (整体式方正线条)
描述：单体壳体（monocoque）配合较为方正的车身线条，营造简洁、功能性强的外观。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 表面与色彩处理（Surface Treatment & Color & Finish）
description: 涵盖汽车外观的表面性质与色彩处理，包括光泽度与反射特性、曲面连续性与过渡细节、涂装与材质触感等要素，这些决定了汽车的质感、光影效果与视觉时尚感。也包含特定风格的面态处理（如70年代常见的大平面、窄长比例与较硬的折线），影响时代感与比例感知。
text:
名称：表面与色彩处理（Surface Treatment & Color & Finish）
描述：涵盖汽车外观的表面性质与色彩处理，包括光泽度与反射特性、曲面连续性与过渡细节、涂装与材质触感等要素，这些决定了汽车的质感、光影效果与视觉时尚感。也包含特定风格的面态处理（如70年代常见的大平面、窄长比例与较硬的折线），影响时代感与比例感知。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: All-Terrain Tires (全地形轮胎)
description: 花纹更粗犷、胎壁更结实的轮胎，既增强通过性也强化视觉侵略感。
text:
名称：All-Terrain Tires (全地形轮胎)
描述：花纹更粗犷、胎壁更结实的轮胎，既增强通过性也强化视觉侵略感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 轮胎与地板阴影
description: 用宽胶带填实轮胎与地板下方区域形成压得住的深色块面，轮胎外轮廓用7~10 mm 胶带贴出圆整形状；每根贴条略短1~3 mm以避免边缘错位。
text:
名称：轮胎与地板阴影
描述：用宽胶带填实轮胎与地板下方区域形成压得住的深色块面，轮胎外轮廓用7~10 mm 胶带贴出圆整形状；每根贴条略短1~3 mm以避免边缘错位。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat adjustment range
description: Total range of seat travel and tilt used to achieve driver-centric posture and control reach, including fore-aft travel on the seat tracks and any possible vertical (height) and tilt adjustments.
text:
名称：Seat adjustment range
描述：Total range of seat travel and tilt used to achieve driver-centric posture and control reach, including fore-aft travel on the seat tracks and any possible vertical (height) and tilt adjustments.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tri-light Color Coding
description: Rear signaling arrangement that uses distinct, standardized signal colors to differentiate tail, stop and turn lamps in a tri-light configuration, enabling more rapid communication of vehicle state.
text:
名称：Tri-light Color Coding
描述：Rear signaling arrangement that uses distinct, standardized signal colors to differentiate tail, stop and turn lamps in a tri-light configuration, enabling more rapid communication of vehicle state.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wheel & Tire Package
description: 整车配置中轮圈与轮胎的打包规格与选项，涵盖轮圈直径、轮胎剖面、可选套件与不同配置车型的搭配。也包含大尺寸轮圈/轮胎组合，用以强化越野形象、视觉存在感或运动化外观。
text:
名称：Wheel & Tire Package
描述：整车配置中轮圈与轮胎的打包规格与选项，涵盖轮圈直径、轮胎剖面、可选套件与不同配置车型的搭配。也包含大尺寸轮圈/轮胎组合，用以强化越野形象、视觉存在感或运动化外观。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ProvocativeYetSensibleStance
description: 外观具有强烈吸引力但不偏离功能与制造/成本现实的姿态表达。
text:
名称：ProvocativeYetSensibleStance
描述：外观具有强烈吸引力但不偏离功能与制造/成本现实的姿态表达。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tall Sidewall
description: Increased sidewall height that distributes load, protects rim from rocks and improves ride comfort; increases sidewall flex which can reduce handling precision.
text:
名称：Tall Sidewall
描述：Increased sidewall height that distributes load, protects rim from rocks and improves ride comfort; increases sidewall flex which can reduce handling precision.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SideImpactBeams
description: 门内横梁、门铰/锁止强化与纵向承载构件，限制侧向入侵并传递载荷到底盘。
text:
名称：SideImpactBeams
描述：门内横梁、门铰/锁止强化与纵向承载构件，限制侧向入侵并传递载荷到底盘。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Artistic Expression (艺术性)
description: 追求造型的艺术与符号表达
text:
名称：Artistic Expression (艺术性)
描述：追求造型的艺术与符号表达

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lightweight construction (轻量化车身)
description: 车重较低（示例：750 kg），提高经济性与操控灵活性。
text:
名称：Lightweight construction (轻量化车身)
描述：车重较低（示例：750 kg），提高经济性与操控灵活性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Automation and advanced production
description: Modern manufacturing and automation enabling low-cost production of complex engines with high repeatability and reliability.
text:
名称：Automation and advanced production
描述：Modern manufacturing and automation enabling low-cost production of complex engines with high repeatability and reliability.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver State Monitoring
description: Sensors and algorithms for drowsiness detection, workload monitoring and intoxication detection to support safety systems.
text:
名称：Driver State Monitoring
描述：Sensors and algorithms for drowsiness detection, workload monitoring and intoxication detection to support safety systems.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tall driver package
description: Increased occupant seating height and upright posture enabling space-efficient layouts.
text:
名称：Tall driver package
描述：Increased occupant seating height and upright posture enabling space-efficient layouts.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Spatial Placement
description: Mounting location, mounting height, and lateral separation used to give cues about vehicle position, distance and width.
text:
名称：Spatial Placement
描述：Mounting location, mounting height, and lateral separation used to give cues about vehicle position, distance and width.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 3D Modelling / 3D Modelling Modes
description: 三维建模方式与能力集合（包括线框、曲面、实体建模等），用于创建高保真三维数字原型，揭示完整表面、比例与交互，决定可实现的几何复杂度与可编辑性。High-fidelity three-dimensional modelling capabilities that reveal full surfaces, proportions and interactions.
text:
名称：3D Modelling / 3D Modelling Modes
描述：三维建模方式与能力集合（包括线框、曲面、实体建模等），用于创建高保真三维数字原型，揭示完整表面、比例与交互，决定可实现的几何复杂度与可编辑性。High-fidelity three-dimensional modelling capabilities that reveal full surfaces, proportions and interactions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Transparent engine hood / Exposed disk brakes with red pistons
description: 透明引擎罩使发动机可视化；外露碟刹并以红色活塞着色以突出运动性能。整体视觉策略在于直接表达机械力量与性能。
text:
名称：Transparent engine hood / Exposed disk brakes with red pistons
描述：透明引擎罩使发动机可视化；外露碟刹并以红色活塞着色以突出运动性能。整体视觉策略在于直接表达机械力量与性能。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Bulkheads
description: Removable or fixed partitions to separate cargo from cabin; used for load security and modular division.
text:
名称：Bulkheads
描述：Removable or fixed partitions to separate cargo from cabin; used for load security and modular division.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visible mid-engine through rear window
description: Mid-mounted engine that can be seen from the rear glazing, evokes a race car layout and mechanical purity.
text:
名称：Visible mid-engine through rear window
描述：Mid-mounted engine that can be seen from the rear glazing, evokes a race car layout and mechanical purity.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Transverse front-mounted inline-4 (横置前置直列四缸)
description: 发动机横置于前舱，节约纵向空间，便于紧凑的车头包装与前轮驱动布局。
text:
名称：Transverse front-mounted inline-4 (横置前置直列四缸)
描述：发动机横置于前舱，节约纵向空间，便于紧凑的车头包装与前轮驱动布局。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Double rear swing doors
description: Two separate rear door leaves allowing flexible opening strategies.
text:
名称：Double rear swing doors
描述：Two separate rear door leaves allowing flexible opening strategies.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SideViewCurvature
description: 侧向曲率通常被保持在最小量级以减少光学畸变，但在平面视图上（plan-view）常见弯曲以匹配车身轮廓。
text:
名称：SideViewCurvature
描述：侧向曲率通常被保持在最小量级以减少光学畸变，但在平面视图上（plan-view）常见弯曲以匹配车身轮廓。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: cargo bed / open cargo bed
description: Rear open-bed area of a pickup or light truck for transporting cargo, providing direct top access and easy loading of large or irregular items. Typically includes a tailgate and can be fitted with a soft or hard cover (tonneau), and in some designs may be extendable/adjustable to increase usable load length. (西班牙语: Área trasera descubierta para transporte de mercancías; 中文: 后部开放货箱，可带篷布/盖板及可伸缩设计。)
text:
名称：cargo bed / open cargo bed
描述：Rear open-bed area of a pickup or light truck for transporting cargo, providing direct top access and easy loading of large or irregular items. Typically includes a tailgate and can be fitted with a soft or hard cover (tonneau), and in some designs may be extendable/adjustable to increase usable load length. (西班牙语: Área trasera descubierta para transporte de mercancías; 中文: 后部开放货箱，可带篷布/盖板及可伸缩设计。)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 色相 (Hue)
description: 由光谱成分/波长决定的颜色类别（如红、黄、蓝等），是区分颜色类别的主要特征。
text:
名称：色相 (Hue)
描述：由光谱成分/波长决定的颜色类别（如红、黄、蓝等），是区分颜色类别的主要特征。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: JoystickControl
description: Alternative steering/throttle/brake interface for drivers lacking range or dexterity for conventional wheel.
text:
名称：JoystickControl
描述：Alternative steering/throttle/brake interface for drivers lacking range or dexterity for conventional wheel.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Colourful stylish covers / elegant engine covers
description: 用色彩化/造型化的罩件掩藏机械部件，传达简洁、友好且高科技的视觉印象，装饰性设计同时满足用户对“好看且习惯性易用”的期待。
text:
名称：Colourful stylish covers / elegant engine covers
描述：用色彩化/造型化的罩件掩藏机械部件，传达简洁、友好且高科技的视觉印象，装饰性设计同时满足用户对“好看且习惯性易用”的期待。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Active Suspension
description: System that actively controls wheel vertical movement and overall dynamic response using powered actuators (e.g., electro-hydraulic active actuators, fully active hydraulic systems, power jacks) to improve ride comfort, handling and dynamic response.
text:
名称：Active Suspension
描述：System that actively controls wheel vertical movement and overall dynamic response using powered actuators (e.g., electro-hydraulic active actuators, fully active hydraulic systems, power jacks) to improve ride comfort, handling and dynamic response.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Classic Mustang cues
description: 圆形/双圆头灯配置、马标格栅、隆起引擎盖与标志性车身侧面折线。
text:
名称：Classic Mustang cues
描述：圆形/双圆头灯配置、马标格栅、隆起引擎盖与标志性车身侧面折线。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: NeutralDesignTendency(设计中性化)
description: 整体造型趋于中性，减少极端个性，通过简洁比例与中性细节提升普适接受度。
text:
名称：NeutralDesignTendency(设计中性化)
描述：整体造型趋于中性，减少极端个性，通过简洁比例与中性细节提升普适接受度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Structural Windshield Glazing & Header
description: Glazing contributes to bodyshell structural integrity by carrying load and increasing torsional stiffness; thicker glass and a stiff, reinforced windshield header help resist deformation, maintain aperture integrity and transfer loads to the roof structure.
text:
名称：Structural Windshield Glazing & Header
描述：Glazing contributes to bodyshell structural integrity by carrying load and increasing torsional stiffness; thicker glass and a stiff, reinforced windshield header help resist deformation, maintain aperture integrity and transfer loads to the roof structure.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tyre dynamic model & tread evaluation software

名称：Tyre dynamic model & tread evaluation software

名称：Body Roll

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

名称：Wheel vertical displacement phase

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tire Choice
description: 用户在轮胎选择上通常在抓地力和乘坐舒适之间进行平衡，偏好能满足其使用场景（运动、舒适、越野等）的轮胎组合。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Turn Signal Integration
description: 转向灯在镜体/灯带/侧标中的位置与动态效果，影响视觉连贯性与科技感。
text:
名称：Turn Signal Integration

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Rubberized prop rod sleeve
description: A colored/rubber sleeve on hood prop rod to assist grasping and locating under low light.
text:
名称：Rubberized prop rod sleeve
描述：A colored/rubber sleeve on hood prop rod to assist grasping and locating under low light.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Expandable boot

text:
名称：Expandable boot

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Forward A-pillar / Upright Windshield
description: A-pillar located ahead of the front axle line with a more vertical windshield pitch, typical of cab-forward or upright windshield packaging; affects visibility, greenhouse proportion and aerodynamic behaviour.
text:
名称：Forward A-pillar / Upright Windshield
描述：A-pillar located ahead of the front axle line with a more vertical windshield pitch, typical of cab-forward or upright windshield packaging; affects visibility, greenhouse proportion and aerodynamic behaviour.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: MinimalHandMovement
description: 控制激活需要尽可能少的手指/手部位移，优先单手或手不离方向盘操作。
text:
名称：MinimalHandMovement
描述：控制激活需要尽可能少的手指/手部位移，优先单手或手不离方向盘操作。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 高位后保险杠 (High-mounted rear bumper)
description: 将后保险杠安装在较高位置或采用收紧的后围造型，以减少刮蹭概率并提高离去角。
text:
名称：高位后保险杠 (High-mounted rear bumper)
描述：将后保险杠安装在较高位置或采用收紧的后围造型，以减少刮蹭概率并提高离去角。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large-diameter Wheels
description: Wheels with increased rim diameter that alter visual proportions and perceived vehicle stance; allow installation of larger brake rotors and change visual treatment. Includes physical wheel dimension considerations (listed range example: 138–148). 增大轮圈直径以改变视觉比例和车身姿态；可容纳更大制动盘并影响轮毂视觉处理。
text:
名称：Large-diameter Wheels
描述：Wheels with increased rim diameter that alter visual proportions and perceived vehicle stance; allow installation of larger brake rotors and change visual treatment. Includes physical wheel dimension considerations (listed range example: 138–148). 增大轮圈直径以改变视觉比例和车身姿态；可容纳更大制动盘并影响轮毂视觉处理。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large aperture & low lift-over
description: Wide unobstructed door opening (large aperture) and low lift-over height; preferred by users who need to move bulky materials easily and desirable for lifestyle and utility-focused vehicles.
text:
名称：Large aperture & low lift-over
描述：Wide unobstructed door opening (large aperture) and low lift-over height; preferred by users who need to move bulky materials easily and desirable for lifestyle and utility-focused vehicles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: VisibleTowHitch & ReinforcedFrame (可见牵引装置与强化车架)
description: 外观可见牵引装置和结构加固部位，用以传达功能可靠性与力量感。
text:
名称：VisibleTowHitch & ReinforcedFrame (可见牵引装置与强化车架)
描述：外观可见牵引装置和结构加固部位，用以传达功能可靠性与力量感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 均衡前后悬
description: 前后悬长度配比均衡，注重后备厢容积与行驶稳定性，常见于家用轿车与部分新能源车型。
text:
名称：均衡前后悬
描述：前后悬长度配比均衡，注重后备厢容积与行驶稳定性，常见于家用轿车与部分新能源车型。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed propulsion modules & modular attach points
description: Visible thruster-like housings and mechanical interfaces.
text:
名称：Exposed propulsion modules & modular attach points
描述：Visible thruster-like housings and mechanical interfaces.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: IntegratedRamp
description: Built-in deployable ramp stored within vehicle bodywork for wheelchair boarding.
text:
名称：IntegratedRamp
描述：Built-in deployable ramp stored within vehicle bodywork for wheelchair boarding.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Clamshell hood with side cutlines
description: Hood or trunk lid whose seams are located at the sides.
text:
名称：Clamshell hood with side cutlines
描述：Hood or trunk lid whose seams are located at the sides.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Haptic Feedback
description: Tactile (haptic) feedback covering both the actuators/mechanisms that produce tactile or vibrotactile sensations (e.g., floating structures, vibro-motors, linear actuators) and the tactile response and force characteristics of knobs, switches and touch controls to support eyes-off operation.
text:
名称：Haptic Feedback
描述：Tactile (haptic) feedback covering both the actuators/mechanisms that produce tactile or vibrotactile sensations (e.g., floating structures, vibro-motors, linear actuators) and the tactile response and force characteristics of knobs, switches and touch controls to support eyes-off operation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PowertrainMountIsolation
description: 动力总成支座与车身之间的隔振设计，用以降低传递至车身的振动与噪声。
text:
名称：PowertrainMountIsolation
描述：动力总成支座与车身之间的隔振设计，用以降低传递至车身的振动与噪声。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SteeringWheelObstruction
description: Place displays and controls to prevent blocking by the steering wheel, stalks, or hands from normal eye ellipses. Takes into account the steering wheel's size, position and contour relative to the primary sight path (方向盘的尺寸、位置与轮廓对主视线通路的遮挡程度), ensuring controls and information remain visible and usable during normal driving posture.
text:
名称：SteeringWheelObstruction
描述：Place displays and controls to prevent blocking by the steering wheel, stalks, or hands from normal eye ellipses. Takes into account the steering wheel's size, position and contour relative to the primary sight path (方向盘的尺寸、位置与轮廓对主视线通路的遮挡程度), ensuring controls and information remain visible and usable during normal driving posture.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: AWD_PackagingIntrusion
description: Packaging impacts (larger center tunnel, driveline components) caused by AWD/4WD systems that intrude into occupant volume.
text:
名称：AWD_PackagingIntrusion
描述：Packaging impacts (larger center tunnel, driveline components) caused by AWD/4WD systems that intrude into occupant volume.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 底盘最低点抬高 / 护板设计 (Raised underbody / skid plate)
description: 通过护板或重设计底盘结构抬高最低点，避免在跨越障碍时触底。
text:
名称：底盘最低点抬高 / 护板设计 (Raised underbody / skid plate)
描述：通过护板或重设计底盘结构抬高最低点，避免在跨越障碍时触底。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Signal Timing/Temporal Pattern
description: Flash rate and temporal profile used to speed detection and recognition (e.g., turn vs hazard vs stop).
text:
名称：Signal Timing/Temporal Pattern
描述：Flash rate and temporal profile used to speed detection and recognition (e.g., turn vs hazard vs stop).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Polycarbonate Headlight Lens
description: Use of polycarbonate for external headlamp/headlight lenses to allow thin profiles, integrated shapes and optical clarity. Polycarbonate is noted for toughness and scratch resistance. Lenses are commonly coated with an acrylic or polyurethane hard lacquer to protect against UV and chemical degradation.
text:
名称：Polycarbonate Headlight Lens
描述：Use of polycarbonate for external headlamp/headlight lenses to allow thin profiles, integrated shapes and optical clarity. Polycarbonate is noted for toughness and scratch resistance. Lenses are commonly coated with an acrylic or polyurethane hard lacquer to protect against UV and chemical degradation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Control Location Acceptability
description: Subjective and objective acceptability of control placement relative to driver reach envelope.
text:
名称：Control Location Acceptability
描述：Subjective and objective acceptability of control placement relative to driver reach envelope.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: RemovableSeats
description: Seats that can be removed or folded quickly to create wheelchair space.
text:
名称：RemovableSeats
描述：Seats that can be removed or folded quickly to create wheelchair space.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Outboard cutlines

text:
名称：Outboard cutlines
描述：Cutlines positioned as far outboard as possible to maximize aperture and keep central surfaces clean.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Fenders and external running boards
description: Wings/fenders ranging from flattened profiles that create a cleaner side contour to large, separate (pronounced) fenders commonly paired with external running boards. Typical of early 20th-century luxury and vintage vehicles, combining both streamlined (flattened) and pronounced separate fender treatments.
text:
名称：Fenders and external running boards
描述：Wings/fenders ranging from flattened profiles that create a cleaner side contour to large, separate (pronounced) fenders commonly paired with external running boards. Typical of early 20th-century luxury and vintage vehicles, combining both streamlined (flattened) and pronounced separate fender treatments.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High Energy Density Battery Choice
description: Selection of battery chemistry and packaging optimized for energy per unit volume to maximize range given packaging constraints.
text:
名称：High Energy Density Battery Choice
描述：Selection of battery chemistry and packaging optimized for energy per unit volume to maximize range given packaging constraints.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HeadClearance
description: Vertical clearance at door entrance allowing the occupant's head to pass without obstruction; evaluated from SgRP. Also used to refer to head swing clearance where clearance during head movement is considered.
text:
名称：HeadClearance
描述：Vertical clearance at door entrance allowing the occupant's head to pass without obstruction; evaluated from SgRP. Also used to refer to head swing clearance where clearance during head movement is considered.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SectionalReferencePlanes
description: Defined 2D/3D cut planes through occupant H-points and head contours used to drive interior and exterior envelope.
text:
名称：SectionalReferencePlanes
描述：Defined 2D/3D cut planes through occupant H-points and head contours used to drive interior and exterior envelope.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 纯度 (Purity / Saturation)
description: 颜色中彩色成分的比例；纯度越高颜色越鲜艳，掺入黑/白/他色会降低纯度；受材料表面结构（光滑/粗糙）影响显著。
text:
名称：纯度 (Purity / Saturation)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Front McPherson suspension (前麦弗逊悬架)
description: 典型的前麦弗逊独立悬挂，提高舒适性与转向响应，利于紧凑车横置发动机布局。
text:
名称：Front McPherson suspension (前麦弗逊悬架)
描述：典型的前麦弗逊独立悬挂，提高舒适性与转向响应，利于紧凑车横置发动机布局。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed Round Headlamps (独立圆形前灯)
description: 圆形灯体独立于车身翼子板之外安装，强调功能性与年代感。
text:
名称：Exposed Round Headlamps (独立圆形前灯)
描述：圆形灯体独立于车身翼子板之外安装，强调功能性与年代感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Absorptive mineral wool (long-fibre)
description: Sound-absorbing fill used in dissipative silencers; thickness and density control attenuation at mid/high frequencies.
text:
名称：Absorptive mineral wool (long-fibre)
描述：Sound-absorbing fill used in dissipative silencers; thickness and density control attenuation at mid/high frequencies.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Progression of 10s
description: Numeric labels presented every 10 units (e.g., 0,10,20...). Shown in tests to lower read error and preferred by subjects.
text:
名称：Progression of 10s
描述：Numeric labels presented every 10 units (e.g., 0,10,20...). Shown in tests to lower read error and preferred by subjects.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 轮辋罩细节数字化

text:
名称：轮辋罩细节数字化
描述：将轮辋罩等复杂细部在计算机中按实际尺寸的1/5比例制作并打印成效果，用于贴图与参考，提升细节质量。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Fixed hood (limited user access)
description: 固定引擎罩设计，用户对机械部件的接触被限制，仅保留基本维护口（如加油、冷却液）。
text:
名称：Fixed hood (limited user access)
描述：固定引擎罩设计，用户对机械部件的接触被限制，仅保留基本维护口（如加油、冷却液）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HiddenSteeringComponents
description: Packaging and routing choices to keep steering rack, tie rods and linkages out of visible exterior areas.
text:
名称：HiddenSteeringComponents
描述：Packaging and routing choices to keep steering rack, tie rods and linkages out of visible exterior areas.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 轻量化材料与低能耗设计
description: 使用复合材料、回收材料与优化空气动力学以降低整体能耗与环境足迹。
text:
名称：轻量化材料与低能耗设计
描述：使用复合材料、回收材料与优化空气动力学以降低整体能耗与环境足迹。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Passenger pass-through clearance
description: Clearance through center tunnel or between seats that allows occupant passage (e.g., middle-seat access) and affects lateral seat placement.
text:
名称：Passenger pass-through clearance
描述：Clearance through center tunnel or between seats that allows occupant passage (e.g., middle-seat access) and affects lateral seat placement.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: MaterialType
description: Basic material category (leather vs. cloth) influencing appearance, tactile cues and thermal sensation.
text:
名称：MaterialType
描述：Basic material category (leather vs. cloth) influencing appearance, tactile cues and thermal sensation.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Curvature and rhythm
description: 线条的弯曲程度与弧段排列节奏，决定视觉流动性与运动感。
text:
名称：Curvature and rhythm
描述：线条的弯曲程度与弧段排列节奏，决定视觉流动性与运动感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Inclined Rear Window

text:
名称：Inclined Rear Window
描述：Rear window set at a moderate angle rather than fully vertical to reduce separation and shape drag.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: EngineAndSpindleCutlines
description: Cut sections through front/rear spindles and engine to validate suspension/engine packaging under hood and fenders.
text:
名称：EngineAndSpindleCutlines
描述：Cut sections through front/rear spindles and engine to validate suspension/engine packaging under hood and fenders.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver eye point height
description: Relative vertical location of the driver's eyes (eye point height). Used to evaluate visibility, sight lines and instrument-cluster ergonomics. This eye point interacts with decklid and glass geometry to determine outward visibility. The term 'Elevated Eye Point' additionally describes the perceptual effect produced by a higher seat/eye reference (SgRP).
text:
名称：Driver eye point height

This eye point interacts with decklid and glass geometry to determine outward visibility. The term 'Elevated Eye Point' additionally describes the perceptual effect produced by a higher seat/eye reference (SgRP).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ParametricControl
description: The set of editable parameters and rules used in parametric models to produce controlled variations.
text:
名称：ParametricControl
描述：The set of editable parameters and rules used in parametric models to produce controlled variations.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wedge silhouette / rising rear beltline (楔形轮廓/上扬腰线)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: FlashBoiler

text:
名称：FlashBoiler
描述：Boiler design generating steam quickly by passing water through heated tubes, reducing warm-up time compared with large pressure-vessel boilers.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: QuickReleaseWheelchairFasteners

text:
名称：QuickReleaseWheelchairFasteners
描述：Fastening systems enabling rapid, one-handed securement of wheelchairs without special hardware.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 翼板处理 (Winglet / feature edge treatment)

text:
名称：翼板处理 (Winglet / feature edge treatment)
描述：翼板或侧翼的局部体量和曲率处理，会影响三维光影与气流。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SeatControlsBelowCompressionPoint

text:
名称：SeatControlsBelowCompressionPoint
描述：Recliner handles, side seat shields and other controls positioned beneath the seat compression point to avoid interference during entry/exit.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Side Silhouette (侧面轮廓)

名称：Side Silhouette (侧面轮廓)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

名称：AngularSurfaces

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visibility & Interpretation of Displays

text:
名称：Visibility & Interpretation of Displays
描述：How easily drivers can see and interpret instrument and infotainment displays under real-world conditions; influenced by angle, luminance, and distance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: suspensionStiffness
description: 悬架的等效弹簧和阻尼特性组合，影响乘坐舒适性、车身控制及动态响应。
text:
名称：suspensionStiffness

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Manikins / 人体模型与数字仿真
description: 集合式的人体模型与仿真能力，涵盖： - 统计学校正的人体模型与人体测量学模型（Statistically-correct manikins & anthropometric models），基于中位数/回归模型及最新人群调查数据，包含姿态变体并考虑世代增长容差； - 百分位成对人体模型（Percentile-pair manikins），覆盖不同百分位尺度以反映多样体型与配对需求； - 数字人体仿真（Digital Manikin Simulation）：基于3D数字人体模型评估姿态、运动学、力学、强度和施力分布，支持不同性别、尺寸和人群配置； - 人体模型规范（Manikin specification）：涉及标准化与规范差异（例如 SAE 与公司内部模型规格），用于保证模型一致性与适用性。 Combined description (简明合并描述)：Provides sets of anthropometric, percentile and statistically-derived manikins plus 3D digital manikin simulation capability, and documents/specifies manikin standards (e.g. SAE vs company-specific) to support posture, motion, biomechanical and force/strength predictions across genders, sizes and populations.
text:
名称：Manikins / 人体模型与数字仿真
描述：集合式的人体模型与仿真能力，涵盖： - 统计学校正的人体模型与人体测量学模型（Statistically-correct manikins & anthropometric models），基于中位数/回归模型及最新人群调查数据，包含姿态变体并考虑世代增长容差； - 百分位成对人体模型（Percentile-pair manikins），覆盖不同百分位尺度以反映多样体型与配对需求； - 数字人体仿真（Digital Manikin Simulation）：基于3D数字人体模型评估姿态、运动学、力学、强度和施力分布，支持不同性别、尺寸和人群配置； - 人体模型规范（Manikin specification）：涉及标准化与规范差异（例如 SAE 与公司内部模型规格），用于保证模型一致性与适用性。 Combined description (简明合并描述)：Provides sets of anthropometric, percentile and statistically-derived manikins plus 3D digital manikin simulation capability, and documents/specifies manikin standards (e.g. SAE vs company-specific) to support posture, motion, biomechanical and force/strength predictions across genders, sizes and populations.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PressureDifferenceVentilationStrategy
description: 两种基于进出气压力差的通风设计思路的合并描述： 1) 大压力差（HighPressureDifferenceEffect）：利用较大的自然压力差可驱动强劲的自然通风，但室内气流对车速和温度（尤其加热空气时）高度敏感，导致通风性能随工况波动较大。 2) 低压力差＋风扇辅助（LowPressureDifferenceStrategy）：采用较小的自然压力差并配合风扇提供主动气流，实现更可控、稳定的室内流动，降低对车速和温度的依赖，但需要额外能耗。 权衡：高压力差策略适用于优先被动节能且外部条件可预测的场景；低压力差加风扇适用于需稳定、可控舱内环境或热效应会显著扰动自然通风的场景。
text:
名称：PressureDifferenceVentilationStrategy
描述：两种基于进出气压力差的通风设计思路的合并描述： 1) 大压力差（HighPressureDifferenceEffect）：利用较大的自然压力差可驱动强劲的自然通风，但室内气流对车速和温度（尤其加热空气时）高度敏感，导致通风性能随工况波动较大。 2) 低压力差＋风扇辅助（LowPressureDifferenceStrategy）：采用较小的自然压力差并配合风扇提供主动气流，实现更可控、稳定的室内流动，降低对车速和温度的依赖，但需要额外能耗。 权衡：高压力差策略适用于优先被动节能且外部条件可预测的场景；低压力差加风扇适用于需稳定、可控舱内环境或热效应会显著扰动自然通风的场景。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: WheelArchDesign
description: 车轮拱的造型与间隙控制（包括封闭式轮拱、紧密轮拱间隙等），旨在通过缩小轮胎外廓与车身开口之间的径向间隙并使翼子板与车身表面融合，减少轮胎引起的湍流和横风侧吸，从而获得更平滑的气动外形；同时影响可见轮胎剖面与整车姿态的视觉感知。'wheel_arch_clearance' 为衡量该项的几何参数，定义为轮胎包络与车身开口或轮拱内表面的最小几何间隙，决定最小可允许的包线偏移。
text:
名称：WheelArchDesign
描述：车轮拱的造型与间隙控制（包括封闭式轮拱、紧密轮拱间隙等），旨在通过缩小轮胎外廓与车身开口之间的径向间隙并使翼子板与车身表面融合，减少轮胎引起的湍流和横风侧吸，从而获得更平滑的气动外形；同时影响可见轮胎剖面与整车姿态的视觉感知。'wheel_arch_clearance' 为衡量该项的几何参数，定义为轮胎包络与车身开口或轮拱内表面的最小几何间隙，决定最小可允许的包线偏移。

Includes sedan-like (car-like) tuning for a smoother, quieter ride (以轿车调校为主的悬架与隔振；低噪音、舒适悬挂与座椅支持).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Material Tactile Quality
description: Interior material and surface tactile characteristics that determine user contact experience and perceived quality. 包括表面触感（粗糙度、纤维感、压纹等纹理特征）、接触面的软硬/顺应性（softness/compliance）、抓握感（grippiness）与温感（temperature feel）。适用部位包括仪表板、门内饰、座椅、方向盘、扶手与仪表面板等，影响舒适性、握持感与整体感知品质。
text:
名称：Material Tactile Quality
描述：Interior material and surface tactile characteristics that determine user contact experience and perceived quality. 包括表面触感（粗糙度、纤维感、压纹等纹理特征）、接触面的软硬/顺应性（softness/compliance）、抓握感（grippiness）与温感（temperature feel）。适用部位包括仪表板、门内饰、座椅、方向盘、扶手与仪表面板等，影响舒适性、握持感与整体感知品质。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Detectability
description: Likelihood that an observer detects a visual target or change (e.g., tail lamp, gauge pointer); dependent on size, contrast, luminance and context. Answer parameter indicating target detectability (1 = detectable, 0 = not detectable) based on contrast vs threshold.
text:
名称：Detectability
描述：Likelihood that an observer detects a visual target or change (e.g., tail lamp, gauge pointer); dependent on size, contrast, luminance and context. Answer parameter indicating target detectability (1 = detectable, 0 = not detectable) based on contrast vs threshold.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 单箱大尺度空间（Single-box large volume）
description: 突破传统三厢/两厢形式，采用单箱体造型以获得更大且灵活的内部空间，满足多功能用途。
text:
名称：单箱大尺度空间（Single-box large volume）
描述：突破传统三厢/两厢形式，采用单箱体造型以获得更大且灵活的内部空间，满足多功能用途。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lens Optics & Distribution
description: Optical design (reflector, lens, diffuser) that shapes beam spread, cutoff and angular intensity distribution to control glare and ensure visibility at approach angles.
text:
名称：Lens Optics & Distribution
描述：Optical design (reflector, lens, diffuser) that shapes beam spread, cutoff and angular intensity distribution to control glare and ensure visibility at approach angles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Accessible Controls / Control Accessibility
description: Controls placed within primary reach zones with clear, legible displays; appropriate placement, size, tactile differentiation and feedback to minimize reach and cognitive load and to ensure operability across different body sizes (button layout, travel, feedback).
text:
名称：Accessible Controls / Control Accessibility
描述：Controls placed within primary reach zones with clear, legible displays; appropriate placement, size, tactile differentiation and feedback to minimize reach and cognitive load and to ensure operability across different body sizes (button layout, travel, feedback).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Material Recyclability and Recycled Material Use
description: Extent and manner of using recyclable and recycled materials in the vehicle (interior and exterior). Covers selection of materials that enable material recovery and end-of-life recycling (e.g., thermoplastics and long-fibre reinforced thermoplastics versus thermosets), specification and visible presentation of recycled-content materials in trim, seat fabrics and panels, and examples of recycled-fiber-reinforced plastics for body panels (e.g., duroplast). Emphasises facilitation of material recovery, recycling compliance and resource-efficient construction.
text:
名称：Material Recyclability and Recycled Material Use
描述：Extent and manner of using recyclable and recycled materials in the vehicle (interior and exterior). Covers selection of materials that enable material recovery and end-of-life recycling (e.g., thermoplastics and long-fibre reinforced thermoplastics versus thermosets), specification and visible presentation of recycled-content materials in trim, seat fabrics and panels, and examples of recycled-fiber-reinforced plastics for body panels (e.g., duroplast). Emphasises facilitation of material recovery, recycling compliance and resource-efficient construction.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 宽阔车肩与车身流动曲面
description: 明显的横向体量与连续的曲面，提升光影与肌肉感。
text:
名称：宽阔车肩与车身流动曲面
描述：明显的横向体量与连续的曲面，提升光影与肌肉感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: License Plate Pocket
description: Recessed or flush-mounted pocket/bezel area in the front or rear bumper, spoiler or boot that houses the license plate and any required illumination. Depth, size and mounting angle vary by market and styling and can affect rear-end packaging.
text:
名称：License Plate Pocket
描述：Recessed or flush-mounted pocket/bezel area in the front or rear bumper, spoiler or boot that houses the license plate and any required illumination. Depth, size and mounting angle vary by market and styling and can affect rear-end packaging.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Bright Color Finish
description: High-chroma, vibrant paint finishes that increase perceived sportiness, youthfulness and visual impact.
text:
名称：Bright Color Finish
描述：High-chroma, vibrant paint finishes that increase perceived sportiness, youthfulness and visual impact.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
description: Microphone and loudspeaker based system sampling cabin noise and emitting inverted signals to cancel low-frequency noise (approximately 50–200 Hz), reducing body 'boom' and engine vibration noise.
text:
名称：Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
描述：Microphone and loudspeaker based system sampling cabin noise and emitting inverted signals to cancel low-frequency noise (approximately 50–200 Hz), reducing body 'boom' and engine vibration noise.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Inboard underfloor location
description: Location under rear occupant area / underfloor inboard — uses natural empty volume to house fuel or batteries; minimizes packaging intrusion.
text:
名称：Inboard underfloor location
描述：Location under rear occupant area / underfloor inboard — uses natural empty volume to house fuel or batteries; minimizes packaging intrusion.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 通过性
description: 车辆越野或复杂地形通过能力，既是性能指标也是视觉表现元素。
text:
名称：通过性
描述：车辆越野或复杂地形通过能力，既是性能指标也是视觉表现元素。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SideAirIntakes
description: Entradas de aire prominentes para admisión y refrigeración de un motor de gran rendimiento.
text:
名称：SideAirIntakes
描述：Entradas de aire prominentes para admisión y refrigeración de un motor de gran rendimiento.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lens Surface Area
description: Visible lens area contributing to light output and meeting minimum surface-area legislative requirements.
text:
名称：Lens Surface Area
描述：Visible lens area contributing to light output and meeting minimum surface-area legislative requirements.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 肩线/特征线
description: 贯穿或断裂的肩线是品牌识别的重要中观元素；当肩线出现多次转折或折角时，会产生紧张感与动感，增强侧面视觉张力。
text:
名称：肩线/特征线
描述：贯穿或断裂的肩线是品牌识别的重要中观元素；当肩线出现多次转折或折角时，会产生紧张感与动感，增强侧面视觉张力。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seamless canopy & integrated lighting
description: Large glass canopy and continuous light strip as futuristic signature.
text:
名称：Seamless canopy & integrated lighting
描述：Large glass canopy and continuous light strip as futuristic signature.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Modular component design (steering wheel, mirrors, infotainment)
description: Physical and electrical interfaces designed for removal and upgrade: steering wheel, in-car mirrors, infotainment head units, control modules.
text:
名称：Modular component design (steering wheel, mirrors, infotainment)
描述：Physical and electrical interfaces designed for removal and upgrade: steering wheel, in-car mirrors, infotainment head units, control modules.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High greenhouse-to-body ratio
description: Tall cabin proportion relative to body height to increase perceived space.
text:
名称：High greenhouse-to-body ratio
描述：Tall cabin proportion relative to body height to increase perceived space.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ChromePlatedPlastic (塑料电镀格栅)
description: 电镀塑料并可涂装以增强装饰性、耐磨性和耐热性，同时保持轻量化与成型自由度。
text:
名称：ChromePlatedPlastic (塑料电镀格栅)
描述：电镀塑料并可涂装以增强装饰性、耐磨性和耐热性，同时保持轻量化与成型自由度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HorseshoeGrille
description: Motivo distintivo de Bugatti que actúa como firma de marca y elemento visual central.
text:
名称：HorseshoeGrille
描述：Motivo distintivo de Bugatti que actúa como firma de marca y elemento visual central.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 车肩宽度
description: 左右轮拱外缘之间的视觉宽度。
text:
名称：车肩宽度
描述：左右轮拱外缘之间的视觉宽度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 生活化服务触点 (Lifestyle service touchpoints)
description: 将线下活动（下午茶、插花、瑜伽、亲子出游等）作为对用户的服务和营销延伸。
text:
名称：生活化服务触点 (Lifestyle service touchpoints)
描述：将线下活动（下午茶、插花、瑜伽、亲子出游等）作为对用户的服务和营销延伸。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Vehicle Outline at Y0
description: The 2D silhouette of the vehicle cut through the Y-zero centerline used in side and rear sections to express symmetry, proportions and external envelope.
text:
名称：Vehicle Outline at Y0
描述：The 2D silhouette of the vehicle cut through the Y-zero centerline used in side and rear sections to express symmetry, proportions and external envelope.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Transparent Glass Rendering
description: 在渲染中表现玻璃的透明度、反射及色散等视觉特性，以评估车窗与灯具的视觉效果。
text:
名称：Transparent Glass Rendering
描述：在渲染中表现玻璃的透明度、反射及色散等视觉特性，以评估车窗与灯具的视觉效果。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Separate_Outboard_And_Inboard_Compartments
description: Tail lamps in separate outboard compartments while stop/turn combined in inboard compartments (configuration-specific layout).
text:
名称：Separate_Outboard_And_Inboard_Compartments
描述：Tail lamps in separate outboard compartments while stop/turn combined in inboard compartments (configuration-specific layout).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Deformable zones (Zonas deformables)
description: Elementos estructurales diseñados para deformarse y absorber energía en colisiones.
text:
名称：Deformable zones (Zonas deformables)
描述：Elementos estructurales diseñados para deformarse y absorber energía en colisiones.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Low strut design
description: Strut or spring mounted lower relative to wheel centerline (e.g., low strut variants) specifically to reduce fender/hood height.
text:
名称：Low strut design
描述：Strut or spring mounted lower relative to wheel centerline (e.g., low strut variants) specifically to reduce fender/hood height.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Ease of integrating AWD
description: Packaging characteristic of rear-engine/transaxle layout that facilitates adding front-drive components to create AWD systems.
text:
名称：Ease of integrating AWD
描述：Packaging characteristic of rear-engine/transaxle layout that facilitates adding front-drive components to create AWD systems.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Metallic Finish
description: Paint and surface finishes that simulate or emphasize metal luster: fine metal flake, high specular highlights, polished surfaces (e.g., silver-polished ceremonial treatments). Enhances perceived material quality, depth, technicality and sportiness.
text:
名称：Metallic Finish
描述：Paint and surface finishes that simulate or emphasize metal luster: fine metal flake, high specular highlights, polished surfaces (e.g., silver-polished ceremonial treatments). Enhances perceived material quality, depth, technicality and sportiness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: A-pillar thickness (A柱厚度)
description: A柱的壁厚或横截面尺寸（宽度/深度），直接影响驾驶员的侧向视野并可能形成盲区。 / A-pillar thickness: the wall thickness or cross-sectional size (width/depth) of the A-pillar; directly affects lateral visibility and can create driving blind spots.
text:
名称：A-pillar thickness (A柱厚度)
描述：A柱的壁厚或横截面尺寸（宽度/深度），直接影响驾驶员的侧向视野并可能形成盲区。 / A-pillar thickness: the wall thickness or cross-sectional size (width/depth) of the A-pillar; directly affects lateral visibility and can create driving blind spots.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Radiator left-side placement
description: Radiator mounted on left to keep fan coupled to engine and save space on right side.
text:
名称：Radiator left-side placement
描述：Radiator mounted on left to keep fan coupled to engine and save space on right side.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Prop-shaft-tunnel backbone
description: Using the propeller shaft tunnel as a structural backbone (Lotus Elan) to reduce weight while retaining torsional rigidity.
text:
名称：Prop-shaft-tunnel backbone
描述：Using the propeller shaft tunnel as a structural backbone (Lotus Elan) to reduce weight while retaining torsional rigidity.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Space-saver tire limitation
description: Technical constraint that space-saver tires must not be smaller than 80% of original diameter to avoid drivetrain wear.
text:
名称：Space-saver tire limitation
描述：Technical constraint that space-saver tires must not be smaller than 80% of original diameter to avoid drivetrain wear.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: rearWheelSteering
description: Active steering on rear axle to reduce turning radius and improve maneuverability for long-wheelbase vehicles.
text:
名称：rearWheelSteering
描述：Active steering on rear axle to reduce turning radius and improve maneuverability for long-wheelbase vehicles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wide Track & Low Stance
description: Combination of increased track width (wider lateral wheel spacing) and reduced ride height to convey agility, stability and an aggressive, planted posture.
text:
名称：Wide Track & Low Stance
描述：Combination of increased track width (wider lateral wheel spacing) and reduced ride height to convey agility, stability and an aggressive, planted posture.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Firewall / metal floor separation
description: Structural barrier between occupants and fuel/storage; ensures fuel remains contained and away from passenger cell in collision.
text:
名称：Firewall / metal floor separation
描述：Structural barrier between occupants and fuel/storage; ensures fuel remains contained and away from passenger cell in collision.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 紧凑瘦长比例（slim/lean proportions）
description: 受当时服装与流行文化影响，车辆也倾向于更瘦、更紧凑、更扁平的视觉比例，体现时髦标准。
text:
名称：紧凑瘦长比例（slim/lean proportions）
描述：受当时服装与流行文化影响，车辆也倾向于更瘦、更紧凑、更扁平的视觉比例，体现时髦标准。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: tone
description: Color characteristic encompassing low-chroma, moderate-to-high brightness tones that harmonize with surroundings and convey cleanliness; can include natural-associative cues that evoke nature and freshness to increase individuality, as well as reserved/calm tones that express introversion and stability.
text:
名称：tone
描述：Color characteristic encompassing low-chroma, moderate-to-high brightness tones that harmonize with surroundings and convey cleanliness; can include natural-associative cues that evoke nature and freshness to increase individuality, as well as reserved/calm tones that express introversion and stability.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lower seat height / reduced step-over
description: Lowering seat height and reducing the step-over at the door sill as an interior packaging decision to improve ingress/egress and achieve a lower seating position. Related to overall packaging but distinct from vehicle ride height and track width.
text:
名称：Lower seat height / reduced step-over
描述：Lowering seat height and reducing the step-over at the door sill as an interior packaging decision to improve ingress/egress and achieve a lower seating position. Related to overall packaging but distinct from vehicle ride height and track width.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Steering feel & effort
description: Driver's perceived steering response, feedback and required effort (torque) when steering. Influenced by suspension and steering kinematics (geometry, compliance, swivel-pin offset, scrub), steering system design and active systems. Includes haptic feedback provided by adaptive steering and active chassis systems that modulate tactile cues and body motions to enhance engagement and perceived control.
text:
名称：Steering feel & effort
描述：Driver's perceived steering response, feedback and required effort (torque) when steering. Influenced by suspension and steering kinematics (geometry, compliance, swivel-pin offset, scrub), steering system design and active systems. Includes haptic feedback provided by adaptive steering and active chassis systems that modulate tactile cues and body motions to enhance engagement and perceived control.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: DifferentialIntegration
description: Whether differential is housed with gearbox or as part of the axle; affects lubrication, weight, and packaging.
text:
名称：DifferentialIntegration
描述：Whether differential is housed with gearbox or as part of the axle; affects lubrication, weight, and packaging.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 发动机罩棱线
description: 较为平直或带明确折角的罩线，用以传达成功与富贵感（如奔驰）。

名称：发动机罩棱线
描述：较为平直或带明确折角的罩线，用以传达成功与富贵感（如奔驰）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Frame Rail - Stamped Steel

名称：Frame Rail - Stamped Steel
描述：Steel unibody structural member produced by stamping and spot welding.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: DisplayHeight
description: Vertical and angular placement of driver-facing displays relative to eyellipse and field-of-view.
text:
名称：DisplayHeight
描述：Vertical and angular placement of driver-facing displays relative to eyellipse and field-of-view.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Plane-and-Convex Mirror Combination
description: 在驾驶员侧并列配置平面镜与凸面镜，使驾驶员可选用平面或凸面镜来获得精确参照或更宽视野。
text:
名称：Plane-and-Convex Mirror Combination
描述：在驾驶员侧并列配置平面镜与凸面镜，使驾驶员可选用平面或凸面镜来获得精确参照或更宽视野。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Basic body outline (preliminary)
description: Initial body silhouette sketch included in package to align engineering clearances and styling proportions.
text:
名称：Basic body outline (preliminary)
描述：Initial body silhouette sketch included in package to align engineering clearances and styling proportions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Waistline (Side Waistline / Waistline Profile)
description: The vehicle side waistline running from front to rear that provides lateral visual stretching and family recognition. Its profile may vary in apparent width (narrow→wide→narrow), exhibiting width curves, local convex points and gradient regions to convey motion and tension.
text:
名称：Waistline (Side Waistline / Waistline Profile)
描述：The vehicle side waistline running from front to rear that provides lateral visual stretching and family recognition. Its profile may vary in apparent width (narrow→wide→narrow), exhibiting width curves, local convex points and gradient regions to convey motion and tension.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Ingress/egress ease
description: Composite attribute influenced by step geometry, handle positions and clearances.
text:
名称：Ingress/egress ease
描述：Composite attribute influenced by step geometry, handle positions and clearances.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: BMW Display Key (with display)
description: 带显示屏的钥匙作为交互媒介，支持远程泊车与状态反馈。
text:
名称：BMW Display Key (with display)
描述：带显示屏的钥匙作为交互媒介，支持远程泊车与状态反馈。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Respondent Knowledge Requirement
description: Degree to which a question requires respondent memory or knowledge they may not have.
text:
名称：Respondent Knowledge Requirement
描述：Degree to which a question requires respondent memory or knowledge they may not have.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Aluminum panels
description: Uso de aluminio para partes difíciles de curvar y para reducir peso respecto a acero.
text:
名称：Aluminum panels
描述：Uso de aluminio para partes difíciles de curvar y para reducir peso respecto a acero.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Very flexible long-travel suspension

名称：Very flexible long-travel suspension

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Product Recognizability（产品识别性）

text:
名称：Product Recognizability（产品识别性）
描述：品牌特征在造型中的可辨识程度（Logo以外的造型语言）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Innovative-maximization mindset
description: 设计中优先追求突破常规与新颖性的思维属性，鼓励非常规方案探索。
text:

描述：设计中优先追求突破常规与新颖性的思维属性，鼓励非常规方案探索。

name: Coupe roofline (轿跑化车顶线)
description: 较低且向后倾斜的快背车顶
text:
名称：Coupe roofline (轿跑化车顶线)
描述：较低且向后倾斜的快背车顶

name: 局部后门线

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Padded interior (Habitáculo embotado)

text:
名称：Padded interior (Habitáculo embotado)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tape Lines
description: Black crepe adhesive tape applied to the package to represent primary outlines, beltlines and character lines.
text:
名称：Tape Lines

name: Monocular/binocular obstruction zone
description: Angular regions describing visibility to one or both eyes: areas where an object is visible to only one eye (monocular zones) or occluded to both eyes (binocular obscurations). Binocular obscuration refers specifically to parts of the field not visible to both eyes simultaneously (overlap of occlusions) and is always smaller than monocular obscurations. These measures are used to quantify blind spots, fusion constraints and are critical for safety assessments.

Emphasizes very small overall width (and sometimes short length) to suit constrained urban environments.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

Passive or hydro-elastic isolators are suitable where simpler implementation and lower cost are priorities or where the expected excitation bandwidth is limited.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exterior Color
description: Hue, saturation and finish of the car body used for identity, visibility and psychological effect. Hue influences perceived size and proximity (e.g. red/yellow tend to make a car appear larger/closer; blue/green tend to make it appear smaller/farther). Saturation affects conspicuity and perceived visual noise in urban environments — high saturation creates a vivid, attention-grabbing effect. Light/pastel (low-saturation) tones improve visual comfort under bright sunlight. Cultural and regional variants prescribe recommended and avoided hues; certain hues (e.g. green) can have positive cultural associations. Bright, high-value and high-saturation palettes may be used to match local aesthetic preferences.

description: 强调简洁的操控与结构布局以提升机械手感与可维护性。设计要点包括：最少化控制（例如简化传动控制——无或简化的离合/踏板换挡）、精简仪表与直观的人机布局；针对乘用车常见采用直列四缸、简单传动系与有限电子辅助以保留机械反馈；在小型或两轮车辆中可采用暴露式链传动与单缸等易维护配置以便路边维修；总体追求部件最少、便于快速装配和周期性维护。传动与防护（封闭或暴露）可根据车辆类型与使用场景权衡，以达成维护便利与可靠性的平衡。
text:
名称：Simple mechanical layout / 简单机械布局与可维护性
描述：强调简洁的操控与结构布局以提升机械手感与可维护性。设计要点包括：最少化控制（例如简化传动控制——无或简化的离合/踏板换挡）、精简仪表与直观的人机布局；针对乘用车常见采用直列四缸、简单传动系与有限电子辅助以保留机械反馈；在小型或两轮车辆中可采用暴露式链传动与单缸等易维护配置以便路边维修；总体追求部件最少、便于快速装配和周期性维护。传动与防护（封闭或暴露）可根据车辆类型与使用场景权衡，以达成维护便利与可靠性的平衡。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Line balance
description: 车身主侧面线条的起承转合关系，影响视觉节奏与造型重心。
text:
名称：Line balance
描述：车身主侧面线条的起承转合关系，影响视觉节奏与造型重心。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Projector Lamp Option
description: 采用投影式光学（projector optics）的方案，能够在较小的光学元件直径或可见尺寸下达到所需的光度学指标（识别/合规光强）。
text:
名称：Projector Lamp Option
描述：采用投影式光学（projector optics）的方案，能够在较小的光学元件直径或可见尺寸下达到所需的光度学指标（识别/合规光强）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Subjective Satisfaction Metrics
description: 用于衡量用户在使用产品或交互过程中主观感受与评价的度量体系，包含满意度、喜好程度、功能期望度、可用性评分与使用过程中的幸福感/愉悦度等。可通过自评量表或反馈机制收集（例如10分制中高于8分的比例），用于评估设计的情感与体验表现并指导迭代。
text:
名称：Subjective Satisfaction Metrics
描述：用于衡量用户在使用产品或交互过程中主观感受与评价的度量体系，包含满意度、喜好程度、功能期望度、可用性评分与使用过程中的幸福感/愉悦度等。可通过自评量表或反馈机制收集（例如10分制中高于8分的比例），用于评估设计的情感与体验表现并指导迭代。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: DoorCloseSound
description: Acoustic signature of door closure that signals solidity and build quality (resonance, decay, pitch).
text:
名称：DoorCloseSound
描述：Acoustic signature of door closure that signals solidity and build quality (resonance, decay, pitch).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Mass centralized at mid-wheelbase
description: Placement of heavy components (engine, transmission, batteries) close to vehicle center to lower polar moment.
text:
名称：Mass centralized at mid-wheelbase

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Crush Zone Allocation

text:
名称：Crush Zone Allocation

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: CruciformFrame

text:
名称：CruciformFrame

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PowertrainMassDistribution
description: Axial and longitudinal placement of engine/transmission mass relative to wheel centres; influences polar moment and perceived sportiness.
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: driver_eye_point_ray_diagram_assessment

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Vibration isolation (振动隔离)
description: Mounting and damping solutions to prevent structure-borne vibration from entering the cabin. 设计上减少路面输入到车身与座舱的振动传递，包括悬架、座椅和轮胎等系统的协同设计。
text:
名称：Vibration isolation (振动隔离)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ExposedPipes
description: Prominent external exhaust or intake pipes signaling mechanical power and raw performance.

名称：ExposedPipes
描述：Prominent external exhaust or intake pipes signaling mechanical power and raw performance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: LED lamp clusters (LED灯组)
description: Modular lighting units adding a hi-tech graphic signature at low integration cost.

名称：LED lamp clusters (LED灯组)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

description: 座椅的轮廓、侧向包裹与视觉比例，传达支撑性与舒适性的设计信息 (Contours, side bolsters and visual proportions that communicate support and comfort).
text:
名称：Seat Silhouette and Bolstering (座椅轮廓与包裹性)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High Ground Clearance & Robust Suspension
description: Attributes that deliver off-road capability and visual cue of ruggedness.
text:
名称：High Ground Clearance & Robust Suspension
描述：Attributes that deliver off-road capability and visual cue of ruggedness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Signal Modulation & Timing
description: Temporal characteristics (flash rate, duty cycle) used to signal turn/back and enhance detectability.
text:
名称：Signal Modulation & Timing
描述：Temporal characteristics (flash rate, duty cycle) used to signal turn/back and enhance detectability.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: wheelbaseVisualCount
description: 侧面按轮胎直径为单位可视化的轴距占比，便于评估视觉修长感（例如 2.5、3、3.5 个轮径）。
text:
名称：wheelbaseVisualCount
描述：侧面按轮胎直径为单位可视化的轴距占比，便于评估视觉修长感（例如 2.5、3、3.5 个轮径）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Innovaciones funcionales y estéticas históricas
description: Atributos concretos como cinturones de seguridad, estructuras de crumple, optimización aerodinámica, integración eléctrica y HMI digital que materializan la innovación de diseño.
text:
名称：Innovaciones funcionales y estéticas históricas
描述：Atributos concretos como cinturones de seguridad, estructuras de crumple, optimización aerodinámica, integración eléctrica y HMI digital que materializan la innovación de diseño.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Multimodal Alerts
description: Integrated multimodal alert designs using visual, auditory and haptic channels with redundant cues for critical warnings; adaptive intensity and priority to improve detection, recognition and decision-making and to address recognition and decision failures.
text:
名称：Multimodal Alerts
描述：Integrated multimodal alert designs using visual, auditory and haptic channels with redundant cues for critical warnings; adaptive intensity and priority to improve detection, recognition and decision-making and to address recognition and decision failures.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Underfloor / Underseat Engine Packaging
description: Packaging a small engine or motor beneath the vehicle floor — commonly under the rear floor or beneath the passenger seat — to shorten overall vehicle length and free cabin space. Typically implemented with a low‑profile engine and transmission layout under the passenger or rear floor.
text:
名称：Underfloor / Underseat Engine Packaging
描述：Packaging a small engine or motor beneath the vehicle floor — commonly under the rear floor or beneath the passenger seat — to shorten overall vehicle length and free cabin space. Typically implemented with a low‑profile engine and transmission layout under the passenger or rear floor.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High Sill
description: Raised door/rear sill geometry that increases the vertical lift required to load or to enter/exit. Includes rear-sill 'lift-over' that raises the luggage lip and improves structural continuity, at the expense of reduced loading/access convenience. Typical design trade-off: better structural/integrity and potential styling cues versus decreased ease of cargo handling and boarding.
text:
名称：High Sill
描述：Raised door/rear sill geometry that increases the vertical lift required to load or to enter/exit. Includes rear-sill 'lift-over' that raises the luggage lip and improves structural continuity, at the expense of reduced loading/access convenience. Typical design trade-off: better structural/integrity and potential styling cues versus decreased ease of cargo handling and boarding.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: LowRideHeight (低坐姿)
description: 较低离地间隙与座椅位置，塑造运动化、低重心视觉效果。
text:
名称：LowRideHeight (低坐姿)
描述：较低离地间隙与座椅位置，塑造运动化、低重心视觉效果。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: SkidPlates (护板)
description: 车底防护板，强调耐用性与越野功能性的外观细节。
text:
名称：SkidPlates (护板)
描述：车底防护板，强调耐用性与越野功能性的外观细节。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Long S-curve side sweep (长S曲线侧扫)
description: 从前翼子板向车尾延伸的连续长S形曲线，用以拉长车身视觉长度并强化装饰感。
text:
名称：Long S-curve side sweep (长S曲线侧扫)
描述：从前翼子板向车尾延伸的连续长S形曲线，用以拉长车身视觉长度并强化装饰感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wire spoke wheels (钢丝辐条轮毂)
description: 复古钢丝辐条轮毂，视觉轻巧且能传达工艺感与经典赛车血统。
text:
名称：Wire spoke wheels (钢丝辐条轮毂)
描述：复古钢丝辐条轮毂，视觉轻巧且能传达工艺感与经典赛车血统。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Symmetric Lamp Layout
description: Two or four forward-facing lamps mounted symmetrically about the centerline, spaced as far apart as practical to meet photometric spread.
text:
名称：Symmetric Lamp Layout
描述：Two or four forward-facing lamps mounted symmetrically about the centerline, spaced as far apart as practical to meet photometric spread.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Trailing Arm Suspension
description: 后轮通过向前前置的摆臂铰接，摆臂常连成对并可由扭力梁（twist beam）链接以节省空间。
text:
名称：Trailing Arm Suspension
描述：后轮通过向前前置的摆臂铰接，摆臂常连成对并可由扭力梁（twist beam）链接以节省空间。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Stamped / Pressed steel panels
description: Steel body panels formed by industrial stamping/pressing in moulds; enable mass production with high precision, produce complex multi‑curvature shapes and deliver higher panel stiffness.
text:
名称：Stamped / Pressed steel panels
描述：Steel body panels formed by industrial stamping/pressing in moulds; enable mass production with high precision, produce complex multi‑curvature shapes and deliver higher panel stiffness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Premium Trim & Chrome Detailing
description: High-quality finishes and detailing that signal luxury positioning.
text:
名称：Premium Trim & Chrome Detailing
描述：High-quality finishes and detailing that signal luxury positioning.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: key styling lines
description: 贯穿车身的主造型线，用以表达体量、方向与动态。
text:
名称：key styling lines
描述：贯穿车身的主造型线，用以表达体量、方向与动态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Hierarchy of Drivers
description: 将组件分为驱动（主要影响比例）与从属（可随主导硬点调整），用于决策与冲突优先级。
text:
名称：Hierarchy of Drivers
描述：将组件分为驱动（主要影响比例）与从属（可随主导硬点调整），用于决策与冲突优先级。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Door action & range (Door opening width/angle)
description: Kinematics, available swing/clearance and opening width/angle of the door as built into mock-up.
text:
名称：Door action & range (Door opening width/angle)
描述：Kinematics, available swing/clearance and opening width/angle of the door as built into mock-up.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lines Converge Forward
description: 侧面多条平向线条在透视下呈向前汇聚，增强动感与前冲视觉效果。
text:
名称：Lines Converge Forward
描述：侧面多条平向线条在透视下呈向前汇聚，增强动感与前冲视觉效果。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 高级内饰材质与可视工艺
description: 皮革、绒面、环保高分子材料与精细缝线、装饰条组合
text:
名称：高级内饰材质与可视工艺
描述：皮革、绒面、环保高分子材料与精细缝线、装饰条组合

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Four-wheel brakes & hydraulic dampers (四轮制动与液压减震)
description: Mejoras de seguridad y confort que aumentan la percepción de calidad y facilidad de mantenimiento.
text:
名称：Four-wheel brakes & hydraulic dampers (四轮制动与液压减震)
描述：Mejoras de seguridad y confort que aumentan la percepción de calidad y facilidad de mantenimiento.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: BeamCutoff and Pattern Asymmetry
description: Low-beam pattern with a distinct horizontal/vertical cutoff and intentional lateral asymmetry to illuminate the right lane edge while reducing illumination toward oncoming traffic.
text:
名称：BeamCutoff and Pattern Asymmetry
描述：Low-beam pattern with a distinct horizontal/vertical cutoff and intentional lateral asymmetry to illuminate the right lane edge while reducing illumination toward oncoming traffic.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Voice-Activated Destination Entry
description: 语音交互选项，研究显示可显著降低分心指标。
text:
名称：Voice-Activated Destination Entry
描述：语音交互选项，研究显示可显著降低分心指标。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 品牌标识性元素（品牌签名元素）
description: 可跨车型延展的视觉符号与可识别细节，用于构建品牌记忆点与信任感，并将产品与品牌直接关联。例如特殊灯带、格栅造型或饰条等可识别细节。
text:
名称：品牌标识性元素（品牌签名元素）
描述：可跨车型延展的视觉符号与可识别细节，用于构建品牌记忆点与信任感，并将产品与品牌直接关联。例如特殊灯带、格栅造型或饰条等可识别细节。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Rear-wheel drive layout
description: Drive layout where the driven wheels are at the rear. Descriptions cover general RWD characteristics (longitudinal weight transfer, dynamic balance, potential oversteer) and early three‑wheel vehicles that used rear traction before the adoption of four wheels.
text:
名称：Rear-wheel drive layout
描述：Drive layout where the driven wheels are at the rear. Descriptions cover general RWD characteristics (longitudinal weight transfer, dynamic balance, potential oversteer) and early three‑wheel vehicles that used rear traction before the adoption of four wheels.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Shape Relationship Breakthrough (形态关系突破)
description: 在面与面、体块与体块之间创造新的连接或断裂方式以产生视觉新意。
text:
名称：Shape Relationship Breakthrough (形态关系突破)
描述：在面与面、体块与体块之间创造新的连接或断裂方式以产生视觉新意。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: CoupleDimension
description: Horizontal measure between H‑points used in early packaging to estimate rear knee and leg room.
text:
名称：CoupleDimension
描述：Horizontal measure between H‑points used in early packaging to estimate rear knee and leg room.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lens Cleanliness / Degradation
description: Soiling, oxidation and aging reduce lens transmittance causing lower effective beam output and changed beam shape.
text:
名称：Lens Cleanliness / Degradation
描述：Soiling, oxidation and aging reduce lens transmittance causing lower effective beam output and changed beam shape.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Shape
description: Overall silhouette, primary massing and volumetric geometry of the vehicle — including roofline, beltline, hood and trunk volumes — covering form, outline, lines and large-scale surfaces. Central to the silhouette and perceptual reading of the object; determines the immediate visual character and how the product's massing is perceived at first glance.
text:
名称：Shape
描述：Overall silhouette, primary massing and volumetric geometry of the vehicle — including roofline, beltline, hood and trunk volumes — covering form, outline, lines and large-scale surfaces. Central to the silhouette and perceptual reading of the object; determines the immediate visual character and how the product's massing is perceived at first glance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat pressure monitoring
description: 使用座垫压力传感阵列客观反映乘员受力分布，作为座椅舒适性与姿态调整的输入。
text:
名称：Seat pressure monitoring
描述：使用座垫压力传感阵列客观反映乘员受力分布，作为座椅舒适性与姿态调整的输入。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Comfortable rear seating with flat floor and reconfigurable layout
description: Design focus on rear passenger comfort and flexible interior packaging: cushioning and spacious rear accommodation enabled by larger trunk and central cabin placement, combined with a flat floor and reconfigurable/stowable seating layout to increase cargo flexibility (typical of MPVs).
text:
名称：Comfortable rear seating with flat floor and reconfigurable layout
描述：Design focus on rear passenger comfort and flexible interior packaging: cushioning and spacious rear accommodation enabled by larger trunk and central cabin placement, combined with a flat floor and reconfigurable/stowable seating layout to increase cargo flexibility (typical of MPVs).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 高轮眉落差（引擎盖明显高于轮眉）
description: 越野/豪华SUV用户偏好以提升力量感和行程裕量。
text:
名称：高轮眉落差（引擎盖明显高于轮眉）
描述：越野/豪华SUV用户偏好以提升力量感和行程裕量。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Flexible Interior Layout
description: Sliding, folding, removable or sliding seats and configurable storage to support multiple passenger and cargo configurations, improving accommodation, perceived space utility and operational efficiency. text:
名称：Flexible Interior Layout
描述：Sliding, folding, removable or sliding seats and configurable storage to support multiple passenger and cargo configurations, improving accommodation, perceived space utility and operational efficiency. Also includes reconfigurable 'lounge' cabin modes enabling relaxation, work or social use when driving is delegated to autonomous systems. / 可变座椅布局（滑动/折叠/可拆卸）和可配置储物，支持多种乘员与载物组合，提高车辆利用率与空间感；亦包含在自动驾驶场景下用于放松、办公或社交的休闲舱模式。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sandwich panels (honeycomb / sandwich construction)
description: Composite/multi-layer panels consisting of two thin face sheets separated by a core (commonly a honeycomb). Used to increase bending stiffness, tune NVH (acoustic damping) and improve overall structural stiffness.
text:
名称：Sandwich panels (honeycomb / sandwich construction)
描述：Composite/multi-layer panels consisting of two thin face sheets separated by a core (commonly a honeycomb). Used to increase bending stiffness, tune NVH (acoustic damping) and improve overall structural stiffness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: structuralHonesty
description: 在外观与布局中直观体现结构与功能关系，避免与功能冲突的装饰。
text:
名称：structuralHonesty
描述：在外观与布局中直观体现结构与功能关系，避免与功能冲突的装饰。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: BrassBodyFinish
description: Uso estético del latón pulido en superficies exteriores y adornos.
text:
名称：BrassBodyFinish
描述：Uso estético del latón pulido en superficies exteriores y adornos.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Clean flowing lines
description: 车身采用干净且连续的曲面与线条，减少突兀特征以改善美感与气动性能。
text:
名称：Clean flowing lines
描述：车身采用干净且连续的曲面与线条，减少突兀特征以改善美感与气动性能。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Adaptabilidad y sostenibilidad
description: Atributos demandados por el mercado que permiten anticiparse a nuevas exigencias.
text:
名称：Adaptabilidad y sostenibilidad
描述：Atributos demandados por el mercado que permiten anticiparse a nuevas exigencias.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Interactive feedback systems
description: Haptic, acoustic and visual feedback architectures that scaffold user experience over time.
text:
名称：Interactive feedback systems
描述：Haptic, acoustic and visual feedback architectures that scaffold user experience over time.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Loose Ideation Sketching
description: 以粗略草图和少量硬点启动包件布局，避免在早期陷入过多细节。

描述：以粗略草图和少量硬点启动包件布局，避免在早期陷入过多细节。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Bumper band vertical placement / Bumper band height

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Color (颜色属性)
description: 综合色彩属性，涵盖色相、饱和度与亮度的选择（Hue, saturation, brightness）、色彩饱和度与搭配策略（Colorfulness & Color harmony）、颜色多样性（Color variety）、以及由深/饱和色与浅/去饱和色产生的视觉重量感（ColorDensity）。另包含明暗强烈对比的表面处理（High Contrast Finish）对轮廓层次与静止/运动视觉效果的影响。总体用于塑造情绪与感知空间、提升视觉冲击力与品牌辨识度、增强造型可读性并满足表达性买家偏好。

text:
名称：ExposedWheels
描述：Ruedas claramente visibles fuera de la línea de la carrocería, con guardabarros separados.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Carriage-derived silhouette

text:
名称：Carriage-derived silhouette

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 局部—整体过渡处理（曲面连续性）

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Lamp Color

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

description: Visible cues in the side elevation that communicate a heavy or prominent powertrain (long hood, high bonnet, center tunnel prominence).
text:
名称：SideViewPowertrainDominance
描述：Visible cues in the side elevation that communicate a heavy or prominent powertrain (long hood, high bonnet, center tunnel prominence).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Brake cooling ducts
description: Ducts and openings that channel air to brake rotors; common on high-performance cars.
text:
名称：Brake cooling ducts
描述：Ducts and openings that channel air to brake rotors; common on high-performance cars.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 视角切换与基本模型控制
