text:
名称：视角切换与基本模型控制
描述：用于检视造型比例与姿态的基础交互手段。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Interior_Accessibility
description: Features to aid mobility: ramps, swivel seats, wide doors, low sill height
text:
名称：Interior_Accessibility
描述：Features to aid mobility: ramps, swivel seats, wide doors, low sill height

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: B-pillar removal
description: Design choice to remove or reduce the central pillar to create a larger side opening.
text:
名称：B-pillar removal
描述：Design choice to remove or reduce the central pillar to create a larger side opening.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Flash Frequency and Duty
description: 闪烁频率与开/关时长（占空比）是区分转向、警示等信号的重要视觉属性。
text:
名称：Flash Frequency and Duty
描述：闪烁频率与开/关时长（占空比）是区分转向、警示等信号的重要视觉属性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Flexible Manufacturing Capability
description: Plant and process capability to switch variants, support customization and short runs without large cost penalties.
text:
名称：Flexible Manufacturing Capability
描述：Plant and process capability to switch variants, support customization and short runs without large cost penalties.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Boxy passenger cell (盒式乘员舱)
description: 接近直立的A/B柱和接近矩形的车顶轮廓，形成方盒子式的乘员舱外廓。
text:
名称：Boxy passenger cell (盒式乘员舱)
描述：接近直立的A/B柱和接近矩形的车顶轮廓，形成方盒子式的乘员舱外廓。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Consistent control interface styling
description: Shared visual motifs, iconography, tactile cues and layout rules across control clusters to convey a single-design feel.
text:
名称：Consistent control interface styling
描述：Shared visual motifs, iconography, tactile cues and layout rules across control clusters to convey a single-design feel.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exterior Mirror
description: Overall exterior mirror design including mirror body contour, arm styling, integration of lighting, aerodynamic treatment, shape, mount, glass curvature, adjustability and placement/orientation. Determines lateral indirect mirror fields (LMF/RMF), angular coverage, virtual image location and mirror‑induced occlusions (e.g., seen on polar plots), while influencing sightlines, wind noise and vehicle styling.
text:
名称：Exterior Mirror
描述：Overall exterior mirror design including mirror body contour, arm styling, integration of lighting, aerodynamic treatment, shape, mount, glass curvature, adjustability and placement/orientation. Determines lateral indirect mirror fields (LMF/RMF), angular coverage, virtual image location and mirror‑induced occlusions (e.g., seen on polar plots), while influencing sightlines, wind noise and vehicle styling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Panel Break Lines
description: Visible seams and split lines between closures and body panels used deliberately to articulate surfaces and direct gaze.
text:
名称：Panel Break Lines
描述：Visible seams and split lines between closures and body panels used deliberately to articulate surfaces and direct gaze.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Connectivity & Data Integration
description: 车载大数据与互联网连接能力、云服务接入、OTA与数据驱动的人机交互。
text:
名称：Connectivity & Data Integration
描述：车载大数据与互联网连接能力、云服务接入、OTA与数据驱动的人机交互。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 标识性格栅形态
description: 格栅总体轮廓、肋条/网格处理、与灯组的界面关系等构成品牌识别要素。
text:
名称：标识性格栅形态
描述：格栅总体轮廓、肋条/网格处理、与灯组的界面关系等构成品牌识别要素。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Narrow frontal silhouette / Low frontal area
description: Visual and packaging choice to reduce frontal area and lower aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd), thereby improving aerodynamic efficiency and potentially increasing top speed. / 通过较小的正面轮廓与紧凑鼻部设计减少正面迎风面积，降低风阻系数（Cd），提升空气动力学效率并可能提高最高速度。
text:
名称：Narrow frontal silhouette / Low frontal area
描述：Visual and packaging choice to reduce frontal area and lower aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd), thereby improving aerodynamic efficiency and potentially increasing top speed. / 通过较小的正面轮廓与紧凑鼻部设计减少正面迎风面积，降低风阻系数（Cd），提升空气动力学效率并可能提高最高速度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Underbody and seat flexible packaging
description: Allows conversion between passenger and cargo uses in urban contexts.
text:
名称：Underbody and seat flexible packaging
描述：Allows conversion between passenger and cargo uses in urban contexts.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 前下倾斜
description: 整车前部向前下方倾斜（车顶/引擎盖呈前倾态势），以降低迎风截面并改变升力分布。
text:
名称：前下倾斜
描述：整车前部向前下方倾斜（车顶/引擎盖呈前倾态势），以降低迎风截面并改变升力分布。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Configurable Exterior Trims
description: 丰富的轮毂、包围、装饰件配置以实现差异化视觉效果。
text:
名称：Configurable Exterior Trims
描述：丰富的轮毂、包围、装饰件配置以实现差异化视觉效果。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 光带上扬形态
description: 日行灯或光导条的上扬或内收走向，用以表达俯冲、张力或优雅感。
text:
名称：光带上扬形态
描述：日行灯或光导条的上扬或内收走向，用以表达俯冲、张力或优雅感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High_Driver_Eye_Point
description: Driver eye position in heavy trucks typically >2.5 m above ground, creating sightline issues such as hiding small cars in front of long hoods and hiding near-lane objects below beltline.
text:
名称：High_Driver_Eye_Point
描述：Driver eye position in heavy trucks typically >2.5 m above ground, creating sightline issues such as hiding small cars in front of long hoods and hiding near-lane objects below beltline.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Light Source Type
description: 光源类型（白炽灯、卤素、氖、LED 等），决定电/光学响应与光输出特性。
text:
名称：Light Source Type
描述：光源类型（白炽灯、卤素、氖、LED 等），决定电/光学响应与光输出特性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Use of existing military gearbox (采用军用变速箱)
description: Component choice driven by cost/availability rather than refinement.
text:
名称：Use of existing military gearbox (采用军用变速箱)
描述：Component choice driven by cost/availability rather than refinement.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Dependent Suspension (solid axle)
description: Linkage where left and right wheels are connected and motion on one side affects the other.
text:
名称：Dependent Suspension (solid axle)
描述：Linkage where left and right wheels are connected and motion on one side affects the other.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: stretched_arch_roof_truncated_rear(延伸穹顶并截断尾部)
description: 将传统三厢车的车顶弧线向后拉伸并在后部垂直截断以扩展行李空间与后排头部空间。
text:
名称：stretched_arch_roof_truncated_rear(延伸穹顶并截断尾部)
描述：将传统三厢车的车顶弧线向后拉伸并在后部垂直截断以扩展行李空间与后排头部空间。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat rake and cowl slope
description: Combined design attributes (seat inclination and cowl/hood geometry) that determine forward and downward sightlines.
text:
名称：Seat rake and cowl slope
描述：Combined design attributes (seat inclination and cowl/hood geometry) that determine forward and downward sightlines.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Accommodative legroom & headroom
description: 座舱几何以涵盖更广泛身高与腿长范围，强调可调节性与富裕空间。
text:
名称：Accommodative legroom & headroom
描述：座舱几何以涵盖更广泛身高与腿长范围，强调可调节性与富裕空间。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visual-Manual Destination Entry
description: 需要在屏幕上进行查看与手动输入的目的地录入界面（传统触控/按键菜单）。
text:
名称：Visual-Manual Destination Entry
描述：需要在屏幕上进行查看与手动输入的目的地录入界面（传统触控/按键菜单）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Trimmed body opening
description: Vehicle body opening with plastic trim installed (e.g., door aperture), used as top datum for entrance height.
text:
名称：Trimmed body opening
描述：Vehicle body opening with plastic trim installed (e.g., door aperture), used as top datum for entrance height.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Bi-fuel Generator-Electric Architecture
description: Architecture using an internal combustion generator (possibly efficient diesel) to produce electricity to drive wheel motors; potential for cost reduction and suitability for smaller vehicles as technology matures.
text:
名称：Bi-fuel Generator-Electric Architecture
描述：Architecture using an internal combustion generator (possibly efficient diesel) to produce electricity to drive wheel motors; potential for cost reduction and suitability for smaller vehicles as technology matures.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Large exterior mirrors
description: Large flat exterior mirrors with increased mirror glass area and optimized mounting. Their large, unstreamlined frontal area can create flow separation and vortex shedding.
text:
名称：Large exterior mirrors
描述：Large flat exterior mirrors with increased mirror glass area and optimized mounting. Their large, unstreamlined frontal area can create flow separation and vortex shedding.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sharp Angular Front Face / 锐利棱角前脸
description: 强攻击感的前脸造型，带有平檐元素与多边形切面，象征狮的神韵。
text:
名称：Sharp Angular Front Face / 锐利棱角前脸
描述：强攻击感的前脸造型，带有平檐元素与多边形切面，象征狮的神韵。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 侧视优先与轮廓清晰 (Side View Emphasis & Clear Silhouette)
description: 在侧视图中明确车顶线、腰线、轮拱与前后悬关系，从而建立主要视觉印象与技术尺寸依据。
text:
名称：侧视优先与轮廓清晰 (Side View Emphasis & Clear Silhouette)
描述：在侧视图中明确车顶线、腰线、轮拱与前后悬关系，从而建立主要视觉印象与技术尺寸依据。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Rounded organic body
description: Bulbous, continuous curves over fenders and body, integrated rounded front end and soft transitions typical of late-1940s small cars.
text:
名称：Rounded organic body
描述：Bulbous, continuous curves over fenders and body, integrated rounded front end and soft transitions typical of late-1940s small cars.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Back_angle
description: Seatback recline angle of occupant; affects headroom, visibility and visual posture.
text:
名称：Back_angle
描述：Seatback recline angle of occupant; affects headroom, visibility and visual posture.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Bumper offset
description: Horizontal/forward projection of the bumper/fascia (visible profile) relative to surrounding surfaces so a pendulum or obstacle contacts the bumper first; also the offset between the bumper impact surface and the body/fascia to provide low-speed energy absorption.
text:
名称：Bumper offset
描述：Horizontal/forward projection of the bumper/fascia (visible profile) relative to surrounding surfaces so a pendulum or obstacle contacts the bumper first; also the offset between the bumper impact surface and the body/fascia to provide low-speed energy absorption.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Foot-to-Tire Clearance
description: Ergonomic relationship between driver foot position and wheel/tire; in long dash-to-axle layouts, foot swing interference is minimal.
text:
名称：Foot-to-Tire Clearance
描述：Ergonomic relationship between driver foot position and wheel/tire; in long dash-to-axle layouts, foot swing interference is minimal.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: CloseLoadPlacement
description: Attributes that enable loads to be held close to the torso (low bumper lip, recessed cargo well, sliding floor).
text:
名称：CloseLoadPlacement
描述：Attributes that enable loads to be held close to the torso (low bumper lip, recessed cargo well, sliding floor).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Overall Height
description: Measured overall vehicle height, accounting for roof structure and ride/ground clearance contribution; used for packaging, garage clearance and visual proportioning.
text:
名称：Overall Height
描述：Measured overall vehicle height, accounting for roof structure and ride/ground clearance contribution; used for packaging, garage clearance and visual proportioning.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: High roofline / tall greenhouse
description: Pronounced vertical cabin with generous headroom relative to overall length to maximize interior volume in a small footprint.
text:
名称：High roofline / tall greenhouse
描述：Pronounced vertical cabin with generous headroom relative to overall length to maximize interior volume in a small footprint.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Inside rearview mirror - lower edge placement(内后视镜下缘高度)
description: 将后视镜下缘置于高于95th眼点至少20 mm的位置，减小遮挡。
text:
名称：Inside rearview mirror - lower edge placement(内后视镜下缘高度)
描述：将后视镜下缘置于高于95th眼点至少20 mm的位置，减小遮挡。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ExteriorModeledOverPackage
description: Exterior surfaces are developed over the established packaging hard points rather than arbitrary styling first.
text:
名称：ExteriorModeledOverPackage
描述：Exterior surfaces are developed over the established packaging hard points rather than arbitrary styling first.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HiddenSensorSurface
description: Sensors located behind transparent or body-colored panels, flush housings and dedicated sensor bands that reduce visual clutter while preserving field of view.
text:
名称：HiddenSensorSurface
描述：Sensors located behind transparent or body-colored panels, flush housings and dedicated sensor bands that reduce visual clutter while preserving field of view.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Minimal Ornamentation
description: Low level of applied decorative motifs; emphasis on material and form rather than surface decoration.
text:
名称：Minimal Ornamentation
描述：Low level of applied decorative motifs; emphasis on material and form rather than surface decoration.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 视觉冲击力
description: 强烈的第一视觉吸引力或视觉印象，通过比例、造型对比与尺度感带来情绪化反应，能够在展厅或路上迅速吸引注意力并激发消费者兴趣。
text:
名称：视觉冲击力
描述：强烈的第一视觉吸引力或视觉印象，通过比例、造型对比与尺度感带来情绪化反应，能够在展厅或路上迅速吸引注意力并激发消费者兴趣。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Rugged Body Cladding
description: Protective cladding and pronounced wheel-arch surrounds.
text:
名称：Rugged Body Cladding
描述：Protective cladding and pronounced wheel-arch surrounds.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Few Side Creases
description: 侧面棱线数量较少，通常保留主腰线与1条副线。
text:
名称：Few Side Creases
描述：侧面棱线数量较少，通常保留主腰线与1条副线。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Polar angular mapping (θ, φ)
description: Representation of objects and apertures in angular coordinates from eye points; enables direct angular measurement of obstructions and sight-lines.
text:
名称：Polar angular mapping (θ, φ)
描述：Representation of objects and apertures in angular coordinates from eye points; enables direct angular measurement of obstructions and sight-lines.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Control Size
description: Physical size or dimensions of controls (e.g., knobs, buttons, touch targets), including physical diameter or active area; affects target width, graspability, visibility and ease of acquisition.
text:
名称：Control Size
描述：Physical size or dimensions of controls (e.g., knobs, buttons, touch targets), including physical diameter or active area; affects target width, graspability, visibility and ease of acquisition.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Control layout (hand & foot controls)
description: Placement of steering, pedals, stalks, buttons and displays relative to eye, hand and foot reference positions.
text:
名称：Control layout (hand & foot controls)
描述：Placement of steering, pedals, stalks, buttons and displays relative to eye, hand and foot reference positions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: increased_width
description: 加宽车体以补偿缩短长度后的体积损失
text:
名称：increased_width
描述：加宽车体以补偿缩短长度后的体积损失

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Brake Signal Temporal Profile
description: 制动信号在时间域的表现（突增幅度、持续时间、是否闪烁等），用以传达减速或紧急制动。
text:
名称：Brake Signal Temporal Profile
描述：制动信号在时间域的表现（突增幅度、持续时间、是否闪烁等），用以传达减速或紧急制动。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Side mirror field of view enlargement(外后视镜视场增大)
description: 通过镜面尺寸/曲率或调整安装位置来增大镜面视场。
text:
名称：Side mirror field of view enlargement(外后视镜视场增大)
描述：通过镜面尺寸/曲率或调整安装位置来增大镜面视场。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 封闭车身（车厢、车门、车窗）
description: 完整封闭的车舱结构，带门窗，隔绝风雨，提高舒适性。
text:
名称：封闭车身（车厢、车门、车窗）
描述：完整封闭的车舱结构，带门窗，隔绝风雨，提高舒适性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sliding door
description: 沿直线水平导轨滑动以完全打开，无外摆臂，提升在狭小环境下的上下车与装载灵活性；常见于厢式车、MPV/面包车和商用车辆。Runs on a straight horizontal track to open fully without outboard swing, increasing ingress/egress and loading flexibility in tight environments; common on minivans, MPVs and commercial vehicles.
text:
名称：Sliding door
描述：沿直线水平导轨滑动以完全打开，无外摆臂，提升在狭小环境下的上下车与装载灵活性；常见于厢式车、MPV/面包车和商用车辆。Runs on a straight horizontal track to open fully without outboard swing, increasing ingress/egress and loading flexibility in tight environments; common on minivans, MPVs and commercial vehicles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Visible Aperture Outlines
description: Deliberately pronounced door and hatch outlines used as a styling motif to emphasize segmentation and functionality.
text:
名称：Visible Aperture Outlines
描述：Deliberately pronounced door and hatch outlines used as a styling motif to emphasize segmentation and functionality.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Sand / light yellow paint
description: Early production color choice driven by availability of leftover varnish from occupation-era vehicle finishes.
text:
名称：Sand / light yellow paint
描述：Early production color choice driven by availability of leftover varnish from occupation-era vehicle finishes.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: FlexibleOLEDPanel(柔性OLED面板)
description: 见上
text:
名称：FlexibleOLEDPanel(柔性OLED面板)
描述：见上

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 移动App与交互界面
description: 预约、搜索、支付、导航、个性化推荐等功能
text:
名称：移动App与交互界面
描述：预约、搜索、支付、导航、个性化推荐等功能

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: EngineOverDrivenWheels
description: Mass of engine located directly above the driven axle (typically front for FWD).
text:
名称：EngineOverDrivenWheels
描述：Mass of engine located directly above the driven axle (typically front for FWD).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Smooth Surface Treatment
description: Design and material treatments that create large, uninterrupted, smooth panels and interfaces: hidden/flush door handles, reduced trim and visible fasteners, bonded assemblies without spot-weld impressions, merged seams and softened creases to strengthen streamlined, technological appearance. Also includes surface treatments and material choices for stain resistance and ease of cleaning to maintain long-term appearance.
text:
名称：Smooth Surface Treatment

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Hood / Bonnet (发动机舱盖)
description: Vehicle hood (bonnet) design including: 1) muscular hood lines — pronounced sculpted/tendon-like lines that run from front to rear to emphasize power and athleticism; 2) faux/stylistic hood — visual hood elements added to evoke a long-hood/front-engine aesthetic when packaging does not require it; and 3) overall hood proportion and surface treatment that influence perceived center of gravity, sportiness and visual weight. / 车辆发动机舱盖（车头盖）设计要素，包括：1）肌理线条（hood tendons）——从前向后延展的饱满有力的雕刻线条，强调力量感与运动气质；2）伪装/视觉车盖（faux hood）——为营造长机舱/前置发动机的视觉效果而加入的装饰性车盖元素；3）舱盖的比例与表面处理会影响视觉重心、运动感与整体视觉重量感。
text:
名称：Hood / Bonnet (发动机舱盖)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Front Overhang (前悬长, FOH)
description: Distance from the front wheel center/axle line to the foremost vehicle edge (leading bumper). It is both a packaging metric and a visual styling attribute. Long/extended overhangs elongate the bonnet/hood area (often due to longitudinal engine/transaxle layout) and create a forward-stretched appearance; short overhangs reduce the distance for a compact, dynamic look; shortening front/rear overhangs improves wheelbase utilization and urban maneuverability. 前悬长指车头轮心/轮轴线至车身最前端之间的距离，既是包装尺寸也是造型要素：长/延长前悬会拉长引擎盖区域（常由纵置动力总成引起），短前悬使车辆更紧凑、更具动感；前后悬缩短则有利于提升轴距利用率与城市机动性。
text:

Edge radius affects airflow switching, visual sharpness and manufacturing feasibility; targets at visible joins are often smaller (e.g., 0.5–3.0 mm). Gap sizes typically require tight tolerances or sealing to prevent leakage.

Influences weight, stiffness, crash performance and manufacturing constraints.

description: Parameters governing rear cross-section reduction, rear roof slope and rear-end taper that affect wake size, pressure drag and overall drag coefficient; influences hatch/cargo packaging and wheel/fender integration. Gentle slope and smooth taper promote attached flow and reduce wake and pressure drag. Design targets commonly fall in the 5–12° range for production vehicles, though geometry can extend up to ~45° depending on packaging and styling. Often considered alongside bonnet slope for overall vehicle profile balance.

label: DesignParameter(设计参数)
name: Driver Fore-Aft Position
description: Longitudinal (fore–aft) coordinate of the driver's seating reference relative to a vehicle datum (e.g., wheel centreline, front spindle or front axle). Positive values indicate the driver positioned forward of the datum. Range and reference datum may vary by vehicle architecture; typical highway/passenger vehicles use smaller offsets (commonly up to ~300 mm) while packaging definitions can extend up to ~1000 mm depending on measurement datum.
text:

label: DesignParameter(设计参数)
name: Front/Rear Overhang Length (前/后悬长度)
description: 车轮中心到车头/车尾外缘的距离，影响车辆视觉紧凑度、行驶动态感、尾部气流分离与后轴负载分配，并决定后备箱容积与开口尺寸。根据各数据源，前悬典型约为0.6–1.1 m（600–1100 mm），后悬典型约为400–1000 mm，整体可归类为短至中等（short–medium/短悬）。

名称：Front/Rear Overhang Length (前/后悬长度)

label: DesignParameter(设计参数)

description: Lateral/longitudinal clearances between the door/A-pillar area and the front wheelhouse structure that enable a person's feet to pass when entering/exiting and to step into and swing into the seat. The two measurements refer to different reference points: the A-pillar-to-wheelhouse gap is the local gap adjacent to the A-pillar/wheelhouse (often smaller, 0–200 mm), while the door-to-wheelhouse clearance is the lateral space between inner door trim and wheelhouse lip required for stepping/maneuvering (commonly ≥300 mm). Values are design-dependent; always confirm which measurement point is referenced when applying dimensions.

描述：Flat capacitive multi-touch displays that integrate display and input functions (combined control-display). They replace CRTs and many mechanical controls in the center stack and console, enable multi-touch gestures and mode switching, and require integrated interaction design for identifying state and control embedding. This shift was driven by consumer mobile/PC interfaces and in-vehicle device integration.

Used to control head support and rearward occlusion.

description: Vehicle stance and proportion that facilitate sliding into or out of the seat with minimal vertical lift, easing ingress/egress.
text:
名称：Accessible low-step posture
描述：Vehicle stance and proportion that facilitate sliding into or out of the seat with minimal vertical lift, easing ingress/egress.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Futuristic Avant-garde
description: Perceived as technologically forward, sleek and concept-driven; metallic finishes often support this association.
text:
名称：Futuristic Avant-garde
描述：Perceived as technologically forward, sleek and concept-driven; metallic finishes often support this association.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low & Sporty
description: Low ride height and aggressive, stretched proportions — typical of coupes and sports cars.
text:
名称：Low & Sporty
描述：Low ride height and aggressive, stretched proportions — typical of coupes and sports cars.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前脸稳重(Front Massiveness)
description: 车辆前部视觉占比和重量感，受格栅尺寸、灯组宽度与横向线条影响。
text:
名称：前脸稳重(Front Massiveness)
描述：车辆前部视觉占比和重量感，受格栅尺寸、灯组宽度与横向线条影响。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 大空间舒适
description: 长轴距、箱体化车身、稳重大气的姿态，传递家用舒适与成熟感
text:
名称：大空间舒适
描述：长轴距、箱体化车身、稳重大气的姿态，传递家用舒适与成熟感

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SurfaceProportions / Scaled Visual Proportions (表面比例 / 按比例的视觉姿态)
description: Visual proportions and perceived curvature of body panels determined by build-up thickness and sculpting allowance; when applied to drawings, represents the vehicle's overall visual posture as presented at the selected drawing scale. 基于面板堆厚和雕刻余量决定的视觉比例与感知曲率；在绘图中则表示按所选绘图比例呈现的车辆整体视觉姿态与比例感。
text:
名称：SurfaceProportions / Scaled Visual Proportions (表面比例 / 按比例的视觉姿态)
描述：Visual proportions and perceived curvature of body panels determined by build-up thickness and sculpting allowance; when applied to drawings, represents the vehicle's overall visual posture as presented at the selected drawing scale. 基于面板堆厚和雕刻余量决定的视觉比例与感知曲率；在绘图中则表示按所选绘图比例呈现的车辆整体视觉姿态与比例感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sitting upright
description: Erect torso alignment used as reference in many anthropometric surveys; produces larger vertical sitting height and eye height than slumped posture.
text:
名称：Sitting upright
描述：Erect torso alignment used as reference in many anthropometric surveys; produces larger vertical sitting height and eye height than slumped posture.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Midsize Car
description: Intermediate proportions with comfortable front and rear seat space for two rows.
text:
名称：Midsize Car
描述：Intermediate proportions with comfortable front and rear seat space for two rows.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat width / Hip room (座椅宽度/臀部空间)
description: 座椅横向有效宽度，直接影响乘员髋部承托与舒适性。Lateral seating space to accommodate hip breadth and sliding posture; affects hip support and overall comfort.
text:
名称：Seat width / Hip room (座椅宽度/臀部空间)
描述：座椅横向有效宽度，直接影响乘员髋部承托与舒适性。Lateral seating space to accommodate hip breadth and sliding posture; affects hip support and overall comfort.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Short driver sightline / open cockpit posture
description: Interior and exterior posture that prioritizes short (e.g., 5th percentile) driver sightlines via a low dash and open cockpit layout; affects perceived hood length, ergonomics, glare behavior and requires IPA adjustments to balance visibility and styling.
text:
名称：Short driver sightline / open cockpit posture
描述：Interior and exterior posture that prioritizes short (e.g., 5th percentile) driver sightlines via a low dash and open cockpit layout; affects perceived hood length, ergonomics, glare behavior and requires IPA adjustments to balance visibility and styling.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Taller seating posture
description: Upright seating with higher H‑point relative to the heel, adopted to ease ingress/egress and short‑distance driving tasks.
text:
名称：Taller seating posture
描述：Upright seating with higher H‑point relative to the heel, adopted to ease ingress/egress and short‑distance driving tasks.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Ingress / Egress posture
description: Overall body stance during entry and exit (head position, torso bend, leg motion) as perceived visually and functionally; influences door opening, sill height and seat position design.
text:
名称：Ingress / Egress posture
描述：Overall body stance during entry and exit (head position, torso bend, leg motion) as perceived visually and functionally; influences door opening, sill height and seat position design.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Light, agile / compact low-mass stance
description: 通过纤细的前后悬、窄质感的质量提示与紧凑的包装来传达轻量与敏捷性，伴随较低的未簧质量以提升操控灵活性和响应性。
text:
名称：Light, agile / compact low-mass stance
描述：通过纤细的前后悬、窄质感的质量提示与紧凑的包装来传达轻量与敏捷性，伴随较低的未簧质量以提升操控灵活性和响应性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Future-facing Posture
description: Proportions and stance that explore advanced technology packaging and novel form languages; requires high-fidelity representation.
text:
名称：Future-facing Posture
描述：Proportions and stance that explore advanced technology packaging and novel form languages; requires high-fidelity representation.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 分层深度尾部姿态 (Layered-depth Rear Stance)
description: 同上
text:
名称：分层深度尾部姿态 (Layered-depth Rear Stance)
描述：同上

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 雕塑感体量姿态
description: 体现为富有体量感、感性饱满的侧面造型。
text:
名称：雕塑感体量姿态
描述：体现为富有体量感、感性饱满的侧面造型。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear-obscured posture
description: Posture where an external-mounted spare (on swinggate) intrudes into the rear visual field, affecting perceived openness and visibility.
text:
名称：Rear-obscured posture
描述：Posture where an external-mounted spare (on swinggate) intrudes into the rear visual field, affecting perceived openness and visibility.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 未来科技感姿态 / 极简未来直立姿态 (Futuristic Minimalist Tech Upright Stance)
description: 低矮引擎盖、宽轮距、短悬伸与贯穿光带，配以极简线面、抽象化灯组和几何化面板；通过竖向识别件与相对收窄的格栅表现直立、前移的视觉重心。整体视觉强调科技感、紧凑与动感，同时传达高级感。
text:
名称：未来科技感姿态 / 极简未来直立姿态 (Futuristic Minimalist Tech Upright Stance)
描述：低矮引擎盖、宽轮距、短悬伸与贯穿光带，配以极简线面、抽象化灯组和几何化面板；通过竖向识别件与相对收窄的格栅表现直立、前移的视觉重心。整体视觉强调科技感、紧凑与动感，同时传达高级感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 洁净极简姿态
description: 侧面线条被弱化或消除，车辆呈现平滑、极简的姿态。
text:
名称：洁净极简姿态
描述：侧面线条被弱化或消除，车辆呈现平滑、极简的姿态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Physical/Visual/Functional Grouping
description: Grouping related controls and displays by physical proximity, visual similarity, or shared function to communicate relationships.
text:
名称：Physical/Visual/Functional Grouping
描述：Grouping related controls and displays by physical proximity, visual similarity, or shared function to communicate relationships.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-seated posture / Rearward-seated tall posture (高坐姿 / 后移坐姿—高个驾驶员)
description: 一种以较高座姿为特征的车辆姿态，包含后移坐姿（为高个驾驶员将座椅后移以获得足够腿部空间）以及高坐姿SUV姿态（较高离地间隙、直立车身、较短下摆角/接近角）。座椅位置是形成后移坐姿的关键参数之一；高坐姿同时传达较强的通过性与视觉力量感。
text:
名称：High-seated posture / Rearward-seated tall posture (高坐姿 / 后移坐姿—高个驾驶员)
描述：一种以较高座姿为特征的车辆姿态，包含后移坐姿（为高个驾驶员将座椅后移以获得足够腿部空间）以及高坐姿SUV姿态（较高离地间隙、直立车身、较短下摆角/接近角）。座椅位置是形成后移坐姿的关键参数之一；高坐姿同时传达较强的通过性与视觉力量感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 圆润稳重流线姿态
description: 侧面以柔和连续曲线为主，整体视觉饱满且亲和，呈现稳重的流线造型；强调流畅性与空气动力学优先，低阻设计带来更好的风阻表现。
text:
名称：圆润稳重流线姿态
描述：侧面以柔和连续曲线为主，整体视觉饱满且亲和，呈现稳重的流线造型；强调流畅性与空气动力学优先，低阻设计带来更好的风阻表现。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung Sporty Stance
description: Low-slung sporty stance characterized by a low overall height and roofline, long hood/bonnet, wide track, low seating position and tight wheel packaging (minimal wheel gap). Conveys a planted, aggressive and athletic silhouette with forward visual momentum; includes variants emphasizing tight wheel arches, stretched proportions and front-lowered appearance. （低矮车顶/车身、长前引擎罩、宽轮距、低坐姿和紧凑轮廓，形成稳定且侵略性的运动造型，包含前低/紧致轮拱等变体。）
text:
名称：Low-slung Sporty Stance
描述：Low-slung sporty stance characterized by a low overall height and roofline, long hood/bonnet, wide track, low seating position and tight wheel packaging (minimal wheel gap). Conveys a planted, aggressive and athletic silhouette with forward visual momentum; includes variants emphasizing tight wheel arches, stretched proportions and front-lowered appearance. （低矮车顶/车身、长前引擎罩、宽轮距、低坐姿和紧凑轮廓，形成稳定且侵略性的运动造型，包含前低/紧致轮拱等变体。）

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Compensatory/Problem Posture
description: Forward-leaning, reaching or twisted postures caused by insufficient adjustability or poor packaging; associated with discomfort over time.
text:
名称：Compensatory/Problem Posture
描述：Forward-leaning, reaching or twisted postures caused by insufficient adjustability or poor packaging; associated with discomfort over time.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Off-road Stance (越野姿态)
description: Elevated, tall/upright silhouette with high ground clearance, significant wheel-arch-to-body gap, greater wheel travel, robust wheel articulation, wide track, short front overhang and high approach angle, visually and functionally conveying off-road capability and improved passability. 短前悬、高离地、直立车身、较大轮拱间隙、较长轮行程、坚固的轮动性、宽轨距与稳定轮廓，视觉与功能上均表现出越野通过性。
text:
名称：Off-road Stance (越野姿态)
描述：Elevated, tall/upright silhouette with high ground clearance, significant wheel-arch-to-body gap, greater wheel travel, robust wheel articulation, wide track, short front overhang and high approach angle, visually and functionally conveying off-road capability and improved passability. 短前悬、高离地、直立车身、较大轮拱间隙、较长轮行程、坚固的轮动性、宽轨距与稳定轮廓，视觉与功能上均表现出越野通过性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ReducedBendingPosture
description: Posture with decreased trunk flexion and lower lumbar disc loading during loading/unloading.
text:
名称：ReducedBendingPosture
描述：Posture with decreased trunk flexion and lower lumbar disc loading during loading/unloading.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: PremiumStance
description: 低重心、宽体、精致细节，传达豪华与精工感的车辆姿态。
text:
名称：PremiumStance
描述：低重心、宽体、精致细节，传达豪华与精工感的车辆姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ZeroRollSteer
description: 滚动时无前束变化，从而无由滚动引发的车轮转向偏差（roll steer=0）。
text:
名称：ZeroRollSteer
描述：滚动时无前束变化，从而无由滚动引发的车轮转向偏差（roll steer=0）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 进攻性前卫姿态
description: 车身线条富有动感、角度感与雕塑化处理，视觉上有冲击力与先锋感。
text:
名称：进攻性前卫姿态
描述：车身线条富有动感、角度感与雕塑化处理，视觉上有冲击力与先锋感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Futuristic technological stance (未来科技感)
description: A stance characterized by smooth, continuous surfaces, refined proportions and a high‑tech visual language; emphasizes simplicity, technology and digital‑interaction cues. / 强调简洁、科技氛围与数字化交互，特征为流畅连续的曲面、精致的比例和高科技视觉语言。
text:
名称：Futuristic technological stance (未来科技感)
描述：A stance characterized by smooth, continuous surfaces, refined proportions and a high‑tech visual language; emphasizes simplicity, technology and digital‑interaction cues. / 强调简洁、科技氛围与数字化交互，特征为流畅连续的曲面、精致的比例和高科技视觉语言。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Door Aperture Cleanliness
description: Visual and dimensional cleanliness of door openings, seams and gaps; fewer visible elements and tidy closures.
text:
名称：Door Aperture Cleanliness
描述：Visual and dimensional cleanliness of door openings, seams and gaps; fewer visible elements and tidy closures.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Calm & Balanced
description: 视觉上以平稳、对称与低视觉重心为主，强调可靠与日常适用性
text:
名称：Calm & Balanced
描述：视觉上以平稳、对称与低视觉重心为主，强调可靠与日常适用性

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Slumped sitting
description: Relaxed pelvis/torso angle reducing vertical sitting height and eye height compared with erect sitting; common source of underestimation when used implicitly.
text:
名称：Slumped sitting
描述：Relaxed pelvis/torso angle reducing vertical sitting height and eye height compared with erect sitting; common source of underestimation when used implicitly.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Frontal symmetric stance
description: Balanced, centered frontal appearance resulting from symmetrical placement of lamps and other frontal elements.
text:
名称：Frontal symmetric stance
描述：Balanced, centered frontal appearance resulting from symmetrical placement of lamps and other frontal elements.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Neutral Seated Posture
description: Driver seated with minimal head/torso movement.
text:
名称：Neutral Seated Posture
描述：Driver seated with minimal head/torso movement.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: FlatFloorStance
description: Visual stance characterized by a flat interior floor, lower overall profile and compact overhangs, common in EV packaging.
text:
名称：FlatFloorStance
描述：Visual stance characterized by a flat interior floor, lower overall profile and compact overhangs, common in EV packaging.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Forward-Thrusting
description: 通过长轴距、短前后悬和上扬腰线营造前冲动势与动感
text:
名称：Forward-Thrusting
描述：通过长轴距、短前后悬和上扬腰线营造前冲动势与动感

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-riding muscular stance / 高坐姿 (High stance)
description: 高离地、宽轮距、短悬/长引擎罩的车身比例，轮拱明显，整体呈肌肉化高坐姿；视觉上给予强烈的越野感与通过性印象。 (High ground clearance, wide track, short overhangs with a long-hood proportion and pronounced wheel arches, presenting a muscular high stance that visually conveys a strong off-road and go-anywhere impression.)
text:
名称：High-riding muscular stance / 高坐姿 (High stance)
描述：高离地、宽轮距、短悬/长引擎罩的车身比例，轮拱明显，整体呈肌肉化高坐姿；视觉上给予强烈的越野感与通过性印象。 (High ground clearance, wide track, short overhangs with a long-hood proportion and pronounced wheel arches, presenting a muscular high stance that visually conveys a strong off-road and go-anywhere impression.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: FootPlacement
description: Positioning and movement of feet when stepping into/out of the vehicle.
text:
名称：FootPlacement
描述：Positioning and movement of feet when stepping into/out of the vehicle.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-speed maneuvering / utilitarian posture
description: Posture focused on slow-speed operation that combines maneuverability and practical function: vehicle wheel angle, steering input and response during low-speed turning with associated driver perception of steering torque, together with accessibility-oriented, upright seating and visible mechanical packaging.
text:
名称：Low-speed maneuvering / utilitarian posture
描述：Posture focused on slow-speed operation that combines maneuverability and practical function: vehicle wheel angle, steering input and response during low-speed turning with associated driver perception of steering torque, together with accessibility-oriented, upright seating and visible mechanical packaging.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Expressive front face (aggressive / friendly / signature)
description: Visual stance of the car's front or rear as interpreted based on lighting geometry (e.g., narrow aggressive eyes vs wide friendly eyes).
text:
名称：Expressive front face (aggressive / friendly / signature)
描述：Visual stance of the car's front or rear as interpreted based on lighting geometry (e.g., narrow aggressive eyes vs wide friendly eyes).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Epicyclic Gearset Packaging Advantage
description: 行星齿系允许在相对较小空间内实现更多档位，从而提高档位数密度。
text:
名称：Epicyclic Gearset Packaging Advantage
描述：行星齿系允许在相对较小空间内实现更多档位，从而提高档位数密度。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: RobustFunctional
description: Tall, capable stance associated with off-road and commercial vehicles emphasizing durability and utility.
text:
名称：RobustFunctional
描述：Tall, capable stance associated with off-road and commercial vehicles emphasizing durability and utility.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung Streamlined Posture / 低矮流线姿态
description: 以低矮车顶与低重心、拉长车身比例、平滑曲线与收束尾部为主要特征，强调空气动力学性能与低风阻（如减小迎风面积、倾斜A柱、平滑过渡），在视觉上传达速度感、运动性与效率，可涵盖从精致流线的日常低阻设计到偏赛道化的低趴造型。
text:
名称：Low-slung Streamlined Posture / 低矮流线姿态
描述：以低矮车顶与低重心、拉长车身比例、平滑曲线与收束尾部为主要特征，强调空气动力学性能与低风阻（如减小迎风面积、倾斜A柱、平滑过渡），在视觉上传达速度感、运动性与效率，可涵盖从精致流线的日常低阻设计到偏赛道化的低趴造型。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Occupant postures and framing
description: Covers the range of postures observed in the population (ergonomically neutral to compensatory due to poor fit) and how occupants are perceived within and related to the vehicle's form. Emphasizes visibility, proportion and framing of occupants within the cabin and how fit influences posture.
text:
名称：Occupant postures and framing
描述：Covers the range of postures observed in the population (ergonomically neutral to compensatory due to poor fit) and how occupants are perceived within and related to the vehicle's form. Emphasizes visibility, proportion and framing of occupants within the cabin and how fit influences posture.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Off-road packaging posture
description: Exterior/interior stance indicating robust drivetrain packaging with higher center console and possible raised hip points.
text:
名称：Off-road packaging posture
描述：Exterior/interior stance indicating robust drivetrain packaging with higher center console and possible raised hip points.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Balanced tapered rear stance(收束平衡的尾部姿态)
description: 后端收束、短后悬所呈现的紧凑而稳健的视觉姿态。
text:
名称：Balanced tapered rear stance(收束平衡的尾部姿态)
描述：后端收束、短后悬所呈现的紧凑而稳健的视觉姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ElevatedRobustStance (高而稳健的姿态)
description: 较高车身、宽轮拱与较大轮胎产生的稳重与越野感视觉印象。
text:
名称：ElevatedRobustStance (高而稳健的姿态)
描述：较高车身、宽轮拱与较大轮胎产生的稳重与越野感视觉印象。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Hands-off autonomous stance
description: See above.
text:
名称：Hands-off autonomous stance
描述：See above.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-and-central-mass posture
description: Stance characterized by heavy components mounted low and near the vehicle centerline to reduce roll and improve handling consistency.
text:
名称：Low-and-central-mass posture
描述：Stance characterized by heavy components mounted low and near the vehicle centerline to reduce roll and improve handling consistency.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Mass-market stance vs Niche/customized stance（大众化姿态 vs 定制化姿态）
description: 根据生产策略不同呈现出偏向成本效率的紧凑姿态或偏向个性化的独特姿态。
text:
名称：Mass-market stance vs Niche/customized stance（大众化姿态 vs 定制化姿态）
描述：根据生产策略不同呈现出偏向成本效率的紧凑姿态或偏向个性化的独特姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Elevated Rear Seating (Theater Posture)
description: Rear occupants seated higher relative to front occupants to improve forward visibility and perceived interior space (theatre seating).
text:
名称：Elevated Rear Seating (Theater Posture)
描述：Rear occupants seated higher relative to front occupants to improve forward visibility and perceived interior space (theatre seating).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seam Quality
description: Visual and tactile finish of stitched or joined edges including alignment, stitch pitch and gap consistency.
text:
名称：Seam Quality
描述：Visual and tactile finish of stitched or joined edges including alignment, stitch pitch and gap consistency.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low, Compact Instrument Stance
description: Instrument cluster is visually low and compact, concentrating information below driver's horizontal sightline.
text:
名称：Low, Compact Instrument Stance
描述：Instrument cluster is visually low and compact, concentrating information below driver's horizontal sightline.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sleek forward-leaning posture
description: Visual stance created by a steep windshield rake and low roofline that emphasizes motion and athleticism. Conveys dynamic forward momentum but can reduce forward field of view at typical eye points.
text:
名称：Sleek forward-leaning posture
描述：Visual stance created by a steep windshield rake and low roofline that emphasizes motion and athleticism. Conveys dynamic forward momentum but can reduce forward field of view at typical eye points.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear-biased (rear-heavy) stance
description: Vehicle posture with greater perceived or actual mass toward the rear axle. Visual cues include short front overhang, proportionally wider or bulkier rear massing, compact cabin forward of the rear axle, recessed or deep rear lamp treatments that increase perceived rear depth, and rear packaging (fuel tank, cargo) raising rear floor—all contributing to a rearward visual center of gravity. Can be present in vehicles with rear or conventional engine layouts; may influence brake circuit layout and handling characteristics.
text:
名称：Rear-biased (rear-heavy) stance
描述：Vehicle posture with greater perceived or actual mass toward the rear axle. Visual cues include short front overhang, proportionally wider or bulkier rear massing, compact cabin forward of the rear axle, recessed or deep rear lamp treatments that increase perceived rear depth, and rear packaging (fuel tank, cargo) raising rear floor—all contributing to a rearward visual center of gravity. Can be present in vehicles with rear or conventional engine layouts; may influence brake circuit layout and handling characteristics.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Distinctive Stance with Heritage Cues（带有历史线索的独特姿态）
description: 带有品牌历史特征的车身姿态，例如经典低矮优雅或方正实用的家族特征。
text:
名称：Distinctive Stance with Heritage Cues（带有历史线索的独特姿态）
描述：带有品牌历史特征的车身姿态，例如经典低矮优雅或方正实用的家族特征。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Robust / Protective / High‑Stiffness Stance
description: A visual and functional stance conveying strength, durability and occupant protection. Characterized by high visual mass and upright proportions (often with larger wheels, visible chassis cues or long overhangs), tactile indicators of build quality (fit, surface finish, corrosion protection) and structural honesty typical of trucks and utility vehicles. Functionally linked to high torsional stiffness so the body shows minimal distortion under load, preserving alignment and a solid, durable appearance.
text:
名称：Robust / Protective / High‑Stiffness Stance
描述：A visual and functional stance conveying strength, durability and occupant protection. Characterized by high visual mass and upright proportions (often with larger wheels, visible chassis cues or long overhangs), tactile indicators of build quality (fit, surface finish, corrosion protection) and structural honesty typical of trucks and utility vehicles. Functionally linked to high torsional stiffness so the body shows minimal distortion under load, preserving alignment and a solid, durable appearance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ReferenceStance
description: 基于竞品与自有车型比较而形成的姿态感知：宽肩、低矮或高腰等视觉比例。
text:
名称：ReferenceStance
描述：基于竞品与自有车型比较而形成的姿态感知：宽肩、低矮或高腰等视觉比例。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Elongated posture (拉伸/前部拉长/具体量感)
description: 由长轴距结合不同前后悬比例（如较短前后悬或明显拉长的引擎盖）形成的拉伸视觉效果。可表现为车身延展且重心稳定的稳重感，或因前部占比增大而产生重心前移、庄重与力量感，并伴随明显的体量感与纤长感。典型特征包括延展的侧面线条、显著的前部比例与强烈的视觉体量。
text:
名称：Elongated posture (拉伸/前部拉长/具体量感)
描述：由长轴距结合不同前后悬比例（如较短前后悬或明显拉长的引擎盖）形成的拉伸视觉效果。可表现为车身延展且重心稳定的稳重感，或因前部占比增大而产生重心前移、庄重与力量感，并伴随明显的体量感与纤长感。典型特征包括延展的侧面线条、显著的前部比例与强烈的视觉体量。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sculptural Flowing Elegant Stance
description: Elongated, flowing silhouette emphasizing sculptural surfaces and an elegant, expressive presence. Achieved through directional reinforcement and tailored stiffness to create continuous, flowing volumes, and often presented with pronounced decorative treatments and large areas of metallic sheen for a luxurious, attention-grabbing appearance.
text:
名称：Sculptural Flowing Elegant Stance
描述：Elongated, flowing silhouette emphasizing sculptural surfaces and an elegant, expressive presence. Achieved through directional reinforcement and tailored stiffness to create continuous, flowing volumes, and often presented with pronounced decorative treatments and large areas of metallic sheen for a luxurious, attention-grabbing appearance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 上半轮廓主导姿态
description: 车辆视觉姿态由上半部分轮廓先行决定，主轮廓的连贯与光顺影响整体比例与力量感。
text:
名称：上半轮廓主导姿态
描述：车辆视觉姿态由上半部分轮廓先行决定，主轮廓的连贯与光顺影响整体比例与力量感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low Step-in / Step-over Posture
description: A vehicle stance characterized by a low sill and/or low floor with a lowered visual base that reduces vertical effort for entry and exit. Improves step-over and step-in accessibility (beneficial to shorter users and family-oriented utility), enhances ingress/egress, and can produce a planted, elongated side appearance.
text:
名称：Low Step-in / Step-over Posture
描述：A vehicle stance characterized by a low sill and/or low floor with a lowered visual base that reduces vertical effort for entry and exit. Improves step-over and step-in accessibility (beneficial to shorter users and family-oriented utility), enhances ingress/egress, and can produce a planted, elongated side appearance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Spatiality (空间性)
description: 强调三维体态与体块在空间中的关系，要求从多个视角观察与调整，注重三维观察下的光影与体积关系。
text:
名称：Spatiality (空间性)
描述：强调三维体态与体块在空间中的关系，要求从多个视角观察与调整，注重三维观察下的光影与体积关系。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Teardrop profile / Teardrop silhouette / 泪滴轮廓
description: 前部圆润、车尾逐渐收窄的纵向车身轮廓（泪滴/水滴形），通过前高后低与平顺曲线形成流线型以减少气流分离与涡流，提高速度与效率；典型于早期注重气动的设计风格（约1910s–1960s）。
text:
名称：Teardrop profile / Teardrop silhouette / 泪滴轮廓
描述：前部圆润、车尾逐渐收窄的纵向车身轮廓（泪滴/水滴形），通过前高后低与平顺曲线形成流线型以减少气流分离与涡流，提高速度与效率；典型于早期注重气动的设计风格（约1910s–1960s）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung aerodynamic / racing stance
description: Visual stance characterized by low ride height, strongly raked windshield and sloped roofline, elongated bonnet and narrow track — combining aerodynamic optimization with classic racing cues. Implications include aerodynamic benefits and potential trade-offs such as increased glazing transmission losses.
text:
名称：Low-slung aerodynamic / racing stance
描述：Visual stance characterized by low ride height, strongly raked windshield and sloped roofline, elongated bonnet and narrow track — combining aerodynamic optimization with classic racing cues. Implications include aerodynamic benefits and potential trade-offs such as increased glazing transmission losses.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: On-road / Sedan stance
description: Low to moderate ride height with low, stretched proportions that emphasize aerodynamics and elegance; longer dash-to-axle and more raked windshield for an aerodynamic silhouette; stable, horizontal emphasis with balanced wheel-to-body ratio and relaxed forward rake.
text:
名称：On-road / Sedan stance
描述：Low to moderate ride height with low, stretched proportions that emphasize aerodynamics and elegance; longer dash-to-axle and more raked windshield for an aerodynamic silhouette; stable, horizontal emphasis with balanced wheel-to-body ratio and relaxed forward rake.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Utility / Function-driven posture
description: Stance focused on usability and load-carrying: larger rear packaging, pronounced rear overhang or squat rear track, higher ride height and clear load-area packaging with simple roofline to prioritize cargo/utility over sporty proportions.
text:
名称：Utility / Function-driven posture
描述：Stance focused on usability and load-carrying: larger rear packaging, pronounced rear overhang or squat rear track, higher ride height and clear load-area packaging with simple roofline to prioritize cargo/utility over sporty proportions.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Tall Upright Cabin
description: Stance characterized by a higher roofline and upright greenhouse with boxier proportions to emphasize interior volume. Often combined with a relatively short overhang and compact nose, highlighting occupant comfort, efficient packaging and a more upright seating environment.
text:
名称：Tall Upright Cabin
描述：Stance characterized by a higher roofline and upright greenhouse with boxier proportions to emphasize interior volume. Often combined with a relatively short overhang and compact nose, highlighting occupant comfort, efficient packaging and a more upright seating environment.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sleek thin-layer surface
description: Vehicle appears smoother and more aerodynamic due to integrated, low-profile lighting elements.
text:
名称：Sleek thin-layer surface
描述：Vehicle appears smoother and more aerodynamic due to integrated, low-profile lighting elements.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dynamic posture
description: Visual stance conveying motion and agility through low front, rising bodyline and stretched proportions; emphasizes sportiness and visual momentum.
text:
名称：Dynamic posture
描述：Visual stance conveying motion and agility through low front, rising bodyline and stretched proportions; emphasizes sportiness and visual momentum.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear packaging-influenced posture
description: Perceived rear stance and ground clearance shaped by exhaust and underbody packaging; bulky acoustic hardware can visually or physically lift rear stance.
text:
名称：Rear packaging-influenced posture
描述：Perceived rear stance and ground clearance shaped by exhaust and underbody packaging; bulky acoustic hardware can visually or physically lift rear stance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: low-slung, rear-biased stance / 低矮后偏重姿态 (rear-biased stance / 后偏姿态)
description: 车辆视觉与动力学表现为重心偏后、后部下压感增强与尾端主导的姿态特征，通常伴随低矮前脸、后部肌肉化和客舱后置，产生后轴视觉重量感与动感姿态。
text:
名称：low-slung, rear-biased stance / 低矮后偏重姿态 (rear-biased stance / 后偏姿态)
描述：车辆视觉与动力学表现为重心偏后、后部下压感增强与尾端主导的姿态特征，通常伴随低矮前脸、后部肌肉化和客舱后置，产生后轴视觉重量感与动感姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: RefinedMinimalistStance
description: 通过一致的、受控的视觉参考形成的姿态，强调简洁与主题一致性。
text:
名称：RefinedMinimalistStance
描述：通过一致的、受控的视觉参考形成的姿态，强调简洁与主题一致性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: StablePracticalStance
description: 视觉上表现为低重心、较小侧倾与受控的俯仰，带来平稳舒适的乘坐感受；同时在工程与车身布局上注重低风阻与较长轴距，并通过重心控制在空间与续航/效率之间取得平衡（兼顾舒适性与实用性）。
text:
名称：StablePracticalStance
描述：视觉上表现为低重心、较小侧倾与受控的俯仰，带来平稳舒适的乘坐感受；同时在工程与车身布局上注重低风阻与较长轴距，并通过重心控制在空间与续航/效率之间取得平衡（兼顾舒适性与实用性）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 整体轮廓（Silhouette）
description: 时代性强的车身轮廓（如箱形、鱼形、楔形等）的回归与再解读
text:
名称：整体轮廓（Silhouette）
描述：时代性强的车身轮廓（如箱形、鱼形、楔形等）的回归与再解读

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: reduced_pitch_amplitude
description: Lower pitch angle for same inertial moment when wheelbase is increased; calmer longitudinal stance.
text:
名称：reduced_pitch_amplitude
描述：Lower pitch angle for same inertial moment when wheelbase is increased; calmer longitudinal stance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Energy-absorbing front-end posture
description: Visual and structural stance where front structure is designed to crumple progressively, preserving the passenger cell.
text:
名称：Energy-absorbing front-end posture
描述：Visual and structural stance where front structure is designed to crumple progressively, preserving the passenger cell.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Front-heavy stance
description: Vehicle with greater mass distribution toward the front axle. Visual signs include longer front overhang and forward-weighted proportions; typically paired with brake circuit layouts (diagonal/X) and suspension tuning that address front axle load and stability.
text:
名称：Front-heavy stance
描述：Vehicle with greater mass distribution toward the front axle. Visual signs include longer front overhang and forward-weighted proportions; typically paired with brake circuit layouts (diagonal/X) and suspension tuning that address front axle load and stability.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: MassMarketProportions
description: Proportions and stance optimized for manufacturability and cost-efficiency; often perceived as conservative but robust.
text:
名称：MassMarketProportions
描述：Proportions and stance optimized for manufacturability and cost-efficiency; often perceived as conservative but robust.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Neutral or adjusted gaze/posture
description: Occupant head/eye posture as perceived for instrument readability: neutral gaze when appropriate (e.g., proper lenses) or adjusted head/eye posture (e.g., when using bifocals) to read clusters.
text:
名称：Neutral or adjusted gaze/posture
描述：Occupant head/eye posture as perceived for instrument readability: neutral gaze when appropriate (e.g., proper lenses) or adjusted head/eye posture (e.g., when using bifocals) to read clusters.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dashboard-prominent posture
description: Posture where instrument panel geometry is visually prominent and interacts strongly with windshield reflections and driver sightlines.
text:
名称：Dashboard-prominent posture
描述：Posture where instrument panel geometry is visually prominent and interacts strongly with windshield reflections and driver sightlines.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Upright (家用/支持/便捷 直立姿态)
description: A family of upright vehicle postures characterized by an upright seating position with maintained lumbar curvature and reduced forward slump, perceived as supportive; emphasizes practicality and interior space (higher roof, short overhang, long wheelbase) typical of family-oriented stances; visual and perceptual cues also correlate with ease of entry and exit (accessible). / 一类直立的车辆姿态：座姿较直、保持腰椎曲度并减少向前塌陷，给人以支撑感；强调实用与空间（更高车顶、短悬长轴），典型于家用稳重姿态；视觉与感知特征也与便于进出相关。
text:
名称：Upright (家用/支持/便捷 直立姿态)
描述：A family of upright vehicle postures characterized by an upright seating position with maintained lumbar curvature and reduced forward slump, perceived as supportive; emphasizes practicality and interior space (higher roof, short overhang, long wheelbase) typical of family-oriented stances; visual and perceptual cues also correlate with ease of entry and exit (accessible). / 一类直立的车辆姿态：座姿较直、保持腰椎曲度并减少向前塌陷，给人以支撑感；强调实用与空间（更高车顶、短悬长轴），典型于家用稳重姿态；视觉与感知特征也与便于进出相关。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Mid- / Mid-rear Low-slung Sports Stance
description: 一种典型跑车姿态：低矮车头/低矮整车姿态，乘员舱向车身中后部推进（cabin-forward / pushed-forward），前悬短且前部包装紧凑，后部常有较长的尾部/发动机舱，发动机位于车轴中后部导致重量后移。整体视觉上呈现性能导向、流线且前长后重的运动感。
text:
名称：Mid- / Mid-rear Low-slung Sports Stance
描述：一种典型跑车姿态：低矮车头/低矮整车姿态，乘员舱向车身中后部推进（cabin-forward / pushed-forward），前悬短且前部包装紧凑，后部常有较长的尾部/发动机舱，发动机位于车轴中后部导致重量后移。整体视觉上呈现性能导向、流线且前长后重的运动感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Utilitarian / Utility-ready Posture
description: A function-first, low-ornament stance emphasizing practicality and durability: straightforward lines, often boxy or compact proportions, strong structural/utility cues (e.g., pronounced rear functional elements). / 低装饰性、功能优先的姿态：线条直白、常见方盒或紧凑比例，强调耐用性与可用性，通过明显的结构性/实用性提示（例如后部功能构件）体现。
text:
名称：Utilitarian / Utility-ready Posture
描述：A function-first, low-ornament stance emphasizing practicality and durability: straightforward lines, often boxy or compact proportions, strong structural/utility cues (e.g., pronounced rear functional elements). / 低装饰性、功能优先的姿态：线条直白、常见方盒或紧凑比例，强调耐用性与可用性，通过明显的结构性/实用性提示（例如后部功能构件）体现。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: RestrictedMovementPosture
description: Reduced ability to make small postural changes; associated with discomfort over long trips.
text:
名称：RestrictedMovementPosture
描述：Reduced ability to make small postural changes; associated with discomfort over long trips.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Padding depth and positioning (below armrest)
description: Local depth and placement of padding in the door inner panel, particularly below the armrest to protect pelvis without interfering with arm space.
text:
名称：Padding depth and positioning (below armrest)
描述：Local depth and placement of padding in the door inner panel, particularly below the armrest to protect pelvis without interfering with arm space.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: amplified_pitch_and_structural_bending
description: Combined effect of CG offset and longitudinal forces producing greater body pitch and structural bending under acceleration/braking.
text:
名称：amplified_pitch_and_structural_bending
描述：Combined effect of CG offset and longitudinal forces producing greater body pitch and structural bending under acceleration/braking.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Steering responsiveness & wheel camber during steering
description: Visual and dynamic posture changes of the wheel when steering and during suspension travel, affecting tire contact.
text:
名称：Steering responsiveness & wheel camber during steering
描述：Visual and dynamic posture changes of the wheel when steering and during suspension travel, affecting tire contact.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 整体姿态(视觉站姿)
description: 视觉上对车辆站姿和动势的感知结果，由姿态感等设计属性直接体现。
text:
名称：整体姿态(视觉站姿)
描述：视觉上对车辆站姿和动势的感知结果，由姿态感等设计属性直接体现。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 张扬·进攻性姿态
description: 视觉上更具攻击性、张扬与动感。
text:
名称：张扬·进攻性姿态
描述：视觉上更具攻击性、张扬与动感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Balanced proportions (均衡比例)
description: 电池与整车布局优化后表现为低重心、前后轴配重均衡的视觉与动态姿态；车身线条与色彩重心共同产生的视觉效果，体现稳重或运动感。
text:
名称：Balanced proportions (均衡比例)
描述：电池与整车布局优化后表现为低重心、前后轴配重均衡的视觉与动态姿态；车身线条与色彩重心共同产生的视觉效果，体现稳重或运动感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 霸道·厚重姿态
description: 视觉上给人稳重、抓地稳、力量感强的印象。
text:
名称：霸道·厚重姿态
描述：视觉上给人稳重、抓地稳、力量感强的印象。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 平和·和谐姿态
description: 视觉上给人平衡、温和的感觉。
text:
名称：平和·和谐姿态
描述：视觉上给人平衡、温和的感觉。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: WellMaintainedStance_维护良好姿态
description: 整车外观与内饰状态维持良好、给用户以可靠、安全、值得信赖的视觉感知。
text:
名称：WellMaintainedStance_维护良好姿态
描述：整车外观与内饰状态维持良好、给用户以可靠、安全、值得信赖的视觉感知。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Raised-frame (large off-road truck)
description: 发动机体积大且安装高、车身高、独立车架使得驾驶员视点处于高位。
text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low, wide / low-slung athletic (aggressive/sporty) stance
description: 视觉上以低车身线和宽轮距为特征，常伴随较低的引擎罩线与低重心、较大的轮毂比和低胎侧，传达运动性、精准操控与稳定性；同时强调低风阻（streamlined）与操控性能，但在前舱空间、内部包装与迎风面积上存在权衡。
text:
名称：Low, wide / low-slung athletic (aggressive/sporty) stance
描述：视觉上以低车身线和宽轮距为特征，常伴随较低的引擎罩线与低重心、较大的轮毂比和低胎侧，传达运动性、精准操控与稳定性；同时强调低风阻（streamlined）与操控性能，但在前舱空间、内部包装与迎风面积上存在权衡。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 掠背/运动姿态 (Coupe-like sloping posture)
description: 侧面掠背明显，流线性强，传递跑车化视觉效果。
text:
名称：掠背/运动姿态 (Coupe-like sloping posture)
描述：侧面掠背明显，流线性强，传递跑车化视觉效果。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Wedge Low-Slung Aggressive / 楔形低趴攻击姿态
description: 单箱楔形车身、低车顶、短前悬与宽后轮距营造的低趴且具有前冲感的姿态。
text:
名称：Wedge Low-Slung Aggressive / 楔形低趴攻击姿态
描述：单箱楔形车身、低车顶、短前悬与宽后轮距营造的低趴且具有前冲感的姿态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Increased thigh clearance and steering-wheel-to-stomach clearance
description: Provide larger vertical and horizontal gaps under the steering wheel to accommodate larger bodies and reduce contact between steering column/under-dash structures and occupant thighs and stomach.
text:
名称：Increased thigh clearance and steering-wheel-to-stomach clearance
描述：Provide larger vertical and horizontal gaps under the steering wheel to accommodate larger bodies and reduce contact between steering column/under-dash structures and occupant thighs and stomach.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-Obstruction Cluster Stance
description: Vehicle stance and component geometry arranged to minimize occlusion of instrument cluster.
text:
名称：Low-Obstruction Cluster Stance
描述：Vehicle stance and component geometry arranged to minimize occlusion of instrument cluster.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Crosswind stability (横风稳定性)
description: 关于车辆在侧风（横风）作用下的姿态特性。描述车辆在横风作用下的抗侧滑与抗偏航能力，可表现为“横风稳定”（车辆抵抗侧向偏移与偏航）或“横风不稳定”（车辆易发生意外侧向偏移或偏航）。需在造型与底盘控制设计中考虑稳定性特征与补偿策略，以提高横风条件下的行驶安全性与可控性。
text:
名称：Crosswind stability (横风稳定性)
描述：关于车辆在侧风（横风）作用下的姿态特性。描述车辆在横风作用下的抗侧滑与抗偏航能力，可表现为“横风稳定”（车辆抵抗侧向偏移与偏航）或“横风不稳定”（车辆易发生意外侧向偏移或偏航）。需在造型与底盘控制设计中考虑稳定性特征与补偿策略，以提高横风条件下的行驶安全性与可控性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Axle Tramp
description: Oscillatory or uncontrolled axle movement under drive/braking torque caused by inadequate torque control or very compliant springs.
text:
名称：Axle Tramp
描述：Oscillatory or uncontrolled axle movement under drive/braking torque caused by inadequate torque control or very compliant springs.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Jet-inspired Posture / 飞机式姿态
description: A posture drawing from aircraft design language, often featuring a raised/receding tail, canopy-like cabin or rearward-extended lines to emphasize futurism and speed. / 以飞机造型语言为主导的姿态，常表现为抬升或后收的尾部、气泡式座舱或向后延伸的线条，强调未来感与速度感。
text:
名称：Jet-inspired Posture / 飞机式姿态
描述：A posture drawing from aircraft design language, often featuring a raised/receding tail, canopy-like cabin or rearward-extended lines to emphasize futurism and speed. / 以飞机造型语言为主导的姿态，常表现为抬升或后收的尾部、气泡式座舱或向后延伸的线条，强调未来感与速度感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: OpenSightlineStance
description: Vehicle configuration and seating alignment that maximizes unobstructed forward field of view.
text:
名称：OpenSightlineStance
描述：Vehicle configuration and seating alignment that maximizes unobstructed forward field of view.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: CaricaturedStance
description: Visual stance resulting from stylized exaggeration: aggressive, dynamic, often non-production realism.
text:
名称：CaricaturedStance
描述：Visual stance resulting from stylized exaggeration: aggressive, dynamic, often non-production realism.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: FrontShortRearLongPosture
description: 前短后长的姿态，前舱紧凑、车身视觉向后延伸，常见于电动车侧面造型。
text:
名称：FrontShortRearLongPosture
描述：前短后长的姿态，前舱紧凑、车身视觉向后延伸，常见于电动车侧面造型。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Raised Sporty Multipurpose Stance
description: Raised sporty multipurpose stance with higher ride height, wide proportions and a forward-leaning visual momentum that balances off-road capability and family-oriented utility. （抬高离地、宽阔轮廓并带有向前的视觉动势，兼顾越野感与家庭多功能性。）
text:
名称：Raised Sporty Multipurpose Stance
描述：Raised sporty multipurpose stance with higher ride height, wide proportions and a forward-leaning visual momentum that balances off-road capability and family-oriented utility. （抬高离地、宽阔轮廓并带有向前的视觉动势，兼顾越野感与家庭多功能性。）

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: long-wheelbase stance
description: Visually elongated vehicle proportion; implies greater turning demands and potential need for additional steering measures.
text:
名称：long-wheelbase stance
描述：Visually elongated vehicle proportion; implies greater turning demands and potential need for additional steering measures.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Two-box / Two-volume hatchback (compact to utilitarian)
description: Two-box (two-volume) hatchback planform with cabin and cargo integrated. Ranges from compact, efficient and practical appearance to a more boxy, utilitarian stance that prioritizes cargo flexibility, low cost and broad rural/urban usability (characteristic of vehicles like the R4 and 2CV).
text:
名称：Two-box / Two-volume hatchback (compact to utilitarian)
描述：Two-box (two-volume) hatchback planform with cabin and cargo integrated. Ranges from compact, efficient and practical appearance to a more boxy, utilitarian stance that prioritizes cargo flexibility, low cost and broad rural/urban usability (characteristic of vehicles like the R4 and 2CV).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Safety/Crashworthiness
description: 被动/主动安全性能与碰撞保护等级。
text:
名称：Safety/Crashworthiness
描述：被动/主动安全性能与碰撞保护等级。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stacked vertical center stack
description: Center stack with clear vertical zones: high display area separated from lower control area by vents.
text:
名称：Stacked vertical center stack
描述：Center stack with clear vertical zones: high display area separated from lower control area by vents.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Spacious interior posture
description: Proportions and surfaces that communicate large usable volume and ergonomic access.
text:
名称：Spacious interior posture
描述：Proportions and surfaces that communicate large usable volume and ergonomic access.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SideProfile_forward_convergence
description: 侧面水平线条相互向前汇聚，营造视觉向前的运动趋势与聚焦于车头的感受。
text:
名称：SideProfile_forward_convergence
描述：侧面水平线条相互向前汇聚，营造视觉向前的运动趋势与聚焦于车头的感受。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung / low-squat sports posture (低趴/低矮运动姿态)
description: 整车呈现低车身高度与低重心、紧凑包装与宽轨距的运动化视觉效果；常伴随前低后压或重心后移的侧面比例，典型特征包括长轴距、短后悬、低车顶、宽轨与收束尾部以提升气动效率与操控表现。该姿态多见于赛车、跑车及轿跑化运动车型，旨在传达速度感、性能导向及优秀空气动力性。 English: A low-slung, low-center-of-gravity sports stance characterized by tight packaging, wide track and a performance-oriented visual balance (often front-low/rear-biased or coupe-like proportions). Features can include long wheelbase, short rear overhang, low roofline and tapered rear for improved aerodynamics and handling; common on race cars, sports cars and coupe-like models.
text:
名称：Low-slung / low-squat sports posture (低趴/低矮运动姿态)
描述：整车呈现低车身高度与低重心、紧凑包装与宽轨距的运动化视觉效果；常伴随前低后压或重心后移的侧面比例，典型特征包括长轴距、短后悬、低车顶、宽轨与收束尾部以提升气动效率与操控表现。该姿态多见于赛车、跑车及轿跑化运动车型，旨在传达速度感、性能导向及优秀空气动力性。 English: A low-slung, low-center-of-gravity sports stance characterized by tight packaging, wide track and a performance-oriented visual balance (often front-low/rear-biased or coupe-like proportions). Features can include long wheelbase, short rear overhang, low roofline and tapered rear for improved aerodynamics and handling; common on race cars, sports cars and coupe-like models.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: FrontBiasedPosture
description: Visual and mass bias toward the front of the vehicle due to concentrated packaging needs.
text:
名称：FrontBiasedPosture
描述：Visual and mass bias toward the front of the vehicle due to concentrated packaging needs.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear-biased Sporty Stance
description: Rear-biased sporty stance featuring a low-slung cabin and compact overall length with visual emphasis on rear mass and wheel-to-body relationship, producing an athletic, rear-focused posture. （低矮驾驶舱、紧凑车长并以车尾质量与轮廓关系为视觉中心，形成偏后重心的运动姿态。）
text:
名称：Rear-biased Sporty Stance
描述：Rear-biased sporty stance featuring a low-slung cabin and compact overall length with visual emphasis on rear mass and wheel-to-body relationship, producing an athletic, rear-focused posture. （低矮驾驶舱、紧凑车长并以车尾质量与轮廓关系为视觉中心，形成偏后重心的运动姿态。）

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SurfaceTensionAndStretch
description: 曲面张力与延展性，影响视觉上曲面的紧致或松弛感。
text:
名称：SurfaceTensionAndStretch
描述：曲面张力与延展性，影响视觉上曲面的紧致或松弛感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Balanced systems-oriented posture
description: 一种强调包装与制造可行性的姿态：比例折中，兼顾低风阻与乘员空间，体现系统工程折衷。
text:
名称：Balanced systems-oriented posture
描述：一种强调包装与制造可行性的姿态：比例折中，兼顾低风阻与乘员空间，体现系统工程折衷。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前部视觉重心与气质
description: 由前脸设计决定的车辆前端视觉表现，影响整车的精神面貌（如攻击性、友好或沉稳）。
text:
名称：前部视觉重心与气质
描述：由前脸设计决定的车辆前端视觉表现，影响整车的精神面貌（如攻击性、友好或沉稳）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Balanced, lively roadster stance
description: Low height, compact footprint and a balance that allows playful oversteer limit while retaining controllability.
text:
名称：Balanced, lively roadster stance
描述：Low height, compact footprint and a balance that allows playful oversteer limit while retaining controllability.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 视觉凝聚(VisualCohesion)
description: 确保意象板上各图像在风格、色调和语义上高度一致，从而形成清晰且可传达的设计方向。
text:
名称：视觉凝聚(VisualCohesion)
描述：确保意象板上各图像在风格、色调和语义上高度一致，从而形成清晰且可传达的设计方向。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Camber-roll coupled
description: Wheel camber changes concurrently with body roll: the wheel outer/incline angle varies as the body rolls, affecting contact patch, tire load distribution, lateral grip and the visual stance of the wheel. / 车轮外倾角随车身侧倾同步变化，影响轮胎接地面积与受力分布、侧向抓地力及视觉姿态。
text:
名称：Camber-roll coupled
描述：Wheel camber changes concurrently with body roll: the wheel outer/incline angle varies as the body rolls, affecting contact patch, tire load distribution, lateral grip and the visual stance of the wheel. / 车轮外倾角随车身侧倾同步变化，影响轮胎接地面积与受力分布、侧向抓地力及视觉姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ReclinedSeated
description: Seatback reclined to approximately 110–120° from horizontal (about 20–30° recline from upright); upper-body load is supported by the seatback, reducing L5/S1 compressive forces.
text:
名称：ReclinedSeated
描述：Seatback reclined to approximately 110–120° from horizontal (about 20–30° recline from upright); upper-body load is supported by the seatback, reducing L5/S1 compressive forces.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Compact city car stance
description: Short, upright proportions with a high roof-to-length ratio, short overhangs and rounded forms conveying maneuverability and interior efficiency.
text:
名称：Compact city car stance
描述：Short, upright proportions with a high roof-to-length ratio, short overhangs and rounded forms conveying maneuverability and interior efficiency.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dramatic Stance (Vertical-opening / Exotic)
description: A dramatic vehicle posture characterized by a theatrical, upright presentation when doors are open and an overall exotic/performance-oriented appearance. It can be realized via vertical-opening doors or other special door motions, and is commonly associated with a high beltline and short door openings. This posture affects perceived vehicle scale, approachability, and conveys a performance or exotic character.
text:
名称：Dramatic Stance (Vertical-opening / Exotic)
描述：A dramatic vehicle posture characterized by a theatrical, upright presentation when doors are open and an overall exotic/performance-oriented appearance. It can be realized via vertical-opening doors or other special door motions, and is commonly associated with a high beltline and short door openings. This posture affects perceived vehicle scale, approachability, and conveys a performance or exotic character.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 时尚小巧城市车姿态
description: 短前后悬、灵活轮廓、强调颜值与城市使用灵活性。
text:
名称：时尚小巧城市车姿态
描述：短前后悬、灵活轮廓、强调颜值与城市使用灵活性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Resonant Torsion & Bending
description: 在特定车速与路面激励条件下产生的结构共振，导致高幅值的扭转与弯曲应力，可能触发焊缝失效。
text:
名称：Resonant Torsion & Bending
描述：在特定车速与路面激励条件下产生的结构共振，导致高幅值的扭转与弯曲应力，可能触发焊缝失效。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Coachbuilt Upright Stance
description: Higher, more upright cabin with classical coachbuilt proportions—separate articulated fenders, pronounced upright greenhouse and formal silhouette. Evokes traditional luxury and formal packaging rather than contemporary SUV ruggedness.
text:
名称：Coachbuilt Upright Stance
描述：Higher, more upright cabin with classical coachbuilt proportions—separate articulated fenders, pronounced upright greenhouse and formal silhouette. Evokes traditional luxury and formal packaging rather than contemporary SUV ruggedness.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Supportive and accommodating posture
description: Posture emphasizing occupant support, safe alignment (head/neck/spine) and adjustability. Enabled by adjustable seating and controls to achieve correct knee angles and comfortable leg reach while maintaining protective support and ergonomic alignment in the cabin.
text:
名称：Supportive and accommodating posture
描述：Posture emphasizing occupant support, safe alignment (head/neck/spine) and adjustability. Enabled by adjustable seating and controls to achieve correct knee angles and comfortable leg reach while maintaining protective support and ergonomic alignment in the cabin.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: leisure-oriented stance
description: 较高离地间隙、稳重且放松的视觉姿态，强调功能与舒适。
text:
名称：leisure-oriented stance
描述：较高离地间隙、稳重且放松的视觉姿态，强调功能与舒适。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: camber_stability
description: Degree to which camber is controlled or varies over suspension motion.
text:
名称：camber_stability
描述：Degree to which camber is controlled or varies over suspension motion.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Durability and Corrosion Resistance
description: 长期使用中的可靠性与耐久性；同时强调耐腐蚀性，通过采用耐腐蚀材料和可靠机械设计以延长使用寿命并提高用户满意度。
text:
名称：Durability and Corrosion Resistance
描述：长期使用中的可靠性与耐久性；同时强调耐腐蚀性，通过采用耐腐蚀材料和可靠机械设计以延长使用寿命并提高用户满意度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed wheels with rugged tires and visible arches (high ground clearance)
description: Elevated ride height with minimal overbody coverage that leaves wheels and wheel arches exposed; commonly paired with large, heavy-tread tires for traction and easy maintenance/ replacement. Typical of early and utilitarian off-road designs (e.g., early Jeeps, Land Rovers).
text:
名称：Exposed wheels with rugged tires and visible arches (high ground clearance)
描述：Elevated ride height with minimal overbody coverage that leaves wheels and wheel arches exposed; commonly paired with large, heavy-tread tires for traction and easy maintenance/ replacement. Typical of early and utilitarian off-road designs (e.g., early Jeeps, Land Rovers).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Cab-forward stance
description: Stance characterized by a forward passenger compartment...
text:
名称：Cab-forward stance
描述：Stance characterized by a forward passenger compartment...

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sporty-Elegant Stance
description: Sporty-elegant stance combining performance cues and refinement: low roof, long wheelbase and muscular haunches that convey both dynamic capability and elegance. （兼具运动性与优雅感：低车顶、长轴距与饱满外廓肌肉线条，既表现性能又体现优雅。）
text:
名称：Sporty-Elegant Stance
描述：Sporty-elegant stance combining performance cues and refinement: low roof, long wheelbase and muscular haunches that convey both dynamic capability and elegance. （兼具运动性与优雅感：低车顶、长轴距与饱满外廓肌肉线条，既表现性能又体现优雅。）

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: CompactUrbanPosture
description: Short overhangs, compact footprint and visually efficient volumes that convey a dense-environment stance suited to urban driving — focused, space-efficient and maneuverable.
text:
名称：CompactUrbanPosture
描述：Short overhangs, compact footprint and visually efficient volumes that convey a dense-environment stance suited to urban driving — focused, space-efficient and maneuverable.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Blocked-Peripheral-Vision Posture
description: Layout where low-mounted controls require downward gaze and diminish awareness of the forward road in peripheral vision.
text:
名称：Blocked-Peripheral-Vision Posture
描述：Layout where low-mounted controls require downward gaze and diminish awareness of the forward road in peripheral vision.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Overall vehicle stance
description: Perceived stance and proportions influenced by engineering characteristic targets; finalized through engineering validation and testing to reflect ride height, wheel tuck and suspension setup.
text:
名称：Overall vehicle stance
描述：Perceived stance and proportions influenced by engineering characteristic targets; finalized through engineering validation and testing to reflect ride height, wheel tuck and suspension setup.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 延长轴距行驶姿态
description: 轴距与车长伸展后视觉上更修长，强调乘坐舒适性与直线稳定性。
text:
名称：延长轴距行驶姿态
描述：轴距与车长伸展后视觉上更修长，强调乘坐舒适性与直线稳定性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 后部贯穿延展姿态
description: 视觉上增强车尾宽度与整体感，形成平稳延伸的尾部姿态。
text:
名称：后部贯穿延展姿态
描述：视觉上增强车尾宽度与整体感，形成平稳延伸的尾部姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 4_occupant_packaging_posture
description: Vehicle stance and proportions configured to accommodate front and rear 95th percentile occupants — upright seating, sufficient headroom and balanced fore-aft proportions.
text:
名称：4_occupant_packaging_posture
描述：Vehicle stance and proportions configured to accommodate front and rear 95th percentile occupants — upright seating, sufficient headroom and balanced fore-aft proportions.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: reduced-mobility ingress posture
description: Postures reflecting limited joint range and strength during transfer movements; used to evaluate transfer aids and vehicle geometry for occupants with reduced mobility.
text:
名称：reduced-mobility ingress posture
描述：Postures reflecting limited joint range and strength during transfer movements; used to evaluate transfer aids and vehicle geometry for occupants with reduced mobility.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 个性化/表达性姿态
description: 强调视觉辨识度，比例与饰件配置倾向于更具个性与展示性的外观。注重独特的造型细节与夸张或细致的比例处理，以突出品牌或车型的个性化表达。
text:
名称：个性化/表达性姿态

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

description: 车辆侧视的整体站姿与比例感，由车侧比例、前后悬长短、车顶弧线、腰线走势、轮拱与轮胎尺寸等要素共同塑造，决定侧面视觉的姿势感与动感。
text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Planted stance
description: A low, well-settled vehicle footprint that conveys stability, precision and composed handling. Typical characteristics include a low-slung silhouette, shortened overhangs, wide track and a low center of gravity that help the car track the road closely and deliver precise responses. Covers variants emphasizing responsiveness ('Planted & responsive'), composed stability ('Composed planted stance') and sporty low height ('Planted, Low-Slung Stance').

Proportions tend to be upright — often with a relatively tall cabin — to maximize interior packaging and usable cabin space. Emphasizes maneuverability, easy parking and suitability for narrow roads and dense urban environments. / 短轴距、短悬、紧凑车身尺寸，常呈较直立（有时为相对较高的车舱）以提高内部空间利用率，强调灵活操控、易停车与城市通勤适应性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前后高低不对称的运动姿态（前高后低 / 俯冲/前冲）
description: 车辆侧面通过前后高度差表现出速度感与动势。常见有两种表达方式：一是视觉上前脸略高、车尾下降（前高后低），二是前端下沉、车尾抬高（前低后高，亦称俯冲或前冲）。在实际造型语境中这些术语有时被混用，应根据具体设计意图区分是强调车尾下沉的前高后低效果，还是强调车头前冲的俯冲效果。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Neutral / Driver-centric / Preferred / Safe Driving Posture
description: Balanced, driver-centric stance that provides clear sightlines, correct reach and ergonomic joint alignment to support safe control and information acquisition. Characterized by spine alignment with minimal compensatory angles, comfortable shoulder/wrist ranges, appropriate leg angles and head/torso orientation that minimize distraction. Includes observed preferred angle ranges for populations (example: neck ~30–66°, trunk‑thigh ~90–115°, knee ~99–138°, arm flexion ~19–75°) — noting mid-range design may not fit all users.
text:
名称：Neutral / Driver-centric / Preferred / Safe Driving Posture
描述：Balanced, driver-centric stance that provides clear sightlines, correct reach and ergonomic joint alignment to support safe control and information acquisition. Characterized by spine alignment with minimal compensatory angles, comfortable shoulder/wrist ranges, appropriate leg angles and head/torso orientation that minimize distraction. Includes observed preferred angle ranges for populations (example: neck ~30–66°, trunk‑thigh ~90–115°, knee ~99–138°, arm flexion ~19–75°) — noting mid-range design may not fit all users.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

description: A driver-focused, ergonomic cockpit posture that balances accessibility, comfort and control. Characterised by inward-biased or angled instrument panels and clustered controls favoring the driver, supportive seating with neutral spine alignment, optimized reach and sightlines to minimise head/eye movement, seating and pedal geometry arranged to avoid interference with wheel/tire movement, and interior packaging that yields a balanced cabin silhouette (affecting beltline, greenhouse height and windshield angle). Prioritises occupant accessibility and long-duration comfort (relaxed, neutral posture) while enabling focused driver interaction.
