label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Adaptive/Controllable Driver-adjustable Damping System
description: Damper system that modulates damping force to dissipate or conserve energy. Can provide continuous adjustment or selectable discrete modes to meet differing user demands. Typical adaptive assembly combines dampers with ECU control, solenoid valves and sensor fusion to adapt stiffness dynamically; discrete damper valve configurations (e.g., soft/medium/firm/super-soft) are commonly selectable by the ECU — often implemented via two ON/OFF solenoids producing up to four states. Functionally this is a semi-active/controllable damper with limited actuation capability compared to fully active actuators.

name: Muscular stance

text:
名称：Muscular stance

text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Driver-Centric Stance
description: 以驾驶者为中心的座舱姿态：座舱、控制装置与显示器朝向主驾驶布置（可表现为不对称布局与轻微的座舱包裹），强调前方能见度、以驾驶者为主的视线与操作可达性；常伴随前倾或参与性的上半身姿态以优化对主要控制的接触与控制感。
text:
名称：Driver-Centric Stance

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Steep windshield rake / low-slung posture
description: A sporty, aerodynamic vehicle stance characterized by a pronounced windshield rake combined with a low roofline and/or low nose, producing a planted, coupe-like silhouette. Aggressive windshield installation and a set-back cabin enhance the aerodynamic appearance. Pronounced rake can increase visible windshield reflections when paired with glossy dash surfaces. Practical maximum windshield tilt is about 65° from vertical to avoid optical distortion. The windshield rake spectrum ranges from upright/visibility-oriented to extreme low-slung/aerodynamic proportions.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung posture (torpedo & flamboyant cruiser)
description: A low-slung, elongated vehicle silhouette characterized by a low roofline and stretched proportions. The posture covers a spectrum from the aerodynamic, narrow 'torpedo' form emphasizing high-speed/low-drag capability, to the 'flamboyant cruiser' variant that retains low, long proportions but adds decorative surfacing and a focus on visual scale and customization (typical of 1950s American cruiser styling).
text:
名称：Low-slung posture (torpedo & flamboyant cruiser)
描述：A low-slung, elongated vehicle silhouette characterized by a low roofline and stretched proportions. The posture covers a spectrum from the aerodynamic, narrow 'torpedo' form emphasizing high-speed/low-drag capability, to the 'flamboyant cruiser' variant that retains low, long proportions but adds decorative surfacing and a focus on visual scale and customization (typical of 1950s American cruiser styling).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Utility / Practical Stance
description: A function-first visual posture emphasizing usable cargo volume, accessibility and practicality across multiple variants. Common manifestations include raised rear floor or extended overhangs for cargo, defined open beds and pronounced rear load areas (pickup), side-loading emphasis for easy functional access, compact-utility proportions with short wheelbase and higher roofline for urban ingress/egress and efficient parking, and robust features (high ride height, upright greenhouse, short overhangs, pronounced wheel-arch gaps) indicating load-carrying or off-road capability. Conveys maintainability, simplicity, stability and suitability for heavy or multi-purpose use.
text:
名称：Utility / Practical Stance
描述：A function-first visual posture emphasizing usable cargo volume, accessibility and practicality across multiple variants. Common manifestations include raised rear floor or extended overhangs for cargo, defined open beds and pronounced rear load areas (pickup), side-loading emphasis for easy functional access, compact-utility proportions with short wheelbase and higher roofline for urban ingress/egress and efficient parking, and robust features (high ride height, upright greenhouse, short overhangs, pronounced wheel-arch gaps) indicating load-carrying or off-road capability. Conveys maintainability, simplicity, stability and suitability for heavy or multi-purpose use.

名称：Low-slung elongated fluid teardrop silhouette
描述：Low-slung, elongated teardrop silhouette with a continuous fluid flow from the hood to the tail. Proportions example: length ~4000 mm, width ~1600 mm, height ~1000 mm. Visual center of gravity is low with a stretched fore–aft silhouette, conveying contained dynamism and elegance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Balanced Posture (平衡姿态)
description: 以规范化尺寸与比例为基础的平衡视觉姿态，表现为稳定、可实现且符合车型定位。该类姿态可细分为：动感且稳重——强调运动感同时保持稳重与豪华质感；中性化——比例均衡、不偏向运动或豪华，适配多款车型；以及强调正确形态的实现——通过尺寸与比例控制确保姿态合理可实现。
text:
名称：Balanced Posture (平衡姿态)
描述：以规范化尺寸与比例为基础的平衡视觉姿态，表现为稳定、可实现且符合车型定位。该类姿态可细分为：动感且稳重——强调运动感同时保持稳重与豪华质感；中性化——比例均衡、不偏向运动或豪华，适配多款车型；以及强调正确形态的实现——通过尺寸与比例控制确保姿态合理可实现。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High Rear Posture
description: Rearward-high stance characterized by an elevated rear loading edge, raised rear header/glass area and/or high-mounted rear lamps. Produces visual emphasis toward the rear and increased perceived vehicle height; can improve structural shear-path continuity (e.g., lift-over) but may reduce ease of cargo loading.
text:

Produces visual emphasis toward the rear and increased perceived vehicle height; can improve structural shear-path continuity (e.g., lift-over) but may reduce ease of cargo loading.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:
名称：Streamlined integrated stance

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Upright high-riding touring stance
description: High and upright body with relatively short wheelbase, open/raised roof treatments and long side running boards, visually conveying a high cockpit and narrow body typical of early touring-car forms. 车身相对高、轴距较短、开敞车顶与长侧踏板，视觉上呈现高座舱与窄车身的早期旅行车形态。
text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

description: 由长引擎罩、短箱式乘员舱和低矮前部造型构成，整体视觉上车身显得修长且优雅，兼具贵族化的端庄感与运动化的速度感：前脸呈向下俯冲的视觉效果，增强运动感与速度感。 (Long hood, short boxy cabin and a low front create an overall elongated, elegant stance that conveys aristocratic dignity while also suggesting sportiness and a sense of speed; the forward‑swept front enhances the impression of motion.)
text:
名称：Elongated / Slender Stance (修长/延展/贵族化姿态)

text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-standing / Raised / High-cab posture
description: Upright, taller stance with an elevated floor and increased ground clearance, producing upright seating, raised heel points and improved forward visibility. Common in small urban 4x4s, raised-cab vehicles and other high-riding designs where driver sightlines are prioritized. 直立且车身较高，车舱地板抬高、离地间隙增加，形成直立座舱、抬高后跟点并优化前向视野，常见于城市小型4x4和高驾驶舱车型。
text:

text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung streamlined / aerodynamic sporty posture
description: 以低矮车身高度、低车顶线和纵向拉伸比例为特征，常见要素包括长引擎罩/长鼻、流线型车顶与后端收敛、外摆轮距或深轮拱以形成宽体感、以及降低迎风面积以减少阻力并提升高速稳定性。视觉效果强调运动性、空气效率与现代感；此类姿态包含若干变体（例如更俯卧的recumbent布局、更宽的wide-stance或通过平整底板实现的flat-floor低趴造型）。 Features: reduced ride height, elongated hood/bonnet, smooth uninterrupted surfaces, tapered rear, low visual center of gravity, close toe/foot-to-front-wheel proportions in side view, emphasis on low drag and dynamic, elegant/sporty appearance. / 重点：低阻力、高速稳定与运动感。
text:
名称：Low-slung streamlined / aerodynamic sporty posture

名称：Trailing-arm design (four-link / triangular)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear Overhang (Increased / Reduced)
description: Variation in the vehicle's rear projection caused by spare/tire size or packaging: Increased Rear Overhang — a larger spare or packaging causes greater rear projection, altering the perceived balance of the vehicle; Reduced Rear Overhang — a smaller spare or compact packaging allows a shorter rear projection and a more compact rear stance. (车辆后悬长度的变化，由备胎/轮胎大小或布置引起：增大后悬——更大的备胎或布置使后部投影更长，改变车辆的视觉平衡；减小后悬——较小的备胎或紧凑布置使后部投影更短，后姿更紧凑。)

text:

描述：Forward-biased proportions with an elongated bonnet and concentrated forward mass. Covers several variants: low-slung sports proportions (compact cabin, low roofline), long-hood/short-deck coupe layouts, front-longitudinal engine packaging commonly paired with RWD, and generale expressions of mechanical/performant presence.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Roll
description: Roll magnitude related to mass, CG height and suspension roll stiffness.
text:
名称：Roll
描述：Roll magnitude related to mass, CG height and suspension roll stiffness.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Seated ergonomic posture
description: Driver's overall seated stance considering pelvis/hip point, spine angle, arm and hand positions and functional/visual ergonomics; influenced by upper‑body containment and protective trim packaging, aimed at occupant efficiency, comfort and interaction with controls.
text:
名称：Seated ergonomic posture
描述：Driver's overall seated stance considering pelvis/hip point, spine angle, arm and hand positions and functional/visual ergonomics; influenced by upper‑body containment and protective trim packaging, aimed at occupant efficiency, comfort and interaction with controls.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: AggressiveDominant(霸气姿态)
description: 具有强烈气场、视觉上突出高度与厚重感的姿态。
text:
名称：AggressiveDominant(霸气姿态)
描述：具有强烈气场、视觉上突出高度与厚重感的姿态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exposed chain transmission
description: Chain drive visible along the chassis connecting gearbox to wheels; influences packaging and maintenance access.
text:
名称：Exposed chain transmission
描述：Chain drive visible along the chassis connecting gearbox to wheels; influences packaging and maintenance access.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Entry/Exit Posture
description: Occupant postures and motions during ingress and egress (leaning, twisting, stepping patterns). Includes perceived effort/space (e.g., low step-in or high sit-up), use of supports, and potential contact/collision points (head, knee) during entry and exit.
text:
名称：Entry/Exit Posture
描述：Occupant postures and motions during ingress and egress (leaning, twisting, stepping patterns). Includes perceived effort/space (e.g., low step-in or high sit-up), use of supports, and potential contact/collision points (head, knee) during entry and exit.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: LongHoodLowRoofStance
description: Vehicle posture with a visually long hood and lower roofline driven by front-biased mass and packaging.
text:
名称：LongHoodLowRoofStance
描述：Vehicle posture with a visually long hood and lower roofline driven by front-biased mass and packaging.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Defensive Prepared Posture
description: Driver assumes an anticipatory stance (hands/grip, foot positioning) ready for evasive or emergency braking actions.
text:
名称：Defensive Prepared Posture
描述：Driver assumes an anticipatory stance (hands/grip, foot positioning) ready for evasive or emergency braking actions.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: CamberGainBehavior
description: 车辆在侧倾或车轮上下行程时的外倾变化规律（gain），影响抓地力与操控感受。
text:
名称：CamberGainBehavior
描述：车辆在侧倾或车轮上下行程时的外倾变化规律（gain），影响抓地力与操控感受。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: LowCompact
description: Passenger car stance with low floor and compact rear packaging, enabled by under-rear-seat tank placement where possible.
text:
名称：LowCompact
描述：Passenger car stance with low floor and compact rear packaging, enabled by under-rear-seat tank placement where possible.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SportyStance(运动姿态)
description: 视觉上更低更宽、前脸动感强烈的姿态。
text:
名称：SportyStance(运动姿态)
描述：视觉上更低更宽、前脸动感强烈的姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Protective Vehicle Stance
description: A protective vehicle stance emphasizing impact resistance and occupant/component protection. Combines a perceived heavy/robust overall posture that communicates structural integrity with localized design offsets (e.g., bumpers projecting slightly forward) that position energy-absorbing elements ahead of vulnerable components to mitigate collision effects.
text:
名称：Protective Vehicle Stance
描述：A protective vehicle stance emphasizing impact resistance and occupant/component protection. Combines a perceived heavy/robust overall posture that communicates structural integrity with localized design offsets (e.g., bumpers projecting slightly forward) that position energy-absorbing elements ahead of vulnerable components to mitigate collision effects.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: AntiLiftControl
description: 加速或制动过程中保持后轴高度稳定或减小抬升/下沉的姿态特征。
text:
名称：AntiLiftControl
描述：加速或制动过程中保持后轴高度稳定或减小抬升/下沉的姿态特征。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 优雅 vs 运动姿态 (Elegant vs Sporty posture)
description: 强调在设计调性上优雅与运动两类姿态的对比。可通过诸如进气口/格栅位置与造型、车身线条处理与肩线力度等关键参数区分运动化（更低更激进的视觉重心、锋利肩线、大开口进气）与优雅化（更柔和的车顶线与肩部过渡、更内敛的进气口设置）两种风格。
text:
名称：优雅 vs 运动姿态 (Elegant vs Sporty posture)
描述：强调在设计调性上优雅与运动两类姿态的对比。可通过诸如进气口/格栅位置与造型、车身线条处理与肩线力度等关键参数区分运动化（更低更激进的视觉重心、锋利肩线、大开口进气）与优雅化（更柔和的车顶线与肩部过渡、更内敛的进气口设置）两种风格。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: tallWheelProfile (大轮径/高轮廓姿态)
description: Raised visual stance caused by larger wheels or taller tyre profiles; affects ground clearance and perceived robustness.
text:
名称：tallWheelProfile (大轮径/高轮廓姿态)
描述：Raised visual stance caused by larger wheels or taller tyre profiles; affects ground clearance and perceived robustness.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ClosureMassDistribution
description: Longitudinal placement of closure center of mass relative to hinge affecting torque and required support force.
text:
名称：ClosureMassDistribution
描述：Longitudinal placement of closure center of mass relative to hinge affecting torque and required support force.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Engine Efficiency
description: Mejoras en rendimiento térmico, downsizing con sobrealimentación y control electrónico para reducir consumo.
text:
名称：Engine Efficiency
描述：Mejoras en rendimiento térmico, downsizing con sobrealimentación y control electrónico para reducir consumo.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: pitch_and_bounce
description: Encompasses pitch and bounce behaviors. Temporal response characteristics (natural periods) determine how disturbances propagate as pitch or bounce; unsprung-mass dynamics affect vertical response and transmissibility to the sprung mass.
text:
名称：pitch_and_bounce
描述：Encompasses pitch and bounce behaviors. Temporal response characteristics (natural periods) determine how disturbances propagate as pitch or bounce; unsprung-mass dynamics affect vertical response and transmissibility to the sprung mass.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: CarriageLike
description: 典型的高车顶、直立前脸与明显的分段视感，常与早期汽车或复古情绪相关。
text:
名称：CarriageLike
描述：典型的高车顶、直立前脸与明显的分段视感，常与早期汽车或复古情绪相关。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Cornering / Roll
description: Stance during lateral maneuvers or when traversing uneven terrain, characterized by vehicle roll, axle articulation and apparent lean; includes roll angle, weight transfer distribution, camber and track changes, and resulting tire steering/angle and contact patch variations. Directly related to lateral force capability (μ_l) and overall cornering behavior.
text:
名称：Cornering / Roll
描述：Stance during lateral maneuvers or when traversing uneven terrain, characterized by vehicle roll, axle articulation and apparent lean; includes roll angle, weight transfer distribution, camber and track changes, and resulting tire steering/angle and contact patch variations. Directly related to lateral force capability (μ_l) and overall cornering behavior.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Level & Stable Ride
description: Maintained ride height, low pitch and controlled bounce perceived as composed and comfortable
text:
名称：Level & Stable Ride
描述：Maintained ride height, low pitch and controlled bounce perceived as composed and comfortable

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: lowSlopingProfile (低趴流线姿态)
description: Low roofline, long bonnet and tapered rear producing a sleek, aerodynamic stance associated with lower c_d at speed.
text:
名称：lowSlopingProfile (低趴流线姿态)
描述：Low roofline, long bonnet and tapered rear producing a sleek, aerodynamic stance associated with lower c_d at speed.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Varied hood/proportion outcomes
description: 不同气缸排列导致的前端体积与高度变化，形成不同车身比例与视觉姿态。
text:
名称：Varied hood/proportion outcomes
描述：不同气缸排列导致的前端体积与高度变化，形成不同车身比例与视觉姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Seated Neutral Posture
description: Upright trunk with balanced spinal curvature and minimal sustained tissue strain; a neutral reference posture minimizing musculoskeletal loading.
text:
名称：Seated Neutral Posture
描述：Upright trunk with balanced spinal curvature and minimal sustained tissue strain; a neutral reference posture minimizing musculoskeletal loading.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Minimized Pitch During Braking/Acceleration
description: A stable fore-aft body attitude with reduced nose-dive (under braking) and squat (under acceleration) achieved by appropriate damping and suspension settings to reduce longitudinal pitch moments.
text:
名称：Minimized Pitch During Braking/Acceleration
描述：A stable fore-aft body attitude with reduced nose-dive (under braking) and squat (under acceleration) achieved by appropriate damping and suspension settings to reduce longitudinal pitch moments.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Poised-to-pounce (蓄势待发)
description: 低重心，整体或局部前倾的视觉动势；前短后长或视觉上由后轮承托，体现准备冲刺、即将爆发的张力与动能感。
text:
名称：Poised-to-pounce (蓄势待发)
描述：低重心，整体或局部前倾的视觉动势；前短后长或视觉上由后轮承托，体现准备冲刺、即将爆发的张力与动能感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Comfortable seated posture
description: Seated stance optimized for sustained driving comfort, featuring balanced torso-to-thigh and neck angles with lumbar support engaged.
text:
名称：Comfortable seated posture
描述：Seated stance optimized for sustained driving comfort, featuring balanced torso-to-thigh and neck angles with lumbar support engaged.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Narrow greenhouse
description: Reduced lateral dimensions of windows/roof (narrowed greenhouse) to lower frontal area and visual height. (缩减车窗/车顶横向尺寸以降低迎风面积与视觉高度。)
text:
名称：Narrow greenhouse
描述：Reduced lateral dimensions of windows/roof (narrowed greenhouse) to lower frontal area and visual height. (缩减车窗/车顶横向尺寸以降低迎风面积与视觉高度。)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Functional Sitting Posture
description: 执行性坐姿，用于上下车、搬运物品或执行驾驶相关动作时采用的姿态，强调机动性、稳定性与可达性而非持续乘坐的最大舒适度。
text:
名称：Functional Sitting Posture
描述：执行性坐姿，用于上下车、搬运物品或执行驾驶相关动作时采用的姿态，强调机动性、稳定性与可达性而非持续乘坐的最大舒适度。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stately Elongated Stance
description: Upright, formal presence with a long bonnet and high hood line, projecting ceremonial, premium and authoritative character distinct from sportier long-hood variants.
text:
名称：Stately Elongated Stance
描述：Upright, formal presence with a long bonnet and high hood line, projecting ceremonial, premium and authoritative character distinct from sportier long-hood variants.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Robust Stance / Robust Safety Stance (结实/稳固安全姿态)
description: 视觉上强调结构强度与承载能力，同时呈现宽体、重心较低或具有明显保护特征以传达稳固与安全感。适用于需表现高强度、承载性或防护性的车型，如卡车、SUV及强调安全性的量产或概念车。
text:
名称：Robust Stance / Robust Safety Stance (结实/稳固安全姿态)
描述：视觉上强调结构强度与承载能力，同时呈现宽体、重心较低或具有明显保护特征以传达稳固与安全感。适用于需表现高强度、承载性或防护性的车型，如卡车、SUV及强调安全性的量产或概念车。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stance & Proportions
description: 车辆的整体站姿与比例感，体现车身重心、长宽高比例与运动感，受车轮相对位置、悬挂参数等影响，决定视觉侵略性、稳重感与运动感。
text:
名称：Stance & Proportions
描述：车辆的整体站姿与比例感，体现车身重心、长宽高比例与运动感，受车轮相对位置、悬挂参数等影响，决定视觉侵略性、稳重感与运动感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SymmetricCarryPosture
description: User maintains a symmetric stance with minimal trunk twist during handling, resulting in reduced asymmetric joint loading.
text:
名称：SymmetricCarryPosture
描述：User maintains a symmetric stance with minimal trunk twist during handling, resulting in reduced asymmetric joint loading.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: optimal_aerodynamic_trim_for_yaw
description: Vehicle aerodynamic configuration optimized to perform well at a typical on-road yaw condition (improves drag and perceived stability).
text:
名称：optimal_aerodynamic_trim_for_yaw
描述：Vehicle aerodynamic configuration optimized to perform well at a typical on-road yaw condition (improves drag and perceived stability).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ReducedSpinalLoadPosture
description: Posture where user can brace with hands to reduce spinal loads while bending or lifting.
text:
名称：ReducedSpinalLoadPosture
描述：Posture where user can brace with hands to reduce spinal loads while bending or lifting.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Disjointed rectilinear stance
description: Visual impression of segmented, boxy volumes and visible production seams associated with early mass-produced cars.
text:
名称：Disjointed rectilinear stance
描述：Visual impression of segmented, boxy volumes and visible production seams associated with early mass-produced cars.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Refined / Lower unsprung mass
description: Visual and dynamic perception of improved ride quality and handling due to reduced unsprung mass.
text:
名称：Refined / Lower unsprung mass
描述：Visual and dynamic perception of improved ride quality and handling due to reduced unsprung mass.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 沉稳耐看
description: 经典、平衡、经得起时间检验的车身视觉姿态。
text:
名称：沉稳耐看
描述：经典、平衡、经得起时间检验的车身视觉姿态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Hood_Release_Visibility
description: 车内发动机盖开启拉杆或舱内拉杆应易于看到、辨认与抓取，减少查找时间和误操作。
text:
名称：Hood_Release_Visibility
描述：车内发动机盖开启拉杆或舱内拉杆应易于看到、辨认与抓取，减少查找时间和误操作。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dynamic forward-leaning posture
description: 由短前悬、上升的腰线和明显的前脸特征营造的视觉姿态，使车辆看起来向前俯冲、蓄势待发。
text:
名称：Dynamic forward-leaning posture
描述：由短前悬、上升的腰线和明显的前脸特征营造的视觉姿态，使车辆看起来向前俯冲、蓄势待发。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stately/Regal Luxury Stance (庄重优雅/豪华姿态)
description: 低而拉伸的车身轮廓与修长前引擎盖、后置乘舱布局（long-hood, rearward-set cabin），配合低车顶线与均衡的轮位，形成宽阔、沉稳且富有尾部力量感的视觉重心。整体线条连贯，视觉上传达尊贵、礼仪感与豪华气质，常见于高端豪华轿车与旗舰车型。
text:
名称：Stately/Regal Luxury Stance (庄重优雅/豪华姿态)
描述：低而拉伸的车身轮廓与修长前引擎盖、后置乘舱布局（long-hood, rearward-set cabin），配合低车顶线与均衡的轮位，形成宽阔、沉稳且富有尾部力量感的视觉重心。整体线条连贯，视觉上传达尊贵、礼仪感与豪华气质，常见于高端豪华轿车与旗舰车型。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: HighRoof_FlatFloor
description: High roofline and flat interior floor enabling upright wheelchair movement and easy transfers.
text:
名称：HighRoof_FlatFloor
描述：High roofline and flat interior floor enabling upright wheelchair movement and easy transfers.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: CarriageLikeUprightStance
description: 高底盘、窄轮距、纵向长机舱和直立驾驶位置，整体呈现出马车转向的早期汽车姿态。 (High chassis, narrow track, long longitudinal engine bay and upright driving position, overall resembling early carriage-like steering posture.)
text:
名称：CarriageLikeUprightStance
描述：高底盘、窄轮距、纵向长机舱和直立驾驶位置，整体呈现出马车转向的早期汽车姿态。 (High chassis, narrow track, long longitudinal engine bay and upright driving position, overall resembling early carriage-like steering posture.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Relaxed Reclined Posture
description: 明显后仰的放松坐姿，针对休憩或低注意力场景设计，要求较大靠背调节范围与相应的侧向与腰部支撑以维持舒适。相对降低对即时视野与驾驶控制的要求。
text:
名称：Relaxed Reclined Posture
描述：明显后仰的放松坐姿，针对休憩或低注意力场景设计，要求较大靠背调节范围与相应的侧向与腰部支撑以维持舒适。相对降低对即时视野与驾驶控制的要求。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung sleek front
description: Visual stance characterized by low, slim front lamps and reduced apparent width.
text:
名称：Low-slung sleek front
描述：Visual stance characterized by low, slim front lamps and reduced apparent width.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Perceived premium stance
description: Visual stance indicating premium build and refinement as perceived by observers.
text:
名称：Perceived premium stance
描述：Visual stance indicating premium build and refinement as perceived by observers.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Reduced roll during cornering
description: Lower body roll angle and more neutral chassis attitude under lateral acceleration achieved via higher lateral damping.
text:
名称：Reduced roll during cornering
描述：Lower body roll angle and more neutral chassis attitude under lateral acceleration achieved via higher lateral damping.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SlopedWindshieldStance
description: Stance characterized by a pronounced windshield rake and an elongated greenhouse; can enhance aerodynamic flow but may alter reflection geometry and increase veiling-glare risk. / 以明显倾斜的前挡风玻璃和拉长的车窗区为特征，能改善气动流线但可能改变反射几何并增加眩光风险。
text:
名称：SlopedWindshieldStance
描述：Stance characterized by a pronounced windshield rake and an elongated greenhouse; can enhance aerodynamic flow but may alter reflection geometry and increase veiling-glare risk. / 以明显倾斜的前挡风玻璃和拉长的车窗区为特征，能改善气动流线但可能改变反射几何并增加眩光风险。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Forward Visibility & Driver Viewing Posture
description: 以向前可见性为优先的视觉与坐姿态，涵盖驾驶员能以最少头/眼转动辨识前方目标与仪表的信息、由95百分位左右/右眼椭圆定义的双目视野用于仪表垂直布置、以及因A/B柱遮挡而影响的道路与侧向可视范围；在外观感知上可表现为更直立、注意力前导的姿态，传达准备就绪与集中注意的视觉信息。
text:
名称：Forward Visibility & Driver Viewing Posture

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Shoulder clearance (肩部间隙)
description: Lateral packaging to avoid contact with door or center console.
text:
名称：Shoulder clearance (肩部间隙)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung Fastback
description: 低重心、溜背比例，侧面线条向后延伸，整体视觉拉长并具运动感。 (Low center of gravity with fastback proportions: side lines extend rearward, creating an elongated, sporty visual impression.)
text:
名称：Low-slung Fastback
描述：低重心、溜背比例，侧面线条向后延伸，整体视觉拉长并具运动感。 (Low center of gravity with fastback proportions: side lines extend rearward, creating an elongated, sporty visual impression.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Monovolumen stance (MPV 姿态)
description: 高顶、短前悬、较长车舱比（cab-forward）与强调实用性的盒式/曲面结合外观。
text:
名称：Monovolumen stance (MPV 姿态)
描述：高顶、短前悬、较长车舱比（cab-forward）与强调实用性的盒式/曲面结合外观。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Seated posture range

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 侧面动感姿态

名称：侧面动感姿态

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Coupe Long-Door Proportions
description: A stance where elongated doors create a stretched side profile and visually break up body proportions typical of large two-door vehicles.
text:
名称：Coupe Long-Door Proportions
描述：A stance where elongated doors create a stretched side profile and visually break up body proportions typical of large two-door vehicles.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Expressive
description: Visually communicates emotion through details, lighting and surface language.
text:
名称：Expressive
描述：Visually communicates emotion through details, lighting and surface language.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-Ride / Soft Stance
description: Stance with taller apparent ride height and softer, more compliant visual impression; associated with off-road/utility vehicles.
text:
名称：High-Ride / Soft Stance
描述：Stance with taller apparent ride height and softer, more compliant visual impression; associated with off-road/utility vehicles.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung compact coupé
description: 紧凑轴距、低车顶与短前后悬的轿跑姿态，强调灵活与动态视觉效果。 (Compact wheelbase, low roof and short overhangs emphasizing agility and a dynamic visual stance.)
text:
名称：Low-slung compact coupé
描述：紧凑轴距、低车顶与短前后悬的轿跑姿态，强调灵活与动态视觉效果。 (Compact wheelbase, low roof and short overhangs emphasizing agility and a dynamic visual stance.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ElongatedProfile
description: Visual stance with an elongated body and extended rear volume or wheelbase to meet cargo-length targets; often perceived as more utilitarian or van-like. 视觉上车身修长，流畅的侧面线条，前后比例延展，后部体积或轴距延长以满足载物需求，常给人更实用/面包车般的视觉印象。
text:
名称：ElongatedProfile
描述：Visual stance with an elongated body and extended rear volume or wheelbase to meet cargo-length targets; often perceived as more utilitarian or van-like. 视觉上车身修长，流畅的侧面线条，前后比例延展，后部体积或轴距延长以满足载物需求，常给人更实用/面包车般的视觉印象。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Neutral / Inclusive Brand-Agnostic Stance (中性/包容，品牌依赖度低姿态)
description: A visual and ergonomic stance where seating and control positions present a balanced, neither overly reclined nor upright posture suitable for the majority of users. Visually not dominated by brand authority — emphasizes function, value and broad appeal. / 中文：一种视觉与人体工程学姿态，座椅与操控位置呈均衡、不过度后仰也不过度直立，适合大多数用户；视觉上不以品牌权威为主导，更强调功能、性价比与普适吸引力。
text:
名称：Neutral / Inclusive Brand-Agnostic Stance (中性/包容，品牌依赖度低姿态)
描述：A visual and ergonomic stance where seating and control positions present a balanced, neither overly reclined nor upright posture suitable for the majority of users. Visually not dominated by brand authority — emphasizes function, value and broad appeal. / 中文：一种视觉与人体工程学姿态，座椅与操控位置呈均衡、不过度后仰也不过度直立，适合大多数用户；视觉上不以品牌权威为主导，更强调功能、性价比与普适吸引力。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung rear-biased coupe
description: Visual stance characterized by a forward cockpit, shortened front overhang, compact cabin and emphasized rear mass/tyre presence.
text:
名称：Low-slung rear-biased coupe
描述：Visual stance characterized by a forward cockpit, shortened front overhang, compact cabin and emphasized rear mass/tyre presence.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Compact Upright
description: 车身较短、轴距偏短，乘员舱相对较高（较高的离地高度）、引擎罩较短，车窗周围更趋垂直，整体造型紧凑挺拔。该姿态既见于早期大众化车型（如Model T）也常用于微型车，适合密集城市环境的短车身、高坐姿布局。
text:
名称：Compact Upright
描述：车身较短、轴距偏短，乘员舱相对较高（较高的离地高度）、引擎罩较短，车窗周围更趋垂直，整体造型紧凑挺拔。该姿态既见于早期大众化车型（如Model T）也常用于微型车，适合密集城市环境的短车身、高坐姿布局。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Majestic elongated low-slung with upright rear
description: 流线与拉长比例共同营造出来的优雅、庄重姿态。 (Elegance and a dignified stance created by streamlined, elongated proportions, combined with a comparatively upright rear.)
text:
名称：Majestic elongated low-slung with upright rear
描述：流线与拉长比例共同营造出来的优雅、庄重姿态。 (Elegance and a dignified stance created by streamlined, elongated proportions, combined with a comparatively upright rear.)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Occupant visibility / framing
description: Degree to which occupants are visible and framed by the cockpit; includes sightlines, rim of cockpit, and relationship to body contours.
text:
名称：Occupant visibility / framing
描述：Degree to which occupants are visible and framed by the cockpit; includes sightlines, rim of cockpit, and relationship to body contours.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: VisuallyAged
description: Vehicle stance/proportion perceived as aged or poorly maintained due to visible corrosion, faded finishes or uneven wear.
text:
名称：VisuallyAged
描述：Vehicle stance/proportion perceived as aged or poorly maintained due to visible corrosion, faded finishes or uneven wear.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung (sporty / streamlined / aggressive)
description: 整体视觉重心低、车身低矮且纵向延展或横向拉伸，常见于跑车、GT与运动化轿车。典型特征包括低车顶线与低坐姿、长引擎盖与短前后悬或紧凑车身包线、在部分车型上表现为宽轨道（wide stance）；强调空气动力学流线、速度感与运动性能，视觉上呈现激进或优雅的运动姿态。通常通过紧凑包装、轻量化材料与以驾驶者为中心的比例来实现。 Overall low visual center of gravity with a long, low silhouette and compact packaging; features include low roofline, long hood, short overhangs, sometimes a wide track, aerodynamic shaping and an athletic/aggressive stance that emphasizes performance.
text:
名称：Low-slung (sporty / streamlined / aggressive)
描述：整体视觉重心低、车身低矮且纵向延展或横向拉伸，常见于跑车、GT与运动化轿车。典型特征包括低车顶线与低坐姿、长引擎盖与短前后悬或紧凑车身包线、在部分车型上表现为宽轨道（wide stance）；强调空气动力学流线、速度感与运动性能，视觉上呈现激进或优雅的运动姿态。通常通过紧凑包装、轻量化材料与以驾驶者为中心的比例来实现。 Overall low visual center of gravity with a long, low silhouette and compact packaging; features include low roofline, long hood, short overhangs, sometimes a wide track, aerodynamic shaping and an athletic/aggressive stance that emphasizes performance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stable ride on high-frequency roughness
description: Cabin experiences reduced vibration and harshness through selective softening of dampers to absorb small-wavelength road inputs.
text:
名称：Stable ride on high-frequency roughness
描述：Cabin experiences reduced vibration and harshness through selective softening of dampers to absorb small-wavelength road inputs.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Clean-side-surface posture
description: A visual stance where doors overlap structural elements, producing a cleaner, more continuous side appearance with fewer visible components.
text:
名称：Clean-side-surface posture
描述：A visual stance where doors overlap structural elements, producing a cleaner, more continuous side appearance with fewer visible components.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 中型轿车姿态
description: 低重心、修长车顶线与运动化比例，体现运动与精致
text:
名称：中型轿车姿态
描述：低重心、修长车顶线与运动化比例，体现运动与精致

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 修长·动感·运动化姿态 (Sleek / Dynamic / Sporty Stance)
description: 融合低车顶线与流线侧面（修长低矮）、无框车窗、更长的前/后悬以及较低重心高度，辅以锋利或分段肩线等细节，形成既流线优雅又更为激进和运动化的车身姿态。典型识别要素包括低矮车顶轮廓、短重心高度、长前后悬与明显的肩线处理（增加视觉动感和侵略性）。
text:
名称：修长·动感·运动化姿态 (Sleek / Dynamic / Sporty Stance)
描述：融合低车顶线与流线侧面（修长低矮）、无框车窗、更长的前/后悬以及较低重心高度，辅以锋利或分段肩线等细节，形成既流线优雅又更为激进和运动化的车身姿态。典型识别要素包括低矮车顶轮廓、短重心高度、长前后悬与明显的肩线处理（增加视觉动感和侵略性）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Long-hood / short-hood variations
description: Differences in hood length relative to cabin created by powertrain packaging choices; used to compare products and show why vehicles differ in benchmark studies.
text:
名称：Long-hood / short-hood variations
描述：Differences in hood length relative to cabin created by powertrain packaging choices; used to compare products and show why vehicles differ in benchmark studies.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Market-Oriented Stance
description: Overall stance and proportions tailored to market/price/size: compact/urban, premium/serene, utility/robust.
text:
名称：Market-Oriented Stance
描述：Overall stance and proportions tailored to market/price/size: compact/urban, premium/serene, utility/robust.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前冲姿态 (Forward-thrust posture)
description: 整体视觉上车头偏前、重心向前，前端重心感强，传达加速感与攻击性，给人进取、动势强烈的感受。
text:
名称：前冲姿态 (Forward-thrust posture)
描述：整体视觉上车头偏前、重心向前，前端重心感强，传达加速感与攻击性，给人进取、动势强烈的感受。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung stance
description: An overall lowered occupant area and stance characterized by a low seating position. Manifests across body types: for sedans it produces a lower overall stance that can feel easier to 'drop into' but may require more leg push to exit; for roadsters it is often combined with long-hood, short-deck proportions and emphasized wheel arches, typical of classic two-seat sports roadsters.
text:
名称：Low-slung stance
描述：An overall lowered occupant area and stance characterized by a low seating position. Manifests across body types: for sedans it produces a lower overall stance that can feel easier to 'drop into' but may require more leg push to exit; for roadsters it is often combined with long-hood, short-deck proportions and emphasized wheel arches, typical of classic two-seat sports roadsters.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Low bonnet / sweeping hood
description: Low front profile to reduce frontal area and improve airflow over the vehicle
text:
名称：Low bonnet / sweeping hood
描述：Low front profile to reduce frontal area and improve airflow over the vehicle

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Crossover stance
description: Higher ride height and robust lower body that visually positions the vehicle between a car and an SUV, conveying capability and a raised driving posture.
text:
名称：Crossover stance
描述：Higher ride height and robust lower body that visually positions the vehicle between a car and an SUV, conveying capability and a raised driving posture.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung aerodynamic supercar
description: 见前，强动力布局推动宽轨低姿态设计。 (High-power drivetrain layouts lead to wide-track, very low stances characteristic of aerodynamic supercars.)
text:
名称：Low-slung aerodynamic supercar
描述：见前，强动力布局推动宽轨低姿态设计。 (High-power drivetrain layouts lead to wide-track, very low stances characteristic of aerodynamic supercars.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High ground clearance / truck stance
description: Elevated ride height and upright proportions associated with pickups, large SUVs and off-road vehicles with body-on-frame chassis. 典型于皮卡、大型SUV和越野车，具有较高的离地间隙与直立的车身比例。
text:
名称：High ground clearance / truck stance
描述：Elevated ride height and upright proportions associated with pickups, large SUVs and off-road vehicles with body-on-frame chassis. 典型于皮卡、大型SUV和越野车，具有较高的离地间隙与直立的车身比例。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Braking Pitch / Brake-Induced Pitch
description: Forward longitudinal attitude change (nose-dive) during braking caused by weight transfer to the front axle. Typically a temporary forward pitch under heavy braking that affects visual stance and wheel-arch clearance.
text:
名称：Braking Pitch / Brake-Induced Pitch
描述：Forward longitudinal attitude change (nose-dive) during braking caused by weight transfer to the front axle. Typically a temporary forward pitch under heavy braking that affects visual stance and wheel-arch clearance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Elevated / Rugged / Commanding Stance
description: Tall, assertive posture with increased ride height or visible wheel arches, conveying off-road capability, load-bearing robustness or a commanding seating position. Applies to SUVs, trucks, heavy-duty commercial vehicles and rugged crossovers emphasizing clearance, protection and presence.
text:
名称：Elevated / Rugged / Commanding Stance
描述：Tall, assertive posture with increased ride height or visible wheel arches, conveying off-road capability, load-bearing robustness or a commanding seating position. Applies to SUVs, trucks, heavy-duty commercial vehicles and rugged crossovers emphasizing clearance, protection and presence.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Composed / Dignified / Stable stance
description: A sober, centered and composed vehicle stance emphasizing a clear visual central axis and a moderate-to-rear visual center. Conveys solidity, refinement and conservative/business character while implying calm attentiveness (relaxed yet ready). Often associated with low NVH, architectural symmetry and a stable, dignified presence.
text:
名称：Composed / Dignified / Stable stance
描述：A sober, centered and composed vehicle stance emphasizing a clear visual central axis and a moderate-to-rear visual center. Conveys solidity, refinement and conservative/business character while implying calm attentiveness (relaxed yet ready). Often associated with low NVH, architectural symmetry and a stable, dignified presence.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-stress local zones (window & door pillars)
description: Specific localized posture/condition where cyclic stresses concentrate (adjacent to weld deposits on upper window pillars and around door pillars).
text:
名称：High-stress local zones (window & door pillars)
描述：Specific localized posture/condition where cyclic stresses concentrate (adjacent to weld deposits on upper window pillars and around door pillars).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dignified upright posture
description: 结合较高坐姿与适中车头长度的视觉姿态，传达沉稳与尊贵感而不追求运动张力；常用于强调体面与稳重的设计语言。
text:
名称：Dignified upright posture
描述：结合较高坐姿与适中车头长度的视觉姿态，传达沉稳与尊贵感而不追求运动张力；常用于强调体面与稳重的设计语言。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Camber & Tire Alignment Posture
description: Describes wheel/tire inclination and lateral position behavior through suspension travel, steering and roll. Encompasses perceived camber change that affects grip and stance, lateral displacement of the wheel envelope during jounce/steer, rear-specific camber response, and the camber-stable or vertical-tire behavior that maintains optimal contact patch under lateral load. Observable from envelope extremes and during high steering lock or cornering.
text:
名称：Camber & Tire Alignment Posture
描述：Describes wheel/tire inclination and lateral position behavior through suspension travel, steering and roll. Encompasses perceived camber change that affects grip and stance, lateral displacement of the wheel envelope during jounce/steer, rear-specific camber response, and the camber-stable or vertical-tire behavior that maintains optimal contact patch under lateral load. Observable from envelope extremes and during high steering lock or cornering.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Upright posture (直立类姿态)
description: 直立类姿态：车舱较高、视野开阔、坐姿与车顶线偏高，传达舒适、实用与保护性的设计导向。可表现为较为放松的直立坐姿以提升舒适性；或以箱体化、方正的体积优先保证内部空间与乘员保护；车轮尺寸增大亦会提高视觉和实际坐高。常见于MPV、厢式/多功能车及部分SUV/跨界车。
text:
名称：Upright posture (直立类姿态)
描述：直立类姿态：车舱较高、视野开阔、坐姿与车顶线偏高，传达舒适、实用与保护性的设计导向。可表现为较为放松的直立坐姿以提升舒适性；或以箱体化、方正的体积优先保证内部空间与乘员保护；车轮尺寸增大亦会提高视觉和实际坐高。常见于MPV、厢式/多功能车及部分SUV/跨界车。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Distributed controllers and cooling
description: Electronic controllers and cooling hardware placed near battery or motors rather than in a centralized engine bay.
text:
名称：Distributed controllers and cooling
描述：Electronic controllers and cooling hardware placed near battery or motors rather than in a centralized engine bay.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Comfort-oriented / Taller stance
description: 强调乘坐舒适性与实用性的车身比例，视觉上更注重宽适与包裹性，通常表现为更高的轮胎侧壁和较小的轮毂，从而带来更高的驾乘姿态与顺应路况的乘坐感。 (Perceived taller ride and classic proportions from higher sidewalls and smaller rims; emphasizes comfort and practicality with a visually wider, more enveloping stance.)
text:
名称：Comfort-oriented / Taller stance
描述：强调乘坐舒适性与实用性的车身比例，视觉上更注重宽适与包裹性，通常表现为更高的轮胎侧壁和较小的轮毂，从而带来更高的驾乘姿态与顺应路况的乘坐感。 (Perceived taller ride and classic proportions from higher sidewalls and smaller rims; emphasizes comfort and practicality with a visually wider, more enveloping stance.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 时代性姿态（Era Stance）
description: 反映特定历史时期审美与技术条件下的整体车身姿态与比例感
text:
名称：时代性姿态（Era Stance）
描述：反映特定历史时期审美与技术条件下的整体车身姿态与比例感

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 延展姿态
description: 低车顶、长侧窗、拉长后悬与长轴距结合流畅的侧面比例，共同营造修长且运动同时兼具优雅的侧面视觉效果。
text:
名称：延展姿态
描述：低车顶、长侧窗、拉长后悬与长轴距结合流畅的侧面比例，共同营造修长且运动同时兼具优雅的侧面视觉效果。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Prolonged contact posture (door-contact displacement)
description: Occupant torso posture during extended contact with the inner door/padding (characterised by initial acceleration peak followed by continued compression and displacement).
text:
名称：Prolonged contact posture (door-contact displacement)
描述：Occupant torso posture during extended contact with the inner door/padding (characterised by initial acceleration peak followed by continued compression and displacement).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: HighFloor/LongFloor
description: Minivan-like stance with elevated cargo floor to allow underfloor packaging of tanks and modular seating.
text:
名称：HighFloor/LongFloor
描述：Minivan-like stance with elevated cargo floor to allow underfloor packaging of tanks and modular seating.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Stable Braking Posture (vs Unstable/Locked)
description: Controlled/ABS-maintained braking posture that avoids full wheel lock, preserves lateral capability and yields more stable deceleration. Stable braking (slip up to ~20%) permits maximum usable longitudinal force; unstable/locked posture (very high slip → near 100%) leads to wheel lock and loss of lateral control.
text:
名称：Stable Braking Posture (vs Unstable/Locked)
描述：Controlled/ABS-maintained braking posture that avoids full wheel lock, preserves lateral capability and yields more stable deceleration. Stable braking (slip up to ~20%) permits maximum usable longitudinal force; unstable/locked posture (very high slip → near 100%) leads to wheel lock and loss of lateral control.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Front-engine long-hood
description: Long hood and visually pushed-back passenger compartment resulting from a long longitudinal engine.
text:
名称：Front-engine long-hood
描述：Long hood and visually pushed-back passenger compartment resulting from a long longitudinal engine.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Refined solidity
description: A grounded, proportionate stance that reads as durable, premium and well-executed.
text:
名称：Refined solidity
描述：A grounded, proportionate stance that reads as durable, premium and well-executed.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 冻结后的最终姿态与比例
description: 在造型冻结后由点云与逆向数字建模确定的最终视觉姿态与比例。
text:
名称：冻结后的最终姿态与比例
描述：在造型冻结后由点云与逆向数字建模确定的最终视觉姿态与比例。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 凝练姿态
description: 通过统一的视觉语言和精炼的设计要点展现单一主旨的车身姿态，线条与比例更为纯粹。
text:
名称：凝练姿态
描述：通过统一的视觉语言和精炼的设计要点展现单一主旨的车身姿态，线条与比例更为纯粹。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: DisplayLocation
description: Placement of visual displays (instrument cluster, center displays) relative to driver sightlines and down-angle cone.
text:
名称：DisplayLocation
描述：Placement of visual displays (instrument cluster, center displays) relative to driver sightlines and down-angle cone.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ProductionStance
description: Realistic stance and proportions consistent with engineering and packaging constraints suitable for further development.
text:
名称：ProductionStance
描述：Realistic stance and proportions consistent with engineering and packaging constraints suitable for further development.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung sporty (低矮运动姿态)
description: Lower H-point, reduced headroom envelope, lower hood, sloping windshield, streamlined roofline, pronounced wheel arches and stretched silhouette — emphasizes sporty aesthetics, visual width, lower visual center of gravity and a dynamic sense. / 低引擎盖、风挡倾角低、车顶线流畅、腰线与轮眉明显、轮廓拉伸，视觉重心低、车内头部空间压缩，强调运动性、视觉宽度与动态感。
text:
名称：Low-slung sporty (低矮运动姿态)
描述：Lower H-point, reduced headroom envelope, lower hood, sloping windshield, streamlined roofline, pronounced wheel arches and stretched silhouette — emphasizes sporty aesthetics, visual width, lower visual center of gravity and a dynamic sense. / 低引擎盖、风挡倾角低、车顶线流畅、腰线与轮眉明显、轮廓拉伸，视觉重心低、车内头部空间压缩，强调运动性、视觉宽度与动态感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Service-oriented posture
description: A stance that visually communicates serviceability and practical utility.
text:
名称：Service-oriented posture
描述：A stance that visually communicates serviceability and practical utility.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Vehicle Attitude
description: Overall perceived stance and proportions (e.g., low-slung, upright, wide-stance). Includes controlled/levelled attitude where the vehicle maintains intended ride height and attitude with minimal squat, dive or roll during acceleration, braking and cornering.
text:
名称：Vehicle Attitude
描述：Overall perceived stance and proportions (e.g., low-slung, upright, wide-stance). Includes controlled/levelled attitude where the vehicle maintains intended ride height and attitude with minimal squat, dive or roll during acceleration, braking and cornering.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sports Car Low Stance
description: Low seating, low overall height and minimal ground clearance to reduce frontal area and center of gravity. 低矮座椅、低车身高度与最小离地间隙以减小迎风面积并降低重心。
text:
名称：Sports Car Low Stance
描述：Low seating, low overall height and minimal ground clearance to reduce frontal area and center of gravity. 低矮座椅、低车身高度与最小离地间隙以减小迎风面积并降低重心。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Seated Comfort Posture
description: Low-to-medium hip point, reclined backrest angle and ergonomic support producing relaxed long-distance comfort.
text:
名称：Seated Comfort Posture
描述：Low-to-medium hip point, reclined backrest angle and ergonomic support producing relaxed long-distance comfort.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: low-slung dynamic stance (低矮/低趴动感姿态)
description: 低车顶、车身姿态低矮且重心前倾；长前引擎舱或修长轮廓，伴随较长的前后悬或短前悬，使整体视觉被拉伸并呈现强烈的运动感。
text:
名称：low-slung dynamic stance (低矮/低趴动感姿态)
描述：低车顶、车身姿态低矮且重心前倾；长前引擎舱或修长轮廓，伴随较长的前后悬或短前悬，使整体视觉被拉伸并呈现强烈的运动感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Executive limousine stance
description: 长轴距、低车顶、沉稳前脸与优雅腰线构成的正式行政型车姿态。
text:
名称：Executive limousine stance
描述：长轴距、低车顶、沉稳前脸与优雅腰线构成的正式行政型车姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Body roll
description: Rotation (lean) of the sprung body about the roll axis (roll angle, φ) experienced during lateral acceleration or cornering. Body roll causes redistribution of vertical tyre loads between inner and outer wheels, influences load transfer, tyre normal loads, handling feel and understeer/oversteer balance. The perceived roll behaviour depends on roll-centre height, spring rates, anti-roll bar configuration and suspension geometry. 'Reduced body roll' denotes a smaller rotation of the sprung body under the same lateral acceleration.
text:
名称：Body roll
描述：Rotation (lean) of the sprung body about the roll axis (roll angle, φ) experienced during lateral acceleration or cornering. Body roll causes redistribution of vertical tyre loads between inner and outer wheels, influences load transfer, tyre normal loads, handling feel and understeer/oversteer balance. The perceived roll behaviour depends on roll-centre height, spring rates, anti-roll bar configuration and suspension geometry. 'Reduced body roll' denotes a smaller rotation of the sprung body under the same lateral acceleration.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dynamic rear toe/steer
description: Small dynamic toe or steer changes at the rear axle that influence transient yaw and handling balance.
text:
名称：Dynamic rear toe/steer
描述：Small dynamic toe or steer changes at the rear axle that influence transient yaw and handling balance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 减少配光元件依赖
description: 固态光源在很多应用中无需大型反光杯或复杂配光件，形态由光源阵列与外形本体决定。
text:
名称：减少配光元件依赖
描述：固态光源在很多应用中无需大型反光杯或复杂配光件，形态由光源阵列与外形本体决定。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung stance
description: A vehicle posture characterized by a low roofline and reduced perceived ride height (often due to underfloor batteries or design), elongated proportions (long bonnet/short cabin), wide track and pronounced wheel presence. Surfaces tend to be taut with tight panel gaps; greenhouse height is reduced and body forms may be refined to minimize drag. The overall effect is a grounded, performance-oriented appearance conveying speed, agility, stability and aerodynamic efficiency.
text:
名称：Low-slung stance
描述：A vehicle posture characterized by a low roofline and reduced perceived ride height (often due to underfloor batteries or design), elongated proportions (long bonnet/short cabin), wide track and pronounced wheel presence. Surfaces tend to be taut with tight panel gaps; greenhouse height is reduced and body forms may be refined to minimize drag. The overall effect is a grounded, performance-oriented appearance conveying speed, agility, stability and aerodynamic efficiency.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Harmonious Stance(和谐姿态)
description: 因比例协调与视觉平衡而呈现的稳定、沉稳、优雅的侧视与三维姿态。
text:
名称：Harmonious Stance(和谐姿态)
描述：因比例协调与视觉平衡而呈现的稳定、沉稳、优雅的侧视与三维姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear occupant seated (95th male)
description: 95th percentile male passenger in rear seat with knees flexed, thighs supported by cushion, head behind driver H-point; lateral position defined relative to vehicle centerline and driver seat.
text:
名称：Rear occupant seated (95th male)
描述：95th percentile male passenger in rear seat with knees flexed, thighs supported by cushion, head behind driver H-point; lateral position defined relative to vehicle centerline and driver seat.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dramatic Stance(戏剧化姿态)
description: 因局部夸张或对比而呈现出的强烈、动感或对抗性的视觉姿态。
text:
名称：Dramatic Stance(戏剧化姿态)
描述：因局部夸张或对比而呈现出的强烈、动感或对抗性的视觉姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Agile athletic stance
description: 通过紧凑的质量分配、短悬伸、均衡的比例和姿态传达灵活性与运动感，暗示敏捷的操控特性。
text:
名称：Agile athletic stance
描述：通过紧凑的质量分配、短悬伸、均衡的比例和姿态传达灵活性与运动感，暗示敏捷的操控特性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Curb
description: Standard unloaded vehicle stance used as a primary styling reference: vehicle with full fluids and minimal load (typically no passengers; may include only the driver), wheels typically at nominal camber.
text:
名称：Curb
描述：Standard unloaded vehicle stance used as a primary styling reference: vehicle with full fluids and minimal load (typically no passengers; may include only the driver), wheels typically at nominal camber.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Driver seated (95th male)
description: 95th percentile male driver with thighs supported on seat pan, knees flexed ~30–45°, shins angled forward toward pedals; H-point located per SAE reference above floor.
text:
名称：Driver seated (95th male)
描述：95th percentile male driver with thighs supported on seat pan, knees flexed ~30–45°, shins angled forward toward pedals; H-point located per SAE reference above floor.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Floating Elegant Stance
description: Postura baja y estable con sensación de flotabilidad por la suspensión; transmite elegancia refinada y modernidad técnica.
text:
名称：Floating Elegant Stance
描述：Postura baja y estable con sensación de flotabilidad por la suspensión; transmite elegancia refinada y modernidad técnica.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前脸光学强调
description: 通过灯具线条与体量塑造前脸的视觉重心、宽度感与科技感。

名称：前脸光学强调
描述：通过灯具线条与体量塑造前脸的视觉重心、宽度感与科技感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-slung sporty dynamic posture
description: Low, stretched proportions with a long wheelbase, low roofline and forward-leaning gesture conveying speed, agility and visual momentum. Pronounced surfacing and athletic detailing reinforce a performance-oriented, sporty appearance.
text:
名称：Low-slung sporty dynamic posture
描述：Low, stretched proportions with a long wheelbase, low roofline and forward-leaning gesture conveying speed, agility and visual momentum. Pronounced surfacing and athletic detailing reinforce a performance-oriented, sporty appearance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Driver workload
description: Cognitive and physical demand imposed on the driver by tasks, interfaces and vehicle operation; a key evaluation metric in simulators and field tests.
text:
名称：Driver workload
描述：Cognitive and physical demand imposed on the driver by tasks, interfaces and vehicle operation; a key evaluation metric in simulators and field tests.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 曲面折线连接 (曲面趋于折线)
description: 车身曲面之间连接倾向于折线/棱角，增强硬朗视觉。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:
名称：Lateral Stance (Narrow or Wide)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:
名称：Stable Light Posture

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Comfort-Oriented Stance
description: Vehicle posture that prioritizes occupant comfort, characterized by soft vertical response and reduced transmission of road disturbances; body and interior proportions, materials and detailing favor comfort and practicality, emphasizing ease of ingress/egress, headroom and control reachability. / 以乘坐舒适为优先的车辆姿态，表现为纵向响应柔和、降低路面扰动传递；通过车身与内饰比例、材料与细节处理来体现舒适性，强调易进出、头部空间与操作可达性，视觉上传达舒适与实用性。
text:
名称：Comfort-Oriented Stance
描述：Vehicle posture that prioritizes occupant comfort, characterized by soft vertical response and reduced transmission of road disturbances; body and interior proportions, materials and detailing favor comfort and practicality, emphasizing ease of ingress/egress, headroom and control reachability. / 以乘坐舒适为优先的车辆姿态，表现为纵向响应柔和、降低路面扰动传递；通过车身与内饰比例、材料与细节处理来体现舒适性，强调易进出、头部空间与操作可达性，视觉上传达舒适与实用性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

description: Low-slung roof, wide track, short overhangs and strong wheel presence giving an athletic appearance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:
名称：Forward-focused Instrument Posture

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Friendly Compact Stance
description: 短前后悬、较高的车身比例与柔和的造型语言，传达亲和、易驾乘与城市友好感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Functional Frontal Lighting Posture

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ProvocativeStance
description: 强调视觉张力与辨识度的低重心、短前悬或极窄车顶线条。

名称：ProvocativeStance

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sedan Posture (轿车姿态)
description: 典型三厢分割，后悬相对延长、车尾流线化以呈现优雅的三厢视觉比例；适中离地间隙，重心偏中后或中等偏后，视觉重心中等至偏后，玻璃/车身比例约40%~50%。整体视觉给人稳重可靠且优雅的感觉。
text:
名称：Sedan Posture (轿车姿态)
描述：典型三厢分割，后悬相对延长、车尾流线化以呈现优雅的三厢视觉比例；适中离地间隙，重心偏中后或中等偏后，视觉重心中等至偏后，玻璃/车身比例约40%~50%。整体视觉给人稳重可靠且优雅的感觉。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Narrow carriage-like posture
description: Visual impression of an open coach with exposed seating and visible running gear; narrow track and high seat position.
text:
名称：Narrow carriage-like posture
描述：Visual impression of an open coach with exposed seating and visible running gear; narrow track and high seat position.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: ContinuousSideRoofline
description: 连续流畅的侧窗顶线/车身侧面姿态，表现为高光连续且比例和谐。
text:
名称：ContinuousSideRoofline
描述：连续流畅的侧窗顶线/车身侧面姿态，表现为高光连续且比例和谐。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Calm Horizontal Stance
description: 以横向延展和平直主线为特征的静稳、沉稳的侧面姿态。
text:
名称：Calm Horizontal Stance
描述：以横向延展和平直主线为特征的静稳、沉稳的侧面姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Cab-forward posture
description: Cabin positioned forward relative to axles with shortened bonnet, visually maximizing cabin volume.
text:
名称：Cab-forward posture
描述：Cabin positioned forward relative to axles with shortened bonnet, visually maximizing cabin volume.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: VisualProximity
description: 车辆被观察者感知的接近程度与视觉重量感，受外观色相与明度影响。
text:
名称：VisualProximity
描述：车辆被观察者感知的接近程度与视觉重量感，受外观色相与明度影响。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Compact low cockpit
description: 低而紧凑的驾驶舱，突出驾驶者主导的视野与包围感，视觉重心偏低。
text:
名称：Compact low cockpit
描述：低而紧凑的驾驶舱，突出驾驶者主导的视野与包围感，视觉重心偏低。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Accommodation-oriented cabin posture
description: Stance and proportions that prioritize interior space and upright seating to maximize occupant comfort and usable cabin volume.
text:
名称：Accommodation-oriented cabin posture
描述：Stance and proportions that prioritize interior space and upright seating to maximize occupant comfort and usable cabin volume.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rounded Front Posture
description: 前部明显饱满、曲面连续，弱化尖锐棱角，给人稳重且亲和的视觉印象。
text:
名称：Rounded Front Posture
描述：前部明显饱满、曲面连续，弱化尖锐棱角，给人稳重且亲和的视觉印象。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Relaxed viewing posture / Open-view posture
description: Neutral head and eye orientation with minimal torso lean for information scanning, resulting in a relaxed upper-body posture facilitated by wide sightlines and reduced visual occlusion.
text:
名称：Relaxed viewing posture / Open-view posture
描述：Neutral head and eye orientation with minimal torso lean for information scanning, resulting in a relaxed upper-body posture facilitated by wide sightlines and reduced visual occlusion.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Prominent chrome grille
description: 宽大且具有家族化特征的镀铬格栅，传达品牌权威与豪华感，同时作为品牌识别要素。
text:
名称：Prominent chrome grille
描述：宽大且具有家族化特征的镀铬格栅，传达品牌权威与豪华感，同时作为品牌识别要素。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 沉稳平稳姿态（稳重·温和）
description: 低体感振动、受控的俯仰与侧倾响应、平顺的垂向动作；视觉上以横向线条为主，整体呈现稳重、温和与成熟的形象，给人沉稳舒适的视觉与触觉印象。
text:
名称：沉稳平稳姿态（稳重·温和）
描述：低体感振动、受控的俯仰与侧倾响应、平顺的垂向动作；视觉上以横向线条为主，整体呈现稳重、温和与成熟的形象，给人沉稳舒适的视觉与触觉印象。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: High-clearance tall upright utilitarian stance
description: Upright, high-ride stance characterized by elevated ride height and a narrow-track, utilitarian profile. Features strong wheel articulation and exposed functional elements with simple, functional proportions that emphasize utility and ease of entry/egress.
text:
名称：High-clearance tall upright utilitarian stance
描述：Upright, high-ride stance characterized by elevated ride height and a narrow-track, utilitarian profile. Features strong wheel articulation and exposed functional elements with simple, functional proportions that emphasize utility and ease of entry/egress.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Organic Sculptural Posture (有机雕塑姿态)
description: 基于生物形态的流线与体块变化，视觉上偏向曲面连续、动感强的姿态。
text:
名称：Organic Sculptural Posture (有机雕塑姿态)
描述：基于生物形态的流线与体块变化，视觉上偏向曲面连续、动感强的姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: RoundedButtPosture (圆滚车尾姿态)
description: 视觉上后部体块突出的低矮但饱满姿态，强调尾部体量感。
text:
名称：RoundedButtPosture (圆滚车尾姿态)
描述：视觉上后部体块突出的低矮但饱满姿态，强调尾部体量感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Technology-Forward Stance
description: Visual posture emphasizing a horizontal cabin composition and broad, low-slung instrument surfacing to communicate technological presence. Characterized by clean, uncluttered surfaces and minimal visible appendages, incorporation of small sensors/flush modules as electronic cues, and distinctive/dynamic lighting treatments (horizontal light bands, bold detail treatments) that enhance recognizability and convey a futuristic tech-forward identity.
text:
名称：Technology-Forward Stance
描述：Visual posture emphasizing a horizontal cabin composition and broad, low-slung instrument surfacing to communicate technological presence. Characterized by clean, uncluttered surfaces and minimal visible appendages, incorporation of small sensors/flush modules as electronic cues, and distinctive/dynamic lighting treatments (horizontal light bands, bold detail treatments) that enhance recognizability and convey a futuristic tech-forward identity.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Lightweight sporty posture
description: Low-mass, agile visual stance characterized by tight packaging, thin panels and structural expressiveness implying performance and nimbleness. Emphasizes functional minimalism and competition-derived priorities, with taut, visually light proportions resulting from weight savings and compact, efficient packaging.
text:
名称：Lightweight sporty posture
描述：Low-mass, agile visual stance characterized by tight packaging, thin panels and structural expressiveness implying performance and nimbleness. Emphasizes functional minimalism and competition-derived priorities, with taut, visually light proportions resulting from weight savings and compact, efficient packaging.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: LongHoodShortCab
description: 发动机前置、强调发动机舱的运动化姿态。
text:
名称：LongHoodShortCab
描述：发动机前置、强调发动机舱的运动化姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sculptural Posture (雕塑化姿态)
description: 以雕塑感为主的视觉姿态，强调体块塑造与光影戏剧性；车辆被感知为艺术品或展陈对象，重视观赏角度与静态构图感。
text:
名称：Sculptural Posture (雕塑化姿态)
描述：以雕塑感为主的视觉姿态，强调体块塑造与光影戏剧性；车辆被感知为艺术品或展陈对象，重视观赏角度与静态构图感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: LowSlung_Streamlined
description: 低车顶、长轴距、贯通式光带与流线表面，传达速度感与科技感
text:
名称：LowSlung_Streamlined
描述：低车顶、长轴距、贯通式光带与流线表面，传达速度感与科技感

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 粗犷·SUV姿态
description: 带有越野感与防护感的姿态。
text:
名称：粗犷·SUV姿态
描述：带有越野感与防护感的姿态。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Use of Nonsmelling Materials
description: Specification and application of materials that do not produce unpleasant or unsafe odors.
text:
名称：Use of Nonsmelling Materials
描述：Specification and application of materials that do not produce unpleasant or unsafe odors.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 前脸科技化/信息化/结构化姿态（Front high-tech/structured/technical stance）
description: 由矩阵像素、LED 单元阵列或可投影功能形成的规则像素/图案与单元排列，使前脸在视觉上呈现精密、结构化与科技感，并兼具信息显示与功能延展性。
text:
名称：前脸科技化/信息化/结构化姿态（Front high-tech/structured/technical stance）
描述：由矩阵像素、LED 单元阵列或可投影功能形成的规则像素/图案与单元排列，使前脸在视觉上呈现精密、结构化与科技感，并兼具信息显示与功能延展性。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Greenhouse Visibility Stance
description: A vehicle stance characterized by expansive glazing and slim/slender pillars that minimize visual occlusion, emphasizing openness, exterior visibility and perceived safety. Typical features include large glazed areas, reduced pillar mass, and design cues that communicate transparency and visibility.
text:
名称：Greenhouse Visibility Stance
描述：A vehicle stance characterized by expansive glazing and slim/slender pillars that minimize visual occlusion, emphasizing openness, exterior visibility and perceived safety. Typical features include large glazed areas, reduced pillar mass, and design cues that communicate transparency and visibility.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Narrow upright posture
description: 非常窄的轨距配以高舱室，突出单列或接近单列行进与最小占地的设计取向，强调紧凑足迹同时保留直立空间感。
text:
名称：Narrow upright posture
描述：非常窄的轨距配以高舱室，突出单列或接近单列行进与最小占地的设计取向，强调紧凑足迹同时保留直立空间感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Wheel-arch covered / compliant posture
description: Bodywork shaped to meet wheel coverage regulations, giving a controlled, integrated wheel-to-body relationship.
text:
名称：Wheel-arch covered / compliant posture
描述：Bodywork shaped to meet wheel coverage regulations, giving a controlled, integrated wheel-to-body relationship.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Side-mounted Dual-mirror Stance
description: 侧面外后视镜采用双镜布局（平面+凸面），形成功能分区明确的车侧外形特征。
text:
名称：Side-mounted Dual-mirror Stance
描述：侧面外后视镜采用双镜布局（平面+凸面），形成功能分区明确的车侧外形特征。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Tall minivan / van stance
description: High roof, upright greenhouse and long/generous cabin with large door apertures that prioritize interior volume, vertical seating and easy access.
text:
名称：Tall minivan / van stance
描述：High roof, upright greenhouse and long/generous cabin with large door apertures that prioritize interior volume, vertical seating and easy access.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Protected Front Stance
description: A visual posture emphasizing pedestrian protection and continuous surfaces at the vehicle front.
text:
名称：Protected Front Stance
描述：A visual posture emphasizing pedestrian protection and continuous surfaces at the vehicle front.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Low-Slung / Sleek Fastback Posture (低矮溜/快背姿态)
description: 低前鼻、平滑延伸或后掠的车顶线条与收敛的尾部共同形成的低矮、动感溜背/快背姿态，既体现速度感与流线效率，也有助于降低风阻。
text:
名称：Low-Slung / Sleek Fastback Posture (低矮溜/快背姿态)
描述：低前鼻、平滑延伸或后掠的车顶线条与收敛的尾部共同形成的低矮、动感溜背/快背姿态，既体现速度感与流线效率，也有助于降低风阻。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Alert/safe-forward stance
description: Perceived stance emphasizing forward visibility and signaling clarity; suggests stability and attentiveness.
text:
名称：Alert/safe-forward stance
描述：Perceived stance emphasizing forward visibility and signaling clarity; suggests stability and attentiveness.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: PerceivedVisibility
description: Visual state describing whether a target/display is perceived (visible) under given conditions; considered 'visible' if C exceeds threshold for adaptation luminance and size.
text:
名称：PerceivedVisibility
描述：Visual state describing whether a target/display is perceived (visible) under given conditions; considered 'visible' if C exceeds threshold for adaptation luminance and size.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Human Modelling Prediction
description: Use of digital human modelling and simulation to predict postural strain and identify necessary adjustments early in concept design.
text:
名称：Human Modelling Prediction
描述：Use of digital human modelling and simulation to predict postural strain and identify necessary adjustments early in concept design.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Ingress/Egress posture
description: Body postures and movement sequences for entering and exiting the vehicle, including leg swing, torso rotation and hand support; concerns occupant clearances during entry/exit and is influenced by seat height and handle positions. Can be approximated with jointed manikins in 2D.
text:
名称：Ingress/Egress posture
描述：Body postures and movement sequences for entering and exiting the vehicle, including leg swing, torso rotation and hand support; concerns occupant clearances during entry/exit and is influenced by seat height and handle positions. Can be approximated with jointed manikins in 2D.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: BalancedAxleProportion
description: A visual vehicle stance where axle placement and a tuned rear overhang produce balanced front-to-rear proportions. Achieved by aligning axle positions, wheelbase and overhang relative to occupant packaging, this posture creates visual harmony and a stable perceived stance.
text:
名称：BalancedAxleProportion
描述：A visual vehicle stance where axle placement and a tuned rear overhang produce balanced front-to-rear proportions. Achieved by aligning axle positions, wheelbase and overhang relative to occupant packaging, this posture creates visual harmony and a stable perceived stance.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Tall-compact / short-wheelbase tall-cabin stance
description: Upright greenhouse and high roofline combined with a compact footprint — short overall length and minimized front/rear overhangs — to maximize interior volume in a smaller package.
text:
名称：Tall-compact / short-wheelbase tall-cabin stance
描述：Upright greenhouse and high roofline combined with a compact footprint — short overall length and minimized front/rear overhangs — to maximize interior volume in a smaller package.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Perceived Front Presence
description: Visual impression of the vehicle's forward stance and assertiveness as influenced by headlamp intensity distribution, shape and glare characteristics.
text:
名称：Perceived Front Presence
描述：Visual impression of the vehicle's forward stance and assertiveness as influenced by headlamp intensity distribution, shape and glare characteristics.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Workshop/experimental posture
description: An appearance that emphasizes function and mechanical origin over refined coachwork; seating and controls are exposed.
text:
名称：Workshop/experimental posture
描述：An appearance that emphasizes function and mechanical origin over refined coachwork; seating and controls are exposed.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Postura capot largo / cabina corta
description: Silueta deportiva y compacta que define el Mustang clásico.
text:
名称：Postura capot largo / cabina corta
描述：Silueta deportiva y compacta que define el Mustang clásico.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Perceived Solid Secure Stance
description: 通过声学和触觉提示传达的车辆稳重、厚重的视觉/感知姿态（非几何姿态），表现为由加固结构和较大重量带来的感知质量感与防护姿态。Perceived mass and protective posture derived from reinforced structures and higher weight, conveyed through acoustic and tactile cues (non-geometric).
text:
名称：Perceived Solid Secure Stance
描述：通过声学和触觉提示传达的车辆稳重、厚重的视觉/感知姿态（非几何姿态），表现为由加固结构和较大重量带来的感知质量感与防护姿态。Perceived mass and protective posture derived from reinforced structures and higher weight, conveyed through acoustic and tactile cues (non-geometric).

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Thigh-support-related posture
description: 由座椅靠垫长度导致的乘员大腿承托状态，关联踏板操作与腰背负荷。
text:
名称：Thigh-support-related posture
描述：由座椅靠垫长度导致的乘员大腿承托状态，关联踏板操作与腰背负荷。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 高顶大空间姿态
description: 车身较高、车内空间宽敞、重心相对较高，符合家用多功能定位。
text:
名称：高顶大空间姿态
描述：车身较高、车内空间宽敞、重心相对较高，符合家用多功能定位。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: InclusiveAccommodationPosture
description: Vehicle stance and perceived proportions that visually and functionally support a wide range of body sizes.
text:
名称：InclusiveAccommodationPosture
描述：Vehicle stance and perceived proportions that visually and functionally support a wide range of body sizes.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 示位与显示集成
description: 固态光源可用于示位、警示及信息显示，将功能融入造型，增强表达力。
text:

描述：固态光源可用于示位、警示及信息显示，将功能融入造型，增强表达力。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: low_hood_low_cowl_posture
description: A stance featuring a low hood and cowl that maximizes forward and near-ground visibility. Characterized by a low bonnet, a relatively long hood-to-cabin ratio and a visually lower center of gravity impression.
text:
名称：low_hood_low_cowl_posture
描述：A stance featuring a low hood and cowl that maximizes forward and near-ground visibility. Characterized by a low bonnet, a relatively long hood-to-cabin ratio and a visually lower center of gravity impression.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Isolated Wheel Motion / Level Body
description: Vehicle maintains a more level and controlled posture when one wheel is disturbed.
text:
名称：Isolated Wheel Motion / Level Body
描述：Vehicle maintains a more level and controlled posture when one wheel is disturbed.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Open-AccessPosture
description: A stance perceived as utilitarian and user-friendly with emphasis on large openings and easy loading.
text:
名称：Open-AccessPosture
描述：A stance perceived as utilitarian and user-friendly with emphasis on large openings and easy loading.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

text:
名称：Dynamic stance and perceived balance
描述：The vehicle's perceived stance in motion and at rest (ride height, squat on acceleration, pitch on braking) as influenced by suspension tuning.

name: driver-isolated front-row layout (驾驶员单独安排的前排布局)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Static_Sitting_Posture
description: Standard upright sitting posture used for static anthropometric measurement
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Affordable / Basic Features (Economy-focused minimal features)
description: Demand-driven need for low-cost, easy-to-maintain vehicles that prioritize access over refinement; economy-focused minimalist specification eliminating non-essential items to reduce cost and complexity (e.g., no radio, no air conditioning, no power steering, single windshield wiper, single side mirror, no airbags).
text:

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Rear stance (coupled / wide)
description: Visual rear posture describing how the rear axle presents itself. When coupled, both wheels behave in a linked manner, producing less individual camber change and a more unified axle attitude under load. In a wide stance, the visual impression of width is emphasized (for example by lamp placement near outer edges), which improves lateral visibility and the perception of road presence. Combined, these aspects describe rear-axle appearance and packaging choices that affect both visual character and loading behavior.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Robust Stance

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)

description: Upright, elevated seating position that provides a commanding driving eye point and enhanced visibility. Emphasizes cargo capacity and accessibility (including larger boot or flat bed proportions), robustness and utility. Variants include rear-loaded configurations where significant cargo over the rear axle raises rear ride height (possible nose-down appearance), and pickup/bed-oriented proportions optimized for load and wheel travel. Common in SUVs, crossovers, trucks and light commercial vehicles.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Seated Forward (Fore-Aft Seating Posture)
description: Family of fore-aft adjustable seating postures governed by the H-point fore-aft position along the seat track. Characterized by a seated-forward position (seat moved forward on the track, often associated with shorter leg length) that increases occupant proximity to the vehicle front. Typical consequences include increased forward field occlusion by the A-pillar and increased required mirror head-turn angles.
text:
名称：Seated Forward (Fore-Aft Seating Posture)

Characterized by a seated-forward position (seat moved forward on the track, often associated with shorter leg length) that increases occupant proximity to the vehicle front. Typical consequences include increased forward field occlusion by the A-pillar and increased required mirror head-turn angles.

Conveys utility, commanding driving position, cargo capability and off-road or lifestyle capability. Common for SUVs, crossovers, vans with high seating and vehicles emphasizing visibility and presence.
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Seat belt system
description: Primary occupant restraint system for front and rear seats that reduces occupant excursion and loads during impacts. Modern seat belt systems incorporate pretensioners and load limiters to control loading time and peak loads. Anchorage and mounting geometry (B‑pillar attachment points, routing, webbing path) and pretensioning directly affect torso posture, comfort and the structural load path into primary structure. Historically optional, seat belts later became mandated and remain one of the most effective safety devices.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Elongated Proportions (含前重与均衡延展变体)
description: 整体纵向比例延展的车辆姿态，通常表现为长车头或延长的轴距与相对紧凑的乘员舱。总体视觉传达强调动力性、传统前置动力布置或奢华感。该大类包含：前重型（front-heavy）：以较长的前悬和前部质量感为特征，常见于强调动力感或传统前置动力布局的车型；均衡延展型（elongated & balanced）：轴距延长且前后悬相对均衡，常用于加长型、行政级轿车与豪华礼宾车。
text:
名称：Elongated Proportions (含前重与均衡延展变体)
描述：整体纵向比例延展的车辆姿态，通常表现为长车头或延长的轴距与相对紧凑的乘员舱。总体视觉传达强调动力性、传统前置动力布置或奢华感。该大类包含：前重型（front-heavy）：以较长的前悬和前部质量感为特征，常见于强调动力感或传统前置动力布局的车型；均衡延展型（elongated & balanced）：轴距延长且前后悬相对均衡，常用于加长型、行政级轿车与豪华礼宾车。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: UprightSeatingPosture
description: 一种以较高坐高和更垂直躯干/靠背取向为特征的坐姿，强调便于进出（ingress/egress）、视野与舒适性。常见于MPV、城市SUV、小型实用车及部分卡车/商用车。表现形式包括：较短的踏入高度（shorter step‑in）、更高的H‑point或H30（部分定义中H30>405 mm）、较短或直立的风挡与高舱顶（upright greenhouse），以及外观上“高/方正”的设计特征。靠背通常接近垂直（≈90°）以提高视野和便利性；在某些卡车/商用车型中也记为较挺直的靠背角度（文献中可见约12–18°的表述，测量参考不同）。若缺乏合适的腰部支撑，L5/S1受压/压缩载荷会增加；恰当的腰椎支撑可维持生理前凸（lordosis），改善舒适性与脊柱力学。
text:
名称：UprightSeatingPosture
描述：一种以较高坐高和更垂直躯干/靠背取向为特征的坐姿，强调便于进出（ingress/egress）、视野与舒适性。常见于MPV、城市SUV、小型实用车及部分卡车/商用车。表现形式包括：较短的踏入高度（shorter step‑in）、更高的H‑point或H30（部分定义中H30>405 mm）、较短或直立的风挡与高舱顶（upright greenhouse），以及外观上“高/方正”的设计特征。靠背通常接近垂直（≈90°）以提高视野和便利性；在某些卡车/商用车型中也记为较挺直的靠背角度（文献中可见约12–18°的表述，测量参考不同）。若缺乏合适的腰部支撑，L5/S1受压/压缩载荷会增加；恰当的腰椎支撑可维持生理前凸（lordosis），改善舒适性与脊柱力学。
