label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Load transfer (lateral and axle-local)
description: General change in vertical tyre loads between wheels. Includes: (1) Lateral load transfer — change in vertical tyre loads between outer and inner wheels during cornering, caused primarily by vehicle roll and weight shift; (2) Axle-local load transfer — load transfer occurring only across the two wheels of a given axle, often due to unsprung mass inertia and axle-local dynamics.
text:
名称：Load transfer (lateral and axle-local)
描述：General change in vertical tyre loads between wheels. Includes: (1) Lateral load transfer — change in vertical tyre loads between outer and inner wheels during cornering, caused primarily by vehicle roll and weight shift; (2) Axle-local load transfer — load transfer occurring only across the two wheels of a given axle, often due to unsprung mass inertia and axle-local dynamics.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SUV姿态
description: SUV类姿态的整体特征及子类型：大型SUV——宽大、稳重的视觉比例，较高离地间隙，强调家庭实用与威严感；家用SUV——高坐姿、较长轴距，注重舒适性与多用途；紧凑SUV——高腰线、夸张轮拱、较高离地感，短前悬与宽轮距的紧凑视觉组合；稳重SUV——侧面线条平缓、进深小，给人沉稳可靠的视觉印象。共同要素为较高离地间隙与稳重宽阔的视觉比例，但各子类型在舒适性、通过性与外观强调点上有所侧重。
text:
名称：SUV姿态
描述：SUV类姿态的整体特征及子类型：大型SUV——宽大、稳重的视觉比例，较高离地间隙，强调家庭实用与威严感；家用SUV——高坐姿、较长轴距，注重舒适性与多用途；紧凑SUV——高腰线、夸张轮拱、较高离地感，短前悬与宽轮距的紧凑视觉组合；稳重SUV——侧面线条平缓、进深小，给人沉稳可靠的视觉印象。共同要素为较高离地间隙与稳重宽阔的视觉比例，但各子类型在舒适性、通过性与外观强调点上有所侧重。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Heel point
description: Point of foot contact (heel) relative to pedal/footwell; datum used for footwell depth, pedal placement and pedal geometry.
text:
名称：Heel point
描述：Point of foot contact (heel) relative to pedal/footwell; datum used for footwell depth, pedal placement and pedal geometry.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 跨级别比较/姿态边界模糊
description: 消费者在视觉判断上弱化传统级别边界，车辆姿态语义向功能化转变。
text:
名称：跨级别比较/姿态边界模糊
描述：消费者在视觉判断上弱化传统级别边界，车辆姿态语义向功能化转变。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Fatigue-prone posture
description: Posture resulting from suboptimal seat support and cushioning leading to discomfort during extended driving.
text:
名称：Fatigue-prone posture
描述：Posture resulting from suboptimal seat support and cushioning leading to discomfort during extended driving.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 内敛豪华姿态
description: 以较低的重心与偏重车尾的比例安排，营造沉稳、低调且尊贵的视觉效果，强调内敛的豪华感。
text:
名称：内敛豪华姿态
描述：以较低的重心与偏重车尾的比例安排，营造沉稳、低调且尊贵的视觉效果，强调内敛的豪华感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Cab-forward (向前客舱姿态)
description: 前轮到踏板距离短、发动机舱短、乘员舱占比大的视觉姿态
text:
名称：Cab-forward (向前客舱姿态)
描述：前轮到踏板距离短、发动机舱短、乘员舱占比大的视觉姿态

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Premium Warm Ambience
description: An interior stance perceived as warm, crafted and comfortable — emphasizes luxury and human-centric feel.
text:
名称：Premium Warm Ambience
描述：An interior stance perceived as warm, crafted and comfortable — emphasizes luxury and human-centric feel.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Adaptable/Multi-variant Posture
description: A vehicle stance capable of supporting multiple derivative models or personalized options while maintaining core proportions.
text:
名称：Adaptable/Multi-variant Posture
描述：A vehicle stance capable of supporting multiple derivative models or personalized options while maintaining core proportions.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Clean Monolithic Stance
description: Perceived wide, low and uninterrupted surface with reduced visual seams; suggests solidity and premium quality.
text:
名称：Clean Monolithic Stance
描述：Perceived wide, low and uninterrupted surface with reduced visual seams; suggests solidity and premium quality.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 稳重/稳重豪华姿态
description: 以高对称度与均衡比例为基础，配合较长的车身比例、平直腰线及较高的前脸，传达稳定、可信赖且兼具高端感的视觉姿态。
text:
名称：稳重/稳重豪华姿态
描述：以高对称度与均衡比例为基础，配合较长的车身比例、平直腰线及较高的前脸，传达稳定、可信赖且兼具高端感的视觉姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 小微型姿态
description: 紧凑、亲民的外观，短鼻、直立尾部，强调城市便捷与机动性
text:
名称：小微型姿态
描述：紧凑、亲民的外观，短鼻、直立尾部，强调城市便捷与机动性

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 整体和谐前脸姿态
description: 灯组、格栅与前机盖线条协调排列产生的沉稳一致的前脸视觉。
text:
名称：整体和谐前脸姿态
描述：灯组、格栅与前机盖线条协调排列产生的沉稳一致的前脸视觉。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Chassis stiffness (Robust Chassis)
description: Global structural stiffness of floor, pillars and cross-members that determines resistance to bending and torsion under combined loads; strong frame and heavy-duty structural members providing durability, solidity and long life.
text:
名称：Chassis stiffness (Robust Chassis)
描述：Global structural stiffness of floor, pillars and cross-members that determines resistance to bending and torsion under combined loads; strong frame and heavy-duty structural members providing durability, solidity and long life.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Anthropometric Data Integration and Configurability
description: Use of up-to-date anthropometric datasets (5th–95th percentiles), accounting for secular growth and regional differences, and support for anthropometric configurability via digital human models to adjust seats, pedals, steering wheel and control elements to match different percentile body sizes and postures. / 使用最新的人体测量数据（5th–95th 百分位），考虑世代增长及区域差异；支持通过数字人体模型调整座椅、踏板、方向盘及控制元件，以匹配不同百分位人群的尺寸与姿态。
text:
名称：Anthropometric Data Integration and Configurability
描述：Use of up-to-date anthropometric datasets (5th–95th percentiles), accounting for secular growth and regional differences, and support for anthropometric configurability via digital human models to adjust seats, pedals, steering wheel and control elements to match different percentile body sizes and postures. / 使用最新的人体测量数据（5th–95th 百分位），考虑世代增长及区域差异；支持通过数字人体模型调整座椅、踏板、方向盘及控制元件，以匹配不同百分位人群的尺寸与姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 品牌家族姿态(Brand Stance)
description: 代表品牌在视觉上的整体姿态（如宽体、低矮、优雅或运动）。
text:
名称：品牌家族姿态(Brand Stance)
描述：代表品牌在视觉上的整体姿态（如宽体、低矮、优雅或运动）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 体感饱满
description: 视觉上表现为车身厚实、体量感强，光影层次明显。
text:
名称：体感饱满
描述：视觉上表现为车身厚实、体量感强，光影层次明显。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Tech-Centric Stance
description: 以数字化为中心的视觉姿态：简洁外观、以舱为核心的内部空间感，强调功能性与信息化体验。
text:
名称：Tech-Centric Stance
描述：以数字化为中心的视觉姿态：简洁外观、以舱为核心的内部空间感，强调功能性与信息化体验。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 高大稳重姿态
description: 通过较高的前脸、明显的轮眉落差和更高的整车姿态强调力量感、通过性及越野属性，视觉上显得结实有力。
text:
名称：高大稳重姿态
描述：通过较高的前脸、明显的轮眉落差和更高的整车姿态强调力量感、通过性及越野属性，视觉上显得结实有力。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Braking / Slowing / Stopped
description: 基于信号的时域与强度特征，外部观察者推断车辆是否减速、紧急制动或已停止。
text:
名称：Braking / Slowing / Stopped
描述：基于信号的时域与强度特征，外部观察者推断车辆是否减速、紧急制动或已停止。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 紧凑高顶城市姿态 (Compact tall urban stance)
description: 短前后悬、高屋顶、轮距占比显著，体现为城市小车的高坐姿与动态屋顶轮廓。
text:
名称：紧凑高顶城市姿态 (Compact tall urban stance)
描述：短前后悬、高屋顶、轮距占比显著，体现为城市小车的高坐姿与动态屋顶轮廓。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Coupe-like / Coupe-like Fastback (轿跑式/溜背运动姿态)
description: 低车顶线与溜背/抬尾廓形，后段下坠或宽尾灯带强化横向视觉宽度，视觉重心后移呈现低宽轿跑化姿态；长车身、短前后悬与溜背曲线营造运动且优雅的侧面，同时兼顾家用舒适性。 Low roofline combined with a fastback/tucked tail profile (or raised tail) and/or a wide taillamp strip emphasizes horizontal width and shifts visual center rearward to create a low, wide coupe-like stance; long body with short overhangs and sweeping roofline produces a sporty yet elegant side profile while retaining everyday comfort.
text:
名称：Coupe-like / Coupe-like Fastback (轿跑式/溜背运动姿态)
描述：低车顶线与溜背/抬尾廓形，后段下坠或宽尾灯带强化横向视觉宽度，视觉重心后移呈现低宽轿跑化姿态；长车身、短前后悬与溜背曲线营造运动且优雅的侧面，同时兼顾家用舒适性。 Low roofline combined with a fastback/tucked tail profile (or raised tail) and/or a wide taillamp strip emphasizes horizontal width and shifts visual center rearward to create a low, wide coupe-like stance; long body with short overhangs and sweeping roofline produces a sporty yet elegant side profile while retaining everyday comfort.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 4x4HighStance (高重心/越野姿态)
description: Tall, upright stance with large frontal area typical of off-road/4x4 vehicles; associated with higher rolling resistance and drag.
text:
名称：4x4HighStance (高重心/越野姿态)
描述：Tall, upright stance with large frontal area typical of off-road/4x4 vehicles; associated with higher rolling resistance and drag.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 下坠尾部 (Tail-down posture)
description: 尾部视觉显得下沉、缺乏抬升与动感，常由三维处理不当或比例失衡引起。
text:
名称：下坠尾部 (Tail-down posture)
描述：尾部视觉显得下沉、缺乏抬升与动感，常由三维处理不当或比例失衡引起。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 轻量化姿态
description: 由于减重而表现出的更低车身视觉比例、更紧凑动态响应与更灵敏的操控感知。
text:
名称：轻量化姿态
描述：由于减重而表现出的更低车身视觉比例、更紧凑动态响应与更灵敏的操控感知。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Exaggerated Proportions
description: Deliberate enlargement or compression of proportions (wheels, greenhouse, overhangs) to convey character. Amplified dimensional relationships used to create a strong visual statement.
text:
名称：Exaggerated Proportions
描述：Deliberate enlargement or compression of proportions (wheels, greenhouse, overhangs) to convey character. Amplified dimensional relationships used to create a strong visual statement.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Perceived Motion State
description: 基于视觉信号判断的车辆运动状态（如正在减速、匀速、停止）。
text:
名称：Perceived Motion State
描述：基于视觉信号判断的车辆运动状态（如正在减速、匀速、停止）。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Intact passenger-cell posture
description: Perceptual stance post-impact where passenger compartment volume and shape are largely preserved.
text:
名称：Intact passenger-cell posture
描述：Perceptual stance post-impact where passenger compartment volume and shape are largely preserved.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Conservative / Familiar stance (保守·延续化姿态)
description: Visual and experiential perception of a vehicle that follows prior forms and compromises rather than presenting a refined, innovative character.
text:
名称：Conservative / Familiar stance (保守·延续化姿态)
描述：Visual and experiential perception of a vehicle that follows prior forms and compromises rather than presenting a refined, innovative character.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Body roll angle (phi)
description: 车辆绕纵向轴的小角度侧倾（滚转）
text:
名称：Body roll angle (phi)
描述：车辆绕纵向轴的小角度侧倾（滚转）

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 低矮扁平运动姿态 (Low-slung flat sporty posture)
description: 视觉上车身纵向压低、侧面轮廓扁平且腰线水平延伸，形成低重心与瘦长比例；通常伴随拉长的轴距与长引擎罩、低车顶以及横向宽阔的底盘，产生运动感与侵略性（前倾感）。此姿态常用于跑车、GT及强调性能与现代简约美学的豪华车型，兼具动感、速度感与极简未来感。
text:
名称：低矮扁平运动姿态 (Low-slung flat sporty posture)
描述：视觉上车身纵向压低、侧面轮廓扁平且腰线水平延伸，形成低重心与瘦长比例；通常伴随拉长的轴距与长引擎罩、低车顶以及横向宽阔的底盘，产生运动感与侵略性（前倾感）。此姿态常用于跑车、GT及强调性能与现代简约美学的豪华车型，兼具动感、速度感与极简未来感。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Sporty Low-slung Coupe Stance
description: Low roofline, long-hood/short-cabin proportions, reclined seating and lower H‑point combined with muscular shoulders, tight wheel-arch fit and low ride height to create an aggressive, performance-oriented silhouette emphasizing sportiness, authority and aerodynamic form. / 低车顶、长前机舱短客舱比例、向后放倒的座舱与低重心，配合明显的肩部肌肉感、紧致轮拱与小轮隙，呈现富攻击性和性能导向的轿跑化姿态。
text:
名称：Sporty Low-slung Coupe Stance
描述：Low roofline, long-hood/short-cabin proportions, reclined seating and lower H‑point combined with muscular shoulders, tight wheel-arch fit and low ride height to create an aggressive, performance-oriented silhouette emphasizing sportiness, authority and aerodynamic form. / 低车顶、长前机舱短客舱比例、向后放倒的座舱与低重心，配合明显的肩部肌肉感、紧致轮拱与小轮隙，呈现富攻击性和性能导向的轿跑化姿态。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 科技感外观细节
description: 通过材料与细节营造的未来感与科技感外观，通常体现在灯组、格栅与饰件处。
text:
名称：科技感外观细节
描述：通过材料与细节营造的未来感与科技感外观，通常体现在灯组、格栅与饰件处。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: 箱型/方正姿态
description: 垂直车侧、明显方形车厢、较高车身，视觉上呈箱子状。
text:
名称：箱型/方正姿态
描述：垂直车侧、明显方形车厢、较高车身，视觉上呈箱子状。

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Carriage-like posture
description: Techo elevado, ruedas expuestas y presencia vertical que recuerda a coches de caballos.
text:
名称：Carriage-like posture
描述：Techo elevado, ruedas expuestas y presencia vertical que recuerda a coches de caballos.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Supported Up-and-Out Transfer Posture
description: Body posture where occupant uses a high handle to pull upward and outward, facilitating exit from third row or rear seat with minimal climbing.
text:
名称：Supported Up-and-Out Transfer Posture
描述：Body posture where occupant uses a high handle to pull upward and outward, facilitating exit from third row or rear seat with minimal climbing.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Distinctive proportions
description: 能够在瞬间传达品牌与车型性格的侧面与三维比例组合。 (Side and three-dimensional proportion combinations that instantly convey brand and model character.)
text:
名称：Distinctive proportions
描述：能够在瞬间传达品牌与车型性格的侧面与三维比例组合。 (Side and three-dimensional proportion combinations that instantly convey brand and model character.)

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Narrow front view
description: Vehicle appears and measures narrower in front elevation to reduce frontal area and drag.
text:
名称：Narrow front view
描述：Vehicle appears and measures narrower in front elevation to reduce frontal area and drag.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: SeatedPostureDefinition
description: Seated posture where lumbar curvature is preserved by seat contour/support.
text:
名称：SeatedPostureDefinition
描述：Seated posture where lumbar curvature is preserved by seat contour/support.

label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
name: Dynamic Momentum (动势/动感)
description: 视觉上体现车辆的运动趋势和前进力量感
text:
名称：Dynamic Momentum (动势/动感)
描述：视觉上体现车辆的运动趋势和前进力量感

label: FamilyDNA(家族DNA)
name: German State Railway Coach DNA
description: Design language used by state-operated long-distance coaches in 1930s Germany combining streamlining with onboard comfort.
text:
名称：German State Railway Coach DNA
描述：Design language used by state-operated long-distance coaches in 1930s Germany combining streamlining with onboard comfort.

label: FamilyDNA(家族DNA)
name: 轿跑/超跑家族
description: 低引擎盖、低轮眉落差、长引擎盖短车舱、低风阻与运动姿态
text:
名称：轿跑/超跑家族
描述：低引擎盖、低轮眉落差、长引擎盖短车舱、低风阻与运动姿态

label: FamilyDNA(家族DNA)
name: SUV/越野家族
description: 高引擎盖、明显轮眉落差、较大轮胎行程与高坐姿
text:
名称：SUV/越野家族
描述：高引擎盖、明显轮眉落差、较大轮胎行程与高坐姿

text:

label: FamilyDNA(家族DNA)
name: Tech-Focused Premium DNA
description: See above.
text:

label: FamilyDNA(家族DNA)

名称：Ford New Edge (Ford Ka progenitor)

description: 见上

description: 由安全法规压力与消费者对空间、舒适性的需求共同驱动，促使包装设计从前置控制布局向提供更大缓冲区和更好正面碰撞管理的方案转变，同时兼顾豪华舒适与高效空间利用（例如在常规车长轿车中实现宽敞座舱）。目标群体包括家庭与多功能使用者、注重安全与空间的买家、寻求豪华舒适的富裕职业人士，以及监管机构和主流消费者。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mechanical Simplicity
description: Design principle favoring reduction of mechanical complexity to improve robustness, efficiency, serviceability and suitability for local manufacturing. Encourages avoiding complex drivetrain components (e.g., differentials, right-angle bevel gears) in favor of simple, robust solutions that are light, easy to maintain and provide direct feedback.
text:
名称：Mechanical Simplicity

Encourages avoiding complex drivetrain components (e.g., differentials, right-angle bevel gears) in favor of simple, robust solutions that are light, easy to maintain and provide direct feedback.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Occupant-Centric Ergonomics
description: Design philosophy that makes human factors the primary driver of interior and packaging decisions. Covers seating geometry and accommodation (H‑point relationships, accommodation curves), ingress/egress, visibility, reachability, adjustability and controls placement; accounts for regional anthropometry and a broad range of body sizes to optimize comfort, usability, accessibility and safety across vehicle classes. / 将人体工程学原则自概念阶段纳入整车设计，强调座舱可乘坐性与舒适性、覆盖目标人群的人体测量范围、可调节性与可及性，并以可视性、包装和安全为主要设计驱动。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety-first design
description: Design philosophy that prioritizes occupant and pedestrian protection as a primary aesthetic and engineering theme. It emphasizes structural robustness, controlled crush zones and deformation management, intrusion minimization, integrated restraint interfaces (airbags, seatbelts), visibility management and pedestrian mitigation measures. This concept informs exterior and structural decisions—bumper and sill heights, crush space and fascia profile, side-impact reinforcements and seals—while embedding regulatory compliance, fail-safes and clear user interfaces.
text:
名称：Safety-first design
描述：Design philosophy that prioritizes occupant and pedestrian protection as a primary aesthetic and engineering theme. It emphasizes structural robustness, controlled crush zones and deformation management, intrusion minimization, integrated restraint interfaces (airbags, seatbelts), visibility management and pedestrian mitigation measures. This concept informs exterior and structural decisions—bumper and sill heights, crush space and fascia profile, side-impact reinforcements and seals—while embedding regulatory compliance, fail-safes and clear user interfaces.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Underfloor Management(下盘气流管理)
description: 强调平整下盘、扩散/导流器与扩压通道的造型逻辑，以控制下压力与下方流场。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 身份识别（轮廓识别度）
description: 通过整车造型，尤其是侧面轮廓，形成可识别的品牌或车型特征，从而实现身份识别。该概念既涵盖一般的品牌/车型身份识别，也强调侧面轮廓的辨识度（例如 Beetle、Hummer、Z4 等车型通过独特轮廓易于辨认），用于评价设计能否在视觉上传达明确且独特的身份特征。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Aspirational Commuter
description: A compact, aspirational urban commuter that balances efficient packaging with elevated styling and slightly enhanced performance; links the concept to the product-family DNA to ensure brand continuity.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 品质经济（经济性）
description: 兼顾高品质与成本效率的造型美学理念：以高品质、标准化的专业服务为核心，同时注重降低制造成本与提高生产效率，倾向于采用可模压、少工序的表面处理与标准化工艺以提升产能与一致性。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Side-view Proportions
description: High-level guidance for the vehicle silhouette as seen in profile — allocation of wheelbase, overhangs, roofline and cabin relative to functional packaging (occupants, cargo, powertrain) and aerodynamic/crash constraints.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 实时渲染质量
description: 用于实时/交互场景的渲染质量评估，更侧重于帧率与交互响应能力，而非极致的几何精度或最高画面质量。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Connected Ergonomics
description: Integrate telematics, screens and connected controls into the occupant reach and sightline envelope: design ensures driver sightlines, ergonomic reach to connected interfaces and good passenger screen visibility while maintaining overall usability and safety. / 将远程信息、屏幕与互联控制纳入可触及与可视范围，兼顾驾驶员视线、乘客屏幕可见性与使用便捷性和安全性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 中观层品牌辨识(品牌家族化造型)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sustainable Shared Mobility
description: 融合共享出行与新能源环保特性，强调方便、低碳、可持续和高周转的设计主题。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Space Efficiency
description: Design approach prioritizing maximization of usable interior and cargo volume and flexible layouts by optimizing packaging (underfloor components, seat stowage) and vehicle proportions. In electric vehicles this leverages compact motors and distributed powertrain components to enable flat floors, shorter bonnets and increased cabin volume while minimizing external footprint.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Repeatability & Rhythm
description: Use of repeated elements to create rhythm; excessive repetition produces monotony—introduce variation and creativity.
text:
名称：Repeatability & Rhythm

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Brand Continuity（品牌延续性）

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ideation
description: A rapid cycle of seeing, imagining and drawing to generate many loose variant concepts; early-stage emphasis on ideas over accuracy and on unconstrained, exploratory development (prioritize rapid, free exploration).
text:
名称：Ideation
描述：A rapid cycle of seeing, imagining and drawing to generate many loose variant concepts; early-stage emphasis on ideas over accuracy and on unconstrained, exploratory development (prioritize rapid, free exploration).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: CamberCurve
description: 测得的车轮行程与外倾角关系曲线（图示），用于将轮行程映射到外倾角。图示范围大约为 wheel travel ∈ [-80, +50] mm, camber ∈ [-3, +1] deg；定义式（样例）：α_i = C - 90 - A_i

name: 大倾角前挡风玻璃

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Pragmatic Rapid Evaluation
description: Design approach prioritizing quick ergonomic checks using simple tools (2D drawings, jointed manikins) when time/resources are limited.
text:
名称：Pragmatic Rapid Evaluation

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional Creativity and Empathy
description: Design approach emphasizing practical engineering solutions combined with human-centered considerations—reflected in Stuart's teaching focus on vehicle packaging and sympathy to user needs.
text:
名称：Functional Creativity and Empathy

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Designer Creativity and Intuition
description: Designers' intuitive, often unconscious creativity and artistic talent that drive styling decisions and sketching closely tied to imagination; this creative intuition plays a central role in design and cannot be fully replaced by market research.
text:
名称：Designer Creativity and Intuition
描述：Designers' intuitive, often unconscious creativity and artistic talent that drive styling decisions and sketching closely tied to imagination; this creative intuition plays a central role in design and cannot be fully replaced by market research.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mass-production Simplicity
description: Design theme emphasizing simplicity, repeatability and minimal variants to minimize unit cost and enable large-scale manufacturability and mobility. Focuses on design for manufacturability and cost efficiency (influence of the Model T and historical production systems).
text:
名称：Mass-production Simplicity
描述：Design theme emphasizing simplicity, repeatability and minimal variants to minimize unit cost and enable large-scale manufacturability and mobility. Focuses on design for manufacturability and cost efficiency (influence of the Model T and historical production systems).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EC Tire Coverage Requirement
description: Regulatory aesthetic/legal constraint requiring tires to be inboard of bodywork in specified angular zones: 30° forward of spindle center and 50° rearward.
text:
名称：EC Tire Coverage Requirement
描述：Regulatory aesthetic/legal constraint requiring tires to be inboard of bodywork in specified angular zones: 30° forward of spindle center and 50° rearward.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Efficiency
description: Design theme emphasizing a minimized exterior footprint and efficient packaging to maximize interior utility and passenger/cargo capacity, improve fuel economy via aerodynamic and packaging efficiencies, and favor low-cost, straightforward mechanical solutions to enable urban mass mobility (e.g., Fiat 600).
text:
名称：Compact Efficiency
描述：Design theme emphasizing a minimized exterior footprint and efficient packaging to maximize interior utility and passenger/cargo capacity, improve fuel economy via aerodynamic and packaging efficiencies, and favor low-cost, straightforward mechanical solutions to enable urban mass mobility (e.g., Fiat 600).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Practicality & Usability (实用性/可用性/使用性)
description: 强调功能实现、空间利用与便捷性，直接响应消费者对工具属性与日常使用场景的需求；注重现实可用性改进，例如更方便的后备厢开启等，侧重提升日常使用的便捷与效率。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

name: Space frame (空间桁架)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ReliabilityAndRedundancy
description: Emphasises long-term dependable operation across diverse global conditions and the incorporation of fail-safe designs and system redundancy. Aims to minimise failures and reputational risk by ensuring critical functions (e.g., braking) remain operational in case of leaks, component faults or other failures through redundant systems and robust engineering.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Longitudinal_Front_Engine_AWD_Packaging

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: New Sharp (新锋锐)
description: 一种强调平直面与锐利交接、清晰棱线与尖锐轮廓的造型美学。其早期雏形可追溯到20世纪60年代，表现为面与面之间不倒角的锐利接合，产生干净、理性且锋利的视觉效果；在1990年代进一步发展为“饱满+硬楞/尖”的新锋锐风格（如Ford KA等），在圆润的体量基础上加入尖锐棱线与尖角，形成具有现代感的锐利造型语言。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Braking Performance & Safety
description: Prioritises stopping power, fade resistance, thermal management and redundancy to ensure consistent braking performance under varied conditions. Incorporates balanced braking dynamics to ensure consistent force distribution and modulation across wheels for enhanced vehicle control and safety.
text:
名称：Braking Performance & Safety

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomic Legibility / Readability
description: Design theme prioritizing legibility and optical accessibility for users with reduced accommodation (e.g. older drivers), and maximizing quick, accurate reading under short exposures. Includes measures such as optimizing numeric progression, numeral placement and overall display accessibility to support rapid comprehension and lower perceptual effort.
text:

Includes measures such as optimizing numeric progression, numeral placement and overall display accessibility to support rapid comprehension and lower perceptual effort.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 三维结构化格栅
description: 通过深度与层次变化塑造的格栅结构，强调体积感与光影变化，带来更强的视觉秩序感与质感。
text:
名称：三维结构化格栅
描述：通过深度与层次变化塑造的格栅结构，强调体积感与光影变化，带来更强的视觉秩序感与质感。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Pragmatic Efficiency
description: Emphasizes manufacturability, cost optimization and high commonality across variants.
text:
名称：Pragmatic Efficiency
描述：Emphasizes manufacturability, cost optimization and high commonality across variants.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Brand Image — Versatility
description: Layouts reflect target market and brand image (luxury, sport, micro, off-road); platform must support multiple body styles and engine/transmission options.
text:
名称：Brand Image — Versatility
描述：Layouts reflect target market and brand image (luxury, sport, micro, off-road); platform must support multiple body styles and engine/transmission options.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Legibility and Information Clarity
description: Prioritize quick comprehension and minimal mental/physical effort for on-board information by maximizing readability across viewing distances, angles and lighting. Ensure legibility through appropriate font size, contrast, luminance and update rates to reduce reading time and errors and support rapid, reliable perception under varying conditions. / 优先确保车载信息可被快速理解并尽量减少精神/体力负担；通过合适的字体大小、对比度、亮度和刷新率，在不同观看距离、角度和光照条件下最大化可读性，从而减少阅读时间与错误。
text:
名称：Legibility and Information Clarity
描述：Prioritize quick comprehension and minimal mental/physical effort for on-board information by maximizing readability across viewing distances, angles and lighting. Ensure legibility through appropriate font size, contrast, luminance and update rates to reduce reading time and errors and support rapid, reliable perception under varying conditions. / 优先确保车载信息可被快速理解并尽量减少精神/体力负担；通过合适的字体大小、对比度、亮度和刷新率，在不同观看距离、角度和光照条件下最大化可读性，从而减少阅读时间与错误。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Packaging-Constrained Styling
description: Design approach in which vehicle exterior styling is constrained by engineering 'hard points' arising from occupant and mechanical packaging. The aesthetic prioritizes function-driven silhouette limits and packaging requirements over purely sculptural or decorative form.
text:
名称：Packaging-Constrained Styling
描述：Design approach in which vehicle exterior styling is constrained by engineering 'hard points' arising from occupant and mechanical packaging. The aesthetic prioritizes function-driven silhouette limits and packaging requirements over purely sculptural or decorative form.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: MassProductionEthos
description: Define or reinforces early manufacturer practices favoring standardization and simplified bodywork.
text:
名称：MassProductionEthos
描述：Define or reinforces early manufacturer practices favoring standardization and simplified bodywork.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Utility & Interior Flexibility
description: 结合紧凑的车身尺寸与以货物承载为优先的设计，同时强调可配置的内部储物、易于取放的布局和多用途座舱功能，以支持家庭出行、通勤和户外活动。
text:
名称：Compact Utility & Interior Flexibility
描述：结合紧凑的车身尺寸与以货物承载为优先的设计，同时强调可配置的内部储物、易于取放的布局和多用途座舱功能，以支持家庭出行、通勤和户外活动。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ease-of-use & Trust
description: Emphasize ergonomics, clear reach zones, and perceptual 'about right' targets for controls; ensure simple, trustworthy interactions through clear information, guided configuration, and familiar interaction patterns to reduce uncertainty around post-purchase changes.
text:
名称：Ease-of-use & Trust
描述：Emphasize ergonomics, clear reach zones, and perceptual 'about right' targets for controls; ensure simple, trustworthy interactions through clear information, guided configuration, and familiar interaction patterns to reduce uncertainty around post-purchase changes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Personalized Premium Futurism (个性化+溢价+未来感)
description: 以高端溢价定位为出发点，融合前瞻科技视觉语言和可配置的个性化选项，营造未来感与差异化识别。
text:
名称：Personalized Premium Futurism (个性化+溢价+未来感)
描述：以高端溢价定位为出发点，融合前瞻科技视觉语言和可配置的个性化选项，营造未来感与差异化识别。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Refinement - Passenger Cars
description: Design theme emphasizing reduced visible gap between tire and body, controlled travel and comfortable behavior.
text:
名称：Refinement - Passenger Cars
描述：Design theme emphasizing reduced visible gap between tire and body, controlled travel and comfortable behavior.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Aggressive Hood Proportions
description: Long hood and muscular front to communicate power.
text:
名称：Aggressive Hood Proportions
描述：Long hood and muscular front to communicate power.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Material-Finish Harmony
description: Materials and finishes within a vehicle should harmonize to create a coherent brand image; match texture, gloss and color relationships.
text:
名称：Material-Finish Harmony
描述：Materials and finishes within a vehicle should harmonize to create a coherent brand image; match texture, gloss and color relationships.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: BrandRecognition
description: 通过统一的造型元素（格栅、灯组、腰线等）建立可辨识的品牌印象，强调规划与持续性。
text:
名称：BrandRecognition
描述：通过统一的造型元素（格栅、灯组、腰线等）建立可辨识的品牌印象，强调规划与持续性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Systems Packaging
description: Design approach that prioritizes functional spatial envelopes for every vehicle system (occupants, interior, powertrain, wheels, suspension, body) so form follows packaging constraints: motion, tolerances, clearances, heat insulation, maintenance and assembly.
text:
名称：Systems Packaging
描述：Design approach that prioritizes functional spatial envelopes for every vehicle system (occupants, interior, powertrain, wheels, suspension, body) so form follows packaging constraints: motion, tolerances, clearances, heat insulation, maintenance and assembly.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Reduce material diversity in proximity
description: Avoid placing many dissimilar materials and parting lines within small regions to prevent perception of clutter, mismatches and unevenness.
text:
名称：Reduce material diversity in proximity
描述：Avoid placing many dissimilar materials and parting lines within small regions to prevent perception of clutter, mismatches and unevenness.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Harmony
description: 汽车色彩应与所处城市/自然环境色彩协调，避免冲突引发视觉噪声
text:
名称：Harmony
描述：汽车色彩应与所处城市/自然环境色彩协调，避免冲突引发视觉噪声

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: FormFunctionIntegration
description: Design principle that aesthetics must correspond with ergonomic functionality and utility.
text:
名称：FormFunctionIntegration
描述：Design principle that aesthetics must correspond with ergonomic functionality and utility.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Minimize Cognitive Capture
description: Avoid displays that dominate attention or create visual clutter in low-demand driving situations.
text:
名称：Minimize Cognitive Capture
描述：Avoid displays that dominate attention or create visual clutter in low-demand driving situations.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Memory seats
description: Seat positions and contour settings that can be memorized and recalled for different drivers.
text:
名称：Memory seats
描述：Seat positions and contour settings that can be memorized and recalled for different drivers.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Body Design Process
description: The overall styling process from initial concept to final design emphasizing staged development, and the roles of stylist and aerodynamist working together.
text:
名称：Body Design Process
描述：The overall styling process from initial concept to final design emphasizing staged development, and the roles of stylist and aerodynamist working together.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Robustness & Reliability (坚固耐用与可靠性)
description: 以耐久、承载能力和可靠性为核心的设计理念：通过强健的表面、可见结构、优良焊接与耐用组件来传达机械耐用性。涵盖重载/商用取向（承载与空间利用）、防护/安全优先（车身吸能与乘员保护）及长期服役的可靠性诉求，强调实用性而非装饰性。
text:
名称：Robustness & Reliability (坚固耐用与可靠性)
描述：以耐久、承载能力和可靠性为核心的设计理念：通过强健的表面、可见结构、优良焊接与耐用组件来传达机械耐用性。涵盖重载/商用取向（承载与空间利用）、防护/安全优先（车身吸能与乘员保护）及长期服役的可靠性诉求，强调实用性而非装饰性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EnginePerformanceIntegration
description: Use of materials and component geometry to improve engine aspiration and thermal behaviour while reducing weight.
text:
名称：EnginePerformanceIntegration
描述：Use of materials and component geometry to improve engine aspiration and thermal behaviour while reducing weight.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Utility-focused Two-seat Cargo / Multifunctionality (Cargo ↔ Passenger)
description: A design theme that encompasses compact two-passenger layouts with integrated cargo areas as well as broader multifunctional strategies for hatchbacks and wagons. Emphasizes balancing passenger accommodation and variable cargo-carrying capability—maximizing useful load space while maintaining a compact footprint.
text:
名称：Utility-focused Two-seat Cargo / Multifunctionality (Cargo ↔ Passenger)
描述：A design theme that encompasses compact two-passenger layouts with integrated cargo areas as well as broader multifunctional strategies for hatchbacks and wagons. Emphasizes balancing passenger accommodation and variable cargo-carrying capability—maximizing useful load space while maintaining a compact footprint.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: DesignReviewInClay
description: Use of full-scale clay models as primary aesthetic evaluation tool for proportions and surface quality.
text:
名称：DesignReviewInClay
描述：Use of full-scale clay models as primary aesthetic evaluation tool for proportions and surface quality.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomic System Integration
description: Design idea that vehicle controls and displays must function as an integrated system so drivers can understand, locate, and operate them intuitively; emphasizes expected locations, clear labeling, unobscured placement, direction-of-motion stereotypes, and grouping/association.
text:
名称：Ergonomic System Integration
描述：Design idea that vehicle controls and displays must function as an integrated system so drivers can understand, locate, and operate them intuitively; emphasizes expected locations, clear labeling, unobscured placement, direction-of-motion stereotypes, and grouping/association.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Five-piece Ultralight Body
description: A modular, five-piece vehicle body architecture prioritizing ultra-low mass, packaging efficiency and simple assembly; emphasizes composite skins and aluminum structural modules to minimize weight and optimize powertrain/suspension integration.
text:
名称：Five-piece Ultralight Body
描述：A modular, five-piece vehicle body architecture prioritizing ultra-low mass, packaging efficiency and simple assembly; emphasizes composite skins and aluminum structural modules to minimize weight and optimize powertrain/suspension integration.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ErgonomicControl
description: Control design philosophy aimed at fast, low-cognitive-load and minimal hand motion operations to improve driving efficiency and safety.
text:
名称：ErgonomicControl
描述：Control design philosophy aimed at fast, low-cognitive-load and minimal hand motion operations to improve driving efficiency and safety.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Emblema caballo al galope
description: Símbolo escultórico que refuerza la narrativa del vehículo como 'pony car' y su identidad visual.
text:
名称：Emblema caballo al galope
描述：Símbolo escultórico que refuerza la narrativa del vehículo como 'pony car' y su identidad visual.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Shape as aesthetic assurance
description: Shape organized to ensure pleasant impression through unity, clear details, functional expression, economic justification and usability.
text:
名称：Shape as aesthetic assurance
描述：Shape organized to ensure pleasant impression through unity, clear details, functional expression, economic justification and usability.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: StylingVisibility
description: Visible styling changes (silhouette, surface gestures, trims) are the most obvious aspects of vehicle development to lay consumers.
text:
名称：StylingVisibility
描述：Visible styling changes (silhouette, surface gestures, trims) are the most obvious aspects of vehicle development to lay consumers.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 折叠机构概念
description: 以折叠而非连续伸缩的方式改变车身尺寸或构型，使结构更紧凑、机械实现更可控。
text:
名称：折叠机构概念
描述：以折叠而非连续伸缩的方式改变车身尺寸或构型，使结构更紧凑、机械实现更可控。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: User_Friendly
description: 以便捷、亲和与降低学习成本为核心的设计理念。弱化机械感、强调温和与细节美学，同时通过高可读性界面、引导性视觉元素与清晰的物理控件来减轻新手压力，兼顾不同群体（如女性与初学者）的审美与易用性。/ A design philosophy centered on convenience, approachability and low learning cost: reducing mechanical harshness, emphasizing gentle and detailed aesthetics, and employing highly readable interfaces, guiding visual elements and clear physical controls to ease novice users while addressing preferences of groups such as women.
text:
名称：User_Friendly
描述：以便捷、亲和与降低学习成本为核心的设计理念。弱化机械感、强调温和与细节美学，同时通过高可读性界面、引导性视觉元素与清晰的物理控件来减轻新手压力，兼顾不同群体（如女性与初学者）的审美与易用性。/ A design philosophy centered on convenience, approachability and low learning cost: reducing mechanical harshness, emphasizing gentle and detailed aesthetics, and employing highly readable interfaces, guiding visual elements and clear physical controls to ease novice users while addressing preferences of groups such as women.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Streamlining / 流线型
description: 以降低风阻为核心的造型与美学理念，强调连续、流畅的车身线条与单一曲面、收尖的前后部及底盘平整化，以减少空气阻力并传达速度与效率感；同时通过掩饰机械碎片化，具有运动与进步的象征性。起源于气动学研究（如Paul Jaray的试验），20世纪20—30年代兴起并在30年代成为主流设计话语，并在20世纪20—50年代广泛应用于量产车（如Chrysler Airflow、大众甲壳虫），体现组件一体化与最小迎风面积等空气动力学原则。
text:
名称：Streamlining / 流线型
描述：以降低风阻为核心的造型与美学理念，强调连续、流畅的车身线条与单一曲面、收尖的前后部及底盘平整化，以减少空气阻力并传达速度与效率感；同时通过掩饰机械碎片化，具有运动与进步的象征性。起源于气动学研究（如Paul Jaray的试验），20世纪20—30年代兴起并在30年代成为主流设计话语，并在20世纪20—50年代广泛应用于量产车（如Chrysler Airflow、大众甲壳虫），体现组件一体化与最小迎风面积等空气动力学原则。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomic comfort orientation
description: Design theme prioritizing occupant comfort and measurable reduction of localized discomfort over driving durations.
text:
名称：Ergonomic comfort orientation
描述：Design theme prioritizing occupant comfort and measurable reduction of localized discomfort over driving durations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Synesthesia
description: 将非视觉感受映射为视觉图像，以便在意象板上通过图像传递抽象感觉。
text:
名称：Synesthesia
描述：将非视觉感受映射为视觉图像，以便在意象板上通过图像传递抽象感觉。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Surface Fidelity (表面连续性与平滑性 / 表面忠实度)
description: Degree to which a surface accurately represents the intended design, characterized by continuous, smooth curvature, consistent reflections and highlights, and absence of waviness, bumps, noise, or discontinuities. In automotive styling it refers to how faithfully the modeled surface conveys the designer's shape intent and visual quality. / 指表面在几何和视觉上忠实再现设计意图的程度，表现为曲率连续、平滑、反射与高光一致、无波纹、凹凸或不连续。在汽车造型中指建模表面如何准确地传达设计师的形状意图和视觉质量。
text:
名称：Surface Fidelity (表面连续性与平滑性 / 表面忠实度)
描述：Degree to which a surface accurately represents the intended design, characterized by continuous, smooth curvature, consistent reflections and highlights, and absence of waviness, bumps, noise, or discontinuities. In automotive styling it refers to how faithfully the modeled surface conveys the designer's shape intent and visual quality. / 指表面在几何和视觉上忠实再现设计意图的程度，表现为曲率连续、平滑、反射与高光一致、无波纹、凹凸或不连续。在汽车造型中指建模表面如何准确地传达设计师的形状意图和视觉质量。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Dynamic Family Language
description: 在保持家族识别元素（灯组、裙线、比例等）的一致性基础上，允许不同车型在细节、形态和比例上发生变化以体现差异化与高端感。
text:
名称：Dynamic Family Language
描述：在保持家族识别元素（灯组、裙线、比例等）的一致性基础上，允许不同车型在细节、形态和比例上发生变化以体现差异化与高端感。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Curb Ground Line
description: Reference datum for ride height and package development; baseline silhouette at empty vehicle.
text:
名称：Curb Ground Line
描述：Reference datum for ride height and package development; baseline silhouette at empty vehicle.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 内饰氛围化（Ambient Interior Lighting）
description: 利用条状LED与色彩控制塑造内部环境氛围，强化内饰的形态特征与体验价值。
text:
名称：内饰氛围化（Ambient Interior Lighting）
描述：利用条状LED与色彩控制塑造内部环境氛围，强化内饰的形态特征与体验价值。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Maintainability
description: 在设计阶段考虑易于保养与修理，降低对熟练技工的依赖。
text:
名称：Maintainability
描述：在设计阶段考虑易于保养与修理，降低对熟练技工的依赖。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 节能环保 (BlueMotion)
description: 以降低能耗和风阻为目的的造型主题。
text:
名称：节能环保 (BlueMotion)
描述：以降低能耗和风阻为目的的造型主题。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Material selection criteria
description: Choose materials satisfying functional, aesthetic (visual/tactile) and economic criteria.
text:
名称：Material selection criteria
描述：Choose materials satisfying functional, aesthetic (visual/tactile) and economic criteria.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sequence of Use Principle
description: Arrange controls and displays in the order of expected use to minimize eye and hand movements; consider prior eye fixation and hand location.
text:
名称：Sequence of Use Principle
描述：Arrange controls and displays in the order of expected use to minimize eye and hand movements; consider prior eye fixation and hand location.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Design-led Emotion (Emotional Design)
description: An aesthetic strategy that prioritizes emotional responses and meaningful attachments. Exterior proportions and packaging are deliberately chosen and adapted primarily to achieve a specific emotional/visual intent and to serve the chosen look.
text:
名称：Design-led Emotion (Emotional Design)
描述：An aesthetic strategy that prioritizes emotional responses and meaningful attachments. Exterior proportions and packaging are deliberately chosen and adapted primarily to achieve a specific emotional/visual intent and to serve the chosen look.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mass-market Accessibility & Versatility
description: 通过平台化、模块化设计以及可负担的定价与包装，覆盖从入门到高端的多个价位段与多种车身形态，提升产品对新兴中产及大众市场的可达性与适配性。 / Design focused on making vehicles accessible to the emerging middle class through affordable pricing and packaging, combined with platform/modular strategies to cover multiple price tiers and body styles.
text:
名称：Mass-market Accessibility & Versatility
描述：通过平台化、模块化设计以及可负担的定价与包装，覆盖从入门到高端的多个价位段与多种车身形态，提升产品对新兴中产及大众市场的可达性与适配性。 / Design focused on making vehicles accessible to the emerging middle class through affordable pricing and packaging, combined with platform/modular strategies to cover multiple price tiers and body styles.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functionality & Autonomy / Autonomy/Convenience
description: Prioritize functional clarity and integration of autonomous features while emphasizing user convenience and new human-vehicle interaction modes (e.g., remote parking / valet), keeping the vehicle seductive and usable. / 强调功能清晰与自动化特性的整合，同时以用户便捷为导向，注重车与人之间的新交互方式（如远程泊车/代客泊车），并保持车辆的吸引力与可用性。
text:
名称：Functionality & Autonomy / Autonomy/Convenience
描述：Prioritize functional clarity and integration of autonomous features while emphasizing user convenience and new human-vehicle interaction modes (e.g., remote parking / valet), keeping the vehicle seductive and usable. / 强调功能清晰与自动化特性的整合，同时以用户便捷为导向，注重车与人之间的新交互方式（如远程泊车/代客泊车），并保持车辆的吸引力与可用性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Line and geometric balance
description: Use lines and geometric forms to suggest movement and create balance.
text:
名称：Line and geometric balance
描述：Use lines and geometric forms to suggest movement and create balance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Adjustable/multi-way power seats with lumbar support and wide-door ingress
description: Combination of adjustable seat features to improve ingress and occupant comfort: seat height/adjustability to reduce knee strain during climbing and provide head/torso clearance; wide door opening for easier ingress; multi-way power adjustment (eight-way) including four-way lumbar support to enhance ergonomic support and personalized seating position.
text:
名称：Adjustable/multi-way power seats with lumbar support and wide-door ingress
描述：Combination of adjustable seat features to improve ingress and occupant comfort: seat height/adjustability to reduce knee strain during climbing and provide head/torso clearance; wide door opening for easier ingress; multi-way power adjustment (eight-way) including four-way lumbar support to enhance ergonomic support and personalized seating position.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Personalization & Customization (个性化与定制化)
description: An aesthetic concept emphasizing user-driven personalization and customization across the vehicle lifecycle: selectable finishes, colours, materials and co-branded options; digital configurators and service-led offerings (subscription-based changes, component swaps, pricing feedback) to enable ongoing changes; modular post-purchase component systems that allow reconfiguration of interior/exterior elements, support multiple configurations on the same chassis, and extend vehicle life. 强调通过数字化配置器、服务化订阅或组件更换实现用户主导的颜色、材质、饰面和联名等个性表达，并通过模块化系统支持购买后重新配置以延长车辆生命周期，可在同一底盘上实现多种配置。
text:
名称：Personalization & Customization (个性化与定制化)
描述：An aesthetic concept emphasizing user-driven personalization and customization across the vehicle lifecycle: selectable finishes, colours, materials and co-branded options; digital configurators and service-led offerings (subscription-based changes, component swaps, pricing feedback) to enable ongoing changes; modular post-purchase component systems that allow reconfiguration of interior/exterior elements, support multiple configurations on the same chassis, and extend vehicle life. 强调通过数字化配置器、服务化订阅或组件更换实现用户主导的颜色、材质、饰面和联名等个性表达，并通过模块化系统支持购买后重新配置以延长车辆生命周期，可在同一底盘上实现多种配置。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Luxury vs Economy
description: 用于在设计轴线上区分“豪华”与“经济”取向的准则，决定表面处理细腻度、比例语言与细节密度，从而传递不同的价格感与品牌定位。
text:
名称：Luxury vs Economy
描述：用于在设计轴线上区分“豪华”与“经济”取向的准则，决定表面处理细腻度、比例语言与细节密度，从而传递不同的价格感与品牌定位。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Usability (包含 Cleanability 与 Delightful Usability)
description: 综合强调实用性与体验性的美学目标：优先减少用户时间与操作负担，降低认知与体力负荷，限制展示信息并保持功能与界面的一致性；同时注重易清洁性与可维护性，将符合人体工程学的设计融入方向盘、控制界面等，以降低用户维护时间并提升便利性；还关注直观且令人愉悦的交互与触觉体验，通过满足期望并适度产生“惊喜”来提升用户对产品的好感。 English: A comprehensive usability-oriented aesthetic that spans functional and experiential dimensions: prioritize minimizing user time and effort, reduce cognitive and physical workload, limit displayed information, and ensure consistent integration of features and interfaces; design for ease of cleaning and serviceability and incorporate ergonomics (e.g., in wheels and controls) to reduce maintenance time; and create intuitive, pleasurable interactions and tactile experiences that meet expectations and occasionally delight users.
text:
名称：Usability (包含 Cleanability 与 Delightful Usability)
描述：综合强调实用性与体验性的美学目标：优先减少用户时间与操作负担，降低认知与体力负荷，限制展示信息并保持功能与界面的一致性；同时注重易清洁性与可维护性，将符合人体工程学的设计融入方向盘、控制界面等，以降低用户维护时间并提升便利性；还关注直观且令人愉悦的交互与触觉体验，通过满足期望并适度产生“惊喜”来提升用户对产品的好感。 English: A comprehensive usability-oriented aesthetic that spans functional and experiential dimensions: prioritize minimizing user time and effort, reduce cognitive and physical workload, limit displayed information, and ensure consistent integration of features and interfaces; design for ease of cleaning and serviceability and incorporate ergonomics (e.g., in wheels and controls) to reduce maintenance time; and create intuitive, pleasurable interactions and tactile experiences that meet expectations and occasionally delight users.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Efficient Packaging
description: Prioritize compact, function-driven packaging of vehicle subsystems to improve interior volume and vehicle packaging. Encompasses e‑drive component integration (motors, controllers, cooling) to enable clean exterior forms, flat floors and better interior packaging, and compact interior/sub-seat packaging (minimized seat package volume) to maximize usable cabin space while maintaining ergonomics.
text:
名称：Efficient Packaging
描述：Prioritize compact, function-driven packaging of vehicle subsystems to improve interior volume and vehicle packaging. Encompasses e‑drive component integration (motors, controllers, cooling) to enable clean exterior forms, flat floors and better interior packaging, and compact interior/sub-seat packaging (minimized seat package volume) to maximize usable cabin space while maintaining ergonomics.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Minimize Visual Demand
description: Design goal to reduce required eye and head movement to access controls while driving, improving safety and convenience.
text:
名称：Minimize Visual Demand
描述：Design goal to reduce required eye and head movement to access controls while driving, improving safety and convenience.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomic-first Aesthetic
description: An aesthetic that signals usability and intuitive operation; favored by users seeking fewer operational errors and lower cognitive load.
text:
名称：Ergonomic-first Aesthetic
描述：An aesthetic that signals usability and intuitive operation; favored by users seeking fewer operational errors and lower cognitive load.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ErgonomicAuthenticity
description: Design priority that vehicle interior geometry must be founded on accurate, up-to-date anthropometric data and realistic postures (e.g. erect vs slumped), avoiding simplistic percentile assumptions.
text:
名称：ErgonomicAuthenticity
描述：Design priority that vehicle interior geometry must be founded on accurate, up-to-date anthropometric data and realistic postures (e.g. erect vs slumped), avoiding simplistic percentile assumptions.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: PneumaticSuspension
description: Air-spring suspension to improve ride comfort and maintain cruising stability at high speeds.
text:
名称：PneumaticSuspension
描述：Air-spring suspension to improve ride comfort and maintain cruising stability at high speeds.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Importance Principle
description: Important controls should be close to the steering wheel; important displays close to driver’s forward line of sight.
text:
名称：Importance Principle
描述：Important controls should be close to the steering wheel; important displays close to driver’s forward line of sight.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Form Freedom
description: Aesthetic concept emphasizing complex, continuous sculpted surfaces and integrated shapes made possible by composite manufacturing.
text:
名称：Form Freedom
描述：Aesthetic concept emphasizing complex, continuous sculpted surfaces and integrated shapes made possible by composite manufacturing.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional Color Scheme
description: Color-driven aesthetic prioritizing visibility and psychophysical perception.
text:
名称：Functional Color Scheme
描述：Color-driven aesthetic prioritizing visibility and psychophysical perception.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 精确/智能照明（Precision / Smart Lighting）
description: 通过传感器及矩阵LED按需分区照明以提升安全并降低眩光。

描述：通过传感器及矩阵LED按需分区照明以提升安全并降低眩光。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Market-specific Localization
description: 为特定市场定制车型特性、尺寸、配置与成本策略——以Honda City项目为例
text:
名称：Market-specific Localization
描述：为特定市场定制车型特性、尺寸、配置与成本策略——以Honda City项目为例

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 箱型
description: 以直立车厢与明确立面为特征的造型，强调车内空间与功能性比例。
text:
名称：箱型
描述：以直立车厢与明确立面为特征的造型，强调车内空间与功能性比例。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Frequency of Usage Principle
description: Frequently used controls and displays should be placed close to the steering wheel and within the driver's forward line of sight, respectively.
text:
名称：Frequency of Usage Principle
描述：Frequently used controls and displays should be placed close to the steering wheel and within the driver's forward line of sight, respectively.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Product Experience / 以用户为中心的服务体验
description: Guides design to consider experience trajectories and multi-sensory feedback, and emphasizes user-centered service elements — convenience, economy and sustainability — delivered via seamless touchpoints, clear information and efficient processes to shape product experience and brand perception.
text:
名称：Product Experience / 以用户为中心的服务体验
描述：Guides design to consider experience trajectories and multi-sensory feedback, and emphasizes user-centered service elements — convenience, economy and sustainability — delivered via seamless touchpoints, clear information and efficient processes to shape product experience and brand perception.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Door Opening Angle
description: 车辆门的实际开启角度及其开启弧线（包括初始接触/first check 与完全开启状态），描述门在开启过程中的几何路径；影响乘客出入空间、脚部摆动净空、把手可及性以及停放/开门时与周边障碍物的间隙。(Geometric path of the door as it opens, affects foot swing clearance, ingress/egress and handle reachability.)
text:
名称：Door Opening Angle
描述：车辆门的实际开启角度及其开启弧线（包括初始接触/first check 与完全开启状态），描述门在开启过程中的几何路径；影响乘客出入空间、脚部摆动净空、把手可及性以及停放/开门时与周边障碍物的间隙。(Geometric path of the door as it opens, affects foot swing clearance, ingress/egress and handle reachability.)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: A柱前移 / A柱前倾
description: A柱底部向车头方向大幅前移，视觉上使A柱延伸到车头并减少传统机舱区隔离感。部分资料以“ A柱前倾 ”表述，两者在语义上常被互换使用，均指A柱相对于车身向前移动/前倾以改变视觉与舱室界面感受。
text:
名称：A柱前移 / A柱前倾
描述：A柱底部向车头方向大幅前移，视觉上使A柱延伸到车头并减少传统机舱区隔离感。部分资料以“ A柱前倾 ”表述，两者在语义上常被互换使用，均指A柱相对于车身向前移动/前倾以改变视觉与舱室界面感受。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Flexible high-quality production
description: 强调通过组织与工艺改进实现高质量、短生产批次与多车型变体的生产能力。
text:
名称：Flexible high-quality production
描述：强调通过组织与工艺改进实现高质量、短生产批次与多车型变体的生产能力。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Stylist-Centered Sculptural Modeling
description: 以首席造型师为核心，通过3D粘土模型与立体雕塑化手段确立车身大面与轮廓（Harley Earl 时代的工作方式）。
text:
名称：Stylist-Centered Sculptural Modeling
描述：以首席造型师为核心，通过3D粘土模型与立体雕塑化手段确立车身大面与轮廓（Harley Earl 时代的工作方式）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Structural & Package-driven Functionalism
description: 将车身造型直接由结构需求与功能包装决定：优先保证结构完整性、明确受力路径并采用闭合/箱形截面以控制应力，同时车身比例和外形由内部布局（乘员舱、动力总成、悬挂与载物空间）的包装需求驱动。
text:
名称：Structural & Package-driven Functionalism
描述：将车身造型直接由结构需求与功能包装决定：优先保证结构完整性、明确受力路径并采用闭合/箱形截面以控制应力，同时车身比例和外形由内部布局（乘员舱、动力总成、悬挂与载物空间）的包装需求驱动。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 面上光势/光形态
description: （同上）
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Structural Integrity
description: Design idea prioritizing clear load paths, stiffness and visible cues of durability; aligns with chassis design aims such as load analysis and sound structural design.
text:
名称：Structural Integrity
描述：Design idea prioritizing clear load paths, stiffness and visible cues of durability; aligns with chassis design aims such as load analysis and sound structural design.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Function-first Complexity Acknowledgement
description: 认识到汽车作为复杂系统必须先明确功能与性能需求，再展开造型；强调功能优先以控制复杂度
text:
名称：Function-first Complexity Acknowledgement

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 子弹头型
description: 极端流线化的前后锥形轮廓，着重减小尾流和压差损失。
text:
名称：子弹头型
描述：极端流线化的前后锥形轮廓，着重减小尾流和压差损失。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Styling Concepts
description: See above; users prefer styling that demonstrably supports ergonomic function.
text:
名称：Styling Concepts
描述：See above; users prefer styling that demonstrably supports ergonomic function.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Multi-functionality (多功能性)
description: 融合载人、载物、休闲与轻度越野使用场景的功能特性与空间布局。
text:
名称：Multi-functionality (多功能性)
描述：融合载人、载物、休闲与轻度越野使用场景的功能特性与空间布局。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 船型/鱼型
description: 整体流线连续、襟尾逐渐收窄，借鉴水动力学的流线造型以减少尾涡。
text:
名称：船型/鱼型
描述：整体流线连续、襟尾逐渐收窄，借鉴水动力学的流线造型以减少尾涡。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Concealed Packaging
description: Minimize the visible impact of fuel or energy storage by using natural open volumes and underfloor or inboard locations, reducing packaging intrusion on cabin and exterior form.
text:
名称：Concealed Packaging
描述：Minimize the visible impact of fuel or energy storage by using natural open volumes and underfloor or inboard locations, reducing packaging intrusion on cabin and exterior form.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Efficiency&Range_高效续航导向
description: 以降低能耗与提高电池效率为导向的造型、轻量化与热管理策略，缓解用户续航担忧。
text:
名称：Efficiency&Range_高效续航导向
描述：以降低能耗与提高电池效率为导向的造型、轻量化与热管理策略，缓解用户续航担忧。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Flexible Under-floor Packaging
description: Maximize usable interior volume by packaging seats and mechanisms to stow into recesses beneath a relatively high, flat floor; emphasizes multi‑configurability, concealed storage and adaptable cabin layouts.
text:
名称：Flexible Under-floor Packaging
描述：Maximize usable interior volume by packaging seats and mechanisms to stow into recesses beneath a relatively high, flat floor; emphasizes multi‑configurability, concealed storage and adaptable cabin layouts.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Preserve design dynamism and originality
description: 强调保留手工制作胶带图带来的动性和原创性的美学理念，反对计算机工具完全替代手工表达。
text:
名称：Preserve design dynamism and originality
描述：强调保留手工制作胶带图带来的动性和原创性的美学理念，反对计算机工具完全替代手工表达。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Material Innovation (材料与工艺创新)
description: 探索新材料与制造工艺以实现轻量化、结构一体化与新颖造型
text:
名称：Material Innovation (材料与工艺创新)
描述：探索新材料与制造工艺以实现轻量化、结构一体化与新颖造型

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Time-Pressure Principle
description: Controls that must be used quickly under external pressure (hazard, horn, defrost, high beams) should be placed close to steering wheel or in prominent, immediately accessible locations.
text:
名称：Time-Pressure Principle
描述：Controls that must be used quickly under external pressure (hazard, horn, defrost, high beams) should be placed close to steering wheel or in prominent, immediately accessible locations.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 宽敞车内空间
description: 以多排座椅布局和灵活装载空间为特征，强调乘坐舒适性与载物能力。
text:
名称：宽敞车内空间
描述：以多排座椅布局和灵活装载空间为特征，强调乘坐舒适性与载物能力。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Simplicity & Robustness (简洁与坚固性 / Robust Simplicity)
description: 融合简洁与坚固性的混合理念：以简单、易维护的机械布局配合经久耐用的结构与组件，从而实现低成本、易包装与可靠的产品形象。典型体现包括使用梁式车轴或半椭叶片弹簧等朴实、便于生产与维修的传动/悬架解决方案。
text:

name: 功能与形态一体化

text:
名称：功能与形态一体化

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Strut-integrated steering axis
description: Steering kingpin/axis aligned with the strut centreline (McPherson), combining steering and suspension functions.
text:
名称：Strut-integrated steering axis
描述：Steering kingpin/axis aligned with the strut centreline (McPherson), combining steering and suspension functions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: RegulatoryAdaptiveDesign_法规适配化设计
description: 在车辆规格、软件功能与运营策略上预留法规适配能力以降低牌照与合规壁垒的影响。
text:
名称：RegulatoryAdaptiveDesign_法规适配化设计
描述：在车辆规格、软件功能与运营策略上预留法规适配能力以降低牌照与合规壁垒的影响。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visual Appeal
description: High-level objective to create forms that attract buyers, emphasizing immediate visual appeal, a strong first impression, and aesthetic clarity to attract consumers.
text:
名称：Visual Appeal
描述：High-level objective to create forms that attract buyers, emphasizing immediate visual appeal, a strong first impression, and aesthetic clarity to attract consumers.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 高保真视觉呈现
description: 通过高质量渲染与物理模型相互验证，确保设计细节在视觉上达到预期效果。
text:
名称：高保真视觉呈现
描述：通过高质量渲染与物理模型相互验证，确保设计细节在视觉上达到预期效果。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Design for Dimensional Control (DDC)
description: A discipline to recognise and manage dimensional variation through design, manufacture and assembly to meet customer quality expectations and reduce need for shop-floor finesse.
text:
名称：Design for Dimensional Control (DDC)
描述：A discipline to recognise and manage dimensional variation through design, manufacture and assembly to meet customer quality expectations and reduce need for shop-floor finesse.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 用车成本导向
description: 追求高性价比与低总持有成本，关注到手价、油耗/能耗、保养与权益。
text:
名称：用车成本导向
描述：追求高性价比与低总持有成本，关注到手价、油耗/能耗、保养与权益。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Interpretability
description: Displayed information should be unambiguous and easily understood; consider layout, scales/pointers, color coding, frame of reference, and proximity of similar displays.
text:
名称：Interpretability
描述：Displayed information should be unambiguous and easily understood; consider layout, scales/pointers, color coding, frame of reference, and proximity of similar displays.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Durability, Reliability & Thermal Integrity
description: A high-level design theme prioritizing long-term functional performance and predictable mechanical life by resisting failure modes (fatigue, corrosion, wear) and maintaining material/component integrity under elevated temperatures and environmental stress. Emphasizes material selection and detail design (e.g., high melting/operating temperature materials, low thermal expansion, coatings and surface treatments) to enable components such as thin rotors, powertrain and exhaust parts to operate reliably at higher surface temperatures with low failure probability and minimal warranty/recall incidence.
text:
名称：Durability, Reliability & Thermal Integrity
描述：A high-level design theme prioritizing long-term functional performance and predictable mechanical life by resisting failure modes (fatigue, corrosion, wear) and maintaining material/component integrity under elevated temperatures and environmental stress. Emphasizes material selection and detail design (e.g., high melting/operating temperature materials, low thermal expansion, coatings and surface treatments) to enable components such as thin rotors, powertrain and exhaust parts to operate reliably at higher surface temperatures with low failure probability and minimal warranty/recall incidence.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crashworthiness
description: Design objective focused on occupant protection through vehicle structural design that manages crash energy and controls deformation. Encompasses controlled structural collapse and energy absorption in impacts (including partial overlap), minimising intrusion, producing a deceleration pulse compatible with restraint systems (airbags, seatbelts), and preserving the survival space. Also includes considerations of structural integrity in relation to occupant packaging and glazing/forward visibility where relevant to safety and occupant protection.
text:
名称：Crashworthiness
描述：Design objective focused on occupant protection through vehicle structural design that manages crash energy and controls deformation. Encompasses controlled structural collapse and energy absorption in impacts (including partial overlap), minimising intrusion, producing a deceleration pulse compatible with restraint systems (airbags, seatbelts), and preserving the survival space. Also includes considerations of structural integrity in relation to occupant packaging and glazing/forward visibility where relevant to safety and occupant protection.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Distinctive Identity (差异化识别)
description: 在造型、表面处理或品牌符号上与现有竞品形成明确区别，同时保留联系以便消费者认知。
text:
名称：Distinctive Identity (差异化识别)
描述：在造型、表面处理或品牌符号上与现有竞品形成明确区别，同时保留联系以便消费者认知。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Regulatory Compliance
description: Design intent to ensure conformity with harmonised international vehicle regulations and approval systems (EEC/ECE/EC), to meet legal dimensional limits and market-specific rules (e.g., width limits), and to satisfy visibility- and lighting-related standards (eye-point setups and driver obscuration, e.g. EC 77/649, SAE J1050) and headlamp/reflector/park-turn lamp packaging and aim requirements per US (SAE/IIHS) and European (EC) regulations.
text:
名称：Regulatory Compliance
描述：Design intent to ensure conformity with harmonised international vehicle regulations and approval systems (EEC/ECE/EC), to meet legal dimensional limits and market-specific rules (e.g., width limits), and to satisfy visibility- and lighting-related standards (eye-point setups and driver obscuration, e.g. EC 77/649, SAE J1050) and headlamp/reflector/park-turn lamp packaging and aim requirements per US (SAE/IIHS) and European (EC) regulations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Precision and Calibration
description: Emphasis on measuring accuracy and repeatable surface definition in full-scale and scale models to ensure intended proportions and aerodynamic performance.
text:
名称：Precision and Calibration
描述：Emphasis on measuring accuracy and repeatable surface definition in full-scale and scale models to ensure intended proportions and aerodynamic performance.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Reading Performance
description: See above.
text:
名称：Reading Performance
描述：See above.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Transparency
description: Use of large glazed areas and see-through upper structures (panoramic windscreens/roofs) to create light, openness and new proportions; driven by glass-technology advances and market taste for panoramic glazing.
text:
名称：Transparency
描述：Use of large glazed areas and see-through upper structures (panoramic windscreens/roofs) to create light, openness and new proportions; driven by glass-technology advances and market taste for panoramic glazing.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Integrated Product and Process Development (IPPD)
description: 管理与工程理念：并行集成产品与制造过程、早期生命周期规划、多学科团队以同时优化性能、成本与支持性。
text:
名称：Integrated Product and Process Development (IPPD)
描述：管理与工程理念：并行集成产品与制造过程、早期生命周期规划、多学科团队以同时优化性能、成本与支持性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Luxury + Versatility
description: 将传统轿车或豪华特质与越野／多功能能力相结合的美学方向，兼顾精致内饰与越野性能特征（例如更高离地间隙、越野车身细节），以实现既有豪华感又具多场景适应性的产品定位。
text:
名称：Luxury + Versatility
描述：将传统轿车或豪华特质与越野／多功能能力相结合的美学方向，兼顾精致内饰与越野性能特征（例如更高离地间隙、越野车身细节），以实现既有豪华感又具多场景适应性的产品定位。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Form Beauty (造型之美)
description: 强调线面协调、比例、材质与色彩的有机整合，使技术与美学贯穿整车设计。
text:
名称：Form Beauty (造型之美)
描述：强调线面协调、比例、材质与色彩的有机整合，使技术与美学贯穿整车设计。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 汽车照明功能复杂化
description: 随着自动驾驶与主动安全传感器融合、矩阵/像素化光源普及，灯组功能边界扩展，造型与结构更复杂。
text:
名称：汽车照明功能复杂化
描述：随着自动驾驶与主动安全传感器融合、矩阵/像素化光源普及，灯组功能边界扩展，造型与结构更复杂。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 滑动侧门
description: 便于乘员上下车的大开口形式，常用于家庭与商务场景。
text:
名称：滑动侧门
描述：便于乘员上下车的大开口形式，常用于家庭与商务场景。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Function-driven Packaging
description: Start from functional objectives and components to drive proportions.
text:
名称：Function-driven Packaging
描述：Start from functional objectives and components to drive proportions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visibility Optimization
description: An overarching design concept that prioritizes driver visibility by maximizing unobstructed sightlines and practical rear visibility (especially for hatchbacks, SUVs and pickups), while controlling glare, reflections and scattering to protect sightlines for drivers of varying heights and to reduce sun glare and blind-spot risk. / 一种以驾驶员视野和可视性为核心的设计理念：通过最大化无遮挡视野和实用的后向可视性（尤其适用于掀背车、SUV 和皮卡），并通过控制眩光、反射与散射来保护不同身高驾驶员的视线、降低日光眩光与盲区风险。
text:
名称：Visibility Optimization
描述：An overarching design concept that prioritizes driver visibility by maximizing unobstructed sightlines and practical rear visibility (especially for hatchbacks, SUVs and pickups), while controlling glare, reflections and scattering to protect sightlines for drivers of varying heights and to reduce sun glare and blind-spot risk. / 一种以驾驶员视野和可视性为核心的设计理念：通过最大化无遮挡视野和实用的后向可视性（尤其适用于掀背车、SUV 和皮卡），并通过控制眩光、反射与散射来保护不同身高驾驶员的视线、降低日光眩光与盲区风险。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Package Efficiency
description: Minimized footprint and packaging optimization to reduce consumption and improve interior efficiency. Prioritizes maximizing usable interior volume within the shortest possible overall length by advancing occupant position and compactly packaging the drivetrain and wheelhouse.
text:
名称：Package Efficiency
描述：Minimized footprint and packaging optimization to reduce consumption and improve interior efficiency. Prioritizes maximizing usable interior volume within the shortest possible overall length by advancing occupant position and compactly packaging the drivetrain and wheelhouse.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: DesignTradeoffAwareness
description: 承认机械、人机与空气动力学之间的冲突，强调在功能与造型间寻找平衡。
text:
名称：DesignTradeoffAwareness
描述：承认机械、人机与空气动力学之间的冲突，强调在功能与造型间寻找平衡。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 中观设计
description: 中观阶段强调局部与整体的关系、局部单元之间的组合与节奏。
text:
名称：中观设计
描述：中观阶段强调局部与整体的关系、局部单元之间的组合与节奏。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EnvironmentalResponsibility (生态友好)
description: Emphasizes minimizing the environmental impact of vehicle systems — including emissions reduction, energy efficiency, clean/alternative energy adoption, low lifecycle impacts and low maintenance — conveying sustainable values and influencing regulatory scope and design trade-offs. / 强调在排放、能效、清洁/替代能源使用、生命周期影响与低维修成本方面将车辆的环境影响降到最低，传达可持续价值，并影响法规范围与设计权衡。
text:
名称：EnvironmentalResponsibility (生态友好)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Tire-Driven Proportion
description: Visual strategy where wheel and tire dimensions strongly determine perceived ride height and stance.
text:
名称：Tire-Driven Proportion
描述：Visual strategy where wheel and tire dimensions strongly determine perceived ride height and stance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Range
description: 实际可用里程，是用户考量新能源车是否符合日常出行需求的核心指标。
text:
名称：Range
描述：实际可用里程，是用户考量新能源车是否符合日常出行需求的核心指标。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: High-mounted radio display
description: Prioritize positioning the radio/display high on the center stack to improve driver sightline and reduce time eyes-off-road.
text:
名称：High-mounted radio display
描述：Prioritize positioning the radio/display high on the center stack to improve driver sightline and reduce time eyes-off-road.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Form Follows Function
description: A design principle that prioritizes functional requirements over traditional form: preference to accept unfamiliar forms when dictated by new functional requirements, realized through minimization of non-functional elements.
text:
名称：Form Follows Function
描述：A design principle that prioritizes functional requirements over traditional form: preference to accept unfamiliar forms when dictated by new functional requirements, realized through minimization of non-functional elements.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Systems Engineering
description: 以系统为中心协调产品、制造与管理体系，重视接口、复合性能与总体权衡。
text:
名称：Systems Engineering
描述：以系统为中心协调产品、制造与管理体系，重视接口、复合性能与总体权衡。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ErgonomicCompliance
description: Use of established ergonomics standards and guidelines (SAE/ISO/BS) to define occupant packaging, controls and displays; prioritises usability, safety and fit-for-population.
text:
名称：ErgonomicCompliance
描述：Use of established ergonomics standards and guidelines (SAE/ISO/BS) to define occupant packaging, controls and displays; prioritises usability, safety and fit-for-population.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 抽象形态 (Abstract Form)
description: 以抽象形态为核心的汽车造型理念：通过对原始意象的提炼与符号化，将面、线、体等三维几何语言抽象化，形成非具象且直觉性强的造型语言，能够跨车型复用并驱动产品系列的设计语。强调线条与曲面的演化、比例、姿态、结构及线—面关系，从整车宏观层面构建造型元素之间的逻辑，使局部服从整体，以提升审美感染力、识别度和高级感。该方法常用于早期造型流程，通过提炼意象、关键词和核心抽象形态推动造型演进，指导具有识别性和延展性的车型设计。
text:
名称：抽象形态 (Abstract Form)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EngineeringResponsibility
description: 工程师对防止灾难性失效、遵守法规与专业判断负有责任的理念，要求跨学科知识与透明记录。
text:
名称：EngineeringResponsibility
描述：工程师对防止灾难性失效、遵守法规与专业判断负有责任的理念，要求跨学科知识与透明记录。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Value Engineering
description: 团队为基础的评估方法，通过提高功能能力或降低成本来优化产品的价值-成本比；包括信息、功能、构想、评估、实施五个阶段。
text:
名称：Value Engineering
描述：团队为基础的评估方法，通过提高功能能力或降低成本来优化产品的价值-成本比；包括信息、功能、构想、评估、实施五个阶段。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Prototyping (Prototype / 原型化)
description: Emphasis on tactile, physical manipulation of surfaces to refine final shapes, combined with a focus on creating functional, manufacturable prototypes that meet mass-market requirements. 强调通过触觉与物理加工来形成和精修最终造型，同时注重功能性与可制造性，符合大众化需求。
text:
名称：Prototyping (Prototype / 原型化)
描述：Emphasis on tactile, physical manipulation of surfaces to refine final shapes, combined with a focus on creating functional, manufacturable prototypes that meet mass-market requirements. 强调通过触觉与物理加工来形成和精修最终造型，同时注重功能性与可制造性，符合大众化需求。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sculptural Interior (体雕塑感)
description: 内饰采用雕塑化连续曲面与体块处理，强调视觉的塑性和空间的可变形态，为多模态内饰体验提供基础设计理念。
text:
名称：Sculptural Interior (体雕塑感)
描述：内饰采用雕塑化连续曲面与体块处理，强调视觉的塑性和空间的可变形态，为多模态内饰体验提供基础设计理念。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tire Size Notation
description: Standard tire code (e.g., 215/50 R16) describing tread width (mm), sidewall aspect ratio (%) and rim diameter (inches).
text:
名称：Tire Size Notation
描述：Standard tire code (e.g., 215/50 R16) describing tread width (mm), sidewall aspect ratio (%) and rim diameter (inches).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 伸缩可变车身概念
description: 车辆在载员/载物满载时通过伸展轴距与车长获得更好乘坐与载物空间，停车或空载时收缩以改善城市停车与机动性。
text:
名称：伸缩可变车身概念
描述：车辆在载员/载物满载时通过伸展轴距与车长获得更好乘坐与载物空间，停车或空载时收缩以改善城市停车与机动性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 宏观设计
description: 确定整车的总体造型方向、概念与车身体量的高级决策阶段。
text:
名称：宏观设计
描述：确定整车的总体造型方向、概念与车身体量的高级决策阶段。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Integration of Traditional Craft and Digital Technology
description: Combining hands-on clay modelling and fabrication skills with electronic recording, CNC milling and digital measurement to accelerate iteration and improve fidelity.
text:
名称：Integration of Traditional Craft and Digital Technology
描述：Combining hands-on clay modelling and fabrication skills with electronic recording, CNC milling and digital measurement to accelerate iteration and improve fidelity.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Human-centeredAesthetics
description: 以人体工程学和易用性为核心的美学方向，外观与界面强调清晰性、可达性与亲和力
text:
名称：Human-centeredAesthetics
描述：以人体工程学和易用性为核心的美学方向，外观与界面强调清晰性、可达性与亲和力

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sport Handling
description: Design theme prioritizing roadholding, steering precision and chassis control to support aggressive driving. Emphasises rapid transient response, steering feedback, tactile shift feel and balance (often rear-wheel-drive), plus thermal and structural robustness to sustain performance and controllable tail behaviour during dynamic manoeuvres.
text:
名称：Sport Handling
