Emphasises rapid transient response, steering feedback, tactile shift feel and balance (often rear-wheel-drive), plus thermal and structural robustness to sustain performance and controllable tail behaviour during dynamic manoeuvres.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Underhood Cooling Efficiency
description: See above.
text:
名称：Underhood Cooling Efficiency
描述：See above.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: CostCompetitiveness
description: Strategic focus on reducing production and procurement costs to meet price-sensitive markets and survive competition.
text:
名称：CostCompetitiveness
描述：Strategic focus on reducing production and procurement costs to meet price-sensitive markets and survive competition.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Design Balance (设计平衡)
description: An overarching aesthetic principle that integrates visual symmetry and controlled variance with engineering and technological considerations. It emphasizes maintaining coherence across variants (balanced design) while strategically coordinating the ratio of visual symbolism to applied technology (design-engineering balance) to achieve both aesthetic harmony and market viability.
text:
名称：Design Balance (设计平衡)
描述：An overarching aesthetic principle that integrates visual symmetry and controlled variance with engineering and technological considerations. It emphasizes maintaining coherence across variants (balanced design) while strategically coordinating the ratio of visual symbolism to applied technology (design-engineering balance) to achieve both aesthetic harmony and market viability.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 分体组合单元概念
description: 整车由可分离单元组成，行驶时组合为完整车辆，停车或购物时单元可拆分并独立使用（如作为购物车或婴儿车）。
text:
名称：分体组合单元概念
描述：整车由可分离单元组成，行驶时组合为完整车辆，停车或购物时单元可拆分并独立使用（如作为购物车或婴儿车）。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ComponentSpatialEnvelope
description: Local geometric packaging of an individual component or subsystem (e.g., engine block envelope, HVAC module envelope).
text:
名称：ComponentSpatialEnvelope
描述：Local geometric packaging of an individual component or subsystem (e.g., engine block envelope, HVAC module envelope).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 逻辑化照明一体化
description: 将灯组作为整车造型逻辑的一部分，通过线性DRL与格栅、车身线条连通，形成品牌识别与整车造型的有机联系。
text:
名称：逻辑化照明一体化
描述：将灯组作为整车造型逻辑的一部分，通过线性DRL与格栅、车身线条连通，形成品牌识别与整车造型的有机联系。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety (安全性)
description: 设计以乘员保护与降低碰撞风险为首要目标，同时强调与道路其他使用者的清晰信息传达与可预测交互。侧重被动与主动约束系统的协同、车身强度、高视野座椅与人体工程学、能见度/醒目性与可识别性、可预测的控制与物理布局、牵引力及全天候可用性，以促进快速且适当的反馈行为，降低事故风险与用户焦虑。
text:
名称：Safety (安全性)
描述：设计以乘员保护与降低碰撞风险为首要目标，同时强调与道路其他使用者的清晰信息传达与可预测交互。侧重被动与主动约束系统的协同、车身强度、高视野座椅与人体工程学、能见度/醒目性与可识别性、可预测的控制与物理布局、牵引力及全天候可用性，以促进快速且适当的反馈行为，降低事故风险与用户焦虑。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Order (秩序)
description: Spatial ordering of components to create visual comfort, unity and balance; a guiding aesthetic principle mentioned in the text.
text:
名称：Order (秩序)
描述：Spatial ordering of components to create visual comfort, unity and balance; a guiding aesthetic principle mentioned in the text.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety-first Instrument Panel
description: Prioritize occupant protection in instrument panel design by minimizing hard projections in the head-impact zone, managing energy absorption and interaction with airbags and knee blockers.
text:
名称：Safety-first Instrument Panel
描述：Prioritize occupant protection in instrument panel design by minimizing hard projections in the head-impact zone, managing energy absorption and interaction with airbags and knee blockers.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Unspoken Wants (Must-have / Basic quality)
description: Must-have baseline features whose absence causes strong dissatisfaction; providing them yields little positive delight but prevents negative reaction.
text:
名称：Unspoken Wants (Must-have / Basic quality)
描述：Must-have baseline features whose absence causes strong dissatisfaction; providing them yields little positive delight but prevents negative reaction.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: FormFollowsFlow
description: 通过流线化的造型在视觉上表现速度与科技感，同时兼顾空气动力学表现。
text:
名称：FormFollowsFlow
描述：通过流线化的造型在视觉上表现速度与科技感，同时兼顾空气动力学表现。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Color Aesthetics (Artistic Color Matching & Color–Form Harmony)
description: Deliberate use of colors, color–form harmony and color relationships (complementary/contrasting, tone/lightness, density) to shape perceived form, optimize visualization, convey model positioning and trigger emotional value/resonance.
text:
名称：Color Aesthetics (Artistic Color Matching & Color–Form Harmony)
描述：Deliberate use of colors, color–form harmony and color relationships (complementary/contrasting, tone/lightness, density) to shape perceived form, optimize visualization, convey model positioning and trigger emotional value/resonance.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 饱满张力车顶轮廓
description: 强调车顶为一条饱满、富有张力的长曲线，传达体量感与流动性；以侧视线条为主导确定造型基尺与硬点。
text:
名称：饱满张力车顶轮廓
描述：强调车顶为一条饱满、富有张力的长曲线，传达体量感与流动性；以侧视线条为主导确定造型基尺与硬点。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mechanical Honesty
description: 以机械构件可见性与结构逻辑为美学价值，体现工程与性能的直观表达。
text:
名称：Mechanical Honesty
描述：以机械构件可见性与结构逻辑为美学价值，体现工程与性能的直观表达。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Interior refinement
description: Design theme prioritizing quietness, comfort, perceived smoothness and user-friendly interior systems (HVAC, electrical conveniences).
text:
名称：Interior refinement
描述：Design theme prioritizing quietness, comfort, perceived smoothness and user-friendly interior systems (HVAC, electrical conveniences).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Carpet
description: Floor coverings affecting color continuity, acoustics and perceived warmth. Includes carpet and underlay thickness (carpetThickness).
text:
名称：Carpet
描述：Floor coverings affecting color continuity, acoustics and perceived warmth. Includes carpet and underlay thickness (carpetThickness).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Color temperature tuning
description: Adjustable correlated color temperature (CCT) to optimize contrast and driver comfort under different conditions.
text:
名称：Color temperature tuning
描述：Adjustable correlated color temperature (CCT) to optimize contrast and driver comfort under different conditions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Market / Regional Adaptability
description: Design theme enabling vehicles to be efficiently adapted across regions and markets: supports quick configuration for LHD and RHD layouts, compliance with local regulations, adaptation to climates and anthropometrics, and alignment with local consumer preferences — all while preserving brand intent, ergonomics and safety.
text:
名称：Market / Regional Adaptability
描述：Design theme enabling vehicles to be efficiently adapted across regions and markets: supports quick configuration for LHD and RHD layouts, compliance with local regulations, adaptation to climates and anthropometrics, and alignment with local consumer preferences — all while preserving brand intent, ergonomics and safety.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Location Expectancy Principle
description: Locate controls and displays where drivers expect them based on market segment conventions and high-volume vehicle studies.
text:
名称：Location Expectancy Principle
描述：Locate controls and displays where drivers expect them based on market segment conventions and high-volume vehicle studies.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: IterativeReviewAndDigitization(迭代评审与数字化)
description: Combine physical model iteration with digital capture (scan/mill) for CAD translation, engineering assessment and tooling.
text:
名称：IterativeReviewAndDigitization(迭代评审与数字化)
描述：Combine physical model iteration with digital capture (scan/mill) for CAD translation, engineering assessment and tooling.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ErgonomicPriority Center Stack
description: Organize center stack and instrument area by functional priority so frequently used controls are within comfortable reach and clear sightlines.
text:
名称：ErgonomicPriority Center Stack
描述：Organize center stack and instrument area by functional priority so frequently used controls are within comfortable reach and clear sightlines.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 功能性
description: 以实用和性能满足为核心的造型指导，强调空间利用、人体工程学与操作便捷。
text:
名称：功能性
描述：以实用和性能满足为核心的造型指导，强调空间利用、人体工程学与操作便捷。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 颜值灵活
description: 兼顾视觉吸引力与使用灵活性的造型理念，适用于城市/家庭与年轻用户场景，强调紧凑、友好且具识别性的外观，同时以外形、颜色与时尚元素为核心诉求，吸引注重颜值的年轻群体（包括年轻女性）。
text:
名称：颜值灵活
描述：兼顾视觉吸引力与使用灵活性的造型理念，适用于城市/家庭与年轻用户场景，强调紧凑、友好且具识别性的外观，同时以外形、颜色与时尚元素为核心诉求，吸引注重颜值的年轻群体（包括年轻女性）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional Packaging
description: Prioritize packaging of cooling, exhaust and final‑drive components to ensure access to airflow and accommodate motion constraints during early vehicle layout studies; focuses on functional requirements that drive packaging decisions.
text:
名称：Functional Packaging
描述：Prioritize packaging of cooling, exhaust and final‑drive components to ensure access to airflow and accommodate motion constraints during early vehicle layout studies; focuses on functional requirements that drive packaging decisions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Stylist-Aerodynamist Collaboration
description: A cross-disciplinary working concept where stylists and aerodynamics engineers co-develop solutions to balance aesthetics and performance.
text:
名称：Stylist-Aerodynamist Collaboration
描述：A cross-disciplinary working concept where stylists and aerodynamics engineers co-develop solutions to balance aesthetics and performance.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Harmony (和谐 / 统一和平衡)
description: Overall balance and unity between technical, material and visual elements; supports visual comfort.
text:
名称：Harmony (和谐 / 统一和平衡)
描述：Overall balance and unity between technical, material and visual elements; supports visual comfort.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Satisfiers (Performance quality)
description: Features where increased performance/quantity raises customer satisfaction proportionally; performance-oriented attributes.
text:
名称：Satisfiers (Performance quality)
描述：Features where increased performance/quantity raises customer satisfaction proportionally; performance-oriented attributes.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Fit to manikins (SAMMIE) in Alias
description: Using digital manikins in Alias to check proportions, clearances and the visual fit of occupants within the 3D model.
text:
名称：Fit to manikins (SAMMIE) in Alias
描述：Using digital manikins in Alias to check proportions, clearances and the visual fit of occupants within the 3D model.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Abstract Form (抽象形态)
description: 以宏观整体形态为出发点，通过从具象形态中提炼本质、简化并概括轮廓，运用连续曲面、留白等手段，逐步由模糊走向清晰地高保真表达某种感觉或关键词。强调形式语言与整体感，作为早期创意过程中用于探讨比例、姿态、动势与曲面特征的方法，而非最终目的。
text:
名称：Abstract Form (抽象形态)
描述：以宏观整体形态为出发点，通过从具象形态中提炼本质、简化并概括轮廓，运用连续曲面、留白等手段，逐步由模糊走向清晰地高保真表达某种感觉或关键词。强调形式语言与整体感，作为早期创意过程中用于探讨比例、姿态、动势与曲面特征的方法，而非最终目的。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Direct Manipulation
description: Integrate display and control surfaces so users interact directly with interface elements (e.g., touchscreens), minimizing intermediary devices.
text:
名称：Direct Manipulation
描述：Integrate display and control surfaces so users interact directly with interface elements (e.g., touchscreens), minimizing intermediary devices.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Tactile / Haptic Feedback
description: Provide perceivable tactile sensations (mechanical detents, haptic pulses) to communicate activation and state.
text:
名称：Tactile / Haptic Feedback
描述：Provide perceivable tactile sensations (mechanical detents, haptic pulses) to communicate activation and state.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 美观性
description: 追求视觉吸引力与情感共鸣的造型理念。
text:
名称：美观性
描述：追求视觉吸引力与情感共鸣的造型理念。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Delighters (Excitement quality / Wows)
description: Unexpected, novel features that create delight; absence does not cause dissatisfaction but presence creates strong positive surprise.
text:
名称：Delighters (Excitement quality / Wows)
描述：Unexpected, novel features that create delight; absence does not cause dissatisfaction but presence creates strong positive surprise.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Appealing Exterior Form
description: Create an attractive, brand-appropriate outer skin that communicates the product image.
text:
名称：Appealing Exterior Form
描述：Create an attractive, brand-appropriate outer skin that communicates the product image.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 空气动力学导向 (aerodynamic styling)
description: 将空气动力学原则融入造型以降低风阻、提升燃效及稳定性，同时影响外观语言。
text:
名称：空气动力学导向 (aerodynamic styling)
描述：将空气动力学原则融入造型以降低风阻、提升燃效及稳定性，同时影响外观语言。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Material-driven Performance
description: Emphasizes performance, efficiency and reliability realized through advanced materials and processing methods.
text:
名称：Material-driven Performance
描述：Emphasizes performance, efficiency and reliability realized through advanced materials and processing methods.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: AdaptiveDrivingPersonalization
description: See above.
text:
名称：AdaptiveDrivingPersonalization
描述：See above.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Absorbent materials inside panels
description: Internal panel linings and cavity treatments to damp high-frequency broadband boundary-layer noise.
text:
名称：Absorbent materials inside panels
描述：Internal panel linings and cavity treatments to damp high-frequency broadband boundary-layer noise.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 可持续与环保美学
description: 通过设计语言传达低碳、节能、材料友好与未来科技感，强化消费者的环保认同
text:
名称：可持续与环保美学
描述：通过设计语言传达低碳、节能、材料友好与未来科技感，强化消费者的环保认同

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomics / 人机工程学
description: 以人为中心的设计方法，优先考虑人体因素（视线、触达、控制布局等），从乘员向外（inside-out）进行造型与功能布局，以优化舒适性、安全性和可用性。涵盖确保乘员安全与舒适的原则，并强调可量化的人机工程学目标与基于量表的验证方法（例如成对比较、方向-幅度评估、可接受性测试）以验证设计决策。
text:
名称：Ergonomics / 人机工程学
描述：以人为中心的设计方法，优先考虑人体因素（视线、触达、控制布局等），从乘员向外（inside-out）进行造型与功能布局，以优化舒适性、安全性和可用性。涵盖确保乘员安全与舒适的原则，并强调可量化的人机工程学目标与基于量表的验证方法（例如成对比较、方向-幅度评估、可接受性测试）以验证设计决策。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visual Tension (视觉张力 / 有序的无序)
description: Selective departure from strict order to create focus or excitement; mentioned as beneficial when used judiciously.
text:
名称：Visual Tension (视觉张力 / 有序的无序)
描述：Selective departure from strict order to create focus or excitement; mentioned as beneficial when used judiciously.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 以用户调研驱动的设计方法
description: 通过对目标人群的生活形态、喜好、行为和需求的实地调研来指导产品概念与参数的确定。
text:
名称：以用户调研驱动的设计方法
描述：通过对目标人群的生活形态、喜好、行为和需求的实地调研来指导产品概念与参数的确定。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Multifunctional & Reconfigurable Controls
description: Allow a single control to serve multiple functions depending on mode, reducing physical controls but increasing mode management.
text:
名称：Multifunctional & Reconfigurable Controls
描述：Allow a single control to serve multiple functions depending on mode, reducing physical controls but increasing mode management.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: MonovolumeModernity
description: Establish a new vehicle type (modern MPV) focusing on people-carrying packaging and flexible use.
text:
名称：MonovolumeModernity
描述：Establish a new vehicle type (modern MPV) focusing on people-carrying packaging and flexible use.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tall Sill Structure
description: Raised, high and wide reinforced sill forming part of the exterior surface. Provides structural support, improved side-impact intrusion resistance and crash protection, and increased torsional stiffness. Also used as a marque/visual design expression.
text:
名称：Tall Sill Structure
描述：Raised, high and wide reinforced sill forming part of the exterior surface. Provides structural support, improved side-impact intrusion resistance and crash protection, and increased torsional stiffness. Also used as a marque/visual design expression.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Proportions
description: Aesthetic concept favoring short overall length, maximized cabin volume and reduced overhangs for urban use.
text:
名称：Compact Proportions
描述：Aesthetic concept favoring short overall length, maximized cabin volume and reduced overhangs for urban use.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lightweight Low-cost High-volume
description: Design goal for microcars and mass-market small cars: minimize weight and complexity to lower cost and enable high production volumes.
text:
名称：Lightweight Low-cost High-volume
描述：Design goal for microcars and mass-market small cars: minimize weight and complexity to lower cost and enable high production volumes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Styling-led exterior-first / Exterior-led Design
description: Design approach in which the vehicle exterior — its proportions and styling — drives packaging and engineering decisions; the exterior form establishes the primary vehicle dimensions. Also referred to as 'outside-in' or 'styling-led exterior-first', emphasizing that exterior styling leads vehicle layout and packaging choices.
text:
名称：Styling-led exterior-first / Exterior-led Design
描述：Design approach in which the vehicle exterior — its proportions and styling — drives packaging and engineering decisions; the exterior form establishes the primary vehicle dimensions. Also referred to as 'outside-in' or 'styling-led exterior-first', emphasizing that exterior styling leads vehicle layout and packaging choices.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Performance, Smoothness and Efficiency
description: Design theme emphasizing overall vehicle performance that combines engine refinement and dynamic smoothness (e.g., smoother firing order, increased cylinder count to reduce individual piston mass) with powertrain efficiency goals — higher power-to-weight, improved thermal efficiency, reduced emissions, and compact packaging enabled by advances in engine technology.
text:
名称：Performance, Smoothness and Efficiency
描述：Design theme emphasizing overall vehicle performance that combines engine refinement and dynamic smoothness (e.g., smoother firing order, increased cylinder count to reduce individual piston mass) with powertrain efficiency goals — higher power-to-weight, improved thermal efficiency, reduced emissions, and compact packaging enabled by advances in engine technology.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 色彩的种类与基本特征
description: 将颜色分为无彩色系（白、黑、灰）和有彩色系（红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫），并明确各自的基本性质：明度、色相、纯度。
text:
名称：色彩的种类与基本特征
描述：将颜色分为无彩色系（白、黑、灰）和有彩色系（红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫），并明确各自的基本性质：明度、色相、纯度。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: HorizontalGrille(横向格栅)
description: 以横向条幅为主的格栅造型，视觉上减弱运动感，增强稳重感与理性气质。
text:
名称：HorizontalGrille(横向格栅)
描述：以横向条幅为主的格栅造型，视觉上减弱运动感，增强稳重感与理性气质。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crossover Hybridization (跨界混合化)
description: 将轿车/掀背的比例与SUV/越野的视觉要素（离地间隙、护板、大轮毂）融合，形成CUV/跨界产品。
text:
名称：Crossover Hybridization (跨界混合化)
描述：将轿车/掀背的比例与SUV/越野的视觉要素（离地间隙、护板、大轮毂）融合，形成CUV/跨界产品。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visibility & Legibility
description: Design theme prioritizing driver/readout visibility and legibility through control of geometric, photometric and surface factors (e.g., windshield rake, instrument panel angle, gloss).
text:
名称：Visibility & Legibility
描述：Design theme prioritizing driver/readout visibility and legibility through control of geometric, photometric and surface factors (e.g., windshield rake, instrument panel angle, gloss).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: LeafInspired(叶形灵感)
description: 以叶片的轮廓、形态或叶脉纹理为隐喻与灵感，抽象推演出线条与面之间的张力关系，形成独特的造型语言（例：雷克萨斯 LF-LC 概念车）。
text:
名称：LeafInspired(叶形灵感)
描述：以叶片的轮廓、形态或叶脉纹理为隐喻与灵感，抽象推演出线条与面之间的张力关系，形成独特的造型语言（例：雷克萨斯 LF-LC 概念车）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Modular Cargo & Seating Flexibility
description: Theme that prioritizes configurable seating (rotating/stowing) and adaptable cargo space to serve multiple use-cases.
text:
名称：Modular Cargo & Seating Flexibility
描述：Theme that prioritizes configurable seating (rotating/stowing) and adaptable cargo space to serve multiple use-cases.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Powertrain-expressive Design / Powertrain-dominant proportions
description: Exterior proportions and forms explicitly express the type and location of the powertrain. A styling theme in which the powertrain defines the side profile and overall vehicle proportions (e.g., long hood, prominent engine packaging, pronounced center tunnel). Electric and ICE solutions should read differently; the visible massing and proportions follow powertrain packaging and placement.
text:
名称：Powertrain-expressive Design / Powertrain-dominant proportions

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Utility/Load-oriented Packaging
description: Prioritise longitudinal driveline layout, high ride height, flat load floor and rearward mass distribution to maximize towing and cargo capacity; packaging driven by utility and load‑carrying requirements.
text:
名称：Utility/Load-oriented Packaging
描述：Prioritise longitudinal driveline layout, high ride height, flat load floor and rearward mass distribution to maximize towing and cargo capacity; packaging driven by utility and load‑carrying requirements.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Practical packaging enabling independent rear suspension
description: Design direction favoring packaging layouts (e.g., FWD) that simplify rear independent suspension adoption for better comfort and handling.
text:
名称：Practical packaging enabling independent rear suspension
描述：Design direction favoring packaging layouts (e.g., FWD) that simplify rear independent suspension adoption for better comfort and handling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Heel point & Ball of Foot (BOF)
description: Ball of foot (BOF): point on the top portion of the driver’s foot normally in contact with the accelerator pedal. Defined as located 200 mm from AHP measured along the pedal plane (per SAE J4004). Together with the heel point, these pedal/foot datums define foot placement relative to the seat H-point and are used for pedal and foot-well packaging and occupant lower-limb posture considerations.

名称：Heel point & Ball of Foot (BOF)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Command-of-the-road seating (High Seating Command)
description: A seating design that elevates the occupant's eyepoint to provide a dominant forward view, improved outward visibility and a sense of control and presence. It enhances driver visibility and perceived command of the vehicle, aiding tasks such as delivery and utility work.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Proportions Communication
description: Emphasize clear exterior dimensions and legible proportions to communicate vehicle function, segment and packaging logic to stakeholders (benchmark comparisons, packaging drawings).
text:
名称：Proportions Communication

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 无忧经济 (Worry-free economy)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Powertrain-driven architecture
description: The powertrain (battery, hybrid, ICE) strongly influences vehicle architecture. BEV and hybrid solutions enable rethinking floor, cabin and trunk packaging to improve space efficiency, packaging integration and overall vehicle layout.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Seating Comfort / Seat Ergonomics
description: Design theme focused on seat geometry and adjustability to provide long‑distance comfort: supporting the lumbar region, allowing small postural adjustments, minimising submaximal tissue stress and awkward postures during normal use, and facilitating easy entry/exit. Emphasises appropriate cushion shaping, support distribution and adjustment ranges to suit a wide anthropometric span. / 以座椅几何形状与可调节性为核心的设计理念，旨在提供长时间乘坐的舒适性：支撑腰部、允许小幅姿态调整、在日常使用中最小化组织应力与尴尬姿势并便于出入。强调座垫与靠背的形状、支撑分布与调节范围以适配更广泛的人体尺寸。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Perception-driven / Visibility-Centric Design
description: Design philosophy that prioritizes human perceptual capabilities and vehicle visibility to optimize safety, usability and perceived quality. Emphasizes detection, just-noticeable-differences (JND), magnitude estimation and legibility of displays and signals, while also ensuring forward and surround visibility (roof and side glass, thin A-pillars, and head environment aligned to occupant package). Addresses minimization of veiling and discomfort glare by applying human visual contrast thresholds and glare models.

name: Distributed Powertrain Architecture
description: Decouple motor(s) from a single large mechanical assembly and distribute propulsion components—motors, controllers and cooling—to remote package locations (e.g., hub motors or axle-mounted motors) to enable new packaging, layout and styling possibilities.

name: DesignDiscipline
description: 设计过程须保持严谨态度、尊重工业规范、为每次微小改动提供合理解释，并记录决策依据。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driver-Centric Ergonomics
description: Design philosophy that prioritizes the driver by optimizing reach, access, visibility and safety when arranging packaging and controls. Emphasizes placing frequently used controls within standardized reach envelopes (e.g., SAE J287) so drivers can operate or adjust while belted, defines H-point referenced zones, ensures predictable control placement and clear sight lines to create a focused driving position.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lighting as Brand Signature / 识别性/品牌特征 (Signature Lighting)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lighting as Safety & Communication
description: Vehicle lighting conceived primarily as a safety device and a communication channel to other road users. Emphasizes visibility, signal clarity and legibility, rapid information conveyance of presence/identity/location/orientation/motion intent (turning, stopping, reversing) at required recognition distances, and adherence to regulatory requirements (e.g. FMVSS108). Also highlights organized symmetry and clear functional separation between lamp types (e.g. headlamps vs. fog lamps).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Service-Oriented Ownership (服务化持有美学)
description: 以全生命周期服务、订阅与打包权益为核心的产品/体验设计思路，强调将“持有”视为一个不断演进的服务：购后升级、设计实验室、交互决策工具与全生命周期支持。Design idea emphasizing ownership as an evolving service centered on lifecycle services, subscriptions and bundled entitlements: post-purchase upgrades, design labs, interactive decision tools and lifecycle support.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Artistic Aesthetics
description: 以艺术性为核心的汽车造型理念，强调审美、设计与材料工艺的结合，通过形式与细节提升品牌识别与用户归属感；强调雕塑般的体量感、情感化造型、表面节奏与视觉张力，营造在路上的艺术存在感。Emphasizes sculptural volumes, emotional form, rhythm of surfaces and visual tension to create an artistic presence on the road.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sporty Off-road
description: A hybrid stance combining off-road ground clearance and structure with sporty roofline/packaging. Balances raised ride height or heel point with lower seating to preserve a sporty roofline, integrating rugged capability with athletic proportions.
text:
名称：Sporty Off-road
描述：A hybrid stance combining off-road ground clearance and structure with sporty roofline/packaging. Balances raised ride height or heel point with lower seating to preserve a sporty roofline, integrating rugged capability with athletic proportions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Rear Occupant Comfort, Visibility, Safety & Packaging
description: Design theme prioritizing rear-seat ergonomic comfort, forward visibility, occupant safety and overall packaging for rear passengers. Guides H-point placement, seat height, space allocation and multifunctional use to enhance comfort, sightlines and protection.
text:
名称：Rear Occupant Comfort, Visibility, Safety & Packaging
描述：Design theme prioritizing rear-seat ergonomic comfort, forward visibility, occupant safety and overall packaging for rear passengers. Guides H-point placement, seat height, space allocation and multifunctional use to enhance comfort, sightlines and protection.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Modularity
description: A product-architecture driven design philosophy that decomposes a vehicle into self-contained, reconfigurable modules and leverages platform reuse. It enables multiple configurations and cost-efficient variant creation, supports parallel development, improves manufacturability and serviceability, and allows interior reconfiguration for people or cargo. In practice this includes modular sub-assemblies and removable/plug-in modules (e.g., lamps, wipers, HVAC, plenum) to simplify maintenance and enable configurable vehicle functions, as well as packaging strategies that can readily accommodate hybrid powertrains without major size changes.

In practice this includes modular sub-assemblies and removable/plug-in modules (e.g., lamps, wipers, HVAC, plenum) to simplify maintenance and enable configurable vehicle functions, as well as packaging strategies that can readily accommodate hybrid powertrains without major size changes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomics / Ergonomic Design
description: An overarching ergonomic design concept for vehicle interiors that prioritises occupant reachability, sightlines, tactile comfort, ease of operation, adjustability and anthropometric fit (5th–95th percentile coverage). Emphasises low‑effort, safe entry/exit, accessible controls, reduced cognitive load and perceptual clarity to accommodate a broad user population and enhance overall usability and safety. / 一种车内人体工程学设计理念，优先考虑乘员的可触达性、视线与感知清晰度、触觉与姿态舒适、操作便捷性与可调节性及人体尺寸贴合（5th–95th百分位覆盖）。强调低强度且安全的出入、可及的控制、降低认知负荷，以适配更广泛的用户群并提升可用性与安全性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Practicality & Visibility
description: Design emphasis combining ease of ingress/egress, good outward visibility and a sense of safety — commonly applied in MPVs, some passenger cars and SUVs where user convenience and sightlines are prioritized. / 强调便捷上下车、良好视野和安全感的设计取向，常见于MPV、部分乘用车及SUV，注重使用便利性与视野体验。
text:
名称：Practicality & Visibility
描述：Design emphasis combining ease of ingress/egress, good outward visibility and a sense of safety — commonly applied in MPVs, some passenger cars and SUVs where user convenience and sightlines are prioritized. / 强调便捷上下车、良好视野和安全感的设计取向，常见于MPV、部分乘用车及SUV，注重使用便利性与视野体验。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety & Driver Assistance
description: Design and system strategies to protect occupants and assist drivers, prioritizing unobstructed external sightlines, perceptual legibility and situational awareness, as well as driver assistance features that enhance overall safety. / 通过设计与系统策略保护乘员并辅助驾驶者，优先保证不受阻挡的外部视野、感知清晰性与情境感知，同时包括提升整体安全性的驾驶辅助功能。
text:
名称：Safety & Driver Assistance
描述：Design and system strategies to protect occupants and assist drivers, prioritizing unobstructed external sightlines, perceptual legibility and situational awareness, as well as driver assistance features that enhance overall safety. / 通过设计与系统策略保护乘员并辅助驾驶者，优先保证不受阻挡的外部视野、感知清晰性与情境感知，同时包括提升整体安全性的驾驶辅助功能。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Economy (节约/经济美学)
description: 以低燃耗、简洁实用和成本效率为核心的设计取向
text:
名称：Economy (节约/经济美学)
描述：以低燃耗、简洁实用和成本效率为核心的设计取向

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: TraditionalPackage
description: Conventional driver height and posture balancing comfort, visibility and ingress/egress for typical passenger vehicles.
text:
名称：TraditionalPackage
描述：Conventional driver height and posture balancing comfort, visibility and ingress/egress for typical passenger vehicles.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Smooth Exterior Transitions
description: Aesthetic drive to avoid abrupt steps between interior trim, door edges and exterior panels for both aero and premium perception.
text:
名称：Smooth Exterior Transitions
描述：Aesthetic drive to avoid abrupt steps between interior trim, door edges and exterior panels for both aero and premium perception.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Binocular / Ambinocular Field
description: Angular extent of visual overlap seen simultaneously by both eyes (binocular field), and the angular overlap in reflected sight-lines from left and right eyes as produced by mirrors (ambinocular). These overlaps are critical for stereoscopic depth perception, mirror design, side-view coverage and accurate depth cues in reflections.
text:
名称：Binocular / Ambinocular Field
描述：Angular extent of visual overlap seen simultaneously by both eyes (binocular field), and the angular overlap in reflected sight-lines from left and right eyes as produced by mirrors (ambinocular). These overlaps are critical for stereoscopic depth perception, mirror design, side-view coverage and accurate depth cues in reflections.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Hatchback
description: Car body with an integrated rear cargo area (liftgate) and a compact two-box layout, prioritizing compact footprint, efficient packaging, practicality and flexible cargo/passenger capability for dense urban markets. Emphasizes light weight, maneuverability and everyday stability (典型代表：1974 年大众 Golf)。设计主题兼顾多功能性与城市使用场景。
text:
名称：Hatchback
描述：Car body with an integrated rear cargo area (liftgate) and a compact two-box layout, prioritizing compact footprint, efficient packaging, practicality and flexible cargo/passenger capability for dense urban markets. Emphasizes light weight, maneuverability and everyday stability (典型代表：1974 年大众 Golf)。设计主题兼顾多功能性与城市使用场景。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Deconstruction / Disassembly（解构与拆解）
description: 将汽车拆解、分离作为审美手段，反思产品生命周期与物件身份（如报废覆盖案例、Ortega作品）。
text:
名称：Deconstruction / Disassembly（解构与拆解）
描述：将汽车拆解、分离作为审美手段，反思产品生命周期与物件身份（如报废覆盖案例、Ortega作品）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driving Dynamics
description: Emphasize weight distribution, driven axle location and handling characteristics; influences selection of layout to achieve desired ride and handling. / 强调重量分布、驱动轴位置及操控特性；影响布局选择以达到期望的乘坐与操控表现。
text:
名称：Driving Dynamics
描述：Emphasize weight distribution, driven axle location and handling characteristics; influences selection of layout to achieve desired ride and handling. / 强调重量分布、驱动轴位置及操控特性；影响布局选择以达到期望的乘坐与操控表现。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Eco-efficiency / Efficiency
description: 以最小能耗与低排放为优先的设计理念，涵盖电驱/混动与能量回收、轻量化、低阻/流线优化、高效包装与降低传动损耗；并体现在节能车灯、环保材料与显性生态设计符号上，旨在提升续航与经济性、降低局部环境影响，兼顾成本/体积敏感市场的需求。
text:
名称：Eco-efficiency / Efficiency
描述：以最小能耗与低排放为优先的设计理念，涵盖电驱/混动与能量回收、轻量化、低阻/流线优化、高效包装与降低传动损耗；并体现在节能车灯、环保材料与显性生态设计符号上，旨在提升续航与经济性、降低局部环境影响，兼顾成本/体积敏感市场的需求。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Senior-Friendly Ergonomics
description: Design theme prioritizing accessibility, reduced physical effort, enhanced readability, and intuitive controls for older drivers.
text:
名称：Senior-Friendly Ergonomics
描述：Design theme prioritizing accessibility, reduced physical effort, enhanced readability, and intuitive controls for older drivers.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Dynamic Handling Focus
description: Design priority that emphasizes responsive handling, stable wheel kinematics and controlled rear-wheel behavior to improve driver confidence and vehicle dynamics.
text:
名称：Dynamic Handling Focus
描述：Design priority that emphasizes responsive handling, stable wheel kinematics and controlled rear-wheel behavior to improve driver confidence and vehicle dynamics.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 线条均匀性
description: 造型线在整个车身上应保持均匀、连续，与设计引导线趋势一致，避免局部厚重或抖动导致视觉不和谐。
text:
名称：线条均匀性
描述：造型线在整个车身上应保持均匀、连续，与设计引导线趋势一致，避免局部厚重或抖动导致视觉不和谐。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 关键线判定
description: 见上。
text:
名称：关键线判定
描述：见上。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Competitive Benchmarking
description: 以竞品车辆和影像作为设计灵感与基准，识别可取特征并决定是否纳入新车设计。
text:
名称：Competitive Benchmarking
描述：以竞品车辆和影像作为设计灵感与基准，识别可取特征并决定是否纳入新车设计。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Roof Height / Roofline Height
description: Vertical placement of the roof or roofline relative to vehicle reference (ground or H-point); a structural packaging parameter that limits available headroom and influences seat H‑point placement, silhouette和视觉比例。
text:
名称：Roof Height / Roofline Height
描述：Vertical placement of the roof or roofline relative to vehicle reference (ground or H-point); a structural packaging parameter that limits available headroom and influences seat H‑point placement, silhouette和视觉比例。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 轮廓线
description: 见上。
text:
名称：轮廓线
描述：见上。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cargo accessibility
description: Theme emphasizing easy loading/unloading through large apertures and low lift-over.
text:
名称：Cargo accessibility
描述：Theme emphasizing easy loading/unloading through large apertures and low lift-over.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Aerodynamic Optimization / 空气动力学优先
description: 强调形态与气动性能的统一，优先考虑风阻与气流管理作为造型发展的重要驱动，影响车身线条与细节处理。Emphasizes the unity of form and aerodynamic performance; prioritizes reducing drag and managing airflow as key drivers of styling, influencing body lines and detail treatment.
text:
名称：Aerodynamic Optimization / 空气动力学优先
描述：强调形态与气动性能的统一，优先考虑风阻与气流管理作为造型发展的重要驱动，影响车身线条与细节处理。Emphasizes the unity of form and aerodynamic performance; prioritizes reducing drag and managing airflow as key drivers of styling, influencing body lines and detail treatment.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Exaggerated Sharpness (夸张锐利化)
description: 整体造型走向强调夸张与戏剧化的棱角、尖锐灯组与强烈面分割以塑造时尚、前卫形象
text:
名称：Exaggerated Sharpness (夸张锐利化)
描述：整体造型走向强调夸张与戏剧化的棱角、尖锐灯组与强烈面分割以塑造时尚、前卫形象

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Interior Sculptural Surfaces (内饰雕塑化表面 / 内饰表面)
description: Continuous, flowing interior surfaces and volumes that form shell- or garment-like contours for the cabin. Combines smooth surfaces and defined volumes to create a tactile, cohesive interior architecture.
text:
名称：Interior Sculptural Surfaces (内饰雕塑化表面 / 内饰表面)
描述：Continuous, flowing interior surfaces and volumes that form shell- or garment-like contours for the cabin. Combines smooth surfaces and defined volumes to create a tactile, cohesive interior architecture.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Rear-Engine Identity
description: 以后置发动机布局为核心的设计概念，影响车身比例与视觉重心。
text:
名称：Rear-Engine Identity
描述：以后置发动机布局为核心的设计概念，影响车身比例与视觉重心。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Foot-Tire Relationship
description: Design theme that prioritizes the lateral and longitudinal relationship between the driver's foot position/swing and the front wheel (tire O.D.), influencing package, windshield placement and front-end silhouette.
text:
名称：Foot-Tire Relationship
描述：Design theme that prioritizes the lateral and longitudinal relationship between the driver's foot position/swing and the front wheel (tire O.D.), influencing package, windshield placement and front-end silhouette.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Precision Optics and Safety
description: Emphasize controlled light distribution to improve visibility while minimizing glare to other road users.
text:
名称：Precision Optics and Safety
描述：Emphasize controlled light distribution to improve visibility while minimizing glare to other road users.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety/Compliance (安全/合规优先)
description: 在造型与布局上优先满足法规与被动/主动安全要求的设计取向
text:
名称：Safety/Compliance (安全/合规优先)
描述：在造型与布局上优先满足法规与被动/主动安全要求的设计取向

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driven by Design (以设计驱动)
description: 厂商以设计作为主要竞争手段，通过视觉革新快速提升品牌吸引力和市场份额
text:
名称：Driven by Design (以设计驱动)
描述：厂商以设计作为主要竞争手段，通过视觉革新快速提升品牌吸引力和市场份额

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 整体轮廓与体量
description: 确立车型的大体轮廓、体量分布和整体比例，是创意阶段决定视觉第一印象的核心概念。
text:
名称：整体轮廓与体量
描述：确立车型的大体轮廓、体量分布和整体比例，是创意阶段决定视觉第一印象的核心概念。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driver-centric Ergonomic Performance
description: Aesthetic concept that integrates ergonomic functionality (pedal reach, sight-lines) with an uncompromised visual identity. / 将人体工程学功能（踏板可达性、视线等）与不妥协的视觉识别整合的美学概念。
text:
名称：Driver-centric Ergonomic Performance
描述：Aesthetic concept that integrates ergonomic functionality (pedal reach, sight-lines) with an uncompromised visual identity. / 将人体工程学功能（踏板可达性、视线等）与不妥协的视觉识别整合的美学概念。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Decorative Curvilinear Ornamentation (卷曲装饰线)
description: 强调表面装饰性、卷曲的长曲线与复杂工艺，主要为形式与身份象征，功能性弱。
text:
名称：Decorative Curvilinear Ornamentation (卷曲装饰线)
描述：强调表面装饰性、卷曲的长曲线与复杂工艺，主要为形式与身份象征，功能性弱。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sculpted Rear (雕塑式车尾美学)
description: 通过尾部线条与decklid处理营造力量感与视觉收束
text:
名称：Sculpted Rear (雕塑式车尾美学)
描述：通过尾部线条与decklid处理营造力量感与视觉收束

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ProportionHarmony_比例和谐
description: 通过特定比例关系（黄金比、根号比、整数比）来获得视觉上的和谐与美感，作为造型分析与设计的指导思想。
text:
名称：ProportionHarmony_比例和谐
描述：通过特定比例关系（黄金比、根号比、整数比）来获得视觉上的和谐与美感，作为造型分析与设计的指导思想。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: MirrorHousingFrontalArea
description: Smaller housing frontal area preferred to improve aerodynamics.
text:
名称：MirrorHousingFrontalArea
描述：Smaller housing frontal area preferred to improve aerodynamics.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 腰线特征
description: 通过腰线塑造侧面轮廓、光影变化与视觉动态。
text:
名称：腰线特征
描述：通过腰线塑造侧面轮廓、光影变化与视觉动态。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Economical Utility
description: Design theme prioritizing low cost, practicality and maximum utility for middle-class and rural users (inspired by Renault 4 objectives).
text:
名称：Economical Utility
描述：Design theme prioritizing low cost, practicality and maximum utility for middle-class and rural users (inspired by Renault 4 objectives).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Desire-Driven / Customer-Centric Design
description: Design philosophy focused on fulfilling customers' real and perceived desires, using media influence and customization to align products with market expectations.
text:
名称：Desire-Driven / Customer-Centric Design
描述：Design philosophy focused on fulfilling customers' real and perceived desires, using media influence and customization to align products with market expectations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: White color
description: Bright, lively, clean and simple; neutral and easy to coordinate with environment; perceived as expanding (makes small car look larger); historically perceived as high-end in some markets.
text:
名称：White color
描述：Bright, lively, clean and simple; neutral and easy to coordinate with environment; perceived as expanding (makes small car look larger); historically perceived as high-end in some markets.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ride Comfort & Refinement (NVH, Dynamic & Haptics)
description: Integrated design theme prioritizing passenger comfort and perceived refinement by minimizing whole-body vibration, cabin noise, and unpleasant tactile feedback. Covers ride quality (soft-ride vs controlled dynamic response), harshness reduction per standards (e.g., ISO 2631), NVH control (acoustic comfort, quiet cabin, even frequency response), tactile/haptic quality of interior controls and surfaces, and variable/adaptive systems (variable stiffness, active height control) to balance comfort with handling. Aims to convey solidity and high perceived quality while reducing fatigue and improving usability.
text:
名称：Ride Comfort & Refinement (NVH, Dynamic & Haptics)
描述：Integrated design theme prioritizing passenger comfort and perceived refinement by minimizing whole-body vibration, cabin noise, and unpleasant tactile feedback. Covers ride quality (soft-ride vs controlled dynamic response), harshness reduction per standards (e.g., ISO 2631), NVH control (acoustic comfort, quiet cabin, even frequency response), tactile/haptic quality of interior controls and surfaces, and variable/adaptive systems (variable stiffness, active height control) to balance comfort with handling. Aims to convey solidity and high perceived quality while reducing fatigue and improving usability.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Designing for the Most (Ergonomics)
description: A design strategy that aims to make the vehicle fit the largest portion of the intended user population by using anthropometric distributions (e.g., 5th–95th percentiles), rather than designing to an average or extremes.
text:
名称：Designing for the Most (Ergonomics)
描述：A design strategy that aims to make the vehicle fit the largest portion of the intended user population by using anthropometric distributions (e.g., 5th–95th percentiles), rather than designing to an average or extremes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Image Revolution (形象革命)
description: 21世纪初品牌普遍通过激进造型语言重塑产品与品牌形象，形成新家族风格
text:
名称：Image Revolution (形象革命)
描述：21世纪初品牌普遍通过激进造型语言重塑产品与品牌形象，形成新家族风格

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 关键造型特征与大面
description: 确定大的面域与关键特征线（如轮眉、窗线、车顶大面等），大面决定高光与视觉质感。
text:
名称：关键造型特征与大面
描述：确定大的面域与关键特征线（如轮眉、窗线、车顶大面等），大面决定高光与视觉质感。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional Packaging
description: 以功能硬点驱动外形比例，保持包件简单；先确立主要空间与硬点（乘员、动力总成、车轮、货物、离地间隙、碰撞结构），通过迭代完善细节。Optimize spatial allocation of occupant, cargo and powertrain to maximize utility and minimize wasted volume; prioritize functional hardpoints and keep body-packaging simple, refining details iteratively.
text:
名称：Functional Packaging
描述：以功能硬点驱动外形比例，保持包件简单；先确立主要空间与硬点（乘员、动力总成、车轮、货物、离地间隙、碰撞结构），通过迭代完善细节。Optimize spatial allocation of occupant, cargo and powertrain to maximize utility and minimize wasted volume; prioritize functional hardpoints and keep body-packaging simple, refining details iteratively.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 渲染质量
description: 指以高分辨率和物理基渲染(PBR)为目标的可视化输出，用于快速评估材质与光影效果，呈现更高的几何与材质细节以支持设计评审与最终影像输出。
text:
名称：渲染质量
描述：指以高分辨率和物理基渲染(PBR)为目标的可视化输出，用于快速评估材质与光影效果，呈现更高的几何与材质细节以支持设计评审与最终影像输出。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 概念到形态过渡
description: 将抽象文字概念转化为具体可视形态的过程，包含验证与迭代步骤。
text:
名称：概念到形态过渡
描述：将抽象文字概念转化为具体可视形态的过程，包含验证与迭代步骤。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Black color
description: Conveys solemnity, dignity and luxury; also associated with trendiness and sexiness; shows dirt easily; commonly used for official/business luxury cars.
text:
名称：Black color
描述：Conveys solemnity, dignity and luxury; also associated with trendiness and sexiness; shows dirt easily; commonly used for official/business luxury cars.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Exaggeration
description: Early sketches often exaggerate proportions and features to communicate the visual message and intent.
text:
名称：Exaggeration
描述：Early sketches often exaggerate proportions and features to communicate the visual message and intent.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: WideTrack_FlushWheel_Stance
description: Increase front/rear tread width and align outer wheel surfaces flush with fender outer sides to create a stable, bold visual stance and reduce fender-related aerodynamic drag.
text:
名称：WideTrack_FlushWheel_Stance
描述：Increase front/rear tread width and align outer wheel surfaces flush with fender outer sides to create a stable, bold visual stance and reduce fender-related aerodynamic drag.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 主从造型层次
description: 区分主造型线与次级造型线的层次关系：先确定主要轮廓再叠加次级细节，形成清晰的造型结构。
text:
名称：主从造型层次
描述：区分主造型线与次级造型线的层次关系：先确定主要轮廓再叠加次级细节，形成清晰的造型结构。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Emotional Dimension / 情感维度

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Package-driven design

描述：Design approach driven by spatial packaging (occupant space, powertrain, crash structures) that determines exterior proportions and packaging decisions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Entry & Egress Convenience / 上下车便捷性
description: Design emphasis on easy, low-effort vehicle entry and exit to reduce awkward postures and physical strain, particularly for older users or those with limited mobility. Focuses on seat height, door aperture, handle placement, step-in distance and unobstructed access. / 强调便于上下车的设计，降低不适姿势和身体负担，尤其针对老年用户或行动受限用户，关注座椅高度、车门开口、把手位置、踏步距离及通行空间等要素。
text:
名称：Entry & Egress Convenience / 上下车便捷性
描述：Design emphasis on easy, low-effort vehicle entry and exit to reduce awkward postures and physical strain, particularly for older users or those with limited mobility. Focuses on seat height, door aperture, handle placement, step-in distance and unobstructed access. / 强调便于上下车的设计，降低不适姿势和身体负担，尤其针对老年用户或行动受限用户，关注座椅高度、车门开口、把手位置、踏步距离及通行空间等要素。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Efficiency and Manufacturability Aesthetic
description: A unified aesthetic theme that prioritizes vehicle efficiency and practical producibility. It combines aerodynamic cleanliness, lightweight materials and reduced mass, visible high‑tech expression, and design-for-manufacture/service principles to lower energy consumption, emissions and unit cost while maintaining performance and serviceability. Design drivers include material/structure choices, exposed technological elements where appropriate, optimized aerodynamic form, and production/process constraints to ensure the design is efficiently manufacturable and economically viable.
text:
名称：Efficiency and Manufacturability Aesthetic
描述：A unified aesthetic theme that prioritizes vehicle efficiency and practical producibility. It combines aerodynamic cleanliness, lightweight materials and reduced mass, visible high‑tech expression, and design-for-manufacture/service principles to lower energy consumption, emissions and unit cost while maintaining performance and serviceability. Design drivers include material/structure choices, exposed technological elements where appropriate, optimized aerodynamic form, and production/process constraints to ensure the design is efficiently manufacturable and economically viable.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Low Center of Gravity

text:
名称：Low Center of Gravity

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Nighttime Visibility and Glare Reduction
description: A design theme focused on maximizing driver detection of roadway features, targets and traffic control devices and ensuring signal legibility at night, while reducing disability and discomfort glare, visual annoyance and interior reflections. Achieved by controlling brightness, reflectance, shielding and placement of illuminated components to balance visibility, safety and occupant visual comfort.
text:

Achieved by controlling brightness, reflectance, shielding and placement of illuminated components to balance visibility, safety and occupant visual comfort.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Line-Centric Tension

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Straight-Hard Geometry

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Rear-engine packaging: traction-focused and mass-balanced strategies
description: A family of rear-engine packaging concepts covering two closely related approaches: (1) a traction-focused, rear-longitudinal engine layout that maximizes rear grip, yields compact front packaging and produces a rear-weighted visual and driving character; and (2) a mass-balanced rear-engine sports car strategy that employs unconventional component placement (for example, positioning the fuel tank ahead of the dash) to shift mass forward and improve overall balance. Both approaches address packaging trade-offs in rear-engined vehicles but prioritize different vehicle dynamics and aesthetic/visual weight distribution.
text:

Both approaches address packaging trade-offs in rear-engined vehicles but prioritize different vehicle dynamics and aesthetic/visual weight distribution.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Photometric Regulatory Compliance (Headlamp Lighting)
description: Design intent and requirements to shape and control vehicle headlamp and lighting beam patterns so they meet regulatory photometric standards (e.g., US FMVSS 108). Includes meeting low‑beam photometry at specified azimuth/elevation test points (min/max candela), translating legal limits into actionable optical parameters (beam shape, intensity, aim) to ensure safety and legal compliance. / 旨在通过调控车辆前照灯及照明光束的分布、强度与指向，满足法规性光度指标（例如美国 FMVSS 108）。包括在规定的方位/仰角测试点上满足低光束的最小/最大坎德拉要求，并将法规限制转化为可实施的光学参数（光束形状、强度、照射指向）以确保安全与合规。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Signal Visibility and Recognition / Focused Signal Visibility
description: 高层次设计概念，强调信号灯在各种观察位置上的可辨识性与响应速度，以提升行驶安全性与驾驶者识别率。实现该目标的策略之一是优先通过集中亮度（中心热点）而非大面积均匀发光来提升信号的可识别性和感知效果——中心明亮区域更易被识别。该概念结合了对观察角度、时间响应（识别速度）与亮度分布的综合考虑，以增强信号传达的有效性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: CleanHygienicInterior_洁净有序内饰

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 女性友好设计 (Female-friendly Design)
description: 以易用、便捷、亲和为目标的设计理念，注重尺寸、交互和情感体验。
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: sportiness
description: Perceptual attribute combining aggressive proportions, wide track, low ride and performance cues (relates to topspeed, torque).
text:
名称：sportiness

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Adaptive & Smart Lighting
description: Lighting systems that dynamically adapt aim, beam pattern and intensity based on speed, road geometry and environment to enhance visibility and safety. A technical implementation of lighting performance/functionality enabling dynamic beam shaping, glare mitigation and contextual signalling, often used to improve perceived quality and reinforce brand lighting signatures.
text:
名称：Adaptive & Smart Lighting
描述：Lighting systems that dynamically adapt aim, beam pattern and intensity based on speed, road geometry and environment to enhance visibility and safety. A technical implementation of lighting performance/functionality enabling dynamic beam shaping, glare mitigation and contextual signalling, often used to improve perceived quality and reinforce brand lighting signatures.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 生活方式嵌入 (Lifestyle Integration)
description: 将产品与用户生活场景连结，扩展到线下活动与长期服务，增强品牌情感粘性。
text:
名称：生活方式嵌入 (Lifestyle Integration)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lighting Functionality & Performance
description: Integrated interior and exterior lighting design that supports visibility, information hierarchy and aesthetic ambience while prioritizing safety, perceived quality and brand recognition. Achieved through appropriate lamp output, beam shaping, signature lighting and glare control to optimize visibility and ensure safety without compromising occupant comfort.
text:
名称：Lighting Functionality & Performance
描述：Integrated interior and exterior lighting design that supports visibility, information hierarchy and aesthetic ambience while prioritizing safety, perceived quality and brand recognition. Achieved through appropriate lamp output, beam shaping, signature lighting and glare control to optimize visibility and ensure safety without compromising occupant comfort.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 线到型转换
description: 从抽象线条研究出发，逐步筛选主次线并由线发展为体，完成由“线”到“型”的形态演进。
text:
名称：线到型转换
描述：从抽象线条研究出发，逐步筛选主次线并由线发展为体，完成由“线”到“型”的形态演进。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: House of Quality (HOQ)
description: Matrix technique that translates customer requirements into measurable engineering characteristics and guides downstream design and production planning.
text:
名称：House of Quality (HOQ)
描述：Matrix technique that translates customer requirements into measurable engineering characteristics and guides downstream design and production planning.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Power packaging efficiency
description: 在有限空间和重量目标下，通过增加气缸数而保持单缸容积/活塞尺寸较小以获得更高功率输出与平顺性。
text:
名称：Power packaging efficiency
描述：在有限空间和重量目标下，通过增加气缸数而保持单缸容积/活塞尺寸较小以获得更高功率输出与平顺性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Wind-Tunnel-Validated Body (风洞验证车身)
description: 通过风洞测试优化并验证的整车外形，强调低Cd与稳定性。
text:
名称：Wind-Tunnel-Validated Body (风洞验证车身)
描述：通过风洞测试优化并验证的整车外形，强调低Cd与稳定性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Internal Combustion Dominance
description: Design and packaging priorities driven by superior power, range and cost of internal combustion engines; favors fuel-storage, long-range packaging and verified mechanical layout like front-engine RWD.
text:
名称：Internal Combustion Dominance

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lightweight Engineering / Lightweighting & Efficiency
description: Design theme prioritizing reduction of overall and rotating mass to improve energy efficiency and NVH, achieved through material selection, structural and geometric optimization.
text:
名称：Lightweight Engineering / Lightweighting & Efficiency
描述：Design theme prioritizing reduction of overall and rotating mass to improve energy efficiency and NVH, achieved through material selection, structural and geometric optimization.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Retractable Hardtop Democratization
description: 将可收折硬顶敞篷技术下放至紧凑级别，通过成本、包装和机电简化实现大众化可用性。
text:
名称：Retractable Hardtop Democratization

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional_Clarity
description: 美学以功能为先，通过清晰的视觉语言和形态提示使操作直观、易理解，兼顾耐用与易维护。
text:
名称：Functional_Clarity

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 功能主义（Functionalism）
description: 以使用功能和空间效率为首要设计目标，形式服从功能，推动单厢化和大尺度内部空间的出现。
text:
名称：功能主义（Functionalism）
描述：以使用功能和空间效率为首要设计目标，形式服从功能，推动单厢化和大尺度内部空间的出现。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driver-oriented Functionality
description: 设计以驾驶员便利性与安全为中心，强调清晰可读的视野和减轻视觉疲劳的安排。
text:
名称：Driver-oriented Functionality
描述：设计以驾驶员便利性与安全为中心，强调清晰可读的视野和减轻视觉疲劳的安排。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Proportionality / Proportions
description: Balance fair relative dimensions between components (length, width, height, wheelbase, overhangs) to create a coherent, expressive silhouette and visual stance. Approaches include classical proportional systems (e.g., golden section), package-driven allocation that prioritizes cabin and system volumes (using benchmark chunks), and using proportion targets to guide silhouette, overhangs and market-segment packaging goals. / 平衡车身长、宽、高及轴距、悬长等部分的相对尺寸，构建连贯且富有表现力的车身姿态。方法包括经典比例（如黄金分割）、以包装为导向的空间分配（优先考虑乘舱和系统体积，使用基准块分配空间），并将比例目标作为驱动外廓、悬长和细分市场包装目标的高层原则。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Design for Manufacturability (DFM) / Manufacturability / 可制造性
description: 在设计早期将制造能力、工艺约束和批量生产要求作为造型决策的驱动，利用可制造性优化造型与工艺以降低单件成本与总体制造成本、提高良率与尺寸精度、改善表面一致性并缩短投产周期。具体实践包括在造型中考虑翻边长度、成形曲面、装配顺序以及焊接/成形可行性，并优先采用利于大规模生产的工艺和结构。A design strategy (DFM) that integrates manufacturing constraints and capabilities to optimize form, cost, quality and production efficiency for mass production.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Practicality

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visibility & Safety (视野与安全)
description: Design concept that prioritizes unobstructed driver sightlines and overall vehicle conspicuity to enhance operational safety. It covers glazing and mirror layout, seating height, wiper and defroster design to keep the forward field of view clear, and lamp placement/photometrics (e.g., parking and turn lamps) to ensure visibility, conspicuity and a balanced frontal appearance. Also addresses dimensional requirements such as minimum luminous area and aperture sizes, minimizing blind spots through ergonomic packaging, and compliance with relevant standards and regulations. 以最大化驾驶员视野与行车可视性为核心的设计理念，涵盖玻璃与镜面布局、座高与人体工学、雨刮与除霜系统以保持前方视野清晰，以及灯具布置与光度学以确保显著性与外观均衡。还考虑最小发光面积/开口尺寸以减少盲区，并强调满足相关法规与标准的合规性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Command Seating
description: High, upright seating/eyepoint strategy that gives occupants the perception of 'sitting high' or a commanding driving position, providing improved hood and roadway visibility. It is a typical positive attribute for SUVs and similar vehicles.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Family Rituals 2.0
description: Design concept that leverages repeating social behaviours (rituals) to create meaning and continuity in product use (Bichard et al. 2015).
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Body Evolution
description: Historical theme describing how proportions, packaging and surface language evolve across automotive eras (pre-war, post-war, modern).
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lighting & Transparency

text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Impact-Protective Bumper Aesthetic
description: Design theme prioritizing visible bumper offsets, sacrificial fascia and energy-absorbing substructure to minimize repair and protect lights/adjacent components in low-speed impacts (US/Canada tests at 2.5–5 mph).
text:
名称：Impact-Protective Bumper Aesthetic
描述：Design theme prioritizing visible bumper offsets, sacrificial fascia and energy-absorbing substructure to minimize repair and protect lights/adjacent components in low-speed impacts (US/Canada tests at 2.5–5 mph).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Urban Mobility / Practicality
description: Design theme for urban-focused vehicles that prioritizes an extremely small exterior footprint and excellent maneuverability for dense city environments, while maximizing usable interior and cargo space. Includes approaches for efficient packaging (roomy interior despite short overall length) and optionally scalable/expandable volume or length to reconcile parking constraints with load-carrying or cargo needs.
text:
名称：Compact Urban Mobility / Practicality
描述：Design theme for urban-focused vehicles that prioritizes an extremely small exterior footprint and excellent maneuverability for dense city environments, while maximizing usable interior and cargo space. Includes approaches for efficient packaging (roomy interior despite short overall length) and optionally scalable/expandable volume or length to reconcile parking constraints with load-carrying or cargo needs.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Affordability / Accessibility
description: A design principle that emphasizes low acquisition and material costs and reduced material/site requirements to make vehicles affordable and widely accessible. It prioritizes practicality for popular social classes (often as an alternative to motorcycles), simplifies production and design processes, and supports easier teaching and dissemination of the design approach.
text:
名称：Affordability / Accessibility
描述：A design principle that emphasizes low acquisition and material costs and reduced material/site requirements to make vehicles affordable and widely accessible. It prioritizes practicality for popular social classes (often as an alternative to motorcycles), simplifies production and design processes, and supports easier teaching and dissemination of the design approach.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Integrated Packaging Efficiency
description: Balance lamp styling with internal packaging to minimize intrusion into trunk space while maintaining visual form and lighting function.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Family-oriented practicality
description: 一种面向家庭用户的造型美学，强调安全性、实用性与舒适性。核心要素包括宽敞且可适配的内饰布局、耐用性与易用性（便捷的出入与操作界面）、简洁直观的交互、以及良好的性价比与多用户/多任务适配能力。
text:
名称：Family-oriented practicality

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Package Efficiency
description: 以最小化整车体积与空间占用为目标的美学取向，强调紧凑布局与高效包装；涵盖动力总成布局、车内空间优化、乘员舒适性及上下车便利性等。Optimize interior space and packaging efficiency (powertrain packaging, occupant comfort, ingress/egress), prioritizing compact layout and minimal overall vehicle volume.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Emotional Resonance

text:
名称：Emotional Resonance

name: 制造工艺驱动的曲面丰富性

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EaseOfEntryExit
description: Design theme that prioritizes easy vehicle ingress and egress — reducing effort and step height required for entry/exit of vehicles (including taller vehicles such as SUVs and pickups) and addressing needs of older or mobility-limited users. Typical design measures include running boards or power-deployable steps, lower step-in height, wider door openings, grab handles, adjustable or lowering suspension, optimized seat height/geometry (including swivel or height-adjust features) and other assistive elements to make entering and exiting safer and more convenient.
text:
名称：EaseOfEntryExit

Typical design measures include running boards or power-deployable steps, lower step-in height, wider door openings, grab handles, adjustable or lowering suspension, optimized seat height/geometry (including swivel or height-adjust features) and other assistive elements to make entering and exiting safer and more convenient.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: EaseOfIngressEgress
description: Design principle that prioritizes easy and safe entry and exit for occupants. Achieved by optimizing seat geometry and materials, seat height, rocker geometry, door inner edge geometry, clearances and step-in height. Also considers the functional role of closures (doors, sliding doors, etc.) where the requirement to allow passage drives the tangent positions and the shape of openings.

Design aim is to minimize perceived sources of noise (e.g., intake, exhaust, powertrain and wind/road transfer), control overall cabin noise, and enhance comfort as well as the detectability of desired signals. / 强调车内（及相关外部）低噪声和精致的声学特征，以传达舒适性、精致感和产品感知品质。目标是最小化发动机进排气、传动、风噪/路噪等感知噪声，控制整体车舱噪声水平，提升舒适性并增强期望信号的可检测性。

name: Ergonomics (人机工程 / Human-centred Ergonomics / Functional Ergonomics)
description: Design discipline that applies anthropometry and biomechanics to vehicle interior design to define occupant accommodation, reach, forces and clearances (including percentile- and multivariate-based limits) and validates solutions with prototypes; prioritizes ease of information acquisition and control activation to reduce driver errors and response time; emphasizes driver–vehicle coordination, visibility and operating comfort and may constrain styling to improve usability and comfort. / 以人体测量学与生物力学为基础，通过百分位与多变量数据确定乘员适配、触及范围、作用力与间隙，并通过原型验证方案；优先保证信息获取与控制操作的便捷以降低驾驶错误与反应时间；强调人—车协调、视野与操控舒适，常以约束造型提升可用性与舒适性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sustainability & Recyclability
description: Design priority to enable reuse, disassembly and recycling across the vehicle life cycle. Encompasses design-for-recycling, material compatibility, ease of disassembly, life-cycle energy and end-of-life disposal considerations, and adherence to regulatory reuse/recycling targets. Encourages component reuse, material transparency and choices that extend ownership while minimizing environmental impact.

Encourages component reuse, material transparency and choices that extend ownership while minimizing environmental impact.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Comfort-Handling Balance
description: Design theme that emphasizes a balanced vehicle character between ride comfort and handling/sport performance. Seeks a compromise between vertical compliance for ride comfort and firm control for handling stability. In passenger-car applications it may also stress cost-effectiveness and a refined appearance. The concept encompasses both fixed-balance implementations and adaptive variants that can switch between comfort and sport behaviours via adjustable dampers or suspension modes.
