label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: PleasingMaterialTexture
description: Overall aesthetic goal: materials in armrests, seats and trim should produce a pleasing tactile and visual impression (comfort, luxury, familiarity).
text:
名称：PleasingMaterialTexture
描述：Overall aesthetic goal: materials in armrests, seats and trim should produce a pleasing tactile and visual impression (comfort, luxury, familiarity).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Torque-focused power
description: High low-end torque emphasis for towing and hauling.
text:
名称：Torque-focused power
描述：High low-end torque emphasis for towing and hauling.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Tyre-road surface condition
description: Surface condition of the road (dry, wet, icy, contaminated) that affects tyre-road friction.
text:
名称：Tyre-road surface condition
描述：Surface condition of the road (dry, wet, icy, contaminated) that affects tyre-road friction.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Simplified Component Set (concept stage)
description: Deliberate omission or simplification of secondary components during initial concept studies to reduce complexity and free packaging choices.
text:
名称：Simplified Component Set (concept stage)
描述：Deliberate omission or simplification of secondary components during initial concept studies to reduce complexity and free packaging choices.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Female-oriented Aesthetic
description: 强调亲和力、优雅与实用并重的设计方向。
text:
名称：Female-oriented Aesthetic
描述：强调亲和力、优雅与实用并重的设计方向。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Glare Minimization
description: Design objective to minimize glare in vehicle environments — including reducing veiling glare from instrument-panel reflections that impair driver forward visibility, and reducing discomfort/disability glare to oncoming drivers — while preserving necessary roadway visibility and conspicuity. Achieved through material and geometry choices, HMI and lighting design (e.g., low-beam signatures, intensity limits), and by balancing trade-offs between roadside/forward illumination and driver seeing distance to maintain safety and reduce distraction.
text:
名称：Glare Minimization
描述：Design objective to minimize glare in vehicle environments — including reducing veiling glare from instrument-panel reflections that impair driver forward visibility, and reducing discomfort/disability glare to oncoming drivers — while preserving necessary roadway visibility and conspicuity. Achieved through material and geometry choices, HMI and lighting design (e.g., low-beam signatures, intensity limits), and by balancing trade-offs between roadside/forward illumination and driver seeing distance to maintain safety and reduce distraction.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Space Efficiency
description: Prioritize passengers and cargo capacity and package efficiency.
text:
名称：Space Efficiency
描述：Prioritize passengers and cargo capacity and package efficiency.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Aggressiveness(张扬/霸气)
description: 强调强烈气场与视觉威慑，常借助竖向元素与高对比来实现。
text:
名称：Aggressiveness(张扬/霸气)
描述：强调强烈气场与视觉威慑，常借助竖向元素与高对比来实现。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Windshield Visibility
description: See above.
text:
名称：Windshield Visibility
描述：See above.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mid-Engine Performance Packaging
description: 将发动机布置在乘员舱后方但在后轴前或靠近后轴的位置（中置/后中置）以集中质量并改善操控与动态响应。此类布局影响车尾高度与可见性，允许更低的前部轮廓与紧凑的整体包装，且在高性能/跑车上常见。
text:
名称：Mid-Engine Performance Packaging
描述：将发动机布置在乘员舱后方但在后轴前或靠近后轴的位置（中置/后中置）以集中质量并改善操控与动态响应。此类布局影响车尾高度与可见性，允许更低的前部轮廓与紧凑的整体包装，且在高性能/跑车上常见。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: largeFrontGrille
description: 大尺寸前格栅/进气口，既作为视觉侵略性元素，也为中冷/散热及进气提供空间。
text:
名称：largeFrontGrille
描述：大尺寸前格栅/进气口，既作为视觉侵略性元素，也为中冷/散热及进气提供空间。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Electric smoothness & compact packaging
description: Smooth acceleration and packaging benefits from electric motors.
text:
名称：Electric smoothness & compact packaging
描述：Smooth acceleration and packaging benefits from electric motors.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: MechanicalClarity
description: Express functional mechanical elements (engine bay, spindles, suspension, cargo bay) through honest packaging; prioritize accessibility and clear spatial logic under the skin.
text:
名称：MechanicalClarity
描述：Express functional mechanical elements (engine bay, spindles, suspension, cargo bay) through honest packaging; prioritize accessibility and clear spatial logic under the skin.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: MacroHolisticThinking(整体型思维)
description: 从宏观层面构建各造型元素之间的逻辑关系，保证整车协调与可控性。
text:
名称：MacroHolisticThinking(整体型思维)
描述：从宏观层面构建各造型元素之间的逻辑关系，保证整车协调与可控性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Comfort & Convenience
description: Design theme emphasizing occupant ease-of-use and everyday comfort: supportive, ergonomic seating, convenient ingress/egress, intuitive interfaces and infotainment, and features that reduce user effort to increase adoption and perceived value.
text:
名称：Comfort & Convenience
描述：Design theme emphasizing occupant ease-of-use and everyday comfort: supportive, ergonomic seating, convenient ingress/egress, intuitive interfaces and infotainment, and features that reduce user effort to increase adoption and perceived value.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: ObjectMetaphorClassification
description: 以马车形、箱形、船形、鱼形、楔形等物象来概括历史阶段，文本中指出此法易掩盖细节与抽象线面的演变。
text:
名称：ObjectMetaphorClassification
描述：以马车形、箱形、船形、鱼形、楔形等物象来概括历史阶段，文本中指出此法易掩盖细节与抽象线面的演变。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety-driven Packaging
description: Design priority to protect the fuel tank from rear impacts and meet safety legislation; drives relocation and structural reinforcement of tank packaging.
text:
名称：Safety-driven Packaging
描述：Design priority to protect the fuel tank from rear impacts and meet safety legislation; drives relocation and structural reinforcement of tank packaging.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: FashionInfluencedDesign
description: 强调时尚潮流与社会文化对汽车内外造型、色彩与视觉元素的深度影响，且时尚具有回潮与螺旋上升的特征。
text:
名称：FashionInfluencedDesign
描述：强调时尚潮流与社会文化对汽车内外造型、色彩与视觉元素的深度影响，且时尚具有回潮与螺旋上升的特征。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Adaptive & Universal Accessibility Design
description: Design approach and priority that adapts interfaces, illumination, seating/controls and other vehicle systems to different user populations and environmental conditions, while maximizing access, ease of modification, and inclusive control interfaces for drivers with disabilities (Universal Design).
text:
名称：Adaptive & Universal Accessibility Design
描述：Design approach and priority that adapts interfaces, illumination, seating/controls and other vehicle systems to different user populations and environmental conditions, while maximizing access, ease of modification, and inclusive control interfaces for drivers with disabilities (Universal Design).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Long S-curve decorative line (长 S 曲线)
description: 沿车侧绘制的优雅延伸曲线，典型地呈长 S 形或双向卷曲，视觉上拉长车身。
text:
名称：Long S-curve decorative line (长 S 曲线)
描述：沿车侧绘制的优雅延伸曲线，典型地呈长 S 形或双向卷曲，视觉上拉长车身。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 青春化/更年轻的设计方向
description: 以年轻群体价值观为导向，强调活力、个性、数字化体验与可定制性，视觉更轻快、表达更直接。
text:
名称：青春化/更年轻的设计方向
描述：以年轻群体价值观为导向，强调活力、个性、数字化体验与可定制性，视觉更轻快、表达更直接。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Front-Engine Layout
description: Packaging and styling concept in which the prime mover is located ahead of the passenger cabin, commonly arranged longitudinally and driving the rear wheels (or four wheels). Typical exterior and proportional consequences include a long hood/long front overhang, visible transmission tunnel and a robust/chassis-forward visual stance. The layout conveys traditional, power- and performance-oriented family character and can improve frontal crash energy absorption. Early implementations were pioneered by manufacturers such as Panhard-Levassor.
text:
名称：Front-Engine Layout
描述：Packaging and styling concept in which the prime mover is located ahead of the passenger cabin, commonly arranged longitudinally and driving the rear wheels (or four wheels). Typical exterior and proportional consequences include a long hood/long front overhang, visible transmission tunnel and a robust/chassis-forward visual stance. The layout conveys traditional, power- and performance-oriented family character and can improve frontal crash energy absorption. Early implementations were pioneered by manufacturers such as Panhard-Levassor.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sliding Door Concept
description: Translating side door system commonly applied to minivans and commercial vans; ideal where out-swinging doors are dangerous or impractical; can be electrically operated.
text:
名称：Sliding Door Concept
描述：Translating side door system commonly applied to minivans and commercial vans; ideal where out-swinging doors are dangerous or impractical; can be electrically operated.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: GlobalPlatformSharing
description: Shared architectures to serve multiple markets economically while preserving brand identity.
text:
名称：GlobalPlatformSharing
描述：Shared architectures to serve multiple markets economically while preserving brand identity.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Non-intrusive Instrument Visibility
description: Ensure primary instruments fall within the binocular 'moustache' visibility zone so information remains unobscured by the wheel; maximize detectability without creating glare or masking other visual information.
text:
名称：Non-intrusive Instrument Visibility
描述：Ensure primary instruments fall within the binocular 'moustache' visibility zone so information remains unobscured by the wheel; maximize detectability without creating glare or masking other visual information.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Serviceable & Accessible Ergonomics
description: Design focus on servicing‑related usability and everyday accessibility: prioritizes reachability, visibility, low strength requirements and clear layout of maintenance and common controls, and styling/layout choices that facilitate service, inspection and frequent user interactions. / 优先考虑维修与常用操作的可用性：强调维护及常用控制的可及性、可视性及低力气要求，并通过造型与布局提升可维护性与可操作性。
text:
名称：Serviceable & Accessible Ergonomics
描述：Design focus on servicing‑related usability and everyday accessibility: prioritizes reachability, visibility, low strength requirements and clear layout of maintenance and common controls, and styling/layout choices that facilitate service, inspection and frequent user interactions. / 优先考虑维修与常用操作的可用性：强调维护及常用控制的可及性、可视性及低力气要求，并通过造型与布局提升可维护性与可操作性。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Biomorphic Proportions / Biomorphic Forms (仿生比例 / 生物仿生形态)
description: Design principles derived from biological shapes: use proportions and body-segmentation inspired by organisms (e.g., fish longitudinal streamlines, mammalian musculature) to influence vehicle proportions and volume composition; emphasize organic, streamlined, asymmetric or dynamically expressive surfaces and overall proportions.
text:
名称：Biomorphic Proportions / Biomorphic Forms (仿生比例 / 生物仿生形态)
描述：Design principles derived from biological shapes: use proportions and body-segmentation inspired by organisms (e.g., fish longitudinal streamlines, mammalian musculature) to influence vehicle proportions and volume composition; emphasize organic, streamlined, asymmetric or dynamically expressive surfaces and overall proportions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Global Commonality
description: 通过共享平台、零部件与总体造型来降低开发成本，强调可规模化与模块化，同时需要在通用性与本地化之间取得平衡。
text:
名称：Global Commonality
描述：通过共享平台、零部件与总体造型来降低开发成本，强调可规模化与模块化，同时需要在通用性与本地化之间取得平衡。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Celebration of Machines (Exposed Mechanics)
description: Aesthetic stance that exposes mechanical elements as subjects of beauty (Leonardo da Vinci influence, early engineers and artists).
text:
名称：Celebration of Machines (Exposed Mechanics)
描述：Aesthetic stance that exposes mechanical elements as subjects of beauty (Leonardo da Vinci influence, early engineers and artists).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Localization for Ergonomics
description: 在保持平台共性的同时，对关键人机界面与控制逻辑进行地域化适配以满足不同国家的法规、文化习惯与使用者期望。
text:
名称：Localization for Ergonomics
描述：在保持平台共性的同时，对关键人机界面与控制逻辑进行地域化适配以满足不同国家的法规、文化习惯与使用者期望。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Originality
description: Emphasis on novel, non-derivative constructive solutions and expressive form.
text:
名称：Originality
描述：Emphasis on novel, non-derivative constructive solutions and expressive form.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Appearance: Clean Profile (外观：干净轮廓)
description: 通过减少可见框件与实现无框玻璃等处理，使侧面轮廓更流畅、视觉更运动或高级。
text:
名称：Appearance: Clean Profile (外观：干净轮廓)
描述：通过减少可见框件与实现无框玻璃等处理，使侧面轮廓更流畅、视觉更运动或高级。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: EngineBrakingValveClosure
description: 通过踏板作用在凸轮轴上，主动关闭进气阀以产生发动机制动的创新制动系统（Rover 20 HP 特征之一）。
text:
名称：EngineBrakingValveClosure
描述：通过踏板作用在凸轮轴上，主动关闭进气阀以产生发动机制动的创新制动系统（Rover 20 HP 特征之一）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crashworthiness (碰撞性能/吸能设计)
description: 设计目标是通过可控塌缩与结构行为吸收冲击能量，保护乘员；以碰撞动力学参数（如压溃模量、结构指数、冲击严重因子等）为评价指标并指导前端结构设计。
text:
名称：Crashworthiness (碰撞性能/吸能设计)
描述：设计目标是通过可控塌缩与结构行为吸收冲击能量，保护乘员；以碰撞动力学参数（如压溃模量、结构指数、冲击严重因子等）为评价指标并指导前端结构设计。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Identity & Brand Image (身份识别与品牌形象)
description: 通过特征化的造型语言（如灯组、格栅、侧面腰线）传递品牌识别与情感价值，增强识别度与形象。
text:
名称：Identity & Brand Image (身份识别与品牌形象)
描述：通过特征化的造型语言（如灯组、格栅、侧面腰线）传递品牌识别与情感价值，增强识别度与形象。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cooling Integration
description: Integrate engine and brake cooling needs with aerodynamic packaging while minimizing negative drag impact.
text:
名称：Cooling Integration
描述：Integrate engine and brake cooling needs with aerodynamic packaging while minimizing negative drag impact.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Service-centric Mobility
description: Design theme prioritizing the integration of mobility services and app-driven workflows to enable continuous user–device–vehicle continuity. Emphasizes clarity of touchpoints, reliability cues and operational efficiency in styling and UX to support shared and service-focused vehicle experiences.
text:
名称：Service-centric Mobility
描述：Design theme prioritizing the integration of mobility services and app-driven workflows to enable continuous user–device–vehicle continuity. Emphasizes clarity of touchpoints, reliability cues and operational efficiency in styling and UX to support shared and service-focused vehicle experiences.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: HighMountedBrakeVisibility
description: Prioritize rearward visibility and regulatory compliance by mounting a single red CHMSL on the vehicle centerline at a regulated height, lateral and elevation visibility, and lens area.
text:
名称：HighMountedBrakeVisibility
描述：Prioritize rearward visibility and regulatory compliance by mounting a single red CHMSL on the vehicle centerline at a regulated height, lateral and elevation visibility, and lens area.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Innovative Image (创新形象)
description: 以文化与消费心理为基础的形象塑造，强调与传统车型的区别并提供归属感。
text:
名称：Innovative Image (创新形象)
描述：以文化与消费心理为基础的形象塑造，强调与传统车型的区别并提供归属感。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Interior-Driven Packaging
description: Design concept that starts packaging from the cabin modules and works outward; vehicle architecture is driven by cargo, seating flexibility and telematics priorities.
text:
名称：Interior-Driven Packaging
描述：Design concept that starts packaging from the cabin modules and works outward; vehicle architecture is driven by cargo, seating flexibility and telematics priorities.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Connected Mobility / Digital Connectivity & In‑Vehicle Infotainment
description: Design theme that integrates telematics, mobile devices, cloud services and in-vehicle multimedia to create seamless, software-driven connectivity between vehicle systems, external networks and user devices. Emphasizes visible and functional continuity, driver-device integration (screens, USB, Bluetooth), infotainment and software experiences while balancing legibility and minimizing driver distraction.
text:
名称：Connected Mobility / Digital Connectivity & In‑Vehicle Infotainment
描述：Design theme that integrates telematics, mobile devices, cloud services and in-vehicle multimedia to create seamless, software-driven connectivity between vehicle systems, external networks and user devices. Emphasizes visible and functional continuity, driver-device integration (screens, USB, Bluetooth), infotainment and software experiences while balancing legibility and minimizing driver distraction.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Regulation-Compliant Aesthetic
description: Design that embeds safety, emissions and fuel-economy considerations into the aesthetic direction.
text:
名称：Regulation-Compliant Aesthetic
描述：Design that embeds safety, emissions and fuel-economy considerations into the aesthetic direction.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Avant-garde / Conceptual Design (前卫/概念设计)
description: 强调造型创新、实验性视觉元素与强烈识别性，用于吸引潮流导向用户与建立品牌声量。
text:
名称：Avant-garde / Conceptual Design (前卫/概念设计)
描述：强调造型创新、实验性视觉元素与强烈识别性，用于吸引潮流导向用户与建立品牌声量。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sport Performance Emphasis
description: Prioritize top speed, handling and cooling over pure efficiency; often increases focus on downforce and brake cooling.
text:
名称：Sport Performance Emphasis
描述：Prioritize top speed, handling and cooling over pure efficiency; often increases focus on downforce and brake cooling.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Product desirability
description: Overall desirability/value perceived by the customer, represented by the combined size of the outer ring(s) in the ring model.
text:
名称：Product desirability
描述：Overall desirability/value perceived by the customer, represented by the combined size of the outer ring(s) in the ring model.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: WellDefinedTestableFunctions
description: Each module encapsulates specific functions and can be tested independently of the whole system.
text:
名称：WellDefinedTestableFunctions
描述：Each module encapsulates specific functions and can be tested independently of the whole system.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Packaging for Low Drag
description: Vehicle packaging decisions that prioritize minimizing frontal area and wake-producing features.
text:
名称：Packaging for Low Drag
描述：Vehicle packaging decisions that prioritize minimizing frontal area and wake-producing features.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Monovolumen (MPV / 车厢化设计)
description: 以最大化车内空间与多功能性为核心的整车造型主题，典型于1990年代由Renault Espace引领的MPV潮流。
text:
名称：Monovolumen (MPV / 车厢化设计)
描述：以最大化车内空间与多功能性为核心的整车造型主题，典型于1990年代由Renault Espace引领的MPV潮流。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Durability / Dent Resistance (耐久与抗凹性)
description: 通过材料与结构选择提升门的抗凹性能与抗损耗能力，平衡外观耐用性与重量。
text:
名称：Durability / Dent Resistance (耐久与抗凹性)
描述：通过材料与结构选择提升门的抗凹性能与抗损耗能力，平衡外观耐用性与重量。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Tidy Cut Lines
description: Minimize visual clutter at panel junctions by aligning cut-lines to glass corners and structural edges; sharp glass corners help keep closure boundaries tidy.
text:
名称：Tidy Cut Lines
描述：Minimize visual clutter at panel junctions by aligning cut-lines to glass corners and structural edges; sharp glass corners help keep closure boundaries tidy.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 对称 / 平衡 (Symmetry / Balance)
description: 以Y0中心线为基准，确保左右对称与视觉均衡，构建稳定的家族识别。通过对称布局与重心控制提升车辆造型的稳定感与识别度。
text:
名称：对称 / 平衡 (Symmetry / Balance)
描述：以Y0中心线为基准，确保左右对称与视觉均衡，构建稳定的家族识别。通过对称布局与重心控制提升车辆造型的稳定感与识别度。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Dynamic-Comfort Duality
description: High-level theme balancing handling stability (sportiness) and ride comfort via electronic damping control (EDC) and driver-selectable modes.
text:
名称：Dynamic-Comfort Duality
描述：High-level theme balancing handling stability (sportiness) and ride comfort via electronic damping control (EDC) and driver-selectable modes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Propulsion Aesthetic (紧凑动力美学)
description: 强调电机/变速装置体积小、重量轻，使外形不再需要大型发动机舱，从而支持更紧凑的前部造型。
text:
名称：Compact Propulsion Aesthetic (紧凑动力美学)
描述：强调电机/变速装置体积小、重量轻，使外形不再需要大型发动机舱，从而支持更紧凑的前部造型。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Complex Surface Freedom

text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Global design language (全球化家族设计)
description: 强调跨区域通用的家族特征、平台共享与可辨识的品牌标识。
text:
名称：Global design language (全球化家族设计)
描述：强调跨区域通用的家族特征、平台共享与可辨识的品牌标识。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Signal Conspicuity
description: 强调信号色、亮度与几何可识别性的美学，目标是最短反应时间和最高识别率（Luoma, Bhise, Troell 等研究支撑）。

名称：Signal Conspicuity

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety Compliance

text:
名称：Safety Compliance

text:
名称：Symmetrical Balance

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mid-transverse Rear-Engine Performance Layout
description: 横置发动机放置在乘员舱后方、接近后轴的位置。常用于轻量级运动/跑车以实现非常紧凑的动力总成包装、显著的后偏重配重和短轴距布局，常见于将前驱横置动力总成改用于后驱的设计中。
text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)

description: Controls design to allow task completion with little or no eye glances, reducing eyes-off-road frequency. Displays and information layout optimized so drivers obtain required information with a few short glances. 控制设计允许在不或极少目视的前提下完成操作，降低视线离开路面的频率。显示和信息布局经过优化，使驾驶员能通过极短的注视获取所需信息。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Economy and Simplicity
description: Design philosophy prioritizing low cost, practicality and functional minimalism — emphasizing ease of manufacture, simple or visible fittings, absence of luxury and low‑tech durable solutions. Applied to small, affordable cars for mass-market and export orientation, with a focus on longevity and utilitarian appearance (e.g., the Trabant).
text:

Applied to small, affordable cars for mass-market and export orientation, with a focus on longevity and utilitarian appearance (e.g., the Trabant).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 线型造型法（线型分析与创意设计法）
description: 以线条为主导进行造型分析与创意设计，以线条组合为发想核心。从侧面造型线发展出整车形态，并以此深化前脸与整体三维效果。

名称：线型造型法（线型分析与创意设计法）

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 细节突破（Detail Evolution）

描述：许多划时代的造型变化源自微小的细节与线面处理上的演进。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Refinement
description: An overarching design concept focused on refining technical features, manufacturing processes, acoustics/structural comfort (NVH) and surface/material detailing to convey quality, comfort, technical sophistication and premium performance while ensuring reliability and cost-effective mass production.
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Gull-wing Door
description: Upward-opening, roof-hinged doors (gull-wing) that provide wide, unobstructed lateral access — improving ingress for inboard seats and enabling access to cargo bay — while creating a distinct, sculptural vehicle identity and unmistakable silhouette. Similar in application and some advantages to scissor doors.

Similar in application and some advantages to scissor doors.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: SingleVolume(单厢化)
description: 电动汽车常见的发展方向，强调连续屋顶线、较短后悬与更一体化的侧面轮廓以突出电动车专属造型语言与内部空间利用。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Sportiness
description: 总体“运动感”美学，涵盖两类表现：一是以操控感与驾驶反馈为核心的运动感（通过踏板与转向调校、操控反馈、性能化视觉细节传达动态驾驶感受）；二是越野/粗犷型的运动感（通过加高车身姿态、宽阔轮眉、暴露护板与功能性细节，呈现更高、更稳健的视觉效果）。融合后的概念用于指导造型与细节取向，使车辆在驾驶感与视觉语言上达到期望的运动化诉求。
text:
名称：Sportiness

text:

description: 通过视觉元素（线条、开口、灯组、材质分割）的规律性变化形成整体的视觉节奏与韵律，强化识别性与感染力。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Aerodynamic Efficiency
description: Design priority to minimise aerodynamic drag (Cd) and related aerodynamic noise, improve energy/fuel efficiency and range, and ensure stable aerodynamic force distribution (control lift/downforce and crosswind sensitivity). Achieved through reduced frontal area, smooth continuous surfaces, streamlined/teardrop-derived forms, tapered rear/long-tail treatments, integrated openings and wheel/tire integration, underside contouring and active aero where appropriate. Expressed both as an engineering target (repeatable flow behaviour for testing and performance) and as an aesthetic of smoothness, elegant tapering and aerodynamic-driven silhouette.
text:
名称：Aerodynamic Efficiency
描述：Design priority to minimise aerodynamic drag (Cd) and related aerodynamic noise, improve energy/fuel efficiency and range, and ensure stable aerodynamic force distribution (control lift/downforce and crosswind sensitivity). Achieved through reduced frontal area, smooth continuous surfaces, streamlined/teardrop-derived forms, tapered rear/long-tail treatments, integrated openings and wheel/tire integration, underside contouring and active aero where appropriate. Expressed both as an engineering target (repeatable flow behaviour for testing and performance) and as an aesthetic of smoothness, elegant tapering and aerodynamic-driven silhouette.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Practicality/Scenario-oriented

description: Aerodynamic strategy prioritising vehicle dynamics and track performance: focuses on producing tuned downforce, aerodynamic balance and stability for improved handling and lap times. May trade some low-drag efficiency for increased downforce, use active aerodynamic elements, and coordinate aero with mass and weight distribution considerations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 360-degree Visibility
description: A system-level visibility requirement ensuring the driver can see at least part of every surrounding vehicle and relevant objects through direct, indirect (three mirrors) and peripheral visual fields in daytime and nighttime conditions. Treated holistically across mirrors, greenhouse, eye point and mirror aiming to provide continuous situational awareness and reduce blind zones. / 一项系统级可视性要求，确保驾驶者通过直接视线、间接（三镜）及周边视野在昼夜条件下至少能看到周围车辆或相关物体的部分；作为镜面、车窗体、视点及镜面调整的整体设计考量，以提升态势感知并减少盲区。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Accessibility & Serviceability
description: 综合性的设计主题，强调车辆对不同用户（包括老年人、行动不便者和日常用户）及维修/服务人员的易访问性与可维护性。涵盖便捷的上下车（尤其是后排/第三排）、直观且符合人体工学的支撑与开口、门体/后备厢/引擎盖的易操作细节、独立闭合与经济高效的日常操作，以及便于装载/卸载、加注燃料、换胎与清洁的设计要求。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ConvexMirror
description: 恒曲率凸面镜会导致图像缩小并使驾驶员倾向于高估目标距离。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Straight Continuous Waistline
description: 侧面腰线较为平直并呈现从头至尾的贯穿关系，作为整车侧面视觉主线。
text:
名称：Straight Continuous Waistline
描述：侧面腰线较为平直并呈现从头至尾的贯穿关系，作为整车侧面视觉主线。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Wheel Proportion Harmony
description: 强调车轮尺寸、轮拱和车身比例之间的视觉平衡，以传达动感与稳定性。
text:
名称：Wheel Proportion Harmony
描述：强调车轮尺寸、轮拱和车身比例之间的视觉平衡，以传达动感与稳定性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: User-centered / User-led Design (以人为本 / 以用户为先导)
description: 以潜在用户需求、使用场景、人体工程学与市场调研为导向的设计方法。先界定目标用户群与使用环境，再推导形态与功能，强调优先保证可用性、舒适性与直观体验，同时兼顾可制造性与实用性，并注重与用户的情感沟通。
text:
名称：User-centered / User-led Design (以人为本 / 以用户为先导)
描述：以潜在用户需求、使用场景、人体工程学与市场调研为导向的设计方法。先界定目标用户群与使用环境，再推导形态与功能，强调优先保证可用性、舒适性与直观体验，同时兼顾可制造性与实用性，并注重与用户的情感沟通。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crosswind Stability(横风稳定性)
description: Design focus on resisting side forces and yaw moments induced by cross-winds to maintain vehicle stability and controllability. 通过车身侧面造型、下盘通道与气动力布置降低横风引起的侧向力与偏航力矩波动。
text:
名称：Crosswind Stability(横风稳定性)
描述：Design focus on resisting side forces and yaw moments induced by cross-winds to maintain vehicle stability and controllability. 通过车身侧面造型、下盘通道与气动力布置降低横风引起的侧向力与偏航力矩波动。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomics (Human-Centered Design)
description: Design philosophy that prioritizes human factors and human-centered principles (ergonomics) to optimize occupant comfort, safety, usability and accessibility. Informed by anthropometrics, biomechanics, manikin validation, usability testing and simulation, it guides interior packaging, seating geometry, control placement, visibility, reach, adjustability and cognitive-load reduction to accommodate target population percentiles, minimize errors and reduce driver distraction.
text:
名称：Ergonomics (Human-Centered Design)
描述：Design philosophy that prioritizes human factors and human-centered principles (ergonomics) to optimize occupant comfort, safety, usability and accessibility. Informed by anthropometrics, biomechanics, manikin validation, usability testing and simulation, it guides interior packaging, seating geometry, control placement, visibility, reach, adjustability and cognitive-load reduction to accommodate target population percentiles, minimize errors and reduce driver distraction.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Energy Conservation
description: Prioritise reduced energy consumption and lower environmental impact across vehicle life-cycle (manufacturing, use, end-of-life).
text:
名称：Energy Conservation
描述：Prioritise reduced energy consumption and lower environmental impact across vehicle life-cycle (manufacturing, use, end-of-life).

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Front-Rear Connection (Cross Beams / Connected Front-Rear Units)
description: 结构上指连接大梁前后、横向布置的横梁，用于分担车身扭矩并承担来自悬架安装点的横向载荷；广义上亦可指轴间的液压或机械连接件或调节器的反馈装置，用于协调前后单元以维持车辆姿态。 / Structural cross beams connecting the front and rear of the mainframe that share torsional loads and carry lateral loads from suspension mounting points; more generally also denotes hydraulic or mechanical inter-axle links or regulator feedback systems used to coordinate front and rear units and maintain vehicle attitude.
text:
名称：Front-Rear Connection (Cross Beams / Connected Front-Rear Units)
描述：结构上指连接大梁前后、横向布置的横梁，用于分担车身扭矩并承担来自悬架安装点的横向载荷；广义上亦可指轴间的液压或机械连接件或调节器的反馈装置，用于协调前后单元以维持车辆姿态。 / Structural cross beams connecting the front and rear of the mainframe that share torsional loads and carry lateral loads from suspension mounting points; more generally also denotes hydraulic or mechanical inter-axle links or regulator feedback systems used to coordinate front and rear units and maintain vehicle attitude.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cost-efficient universal fit
description: 在成本约束下追求‘大多数人适配’的设计思路，潜在牺牲个体舒适性。
text:
名称：Cost-efficient universal fit
描述：在成本约束下追求‘大多数人适配’的设计思路，潜在牺牲个体舒适性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cab-forward (Forward Control)
description: A packaging/design approach where the A-pillar and passenger cell are moved forward relative to the front axle/bumper to maximize cabin volume within a short overall length. Also referred to as Forward Control or Cab-forward.
text:
名称：Cab-forward (Forward Control)
描述：A packaging/design approach where the A-pillar and passenger cell are moved forward relative to the front axle/bumper to maximize cabin volume within a short overall length. Also referred to as Forward Control or Cab-forward.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety-Informative Lighting
description: Must demonstrate safety benefits and comply or be petitioned for regulatory approval (e.g., FMVSS 108).
text:
名称：Safety-Informative Lighting
描述：Must demonstrate safety benefits and comply or be petitioned for regulatory approval (e.g., FMVSS 108).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 造型自由度增强（Design Freedom）
description: LED与光纤等固态光源体积小、布置灵活，赋予灯具外形与安装位置更多自由，减小内部空间约束，促进灯组多样化造型。
text:
名称：造型自由度增强（Design Freedom）
描述：LED与光纤等固态光源体积小、布置灵活，赋予灯具外形与安装位置更多自由，减小内部空间约束，促进灯组多样化造型。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Performance-oriented Packaging
description: Prioritizes dynamic balance, low polar moment and responsive handling by locating heavy powertrain elements close to the vehicle centre (mid/rear bias for sports cars).
text:
名称：Performance-oriented Packaging
描述：Prioritizes dynamic balance, low polar moment and responsive handling by locating heavy powertrain elements close to the vehicle centre (mid/rear bias for sports cars).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Safety-first (以安全为先)
description: A holistic design theme that prioritizes occupant protection and accident prevention across vehicle form, structure, systems and human–machine interaction. Emphasizes active safety (visible, reassuring ADAS and avoidance systems), passive safety (crash energy management, defined crush zones, reinforced survival cell and interior structural integration), containment of hazardous/high-energy components away from occupants (firewalls, isolation of batteries/fuel systems), and information/interaction design that minimizes driver distraction through legible displays, essential warnings and reduced eyes-off-road demands.
text:
名称：Safety-first (以安全为先)
描述：A holistic design theme that prioritizes occupant protection and accident prevention across vehicle form, structure, systems and human–machine interaction. Emphasizes active safety (visible, reassuring ADAS and avoidance systems), passive safety (crash energy management, defined crush zones, reinforced survival cell and interior structural integration), containment of hazardous/high-energy components away from occupants (firewalls, isolation of batteries/fuel systems), and information/interaction design that minimizes driver distraction through legible displays, essential warnings and reduced eyes-off-road demands.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Glare-minimizing Lighting Design
description: A lighting design theme that prioritizes driver comfort and minimization of discomfort glare from oncoming lamps through controlled intensity, beam shaping and adaptive control.
text:
名称：Glare-minimizing Lighting Design
描述：A lighting design theme that prioritizes driver comfort and minimization of discomfort glare from oncoming lamps through controlled intensity, beam shaping and adaptive control.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Economy
description: 低能耗、低运行成本的设计导向（燃油经济性、能耗低）
text:
名称：Economy
描述：低能耗、低运行成本的设计导向（燃油经济性、能耗低）

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Inclusive Readability Lighting
description: Design concept that prioritizes instrument and interface readability for a broad range of users, including those with color vision deficiencies and age-related visual decline. Achieved via hue selection (e.g., orangish-red accents), high-contrast combinations, adjustable intensity and color temperature, ergonomic controls for personalization, and adaptive lighting to maintain legibility across lighting conditions and user needs.
text:
名称：Inclusive Readability Lighting

Achieved via hue selection (e.g., orangish-red accents), high-contrast combinations, adjustable intensity and color temperature, ergonomic controls for personalization, and adaptive lighting to maintain legibility across lighting conditions and user needs.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visibility vs Aerodynamic Efficiency
description: Design theme balancing required driver visibility and packaging against aerodynamic targets. Involves optimizing glazing area, pillar geometry, roofline and packaging to meet sightline/visibility requirements while minimising drag and meeting aero performance goals.
text:
名称：Visibility vs Aerodynamic Efficiency
描述：Design theme balancing required driver visibility and packaging against aerodynamic targets. Involves optimizing glazing area, pillar geometry, roofline and packaging to meet sightline/visibility requirements while minimising drag and meeting aero performance goals.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Pedestrian-Friendly Frontend
description: Design of the vehicle front (fascia, hood and outer skin) to reduce pedestrian injury on impact. Combines rounded outer skin profiles and fascia/hood shaping to increase clearance over hard components, meet pedestrian head-impact legislation, and lower injury risk.
text:
名称：Pedestrian-Friendly Frontend
描述：Design of the vehicle front (fascia, hood and outer skin) to reduce pedestrian injury on impact. Combines rounded outer skin profiles and fascia/hood shaping to increase clearance over hard components, meet pedestrian head-impact legislation, and lower injury risk.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Rear Swing Doors
description: Paired rear doors designed to open individually or together; commonly used on commercial vehicles to provide side access.
text:
名称：Rear Swing Doors
描述：Paired rear doors designed to open individually or together; commonly used on commercial vehicles to provide side access.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Form-Technology Integration (造型与技术一体化)
description: 将技术约束（如气动、轻量化、制造工艺）转化为可识别的家族化造型特征。
text:
名称：Form-Technology Integration (造型与技术一体化)
描述：将技术约束（如气动、轻量化、制造工艺）转化为可识别的家族化造型特征。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Intuitive Interface
description: Design goal to make operation immediate and low-effort through layout, tactile cues and predictable behaviour.
text:
名称：Intuitive Interface
描述：Design goal to make operation immediate and low-effort through layout, tactile cues and predictable behaviour.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Rounded Full Front
description: 无论三厢或两厢，研究车型的车头造型都呈现出圆润、饱满的形态，弱化锐利拐角。
text:
名称：Rounded Full Front
描述：无论三厢或两厢，研究车型的车头造型都呈现出圆润、饱满的形态，弱化锐利拐角。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Load-Flexible Tailgate
description: Design concept emphasizing cargo flexibility: split tailgate with lift glass allows opening without cargo spillage, provides exterior seating and extends load floor.
text:
名称：Load-Flexible Tailgate
描述：Design concept emphasizing cargo flexibility: split tailgate with lift glass allows opening without cargo spillage, provides exterior seating and extends load floor.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 形态演变（Morphing）/ 抽象形态演进
description: 关注汽车外形随时代演变的整体逻辑：一方面强调在保留结构框架（如轴距、轮轨）前提下，通过改变表面形态与构造细节来实现现代化与功能适配的形态演变（Morphing）；另一方面强调从线、曲、面等抽象要素出发，认为设计变化多来源于对线条与曲面处理的演进，而非对具象物象的直接比附（抽象形态演进）。两者合并说明了汽车造型既有结构比例与姿态的宏观演化，也有基于线面处理的微观细节演进。
text:
名称：形态演变（Morphing）/ 抽象形态演进
描述：关注汽车外形随时代演变的整体逻辑：一方面强调在保留结构框架（如轴距、轮轨）前提下，通过改变表面形态与构造细节来实现现代化与功能适配的形态演变（Morphing）；另一方面强调从线、曲、面等抽象要素出发，认为设计变化多来源于对线条与曲面处理的演进，而非对具象物象的直接比附（抽象形态演进）。两者合并说明了汽车造型既有结构比例与姿态的宏观演化，也有基于线面处理的微观细节演进。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Personalized Diversity
description: Emphasizes configurability and segmentation of exterior and interior to meet diverse user preferences. 强调配置可选性与外观内饰的细分化，以满足多样化用户偏好。
text:
名称：Personalized Diversity

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Proportion(比例)
description: 车辆各部分之间的尺度关系（长、短、高、低、宽窄）及其与整体的协调或冲突，作为造型的核心引导理念。
text:
名称：Proportion(比例)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Proportional Design
description: An overarching aesthetic concept that defines vehicle proportions and visual balance through packaging and side elevation, benchmarking and sizing studies (proportion-led design), wheel/tire sizing that harmonizes with body proportions (proportional styling), and the use of specific numeric ratios (e.g., golden ratio 0.618, 1:√2, 1:√3, 1:2, 1:3) to guide visual harmony. While numeric ratios and proportional rules guide design, styling decisions may sometimes override purely functional choices. 一种贯穿整体造型的美学原则：通过整车包装与侧面比例确定基本视觉姿态（比例主导设计）、通过车轮/轮胎尺寸与车身比例的协调实现造型和谐（比例化造型），并运用黄金比例、整数比等数值比例（如0.618、1:√2、1:√3、1:2、1:3）来提升均衡感。尽管数值与比例为造型提供指导，但造型决策在个别情况下可能优先于纯功能性选择。

While numeric ratios and proportional rules guide design, styling decisions may sometimes override purely functional choices. 一种贯穿整体造型的美学原则：通过整车包装与侧面比例确定基本视觉姿态（比例主导设计）、通过车轮/轮胎尺寸与车身比例的协调实现造型和谐（比例化造型），并运用黄金比例、整数比等数值比例（如0.618、1:√2、1:√3、1:2、1:3）来提升均衡感。尽管数值与比例为造型提供指导，但造型决策在个别情况下可能优先于纯功能性选择。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

name: 截面线分析 (Sectional-line analysis)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 美学与空气动力学平衡 (Aerodynamic Integration)
description: 造型需要在视觉美学与风阻、下压力等空气动力学要求之间寻求平衡，通过轮廓与表面处理同时满足视觉美感与低风阻需求，影响整车轮廓与表面细节处理。 / The design seeks a balance between visual aesthetics and aerodynamic requirements such as drag and downforce, using contours and surface treatment to achieve both visual appeal and low aerodynamic resistance.
text:
名称：美学与空气动力学平衡 (Aerodynamic Integration)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomic / Occupant-Centric Packaging
description: Design theme prioritizing occupant space and ergonomics: uses occupant H-point and head-contour reference planes to drive door aperture, side glass, roof-rail and interior volume; emphasizes perceived spaciousness, adjustability, accessibility, safety and measurable interior clearances (legroom, headroom, seat positions), visibility and efficient interior packaging — applicable to maximizing usable cabin volume in compact footprints.
text:
名称：Ergonomic / Occupant-Centric Packaging

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Robustness (含鲁棒公差)
description: 结构和系统在预期及偏离工况下维持功能的能力，抵抗疲劳、过载和异常工况；在制造与装配层面，可通过采用更宽或更易实现的公差（Robust Tolerances）来提高良率并降低加工成本。
text:
名称：Robustness (含鲁棒公差)
描述：结构和系统在预期及偏离工况下维持功能的能力，抵抗疲劳、过载和异常工况；在制造与装配层面，可通过采用更宽或更易实现的公差（Robust Tolerances）来提高良率并降低加工成本。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: IconicDesign

text:

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Surface Articulation / 表面折线与灯光细节
description: 通过受控的表面折线、线条节奏与量感错落，以及光影过渡与独特的灯光结构，构建丰富的视觉层次与触感认知。该属性强调表面层次与节奏感（错落有致的外观）并结合灯组细节与光影处理，以表达力度、节奏与识别性。
text:
名称：Surface Articulation / 表面折线与灯光细节
描述：通过受控的表面折线、线条节奏与量感错落，以及光影过渡与独特的灯光结构，构建丰富的视觉层次与触感认知。该属性强调表面层次与节奏感（错落有致的外观）并结合灯组细节与光影处理，以表达力度、节奏与识别性。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Flexible Interior Configurability
description: Emphasize folding seats and adaptable storage systems to allow multiple occupant and cargo configurations.
text:
名称：Flexible Interior Configurability
描述：Emphasize folding seats and adaptable storage systems to allow multiple occupant and cargo configurations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 4x4 Utility / Jeep ethos / Prestige 4x4
description: 一种四驱美学，结合了粗犷实用的“Jeep”风格——强调越野能力、耐用性和简洁易维护的结构（起源于军用吉普）——以及“Prestige 4x4”的豪华化方向，加入高档用料、精致内外饰与更高的舒适性。豪华越野的典型代表由1970年问世的Range Rover推动普及。
text:
名称：4x4 Utility / Jeep ethos / Prestige 4x4
描述：一种四驱美学，结合了粗犷实用的“Jeep”风格——强调越野能力、耐用性和简洁易维护的结构（起源于军用吉普）——以及“Prestige 4x4”的豪华化方向，加入高档用料、精致内外饰与更高的舒适性。豪华越野的典型代表由1970年问世的Range Rover推动普及。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Two-box silhouette
description: Hatchback or MPV style where engine bay and cargo/roof volumes are combined into two main volumes.
text:
名称：Two-box silhouette
描述：Hatchback or MPV style where engine bay and cargo/roof volumes are combined into two main volumes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 空气动力学/速度追求
description: 为提高车速和效率，应降低迎风阻力与滚动阻力，通过车身几何与轮胎改进实现性能提升。
text:
名称：空气动力学/速度追求
描述：为提高车速和效率，应降低迎风阻力与滚动阻力，通过车身几何与轮胎改进实现性能提升。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Central Axis Symmetry
description: 以车辆中轴为核心的对称美学，通过可见与隐形轴线（bright axis / dark shaft）和特定比例（银比例）形成秩序感与庄重感。
text:
名称：Central Axis Symmetry
描述：以车辆中轴为核心的对称美学，通过可见与隐形轴线（bright axis / dark shaft）和特定比例（银比例）形成秩序感与庄重感。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Material Honesty
description: Emphasize truthful expression of material and structure in surfaces and details.
text:
名称：Material Honesty
描述：Emphasize truthful expression of material and structure in surfaces and details.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Van_UtilityFirst(厢式车/功能优先)
description: 以最大载人或载货功能为主、车厢宽大且全封闭，强调功能性与多用途，通常牺牲外观活力。
text:
名称：Van_UtilityFirst(厢式车/功能优先)
描述：以最大载人或载货功能为主、车厢宽大且全封闭，强调功能性与多用途，通常牺牲外观活力。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: OpenSkyExperience (开阔天窗体验)
description: 以天窗/全景顶带来开阔视野和生活方式体验为中心的设计主题。
text:
名称：OpenSkyExperience (开阔天窗体验)
描述：以天窗/全景顶带来开阔视野和生活方式体验为中心的设计主题。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Lean Production / JIT
description: Minimize waste and inventory, synchronize flow between design and manufacturing to improve throughput.
text:
名称：Lean Production / JIT
描述：Minimize waste and inventory, synchronize flow between design and manufacturing to improve throughput.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Intelligent Material Integration（智能材料整合）
description: 通过新材料（感知/响应/可变刚度等）将舒适性与人机交互功能融合到造型与触感中。
text:
名称：Intelligent Material Integration（智能材料整合）
描述：通过新材料（感知/响应/可变刚度等）将舒适性与人机交互功能融合到造型与触感中。

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: displayCapability
description: 后部灯组具备显示文字、符号或动态图形的能力，受分辨率、刷新率与像素光强影响。
text:
名称：displayCapability
描述：后部灯组具备显示文字、符号或动态图形的能力，受分辨率、刷新率与像素光强影响。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Human-centered Design (以人为本)
description: Design centered on human physiology, behavior and experience—emphasizing ergonomics, usability, comfort and adaptability to diverse users. Balances biological (ergonomics, behavior) and social (aesthetics, symbolism) aspects, unifying economy, applicability and beauty, and reduces cognitive and physical workload by considering information-processing limits and interaction patterns.
text:
名称：Human-centered Design (以人为本)
描述：Design centered on human physiology, behavior and experience—emphasizing ergonomics, usability, comfort and adaptability to diverse users. Balances biological (ergonomics, behavior) and social (aesthetics, symbolism) aspects, unifying economy, applicability and beauty, and reduces cognitive and physical workload by considering information-processing limits and interaction patterns.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Signal Legibility
description: 确保车辆信号在尾灯、制动灯和后转向灯之间无歧义，并能可靠传达车辆运动状态（减速、停止、变道等）。
text:
名称：Signal Legibility
描述：确保车辆信号在尾灯、制动灯和后转向灯之间无歧义，并能可靠传达车辆运动状态（减速、停止、变道等）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Functional product
description: Core functional design that delivers the basic product function (e.g., transport four adults); the inner core of the desirability ring model. "Functional Integration" is an alternative name referring to the same concept.
text:
名称：Functional product
描述：Core functional design that delivers the basic product function (e.g., transport four adults); the inner core of the desirability ring model. "Functional Integration" is an alternative name referring to the same concept.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 跨界混合车型创意
text:
名称：跨界混合车型创意
描述：——

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visual Quality
description: Overall perceived build quality of visible regions: tight/consistent gaps, flush mating surfaces, matched materials, defect-free finishes, concealed fasteners and controlled reflections to deliver a premium, well-crafted appearance.
text:
名称：Visual Quality
描述：Overall perceived build quality of visible regions: tight/consistent gaps, flush mating surfaces, matched materials, defect-free finishes, concealed fasteners and controlled reflections to deliver a premium, well-crafted appearance.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Packaging
description: Packaging is a core method for evaluating proportion quality and enabling design freedom.
text:
名称：Packaging
描述：Packaging is a core method for evaluating proportion quality and enabling design freedom.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Design for Manufacture (Design-to-Manufacture Integration / 设计驱动制造一体化)
description: A design philosophy and integrated development approach that embeds manufacturing constraints and considerations into the early stages of vehicle design, creating a unified design-to-manufacture workflow to improve manufacturability, reduce costs, simplify production, and enhance overall competitiveness. (将制造约束与考虑嵌入车辆设计的早期阶段，推动设计-制造一体化流程，以提升可制造性、降低成本、简化生产并增强竞争力。)
text:
名称：Design for Manufacture (Design-to-Manufacture Integration / 设计驱动制造一体化)
描述：A design philosophy and integrated development approach that embeds manufacturing constraints and considerations into the early stages of vehicle design, creating a unified design-to-manufacture workflow to improve manufacturability, reduce costs, simplify production, and enhance overall competitiveness. (将制造约束与考虑嵌入车辆设计的早期阶段，推动设计-制造一体化流程，以提升可制造性、降低成本、简化生产并增强竞争力。)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cab-forward / Maximize interior space
description: 通过驾驶舱前移、缩短发动机舱和加大挡风玻璃前倾角，在不增加外廓的前提下最大化车内可用体积——MPV形成的核心造型策略。
text:
名称：Cab-forward / Maximize interior space
描述：通过驾驶舱前移、缩短发动机舱和加大挡风玻璃前倾角，在不增加外廓的前提下最大化车内可用体积——MPV形成的核心造型策略。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Comfort and Accommodation
description: Prioritise occupant comfort and accommodation across body sizes by providing adjustable seating geometry and support; ensure vehicle geometry follows anthropometric percentiles and biomechanical limits (clearance, reach, comfort); and optimise ride softness and cabin acoustics (suspension and NVH solutions) to enhance perceived luxury without compromising packaging or design intent.
text:
名称：Comfort and Accommodation
描述：Prioritise occupant comfort and accommodation across body sizes by providing adjustable seating geometry and support; ensure vehicle geometry follows anthropometric percentiles and biomechanical limits (clearance, reach, comfort); and optimise ride softness and cabin acoustics (suspension and NVH solutions) to enhance perceived luxury without compromising packaging or design intent.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Three-door hatchback
description: Compact three-door configuration common in economy models (short rear overhang, upright greenhouse).
text:
名称：Three-door hatchback
描述：Compact three-door configuration common in economy models (short rear overhang, upright greenhouse).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Unique Indoor Environment
description: An interior-focused aesthetic that combines colors, materials and textures to create a distinctive, coherent in-cabin experience.
text:
名称：Unique Indoor Environment
描述：An interior-focused aesthetic that combines colors, materials and textures to create a distinctive, coherent in-cabin experience.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 多元化灯组-车身造型关系
description: 基于固态照明的灵活性，灯组与车身的结合形式呈多样化发展，包括延伸、贯穿、独立体量、穿插与镂空等。
text:
名称：多元化灯组-车身造型关系
描述：基于固态照明的灵活性，灯组与车身的结合形式呈多样化发展，包括延伸、贯穿、独立体量、穿插与镂空等。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Movilidad micro-económica (Isetta)
description: Diseño orientado a un vehículo extremadamente compacto y accesible.
text:
名称：Movilidad micro-económica (Isetta)
描述：Diseño orientado a un vehículo extremadamente compacto y accesible.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Packaging-oriented Utility
description: Prioritize maximising usable interior volume and flexible cargo/occupant configurations within regulatory and size limits.
text:
名称：Packaging-oriented Utility
描述：Prioritize maximising usable interior volume and flexible cargo/occupant configurations within regulatory and size limits.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Comfort-Oriented Design
description: Design priority for occupant comfort and disturbance isolation.
text:
名称：Comfort-Oriented Design
描述：Design priority for occupant comfort and disturbance isolation.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crossover混合概念车
description: 以某种底盘为基础，融合轿车、SUV、MPV等车型的布局、结构与造型元素，创造多功能、混合型的全新概念车，强调多途性与感官/功能的复合体验。
text:
名称：Crossover混合概念车
描述：以某种底盘为基础，融合轿车、SUV、MPV等车型的布局、结构与造型元素，创造多功能、混合型的全新概念车，强调多途性与感官/功能的复合体验。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Night Target Visibility & Legibility
description: Design concept prioritizing the detectability, recognizability and legibility of roadway targets (signs, markings, pedestrians) under low-light/night and varied lighting or weather conditions. Addresses human visual contrast-threshold requirements (e.g. Blackwell/Bhise models) and vehicle lighting optimization — including headlamp performance, beam aim and distribution — while minimizing glare to oncoming road users to support safe target detection and recognition.
text:
名称：Night Target Visibility & Legibility
描述：Design concept prioritizing the detectability, recognizability and legibility of roadway targets (signs, markings, pedestrians) under low-light/night and varied lighting or weather conditions. Addresses human visual contrast-threshold requirements (e.g. Blackwell/Bhise models) and vehicle lighting optimization — including headlamp performance, beam aim and distribution — while minimizing glare to oncoming road users to support safe target detection and recognition.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: ReachEnvelopeAndControlAccess
description: 可触及性与操作界面布局，保证不同体型驾驶者在功能姿态下能安全操作控制装置。
text:
名称：ReachEnvelopeAndControlAccess
描述：可触及性与操作界面布局，保证不同体型驾驶者在功能姿态下能安全操作控制装置。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Integrated Body Electronics
description: Design theme focusing on seamless electronic integration in the passenger compartment to improve perceived quality and usability.
text:
名称：Integrated Body Electronics
描述：Design theme focusing on seamless electronic integration in the passenger compartment to improve perceived quality and usability.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Fuel Efficiency, Cost and Environmental Impact
description: Design priority driven by consumers and policy to reduce fuel consumption and associated emissions, while emphasizing lifecycle cost, fuel consumption and emissions compliance. This trend may encourage adoption of hybrid and electric solutions.
text:
名称：Fuel Efficiency, Cost and Environmental Impact
描述：Design priority driven by consumers and policy to reduce fuel consumption and associated emissions, while emphasizing lifecycle cost, fuel consumption and emissions compliance. This trend may encourage adoption of hybrid and electric solutions.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Cargo-centric Electric Utility
description: Design oriented to maximize cargo volume and accessibility while packaging an electric powertrain (motor, batteries, controllers).
text:
名称：Cargo-centric Electric Utility
描述：Design oriented to maximize cargo volume and accessibility while packaging an electric powertrain (motor, batteries, controllers).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Occupant Protection Emphasis
description: Prioritize rollover and side-impact protection through an oversized greenhouse, tall sill and composite body structure to improve crashworthiness.
text:
名称：Occupant Protection Emphasis
描述：Prioritize rollover and side-impact protection through an oversized greenhouse, tall sill and composite body structure to improve crashworthiness.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Nighttime Usability
description: Ensure safe use at night via effective headlighting, illuminated graphics, and interior/readability considerations.
text:
名称：Nighttime Usability
描述：Ensure safe use at night via effective headlighting, illuminated graphics, and interior/readability considerations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 运动户外化
description: 以户外运动载具与社群认同为核心的外观与功能策略
text:
名称：运动户外化
描述：以户外运动载具与社群认同为核心的外观与功能策略

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Feasible Conventionalism
description: Design theme prioritizing conventional packaging (rear-engine, side-by-side seating), engineering feasibility, low weight and controlled cost — chosen as primary aesthetic/engineering driver for development.
text:
名称：Feasible Conventionalism
描述：Design theme prioritizing conventional packaging (rear-engine, side-by-side seating), engineering feasibility, low weight and controlled cost — chosen as primary aesthetic/engineering driver for development.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: 轮胎低滚阻结构
description: 通过改进轮胎材料与结构减少与地面之间的滚动阻力，提升车速与燃油效率。
text:
名称：轮胎低滚阻结构
描述：通过改进轮胎材料与结构减少与地面之间的滚动阻力，提升车速与燃油效率。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 线形表达反映品牌形象
description: 通过车身线条（腰线、棱线、截面曲线）表达品牌核心价值与市场定位（如经典/运动/富贵/成功）。
text:
名称：线形表达反映品牌形象
描述：通过车身线条（腰线、棱线、截面曲线）表达品牌核心价值与市场定位（如经典/运动/富贵/成功）。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: HoodVisibility
description: Drivers' desire to see the end of the hood, vehicle corners and the near road (ground intercept) to improve lane keeping, parking and perceived vehicle heading.
text:
名称：HoodVisibility
描述：Drivers' desire to see the end of the hood, vehicle corners and the near road (ground intercept) to improve lane keeping, parking and perceived vehicle heading.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Hybrid Performance
description: 融合高功率内燃机与电动驱动，强调高性能、瞬时响应和能量回收以提升赛道与公路表现。
text:
名称：Hybrid Performance
描述：融合高功率内燃机与电动驱动，强调高性能、瞬时响应和能量回收以提升赛道与公路表现。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Historic Innovation & Identity (历史创新与可识别性)
description: 在保证气动优化的前提下，保留或创造能被识别的家族化造型特征。
text:
名称：Historic Innovation & Identity (历史创新与可识别性)
描述：在保证气动优化的前提下，保留或创造能被识别的家族化造型特征。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Mass-production practicality (大规模生产实用性)
description: 以降低成本、设计标准化与装配线制造为核心的美学与工程集合，关注可规模化生产的设计、工艺与经济性，典型历史案例为福特T型车。
text:
名称：Mass-production practicality (大规模生产实用性)
描述：以降低成本、设计标准化与装配线制造为核心的美学与工程集合，关注可规模化生产的设计、工艺与经济性，典型历史案例为福特T型车。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Classic Long-hood Proportion
description: 长前悬/长引擎舱与相对紧凑乘员舱形成优雅而动感的比例，是许多战后GT车家族的核心语言。
text:
名称：Classic Long-hood Proportion
描述：长前悬/长引擎舱与相对紧凑乘员舱形成优雅而动感的比例，是许多战后GT车家族的核心语言。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crossoverization of compact sedans（紧凑型家轿的Crossover化）
description: 将紧凑级家轿结合SUV/Crossover特征，强调运动感、多功能与略高离地间隙
text:
名称：Crossoverization of compact sedans（紧凑型家轿的Crossover化）
描述：将紧凑级家轿结合SUV/Crossover特征，强调运动感、多功能与略高离地间隙

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Hard Suspension (Suspensión dura)
description: Firm spring and damper setup producing sharp responses and limited compliance.
text:
名称：Hard Suspension (Suspensión dura)
描述：Firm spring and damper setup producing sharp responses and limited compliance.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: StandardInterfaces
description: Use of standardized mechanical, electrical and software interfaces to enable interchangeability and supplier integration.
text:
名称：StandardInterfaces
描述：Use of standardized mechanical, electrical and software interfaces to enable interchangeability and supplier integration.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Dynamic Rear Communication
description: 利用可编程/可变照明形成文字或符号显示，以向后方驾驶员传达车辆状态或警示信息。
text:
名称：Dynamic Rear Communication
描述：利用可编程/可变照明形成文字或符号显示，以向后方驾驶员传达车辆状态或警示信息。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Compact Packaging
description: Efficient use of vehicle volume to minimize exterior dimensions while maximizing interior space and functionality. Design philosophy that prioritizes maximal interior and functional volume within minimal exterior dimensions (historically exemplified by Issigonis/Mini). Implementation strategies include compact front powertrain packaging, cab‑forward layouts, short front overhangs, or relocating propulsion rearward for microcars to increase usable cabin space.
text:
名称：Compact Packaging
描述：Efficient use of vehicle volume to minimize exterior dimensions while maximizing interior space and functionality. Design philosophy that prioritizes maximal interior and functional volume within minimal exterior dimensions (historically exemplified by Issigonis/Mini). Implementation strategies include compact front powertrain packaging, cab‑forward layouts, short front overhangs, or relocating propulsion rearward for microcars to increase usable cabin space.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Value Tech Expectation
description: Design concept that reconciles affordability with rich technology content to meet modern customer expectations.
text:
名称：Value Tech Expectation
描述：Design concept that reconciles affordability with rich technology content to meet modern customer expectations.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: NeighborhoodElectricFriendly
description: Design concept that aligns vehicle characteristics with NEV regulations and local low-speed neighborhood mobility needs.
text:
名称：NeighborhoodElectricFriendly
描述：Design concept that aligns vehicle characteristics with NEV regulations and local low-speed neighborhood mobility needs.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: AffordabilityForMassMarket
description: 通过降低制造成本和简化设计，将汽车置于中产家庭可购买的价位，推动大规模消费。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

description: 强调在少数关键设计点上追求创新的深度，而非广泛但浅层的创新项，避免感觉被稀释。

Uses adhesive bonding together with spot welds to join aluminium parts, improving joint stiffness and enabling mass optimization. Spot weld process parameters — including electrode force, weld schedule and monitoring — determine joint quality and fatigue life; these are managed alongside adhesive selection and application to optimize overall joint performance.

description: Offer diverse stylistic directions (sport, luxury, minimalist, avant-garde) to meet segmented consumer tastes.
text:
名称：Individualized Aesthetic Styles
描述：Offer diverse stylistic directions (sport, luxury, minimalist, avant-garde) to meet segmented consumer tastes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Prototyping Strategy (Rapid Prototyping Integration & Flexible-Format Prototyping)
description: 将快速成型与制造技术整合到设计循环中，作为并行工程与设计验证的组成部分；同时基于阶段所需的保真度、预算与沟通目标，务实地选择原型呈现格式（如视频、分镜、2D草图、3D模型等），以提高沟通效率与迭代速度。
text:
名称：Prototyping Strategy (Rapid Prototyping Integration & Flexible-Format Prototyping)
描述：将快速成型与制造技术整合到设计循环中，作为并行工程与设计验证的组成部分；同时基于阶段所需的保真度、预算与沟通目标，务实地选择原型呈现格式（如视频、分镜、2D草图、3D模型等），以提高沟通效率与迭代速度。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Comfort and Quiet Cruising
description: Deliver comfortable ride and low cabin noise at sustained cruise speeds (noted silence at 130 km/h).
text:
名称：Comfort and Quiet Cruising
描述：Deliver comfortable ride and low cabin noise at sustained cruise speeds (noted silence at 130 km/h).

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 灯具作为闪光点
description: 市场和用户越来越偏好在协调的大前提下，灯具能提供明确的品牌识别符号和情感触点。
text:
名称：灯具作为闪光点
描述：市场和用户越来越偏好在协调的大前提下，灯具能提供明确的品牌识别符号和情感触点。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Findability and Location
description: See above.
text:
名称：Findability and Location
描述：See above.

名称：CameraMonocularView
描述：Single-camera external view provided on internal displays; delivers monocular information lacking binocular depth cues.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Harmony across systems
description: Unify appearance and operational feel of systems and subsystems (e.g., radio and climate controls) so they read as designed by the same language while allowing discriminative differences to reduce user errors.
text:
名称：Harmony across systems
描述：Unify appearance and operational feel of systems and subsystems (e.g., radio and climate controls) so they read as designed by the same language while allowing discriminative differences to reduce user errors.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Transitional Hybridization
description: A hybrid design strategy that mixes internal combustion engines (ICE) and electric motors as a stepping-stone toward all‑electric powertrains—prioritizes long range and fuel efficiency while allowing smaller ICEs through electric torque assist.
text:
名称：Transitional Hybridization
描述：A hybrid design strategy that mixes internal combustion engines (ICE) and electric motors as a stepping-stone toward all‑electric powertrains—prioritizes long range and fuel efficiency while allowing smaller ICEs through electric torque assist.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Ergonomics (人体工程学 / 以人为本的人体工学)
description: 以人为中心的设计理念，强调驾驶员与乘员及车辆之间的最佳契合，包括座椅位置、控制布局、舒适性与可达性，旨在提升安全、舒适、便利、性能与效率。 / Design philosophy centered on people that emphasizes optimal fit between driver/passengers and the vehicle — including seating positions, control layout, comfort and accessibility — to improve safety, comfort, convenience, performance and efficiency.
text:
名称：Ergonomics (人体工程学 / 以人为本的人体工学)
描述：以人为中心的设计理念，强调驾驶员与乘员及车辆之间的最佳契合，包括座椅位置、控制布局、舒适性与可达性，旨在提升安全、舒适、便利、性能与效率。 / Design philosophy centered on people that emphasizes optimal fit between driver/passengers and the vehicle — including seating positions, control layout, comfort and accessibility — to improve safety, comfort, convenience, performance and efficiency.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 品牌导向前脸
description: 通过前脸格栅/进气口造型塑造品牌识别度与审美价值，同时兼顾车型特征与气动/散热需求。
text:
名称：品牌导向前脸
描述：通过前脸格栅/进气口造型塑造品牌识别度与审美价值，同时兼顾车型特征与气动/散热需求。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Economy & Accessibility
description: Post-war design priority to produce modern, affordable, reliable cars for an impoverished population; emphasizes low cost, small size, ease of maintenance and high production volumes.
text:
名称：Economy & Accessibility
描述：Post-war design priority to produce modern, affordable, reliable cars for an impoverished population; emphasizes low cost, small size, ease of maintenance and high production volumes.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Downward visibility
description: Aesthetic/functional priority to maximize driver's ability to see near-field and the road immediately ahead and the vehicle edges, influencing hood height and cowl geometry.
text:
名称：Downward visibility
描述：Aesthetic/functional priority to maximize driver's ability to see near-field and the road immediately ahead and the vehicle edges, influencing hood height and cowl geometry.

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Visibility-First Ergonomics / Ergonomic Field-of-View Analysis
description: 将可见性优先的设计原则与视域工效学分析方法结合的一般性概念：在布置仪表与控制件时优先保证前方视野不受遮挡并尽量减少查视分散，同时采用极坐标（polar-plot）方法将三维可视性问题降维为二维角度图，以便直接量测角尺寸、位置及所需的眼/头运动。
text:
名称：Visibility-First Ergonomics / Ergonomic Field-of-View Analysis
描述：将可见性优先的设计原则与视域工效学分析方法结合的一般性概念：在布置仪表与控制件时优先保证前方视野不受遮挡并尽量减少查视分散，同时采用极坐标（polar-plot）方法将三维可视性问题降维为二维角度图，以便直接量测角尺寸、位置及所需的眼/头运动。

name: Visibility-Optimized Cabin(可视性优先驾驶舱)
description: 以最大化不同体型驾驶员，尤其是高个驾驶员的外部可视性为主导的设计主题，强调上窗区清晰、镜面视场增大、B柱遮挡最小化与座椅调节范围扩展。
text:

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)

text:
名称：安全性

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Driver-Centric Visibility
description: A vehicle design principle that prioritizes unobstructed, measurable driver sight-lines and perceptual clarity to support detection of external targets and safe operation across diverse users. It encompasses exterior and glazing geometry, greenhouse packaging, eye point location, and mirror systems; addresses quantifiable angular fields of view and percentile seating (e.g., 5th to 95th) requirements; and manages glazing light transmissivity, contrast and regulatory tint limits to balance visibility, safety and regulatory compliance. / 一种以驾驶者为中心的设计原则，优先保证可测量的无阻视线与感知清晰度，支持不同驾驶者（如5th至95th百分位）在各种交通情境下的目标识别与安全操作。涵盖外形与玻璃几何、车舱布局、视点定位及镜面系统；强调可量化的视角范围，并通过管理玻璃透光率、对比度和法规允许的着色限值在能见度与合规性之间取得平衡。
text:
名称：Driver-Centric Visibility
描述：A vehicle design principle that prioritizes unobstructed, measurable driver sight-lines and perceptual clarity to support detection of external targets and safe operation across diverse users. It encompasses exterior and glazing geometry, greenhouse packaging, eye point location, and mirror systems; addresses quantifiable angular fields of view and percentile seating (e.g., 5th to 95th) requirements; and manages glazing light transmissivity, contrast and regulatory tint limits to balance visibility, safety and regulatory compliance. / 一种以驾驶者为中心的设计原则，优先保证可测量的无阻视线与感知清晰度，支持不同驾驶者（如5th至95th百分位）在各种交通情境下的目标识别与安全操作。涵盖外形与玻璃几何、车舱布局、视点定位及镜面系统；强调可量化的视角范围，并通过管理玻璃透光率、对比度和法规允许的着色限值在能见度与合规性之间取得平衡。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 创新与创造性 (Innovation & Creativity)

text:
名称：创新与创造性 (Innovation & Creativity)

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: Crossover (混合跨界概念)
description: 将轿车、SUV、旅行车及MPV等不同车型的功能与美学特征融合，形成既具生活方式属性又具道路通用性的视觉语言。强调多功能性与生活方式适应性，通过差异化设计在竞争车型中脱颖而出，同时兼顾操控、经济性与舒适性，塑造创新性的形象。
text:
名称：Crossover (混合跨界概念)
描述：将轿车、SUV、旅行车及MPV等不同车型的功能与美学特征融合，形成既具生活方式属性又具道路通用性的视觉语言。强调多功能性与生活方式适应性，通过差异化设计在竞争车型中脱颖而出，同时兼顾操控、经济性与舒适性，塑造创新性的形象。

label: AestheticConcept(美学概念)
name: 沉浸式交互体验

Achieved via streamlined silhouette, smooth underbody, roofline shaping, rear tapering, minimized frontal interruptions, active shutters and integrated/hidden details (e.g., sensors). Also considers packaging trade-offs such as headroom and visibility while preserving premium appearance. 通过平滑的车顶线条、下护板与车身流线、最小化前端扰动、主动格栅/百叶和隐蔽式细节整合来降低风阻，典型目标风阻系数约0.25，兼顾能耗效率、续航与空间包装/豪华感。

description: Suspension linkage/instant-center geometry and mounting points used to resist vehicle pitch under acceleration (anti-squat) — applicable only to driven axles.

label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
name: Underbody Aerodynamics / Smooth Underbody
description: Design measures and physical implementations to smooth and control under-vehicle airflow — smooth undertray/panels, diffusers, sealed seams, side skirts and tight exterior tolerances — to reduce aerodynamic drag, manage wake and recover pressure, and where appropriate generate downforce. Typical implementations include flat underbody panels, diffusers (shaped under-rear geometry, e.g. diffuser angle ~15°), sealed seams and minimized gaps. Packaging, cooling and vehicle integration constraints must be considered.
text:
名称：Underbody Aerodynamics / Smooth Underbody
描述：Design measures and physical implementations to smooth and control under-vehicle airflow — smooth undertray/panels, diffusers, sealed seams, side skirts and tight exterior tolerances — to reduce aerodynamic drag, manage wake and recover pressure, and where appropriate generate downforce. Typical implementations include flat underbody panels, diffusers (shaped under-rear geometry, e.g. diffuser angle ~15°), sealed seams and minimized gaps. Packaging, cooling and vehicle integration constraints must be considered.
